products.name: shelf_life_spec
products.description: Shelf life and storage condition specifications for each SKU, critical for FSMA 204 traceability compliance and retailer receiving standards. Captures total shelf life (days), minimum remaining shelf life at shipment (MRSL), best-by date calculation method (manufacture date + offset vs. fixed calendar), storage temperature range (min/max °C), humidity requirements, light sensitivity, FIFO/FEFO rotation rule, consumer-facing date format (Best By, Use By, Sell By), open-dating regulation compliance (state-level US, EU 1169/2011), and shelf life testing protocol reference. Governs FEFO inventory rotation, DC receiving standards, retailer compliance (e.g., Walmart 2/3 life remaining policy), and cold chain integrity requirements.

attributes.name: shelf_life_spec_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shelf life specification record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Captures employee approving shelf life spec, used in quality assurance and compliance audits.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU this shelf life specification applies to. Links to the product SKU master data.

attributes.name: accelerated_testing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shelf life was determined using accelerated shelf life testing methods rather than real-time aging studies.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this shelf life specification was formally approved by quality assurance.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether uninterrupted cold chain (refrigerated or frozen) is required from production through distribution to maintain shelf life and safety.

attributes.name: consumer_date_format
attributes.description: Format pattern for the consumer-facing date label (e.g., MM/DD/YYYY, DD-MMM-YYYY). Must comply with regional open-dating regulations.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide, EU Regulation 1169/2011

attributes.name: consumer_date_label_type
attributes.description: Type of date label printed on consumer packaging. Best By indicates peak quality date, Use By indicates safety date, Sell By is for retailer inventory management, Expires On indicates absolute expiration.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide, USDA Food Product Dating Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shelf life specification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: date_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the best-by or use-by date. Manufacture_plus_offset adds shelf life days to manufacture date, fixed_calendar uses a predetermined calendar date, batch_specific requires manual entry per batch.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide, Internal Quality Management System (QMS) Standard

attributes.name: dc_receiving_standard
attributes.description: Specific receiving standard or policy that distribution centers must enforce when accepting this product (e.g., minimum remaining shelf life percentage, temperature verification requirements).
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain Standards, Retailer Compliance Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this shelf life specification becomes effective and must be applied to production batches.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this shelf life specification is no longer valid. Null for specifications with no planned end date.

attributes.name: frozen_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Shelf life in days when product is stored in frozen conditions. Null if product is not suitable for freezing.
attributes.references: USDA Food Product Dating Guidance, Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Guidelines

attributes.name: fsma_204_traceability_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) 204 Traceability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is subject to FSMA 204 enhanced traceability requirements for foods on the Food Traceability List.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of this shelf life specification. Specifications should be reviewed regularly to ensure continued validity.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Management System (QMS) Standard, ISO 9001

attributes.name: light_sensitivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is sensitive to light exposure and requires storage in dark or light-protected conditions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shelf life specification record was last modified.

attributes.name: mrsl_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Remaining Shelf Life (MRSL) at Shipment (Days)
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required at the time of shipment to customers or distribution centers. Used to enforce retailer receiving standards (e.g., Walmart 2/3 life remaining policy).
attributes.references: Retailer Compliance Standards, FSMA 204 Traceability Rule

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next periodic review of this shelf life specification is scheduled.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Management System (QMS) Standard, ISO 9001

attributes.name: open_dating_regulation
attributes.description: Reference to the specific open-dating regulation that governs date labeling for this product (e.g., state-level US requirements, EU 1169/2011 Article 9). May vary by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide, EU Regulation 1169/2011, State-Level Food Labeling Laws

attributes.name: post_opening_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product remains safe and of acceptable quality after the package is opened by the consumer. Null if not applicable or if product is single-serve.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide, EU Regulation 1169/2011

attributes.name: quality_hold_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiration at which inventory should be placed on quality hold for review or disposition. Used to prevent shipment of short-dated product.

attributes.name: retailer_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting specific retailer requirements or compliance considerations (e.g., Walmart 2/3 life remaining policy, Target temperature monitoring requirements).

attributes.name: rotation_rule
attributes.description: Inventory rotation method to be applied. FIFO (First In First Out) rotates by receipt date, FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotates by expiration date, LIFO (Last In First Out) is rarely used in food and beverage.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Guidelines, Warehouse Management Best Practices

attributes.name: shelf_life_spec_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shelf life specification. Draft specifications are under development, active specifications are in use, superseded specifications have been replaced by newer versions, and obsolete specifications are no longer valid.

attributes.name: shelf_life_testing_protocol
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory testing protocol or study used to establish the shelf life specification. Links to quality assurance documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Quality Management System (QMS) Standard, Safe Quality Food (SQF) Code

attributes.name: specification_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the shelf life specification, typically used in quality management and PLM systems.

attributes.name: specification_version
attributes.description: Version number of this shelf life specification, incremented when specification parameters change.

attributes.name: storage_humidity_max_percent
attributes.description: Maximum relative humidity percentage allowed during storage to prevent product degradation. Null if humidity control is not required.

attributes.name: storage_humidity_min_percent
attributes.description: Minimum relative humidity percentage required during storage to prevent product degradation. Null if humidity control is not required.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain product quality and safety throughout shelf life. Exceeding this temperature may compromise product integrity.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Guidelines, HACCP Principles

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain product quality and safety throughout shelf life. Critical for cold chain integrity.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Guidelines, HACCP Principles

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_tolerance_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours the product can tolerate temperature excursions outside the specified range without compromising safety or quality. Null if no tolerance is allowed.
attributes.references: HACCP Principles, Cold Chain Management Best Practices

attributes.name: total_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total number of days from manufacture date to end of shelf life (best-by or use-by date). Critical for FEFO inventory rotation and retailer compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide, FSMA 204 Traceability Rule

products.name: npd_project
products.description: New Product Development (NPD) project record tracking each innovation or renovation initiative from concept through commercialization. Captures project code, project name, project type (new SKU, line extension, reformulation, repack, cost reduction, seasonal limited edition, co-brand), target launch date, actual launch date, project sponsor, R&D lead, marketing lead, estimated COGS target, RSP target, target distribution channel, target market/geography, project status, gate review history, and estimated incremental revenue. Links to the resulting SKU(s) upon commercialization. Also governs reformulation requests including estimated COGS impact, regulatory review requirements, and consumer testing needs. Sourced from PLM system.

products.name: lifecycle_event
products.description: Transactional record of each significant lifecycle state change for a SKU — launch, reformulation, repack, label change, temporary discontinuation, permanent discontinuation, reactivation, seasonal rotation, or regulatory hold. Captures event type, event date, triggering reason (regulatory change, cost reduction, consumer complaint, market exit, retailer delisting), responsible business unit, approval reference, prior/new attribute values changed, and downstream notification status. Provides full audit trail of SKU history for regulatory inquiries (FDA recall traceability), quality investigations, commercial portfolio reviews, and SOX compliance evidence.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Change Documents

attributes.name: lifecycle_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lifecycle_event

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Launch event coordination requires linking each lifecycle event to the marketing campaign that supports it, enabling the Launch Calendar report.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Lifecycle events (e.g., GTIN change) trigger regulatory notifications; linking to product registration ensures updates are recorded and reported.

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Identifies employee responsible for lifecycle event, required for change impact and regulatory notification reports.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the SKU master data product. Identifies which finished good this lifecycle event applies to.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lifecycle event was formally approved by the appropriate governance body (e.g., product committee, quality board, regulatory affairs). Used for compliance audit and SOX evidence.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, SOX Compliance Framework

attributes.name: approval_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the formal approval document, change request, or workflow instance that authorized this lifecycle event. Links to PLM, quality management, or regulatory systems for traceability.
attributes.references: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Standard, ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, lessons learned, or cross-references to related events. Used for knowledge capture and future portfolio reviews.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this lifecycle event record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which customer notification was completed (e.g., EDI 832 Price/Sales Catalog sent, ASN updated, or direct communication sent). Null if notification is not required or still pending.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standard, Trade Partner Agreement Standard

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this lifecycle event requires formal notification to retail customers, distributors, or foodservice partners. True for discontinuations, allergen changes, or major repacks.

attributes.name: customer_notification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer notification process for this lifecycle event. Tracks whether downstream partners (retailers, distributors, 3PLs) have been informed of the change.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date until which the prior product state remains valid or the date by which old inventory must be depleted. Null for permanent changes with no transition period. Used for sell-through planning and recall traceability.
attributes.references: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Standard, FIFO/FEFO Inventory Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the new product state (post-event) is effective in the market, distribution network, or production system. Used for cutover planning and inventory management (FEFO/FIFO).

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the lifecycle state change became effective in the market or production system. This is the business event date, distinct from system audit timestamps.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the lifecycle event, used for cross-functional communication and audit trail references. Format: LCE-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the lifecycle event was recorded in the system, including timezone. Used for detailed audit trail and event sequencing.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lifecycle state change. Defines the nature of the transition: launch (new product introduction), reformulation (recipe or ingredient change), repack (packaging change without formula change), label_change (artwork or claims update), temporary_discontinuation (planned pause), permanent_discontinuation (end of life), reactivation (return from discontinuation), seasonal_rotation (planned seasonal availability change), regulatory_hold (compliance-driven suspension), specification_change (non-formula attribute update). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: launch|reformulation|repack|label_change|temporary_discontinuation|permanent_discontinuation|reactivation|seasonal_rotation|regulatory_hold|specification_change — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: financial_impact_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of this lifecycle event in the company's reporting currency. Positive for cost savings or revenue opportunities; negative for write-offs, obsolescence, or lost sales. Used for portfolio management and business case validation.

attributes.name: impact_assessment_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether a formal cross-functional impact assessment (covering quality, supply chain, finance, regulatory, and commercial) was completed before this lifecycle event was approved.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Standard

attributes.name: impact_assessment_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the impact assessment document or workflow instance. Links to PLM or quality management system for detailed analysis and stakeholder sign-offs.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Standard

attributes.name: inventory_write_off_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this lifecycle event triggers an inventory write-off or obsolescence charge. True for permanent discontinuations, regulatory holds, or major reformulations requiring disposal of existing stock.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Accounting Standard, GAAP/IFRS Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this lifecycle event record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: new_allergen_matrix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured representation of allergens declared for the SKU after this lifecycle event. Used to track allergen additions, removals, or cross-contamination risk changes.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA), FSMA

attributes.name: new_gtin
attributes.description: The 14-digit GTIN assigned to the SKU after this lifecycle event. Used when a material change (formula, packaging, allergen) requires a new GTIN per GS1 standards.

attributes.name: new_plm_stage
attributes.description: The PLM stage or product status that the SKU transitioned to as a result of this lifecycle event. Captures the 'to' state in the state transition.

attributes.name: new_product_name
attributes.description: The consumer-facing product name or description that became effective after this lifecycle event. Used for rebranding, label updates, or marketing claim changes.

attributes.name: new_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days of shelf life assigned to the SKU after this lifecycle event. Used when reformulation, packaging change, or preservative adjustment impacts product stability.

attributes.name: new_upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit UPC assigned to the SKU after this lifecycle event. Used when packaging or product changes require a new UPC.

attributes.name: prior_allergen_matrix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured representation of allergens (e.g., milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, wheat, fish, shellfish) that were declared for the SKU before this lifecycle event. Critical for reformulation and regulatory hold events.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA), FSMA

attributes.name: prior_gtin
attributes.description: The 14-digit GTIN that was assigned to the SKU before this lifecycle event. Captured for repack, label change, or reformulation events where GTIN may change per GS1 standards.

attributes.name: prior_plm_stage
attributes.description: The PLM stage or product status that the SKU was in immediately before this lifecycle event occurred. Captures the 'from' state in the state transition for historical analysis.

attributes.name: prior_product_name
attributes.description: The consumer-facing product name or description that was in use before this lifecycle event. Captured for label change, reformulation, or rebranding events.

attributes.name: prior_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days of shelf life that was assigned to the SKU before this lifecycle event. Captured for reformulation or specification change events that impact product stability.

attributes.name: prior_upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit UPC that was assigned to the SKU before this lifecycle event. Captured for North American market SKUs undergoing repack or label changes.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority was formally notified of this lifecycle event. Null if no notification was required. Used for compliance audit and FSMA traceability.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or confirmation code received from the regulatory authority upon notification submission. Used for audit trail and compliance evidence.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this lifecycle event requires formal notification to regulatory authorities (FDA, USDA, EFSA, etc.). True for events impacting food safety, allergens, or nutritional claims.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA, USDA FSIS, EFSA Regulation (EC) No 178/2002

attributes.name: responsible_business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit, division, or brand team that owns and initiated this lifecycle event. Used for accountability, reporting hierarchy, and cross-functional coordination.

attributes.name: supply_chain_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which internal supply chain systems (ERP, WMS, MES) were updated and stakeholders notified of the lifecycle event. Used for operational readiness tracking.

attributes.name: supply_chain_notification_status
attributes.description: Current status of internal supply chain notification for this lifecycle event. Tracks whether manufacturing, distribution centers, and logistics partners have been informed and systems updated.

attributes.name: triggering_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the primary business driver or root cause that initiated this lifecycle event. Used for trend analysis, portfolio management, and regulatory inquiries. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regulatory_change|cost_reduction|consumer_complaint|market_exit|retailer_delisting|quality_issue|supply_disruption|strategic_portfolio_review|innovation_pipeline|seasonal_demand|competitive_response|sustainability_initiative|allergen_management|nutrition_improvement|packaging_optimization|end_of_contract|low_sales_volume|manufacturing_constraint|ingredient_availability|merger_acquisition|brand_rationalization|channel_strategy — 22 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: triggering_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text detailed explanation of the specific circumstances, business context, or regulatory requirement that triggered this lifecycle event. Provides narrative detail beyond the standardized reason code.

products.name: label_spec
products.description: Label specification and artwork management record for each SKU per market/jurisdiction. Captures label version, label type (front panel, back panel, neck label, cap label, case label), regulatory jurisdiction, language, label dimensions, mandatory claim text, marketing claims (clean label, non-GMO, organic, kosher, halal), warning statements, country of origin declaration, net quantity statement, manufacturer/distributor name and address, and artwork approval status. Tracks FDA/USDA/EFSA label compliance.

attributes.name: label_spec_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the label specification record. Primary key for the label specification entity.

attributes.name: artwork_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Artwork Approved By Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Links artwork approval to employee for GMP and brand compliance reporting.

attributes.name: label_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.label_approval. Business justification: Label approval workflow mandates linking each label spec to its approved label record to ensure regulatory compliance before printing.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU for which this label specification applies. Links label artwork and compliance requirements to the specific product variant.

attributes.name: adhesive_type
attributes.description: Type of adhesive used on the label. Critical for packaging line performance and consumer experience, especially for refrigerated or frozen products.

attributes.name: allergen_warning_text
attributes.description: Mandatory allergen declaration text listing major food allergens present in the product or manufacturing facility. Required by FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) and FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act).
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA 21 CFR 101.22, FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act)

attributes.name: artwork_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the label artwork received final approval and was released for production use.

attributes.name: artwork_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the label artwork in the PLM workflow. Tracks progression through legal, regulatory, and quality reviews before production release. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_review|legal_review|regulatory_review|approved|rejected|obsolete — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Approval Workflow Standard

attributes.name: artwork_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or URI to the approved digital artwork file for this label specification. Used by printing vendors and packaging lines.
attributes.references: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Document Management Standard

attributes.name: barcode_type
attributes.description: Type of barcode symbology used on the label for product identification and traceability. Must align with retail and supply chain scanning requirements.

attributes.name: barcode_value
attributes.description: Numeric value encoded in the barcode. Typically the GTIN (Global Trade Item Number), UPC (Universal Product Code), or EAN (European Article Number) for the SKU.

attributes.name: clean_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product qualifies for clean label marketing claims. True if the product contains only recognizable, simple ingredients without artificial additives.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3, USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this label specification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: distributor_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the distributor if different from the manufacturer. Required for co-packed or toll manufactured products.

attributes.name: distributor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the distributor if different from the manufacturer. Used when products are co-packed or toll manufactured.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this label specification becomes active and must be used on production runs. Supports phased label transitions and regulatory compliance deadlines.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this label specification is no longer valid and must be replaced. Supports label version lifecycle management and regulatory update compliance.

attributes.name: gluten_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets gluten-free standards and may display gluten-free claims on the label.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified halal by a recognized Islamic authority and may display halal certification marks on the label.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified kosher by a recognized rabbinical authority and may display kosher certification symbols on the label.

attributes.name: label_height_mm
attributes.description: Physical height of the label in millimeters. Critical for printing specifications and packaging line setup.

attributes.name: label_type
attributes.description: Classification of the label by its position and purpose on the product packaging. Determines which regulatory and marketing content is required. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: front_panel|back_panel|nutrition_panel|ingredient_panel|neck_label|cap_label|case_label|pallet_label|promotional_sticker — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) Labeling Regulations 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: label_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the label specification. Tracks revisions and updates to label artwork, claims, or regulatory text. Incremented with each approved change.

attributes.name: label_width_mm
attributes.description: Physical width of the label in millimeters. Critical for printing specifications and packaging line setup.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the primary language used on the label. Required for multi-market products and bilingual labeling requirements.

attributes.name: mandatory_claim_text
attributes.description: Legally required text that must appear on the label per regulatory jurisdiction. Includes statements mandated by FDA, USDA, EFSA, or other governing bodies.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101, USDA FSIS Labeling Requirements, EFSA Regulation (EU) 1169/2011

attributes.name: manufacturer_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the manufacturer or distributor. Required on label for consumer contact and regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the manufacturer or distributor responsible for the product. Required on label per FDA and USDA regulations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this label specification record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_quantity_statement
attributes.description: Regulatory-compliant statement of the net quantity of contents in the package. Must include both metric and US customary units where required by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: non_gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified as non-GMO and eligible to display non-GMO claims on the label.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified organic by USDA or equivalent authority and may display organic certification marks on the label.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: print_vendor_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the approved printing vendor responsible for producing this label. Used for vendor management and quality traceability.

attributes.name: qr_code_url
attributes.description: URL encoded in the QR code on the label. Typically links to product information, traceability data, or consumer engagement content.

attributes.name: recycling_instructions
attributes.description: Consumer-facing instructions for proper disposal and recycling of the package and label. Required in many jurisdictions for environmental compliance.
attributes.references: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) Packaging Guidelines, Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction for which this label specification is designed. Determines applicable food safety and labeling laws.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes, FDA, USDA, EFSA (European Food Safety Authority)

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Instructions for special handling, storage, or preparation of the product. Examples include refrigeration requirements, shake before use, or heating instructions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101, USDA FSIS Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: substrate_material
attributes.description: Type of material used for the label substrate. Impacts sustainability reporting, recycling instructions, and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: Sustainability Reporting Standard, EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) Packaging Guidelines

attributes.name: sustainability_claim_text
attributes.description: Marketing claims related to sustainability, environmental impact, or corporate social responsibility. Must be substantiated per FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Green Guides.
attributes.references: FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Green Guides 16 CFR Part 260

attributes.name: vegan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified vegan and contains no animal-derived ingredients or by-products.

products.name: product_standard_cost
products.description: Standard cost record for each SKU capturing the fully-loaded COGS build-up: raw material cost, packaging cost, direct labor, manufacturing overhead, co-pack/toll manufacturing fee, freight-in, and total standard cost per case and per unit. Tracks cost version (current standard, prior year, budget, forecast), effective date, plant/production site, currency, and variance to prior period. Owned by product domain as the authoritative product-level cost attribute; feeds pricing strategy (RSP, EDLP), trade promotion ROI, and financial reporting. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO module.

attributes.name: product_standard_cost_id
attributes.description: Primary key for standard_cost

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Records employee approving standard cost, essential for cost control and finance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the cost center responsible for this product cost. Links to the organizational unit that owns the cost build-up and variance accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the manufacturing plant or production site where this cost applies. Standard costs can vary by production location due to regional labor rates, overhead allocation, and sourcing differences.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Configuration

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the profit center for internal profitability reporting. Enables brand-level or category-level margin analysis and Return on Investment (ROI) tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the SKU master data. Links this cost record to the specific finished good product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this standard cost was formally approved for use in financial reporting and pricing decisions. Part of the cost governance audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Approval Date

attributes.name: copacker_toll_fee
attributes.description: Third-party manufacturing fee per unit when production is outsourced to a co-packer or toll manufacturer. Includes processing fee, packaging service, and contract manufacturing markup. Zero for internally manufactured SKUs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Subcontracting Purchase Order

attributes.name: cost_estimate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the costing run or cost estimate that generated this standard cost. Provides traceability to the source costing calculation and supports audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Estimate

attributes.name: cost_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the cost record: draft (under development), approved (validated but not yet active), active (currently in use for valuation), superseded (replaced by newer version), or archived (historical record).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Status

attributes.name: cost_variance_per_unit
attributes.description: Difference between current standard cost per unit and prior period cost per unit. Positive values indicate cost increases; negative values indicate cost reductions. Key metric for cost management and margin protection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Variance

attributes.name: cost_variance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in standard cost per unit compared to prior period. Calculated as (cost_variance_per_unit / prior_period_cost_per_unit) * 100. Used for executive dashboards and cost escalation alerts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Variance Percentage

attributes.name: cost_version
attributes.description: Identifies the type of cost record: current standard (active production cost), prior year (historical comparison), budget (annual plan), forecast (updated projection), planned (future state), or actual (realized cost). Enables variance analysis and cost trend tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Costing Variant

attributes.name: costing_lot_size
attributes.description: Standard production batch or lot size used as the basis for cost calculation. Affects fixed cost allocation per unit. Typically expressed in cases or production units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Costing Lot Size

attributes.name: costing_method
attributes.description: Inventory valuation method applied to this SKU: standard (predetermined cost), average (moving average), First In First Out (FIFO), Last In First Out (LIFO), or weighted average. Determines how inventory is valued on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Valuation Method

attributes.name: costing_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cost estimate was executed and this standard cost was calculated. Supports cost history tracking and regulatory compliance for cost substantiation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Costing Run

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for cost data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the standard cost is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Critical for multi-currency operations and consolidation.

attributes.name: direct_labor_cost
attributes.description: Direct labor cost per unit allocated from production operations including line operators, batch technicians, and quality inspectors. Based on standard labor hours and wage rates per manufacturing routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Activity Type Cost

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this standard cost becomes active and is used for valuation, pricing, and financial reporting. Supports cost roll-forward and period-over-period variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Costing Run Date

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this standard cost record is superseded by a new cost version. Nullable for open-ended current standard costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Costing Validity Period

attributes.name: freight_in_cost
attributes.description: Inbound freight and logistics cost per unit to deliver raw materials and packaging to the production site. Includes transportation, handling, and customs duties. Part of landed cost calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Freight Cost Component

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost record was last updated. Supports change tracking and cost variance investigation.

attributes.name: manufacturing_overhead_cost
attributes.description: Allocated manufacturing overhead per unit including utilities, equipment depreciation, plant supervision, maintenance, quality assurance, and facility costs. Allocated based on cost center rates and activity drivers per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Overhead Cost Component

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for cost accountants to document assumptions, adjustments, or special circumstances affecting this cost record (e.g., commodity hedging impact, one-time tooling amortization, co-packer contract changes).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Notes

attributes.name: packaging_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of all packaging materials per unit including primary packaging (bottles, pouches, wrappers), secondary packaging (cartons, trays), and tertiary packaging (pallets, shrink wrap). Sourced from BOM packaging line items.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Packaging Material Cost Component

attributes.name: price_control_indicator
attributes.description: SAP price control flag: S (standard price - cost remains fixed until manually updated) or V (moving average price - cost recalculated with each goods receipt). Determines inventory valuation behavior.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Price Control

attributes.name: prior_period_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Total standard cost per unit from the previous costing period. Enables period-over-period variance analysis and cost trend tracking for Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Prior Period Cost

attributes.name: raw_material_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of all raw materials and ingredients per unit as defined in the Bill of Materials (BOM). Includes commodity costs, agricultural inputs, and base formulation components. Key driver of Cost of Goods Sold (COGS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Material Cost Component

attributes.name: total_standard_cost_per_case
attributes.description: Fully-loaded standard cost per case or shipping unit. Calculated as total_standard_cost_per_unit multiplied by units per case. Primary cost metric for trade promotion Return on Investment (ROI) analysis and Distribution Center (DC) valuation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Case Cost

attributes.name: total_standard_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Fully-loaded standard cost per individual unit (e.g., per bottle, per pouch, per bar). Sum of raw material, packaging, direct labor, manufacturing overhead, co-packer fee, and freight-in costs. Used for unit-level profitability analysis and Recommended Selling Price (RSP) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Total Cost

attributes.name: units_per_case
attributes.description: Number of individual consumer units (bottles, pouches, bars) contained in one case or shipping unit. Used to convert between unit-level and case-level cost metrics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master Packaging Data

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: SAP valuation class code that determines the General Ledger (GL) accounts to which inventory and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) transactions are posted. Links product costing to financial accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Valuation Class Configuration

products.name: substitution_rule
products.description: Approved product substitution and supersession rules defining which SKUs can replace others in order fulfillment, production, or distribution scenarios. Captures source SKU, substitute SKU, substitution type (equivalent, upgrade, temporary, permanent), substitution direction (one-way, bidirectional), effective date range, applicable channels, priority rank, and approval status. Supports order management fill-rate optimization, inventory depletion of discontinued SKUs, supply continuity during shortages, and retailer-mandated equivalent item programs.

attributes.name: substitution_rule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for substitution_rule

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Links employee approving substitution rule, required for regulatory and allergen compliance tracking.

attributes.name: primary_substitution_substitute_sku_id
attributes.description: The SKU that can replace the source SKU. References the replacement product that can be used when the source SKU is unavailable or being phased out.

attributes.name: source_sku_id
attributes.description: The SKU that is being substituted or replaced. References the original product requested in order fulfillment, production, or distribution scenarios.

attributes.name: allergen_compatibility_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allergen matrices of source and substitute SKUs have been reviewed and confirmed compatible. Critical for food safety and regulatory compliance under Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) and allergen labeling requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: applicable_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sales and distribution channels where this substitution rule applies. Examples include retail, foodservice, e-commerce, Direct Store Delivery (DSD), distributor, export. Empty or null indicates rule applies to all channels.

attributes.name: applicable_customer_segments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segments or account types to which this substitution rule applies. Examples include national_accounts, regional_chains, independent_retailers, club_stores. Empty or null indicates rule applies to all customer types.

attributes.name: applicable_regions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic regions, countries, or market areas where this substitution rule is valid. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or internal region codes. Empty or null indicates global applicability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this substitution rule was formally approved for use in business operations.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the substitution rule. Draft indicates rule is being created; pending_approval indicates awaiting review; approved indicates active and usable; rejected indicates not authorized; suspended indicates temporarily disabled; expired indicates past effective end date.

attributes.name: auto_substitute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substitution can be applied automatically by order management or warehouse management systems without manual approval. True enables automatic substitution; false requires manual review and authorization for each substitution instance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this substitution rule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer must be notified when this substitution is applied to their order. True requires notification via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) or other communication channel; false allows silent substitution.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this substitution rule expires and is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this substitution rule becomes active and can be applied in order fulfillment, production planning, or distribution operations.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this substitution rule was applied in a business transaction. Used to identify inactive rules that may be candidates for archival.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this substitution rule record. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this substitution rule record was last updated. Supports audit trail and change management requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or business rationale for this substitution rule. May include details about customer agreements, supply chain constraints, or quality considerations.

attributes.name: nutritional_equivalence_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the nutritional panels of source and substitute SKUs have been compared and confirmed substantially equivalent. Important for institutional foodservice contracts and nutritional program compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Nutrition Labeling and Education Act (NLEA)

attributes.name: price_adjustment_type
attributes.description: Defines how pricing is handled when substitution occurs. no_adjustment uses standard substitute SKU price; match_source charges the original source SKU price; use_substitute charges the substitute SKU price; percentage_discount applies a discount percentage; fixed_discount applies a fixed amount discount.

attributes.name: price_adjustment_value
attributes.description: Numeric value for price adjustment when price_adjustment_type is percentage_discount or fixed_discount. For percentage_discount, represents the discount percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5% off). For fixed_discount, represents the discount amount in base currency.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the preference order when multiple substitutes exist for the same source SKU. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by order management systems to select the optimal substitute.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory or compliance review is required before this substitution can be executed. True for substitutions involving formula changes, allergen differences, or claims substantiation that require Food and Drug Administration (FDA) or United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) review.

attributes.name: substitution_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitution is one-way (source can be replaced by substitute only) or bidirectional (either SKU can replace the other). Bidirectional typically applies to equivalent products.

attributes.name: substitution_ratio
attributes.description: Conversion factor for quantity substitution. Indicates how many units of the substitute SKU are needed to replace one unit of the source SKU. For example, 1.5 means 1.5 units of substitute replace 1 unit of source.

attributes.name: substitution_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for establishing this substitution rule. Discontinuation indicates source SKU is being phased out; supply_shortage indicates temporary unavailability; cost_optimization indicates more economical alternative; quality_improvement indicates enhanced product; regulatory_change indicates compliance-driven substitution; packaging_change or formulation_change indicate product updates; seasonal_transition indicates seasonal variant swap; inventory_depletion indicates planned stock runout; customer_request indicates retailer-mandated equivalent. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discontinuation|supply_shortage|cost_optimization|quality_improvement|regulatory_change|packaging_change|formulation_change|seasonal_transition|inventory_depletion|customer_request — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the substitution relationship. Equivalent indicates functionally identical products; upgrade indicates higher-value replacement; downgrade indicates lower-value replacement; temporary indicates short-term substitution during supply disruptions; permanent indicates supersession due to discontinuation; seasonal indicates time-bound substitution for seasonal variants.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of how many times this substitution rule has been applied in actual order fulfillment, production, or distribution transactions. Used for substitution effectiveness analysis and fill rate optimization.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who created this substitution rule record. Typically a supply chain planner, product manager, or demand planner.

products.name: production_assignment
products.description: Represents the assignment of a SKU to a production asset for a specific time period. Captures when the SKU is scheduled to be produced on the asset.. Existence Justification: A SKU can be manufactured on multiple production assets and an asset can produce many different SKUs. The assignment of a SKU to an asset is scheduled with start and end dates for capacity planning and traceability, and these assignments are actively created and maintained by production planners.

attributes.name: production_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the production_assignment association

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to Asset

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to SKU

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU assignment to the asset ends

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the SKU assignment to the asset becomes effective

products.name: inventory_allocation
products.description: This association captures the allocation of a SKU to a specific storage location, including quantities on hand, reserved amounts, in‑transit stock, and shelf‑life dates. Each record links one SKU to one storage location and stores attributes that belong only to the SKU‑location relationship.. Existence Justification: A SKU can be stocked in multiple storage locations, and each storage location can hold many different SKUs. The inventory management process actively creates and updates records that capture quantities, reservation status, and shelf‑life information for each SKU‑location pair. This relationship is managed as a distinct business entity used for allocation, replenishment, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: inventory_allocation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the inventory_allocation association

attributes.name: sku_id

products.description: Represents the manufacturing Bill of Materials linking a SKU to a plant. Each record captures the version, status, and validity period of the BOM for that SKU‑plant pair.. Existence Justification: A SKU can be manufactured at multiple plants, and each plant can produce many SKUs. The business maintains a versioned Bill of Materials per SKU‑plant combination with validity dates, status, and version information, which is actively created and managed by manufacturing planners.

attributes.name: product_production_bom_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the production_bom association

attributes.name: plant_id

attributes.name: sku_id

attributes.name: bom_status

attributes.name: bom_version

attributes.name: valid_from_date

attributes.name: valid_to_date

products.name: category
products.description: Master reference table for category. Referenced by category_id.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Primary key for category

attributes.name: parent_category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the immediate parent category for hierarchical organization.

attributes.name: allergen_info
attributes.description: Allergen statements applicable to the category (e.g., contains nuts, gluten‑free).

attributes.name: category_code

attributes.name: category_name

attributes.name: category_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: marketing_description

attributes.name: nutritional_profile

attributes.name: packaging_type

attributes.name: regulatory_classification

attributes.name: shelf_life_days

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: target_market

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
