domains.name: ingredient
domains.description: Authoritative domain for all raw materials, additives, flavors, preservatives, and packaging components used in F&B manufacturing. Manages ingredient specifications, supplier-approved ingredient lists, Brix/pH/CFU tolerances, clean-label attributes, allergen declarations, GMO status, organic certifications, certificates of analysis (COA), and ingredient traceability for FSMA compliance.
domains.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 182, Codex Alimentarius GSFA, GFSI, FSMA

products.name: raw_material
products.description: Master record and Single Source of Truth for all raw materials, additives, flavors, preservatives, and packaging components used in F&B manufacturing. Captures INCI name, CAS number, E-number (EU additive code), ingredient class (raw material, flavor, preservative, colorant, packaging component), hierarchical category classification (L1 class > L2 sub-class > L3 type), origin type (animal, plant, mineral, synthetic), clean-label eligibility and consumer-facing claim attributes (no artificial colors/flavors/preservatives, gluten-free, vegan, plant-based, fair trade), dietary compliance flags (vegan, kosher, halal), organic certification status, GMO classification (non-GMO, GMO, GMO-derived), GMO verification method (supplier declaration, PCR testing, third-party certification), Non-GMO Project Verified flag, identity preservation flag, allergen declaration flags per FDA FALCPA and EFSA categories, shelf life parameters, storage conditions, moisture sensitivity, PLM lifecycle stage, sensory standard profile (appearance, color, aroma, flavor, texture descriptors), and regulatory restriction profile by jurisdiction. Referenced by every transactional record in this domain.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Master (MARA/MARC) — Ingredient/Raw Material

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the raw material. Primary key for this master data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Key accounts often have approved‑ingredient lists; linking raw material to the account records which accounts have approved each ingredient.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand Ingredient Compliance Report requires mapping each raw material to the brand that uses it for labeling and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: category_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.category_strategy. Business justification: REQUIRED: Sourcing strategy reports assign each raw material to a category strategy defining risk, spend, and sustainability targets.

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Required for FDA facility traceability of raw material source; regulatory compliance reports demand linking each ingredient to its registered establishment.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Novel ingredient registration requires a FK to product_registration to track approval status, jurisdiction, and compliance deadlines.

attributes.name: quality_haccp_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.haccp_plan. Business justification: Raw material hazard categories are incorporated into HACCP plans; FK supports hazard‑based control documentation.

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Raw material specification management requires linking each raw material to its quality specification for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: allergen_eggs
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from eggs. Required for FDA FALCPA allergen labeling compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_fish
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from fish. Required for FDA FALCPA allergen labeling compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_milk
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from milk. Required for FDA FALCPA allergen labeling compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_peanuts
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from peanuts. Required for FDA FALCPA allergen labeling compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_sesame
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from sesame. Required for FDA FASTER Act allergen labeling compliance (effective 2023).

attributes.name: allergen_shellfish
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from crustacean shellfish. Required for FDA FALCPA allergen labeling compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_soybeans
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from soybeans. Required for FDA FALCPA allergen labeling compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_tree_nuts
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from tree nuts. Required for FDA FALCPA allergen labeling compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_wheat
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains or is derived from wheat. Required for FDA FALCPA allergen labeling compliance.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Critical for regulatory compliance and supplier specifications.

attributes.name: category_l1
attributes.description: Top-level hierarchical category classification (e.g., Dairy, Sweeteners, Proteins, Fats & Oils, Spices & Seasonings). First tier of ingredient taxonomy.

attributes.name: category_l2
attributes.description: Second-level hierarchical category classification providing more granular segmentation within L1 class (e.g., under Dairy: Milk Powders, Whey Products, Cheese Cultures).

attributes.name: category_l3
attributes.description: Third-level hierarchical category classification providing most specific ingredient type within L2 sub-class (e.g., under Milk Powders: Skim Milk Powder, Whole Milk Powder, Buttermilk Powder).

attributes.name: clean_label_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient meets clean-label criteria (recognizable, simple ingredients without artificial additives). Key attribute for consumer-facing product claims and NPD.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this raw material master record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: e_number
attributes.description: EU-assigned code for food additives approved for use in the European Economic Area. Required for EU labeling compliance.

attributes.name: fair_trade_certified
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient has been sourced under fair trade standards, ensuring ethical labor practices and fair compensation to producers.

attributes.name: gluten_free
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient is free from gluten proteins (wheat, barley, rye, triticale). Required for gluten-free product formulation and FDA gluten-free labeling compliance.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21 Part 101.91 Gluten-Free Labeling

attributes.name: gmo_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the ingredients GMO status. Critical for regulatory compliance, labeling requirements, and consumer transparency.

attributes.name: gmo_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the GMO status of the ingredient. Documents the rigor of GMO status validation for compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.value_regex: supplier declaration|PCR testing|third-party certification|identity preservation|not verified

attributes.name: halal_certified
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient has been certified as meeting halal dietary requirements by a recognized halal certification body.
attributes.references: Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America (IFANCA)

attributes.name: identity_preserved
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient has been kept segregated throughout the supply chain to maintain its specific identity characteristics (e.g., non-GMO, organic, specific variety). Critical for premium ingredient sourcing and traceability.

attributes.name: inci_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Name
attributes.description: Standardized INCI name for the ingredient, used for regulatory labeling and international ingredient identification.

attributes.name: ingredient_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the ingredient type. Primary categorical segmentation for procurement, formulation, and regulatory purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw material|flavor|preservative|colorant|packaging component|additive|processing aid|nutrient fortification — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: kosher_certified
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient has been certified as meeting kosher dietary laws by a recognized kosher certification agency.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the raw material in the PLM system. Governs availability for new formulations and procurement authorization.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the raw material, typically sourced from ERP system (SAP MM Material Master). Used across procurement, manufacturing, and quality systems.

attributes.name: material_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the raw material, additive, flavor, preservative, or packaging component. Primary identity label for business users.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this raw material master record was last modified. Audit trail for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: moisture_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient is sensitive to moisture and requires special handling or packaging to prevent degradation. Impacts storage, handling, and packaging specifications.

attributes.name: no_artificial_colors
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient is free from synthetic or artificial color additives. Supports clean-label and natural product positioning.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21 Part 74 Color Additives

attributes.name: no_artificial_flavors
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient is free from synthetic or artificial flavor compounds. Critical for natural and clean-label claims.

attributes.name: no_artificial_preservatives
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient is free from synthetic preservatives. Supports clean-label and natural product claims.

attributes.name: non_gmo_project_verified
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient has been verified by the Non-GMO Project, the leading third-party verification program for non-GMO products in North America.

attributes.name: organic_certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization that issued the organic certification (e.g., USDA, EU Organic, IFOAM). Required for organic claim substantiation and audit trails.

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient has been certified organic by a recognized certification body (USDA Organic, EU Organic, etc.).

attributes.name: origin_type
attributes.description: Source origin classification of the raw material. Critical for dietary compliance, allergen management, and clean-label positioning.

attributes.name: plant_based
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient is derived from plant sources. Supports plant-based product positioning and consumer trend alignment.

attributes.name: regulatory_restriction_profile
attributes.description: Summary of regulatory restrictions or usage limitations by jurisdiction (e.g., banned in EU, restricted use levels in US, requires warning label in CA). Critical for global product formulation and compliance.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21, EFSA Regulations, Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: sensory_appearance
attributes.description: Standard sensory profile description for visual appearance characteristics. Used by sensory panels and quality control for organoleptic evaluation.

attributes.name: sensory_aroma
attributes.description: Standard sensory profile description for aroma characteristics. Used by sensory panels and quality control for organoleptic evaluation.

attributes.name: sensory_color
attributes.description: Standard sensory profile description for color characteristics. Used by sensory panels and quality control for organoleptic evaluation.

attributes.name: sensory_flavor
attributes.description: Standard sensory profile description for flavor characteristics. Used by sensory panels and quality control for organoleptic evaluation.

attributes.name: sensory_texture
attributes.description: Standard sensory profile description for texture and mouthfeel characteristics. Used by sensory panels and quality control for organoleptic evaluation.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Expected shelf life of the raw material in days under specified storage conditions. Critical for inventory management, FEFO rotation, and formulation planning.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the raw material (e.g., ambient, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen -18°C, controlled humidity). Essential for warehouse management and quality preservation.

attributes.name: vegan
attributes.description: Indicates the ingredient contains no animal-derived components or by-products. Essential for vegan product formulation and certification.

products.name: approved_supplier
products.description: Approved Supplier List (ASL) association between a specific supplier and a specific raw material, representing the authorized sourcing relationship. Captures supplier item code, supplier item description, supplier country of origin, approval status (approved, conditional, suspended, revoked), approval date, re-approval due date, GFSI certification type (SQF, BRC, FSSC 22000, IFS), GFSI certificate expiry, MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity), lead time days, price UOM, and last audit score. Sourced from TraceGains Supplier Compliance and SAP MM Source List.
products.reference: TraceGains Supplier Compliance — Approved Supplier List (ASL)

attributes.name: approved_supplier_id
attributes.description: Primary key for approved_supplier

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Supplier approval process mandates linking each approved supplier to the regulatory establishment registration of its manufacturing site.

attributes.name: primary_approved_ingredient_raw_material_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approved supplier-ingredient relationship record. Primary key for the approved supplier list entry.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier entity that is approved to supply this ingredient. Links to the supplier master data.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current allergen declaration document is on file for this supplier-ingredient combination. Critical for FSMA compliance and allergen management programs.
attributes.references: FSMA, FDA Food Allergen Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the supplier was officially approved to supply this ingredient. Marks the start of the authorized sourcing relationship.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the supplier for this specific ingredient. Approved = fully authorized; Conditional = approved with restrictions; Suspended = temporarily not allowed; Revoked = permanently removed; Pending = under review.

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must be provided with each shipment of this ingredient from this supplier. COAs verify ingredient specifications and quality parameters.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), TraceGains Document Management

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master purchase contract or supply agreement governing this supplier-ingredient relationship. Links to contract management systems for terms and conditions.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the ingredient is sourced or manufactured by the supplier. Critical for FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) traceability and customs compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this approved supplier record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Essential for multi-currency procurement and financial reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this approved supplier relationship expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended relationship. Used for contract lifecycle management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this approved supplier relationship is effective. Used for time-based sourcing decisions and historical tracking.

attributes.name: gfsi_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certificate Expiry Date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the suppliers GFSI certification. Suppliers must maintain valid certification to remain on the approved supplier list.

attributes.name: gfsi_certificate_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certificate Number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued by the GFSI certification body. Used for verification and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: gfsi_certification_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Type
attributes.description: The type of GFSI (Global Food Safety Initiative) certification held by the supplier. Common schemes include SQF (Safe Quality Food), BRC (Brand Reputation Compliance), FSSC 22000 (Food Safety System Certification), IFS (International Featured Standards), GLOBALG.A.P., and PrimusGFS.

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: The GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) status of the ingredient from this supplier. GMO = contains genetically modified material; Non-GMO = does not contain GMO; Non-GMO Verified = third-party verified; Organic = certified organic (inherently non-GMO).

attributes.name: halal_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is certified to provide this ingredient as Halal-compliant. Required for products targeting Muslim consumers and certain export markets.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: The Incoterms rule governing the delivery, risk transfer, and cost responsibilities between buyer and supplier. Common terms include EXW (Ex Works), FOB (Free On Board), CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: kosher_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is certified to provide this ingredient as Kosher-compliant. Required for products targeting Jewish consumers and certain retail channels.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent supplier audit conducted for this ingredient. Audits verify compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Compliance, GFSI Audit Requirements

attributes.name: last_audit_score
attributes.description: The numerical score from the most recent supplier audit, typically on a 0-100 scale. Higher scores indicate better compliance and performance. Used for supplier risk assessment and scorecard evaluation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this approved supplier record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected delivery at the receiving facility. Critical for demand planning and inventory optimization.
attributes.references: SAP MM Source List, JDA Supply Planning

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity (MOQ) required by the supplier for this ingredient. Represents the smallest amount that can be ordered in a single purchase order.

attributes.name: moq_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the minimum order quantity, such as kg, lbs, liters, gallons, cases, pallets. Must align with supplier pricing and ordering systems.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next supplier audit. Ensures regular monitoring and continuous compliance verification.

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is certified to provide this ingredient as organic (USDA Organic, EU Organic, or equivalent). Required for clean-label and organic product lines.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP), EU Organic Regulation

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The negotiated payment terms for this supplier-ingredient relationship, such as Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30. Defines when payment is due and any early payment discounts available.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is designated as a preferred supplier for this ingredient. Preferred suppliers receive priority in sourcing decisions based on quality, reliability, and cost performance.

attributes.name: price_per_uom
attributes.description: The negotiated price per unit of measure for this ingredient from this supplier. Used for cost estimation and procurement decisions. Business-confidential pricing information.

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure basis for the price, such as per kg, per lb, per liter, per case. Must be clearly defined for accurate cost calculations.

attributes.name: reapproval_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the supplier must be re-evaluated and re-approved for continued authorization. Ensures periodic review of supplier compliance and quality performance.

attributes.name: supplier_item_code
attributes.description: The unique item code or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that the supplier uses to identify this ingredient in their catalog. Used for purchase orders and supplier communication.

attributes.name: supplier_item_description
attributes.description: The suppliers description of the ingredient item, which may differ from internal nomenclature. Provides supplier-specific product naming and specification details.

products.name: lot
products.description: Lot-level traceability record for each received batch of raw material, enabling FSMA forward and backward traceability. Captures internal lot number, supplier lot number, GS1 SSCC (Serial Shipping Container Code), receipt date, expiry date, best-before date, quantity received (UOM), plant/DC received at, storage location, FEFO sequence number, quarantine flag, lot status (unrestricted, quality hold, blocked, consumed, expired), and disposition reason. Links to COA and purchase receipt. Sourced from SAP MM Batch Management.
products.reference: SAP MM Batch Management — Material Lot / Batch Record

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lot

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Recall traceability report requires linking each ingredient lot to the end‑customer account that received the product for rapid recall actions.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.asset. Business justification: FSMA traceability requires linking each ingredient lot to the equipment that processed it, enabling recall, compliance reporting, and equipment‑level accountability.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Inventory valuation: lot balances are reported per legal entity (company code) for financial statements and compliance.

attributes.name: fsma_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.fsma_record. Business justification: FSMA compliance requires each ingredient lot to be associated with a specific FSMA record for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_receipt. Business justification: REQUIRED: Quality inspection and FSMA traceability reports link each lot to the specific goods receipt that delivered it.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_shipment. Business justification: REQUIRED: FSMA traceability report needs to link each raw‑material lot to its inbound shipment for recall and compliance.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Lot‑level quality inspections are recorded; linking lot to inspection_lot enables traceability reports.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: FSMA traceability: link ingredient lot to sales order to identify which orders contain the lot for recall and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Recall & audit process needs to map each raw‑material lot to its originating purchase order for traceability and compliance.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master ingredient specification that this lot represents.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.shipment. Business justification: Traceability Report: each ingredient lot must be linked to the outbound shipment for recall and FSMA compliance.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: REQUIRED: Raw material receipt location tracking for inventory audit and FSMA traceability; experts expect each lot to reference its storage location.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who provided this ingredient lot.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allergens present in or potentially cross-contaminated with this ingredient lot.

attributes.name: best_before_date
attributes.description: Date until which the ingredient maintains optimal quality characteristics, may still be usable after this date subject to quality review.

attributes.name: coa_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the Certificate of Analysis provided by the supplier, containing test results and quality parameters.

attributes.name: coa_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the Certificate of Analysis was received from the supplier.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the ingredient was grown, harvested, or manufactured.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ingredient lot record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disposition_reason
attributes.description: Reason for the current disposition status of the lot (e.g., failed specification, expired, contamination risk).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the ingredient lot should not be used in production due to quality or safety concerns.

attributes.name: fefo_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Sequence Number
attributes.description: Sequence number used to prioritize lot consumption based on expiry date, ensuring oldest lots are used first.

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient lot contains genetically modified organisms.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient lot is certified halal by a recognized halal certification body.

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: Date when a quality hold or quarantine status was released, allowing the lot to be used in production.

attributes.name: internal_lot_number
attributes.description: Company-assigned unique lot number for internal traceability and inventory management. Primary business identifier for the lot.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient lot is certified kosher by a recognized kosher certification agency.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ingredient lot record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ingredient lot indicating its availability for production use.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when the ingredient was manufactured or produced by the supplier.

attributes.name: organic_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number from the organic certification body if the lot is organic certified.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient lot is certified organic by a recognized certification body.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code where the ingredient lot was received and is stored.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of quality inspection and testing for the ingredient lot.

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Current available quantity of the ingredient lot after consumption, adjustments, and reservations.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Total quantity of ingredient received in this lot, measured in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot is under quarantine pending quality inspection and approval.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the ingredient lot was physically received at the plant or distribution center.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special handling instructions related to the ingredient lot.

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date when the ingredient lot must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications before further use.

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code for pallet or container-level traceability in the supply chain.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required environmental storage condition for the ingredient lot to maintain quality and safety.

attributes.name: supplier_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number assigned by the supplier, used for backward traceability to supplier production records.

attributes.name: temperature_at_receipt
attributes.description: Measured temperature of the ingredient lot at the time of receipt, critical for temperature-sensitive materials.

attributes.name: traceability_lot_code
attributes.description: Extended traceability code used for FSMA compliance, enabling forward and backward traceability through the supply chain.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the ingredient lot quantity (e.g., kilograms, liters, pounds). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|TON|EA|CS|BAG|DRUM|PALLET — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_certification_status
attributes.description: Certification status of the supplier at the time this lot was received, indicating compliance with company quality standards.

products.name: allergen
products.description: Authoritative allergen declaration record for each raw material, capturing the presence, absence, or may-contain status of each major allergen category as required by FDA FALCPA, EU Regulation 1169/2011, and other jurisdictions. Captures allergen type (peanut, tree nut, milk, egg, wheat/gluten, soy, fish, shellfish, sesame, mustard, celery, lupin, molluscs, sulphites), declaration type (contains, may contain/cross-contact, free-from), declaration basis (formulation, supplier declaration, lab test), effective date, and jurisdiction. Supports allergen matrix generation for finished goods labeling.
products.reference: FDA FALCPA / EU Reg 1169/2011 — Allergen Declaration

attributes.name: allergen_id
attributes.description: Primary key for allergen

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material or ingredient for which this allergen declaration applies. Links to the ingredient master data.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who provided the allergen declaration or certificate of analysis for this ingredient.

attributes.name: allergen_type
attributes.description: The specific allergen category as defined by FDA FALCPA and EU Regulation 1169/2011. Identifies which of the major allergen groups this declaration addresses. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: peanut|tree_nut|milk|egg|wheat_gluten|soy|fish|shellfish|sesame|mustard|celery|lupin|molluscs|sulphites — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA, EU Regulation 1169/2011, Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this allergen declaration was formally approved by the quality assurance team.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quality assurance professional who approved this allergen declaration for use in finished goods labeling.

attributes.name: coa_document_number
attributes.description: The unique document identifier for the Certificate of Analysis that supports this allergen declaration. Used for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, clarifications, or special handling instructions related to this allergen declaration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allergen declaration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_contact_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk that the ingredient may be cross-contaminated with the allergen during manufacturing, processing, or transportation. Used to determine may-contain declarations.

attributes.name: declaration_basis
attributes.description: The method or source used to determine the allergen status. Indicates whether the declaration is based on ingredient formulation, supplier-provided documentation, laboratory testing, or facility risk assessment.

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the allergen declaration record. Tracks the approval workflow and validity state.

attributes.name: declaration_type
attributes.description: The nature of the allergen declaration indicating whether the allergen is intentionally present, potentially present due to cross-contact, or absent from the ingredient.

attributes.name: detection_limit_ppm
attributes.description: The minimum concentration level in parts per million at which the allergen can be reliably detected by the test method. Applicable only when declaration is based on laboratory testing.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this allergen declaration becomes valid and applicable for regulatory compliance and labeling purposes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this allergen declaration is no longer valid. Used to manage changes in ingredient formulation or supplier declarations over time.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The country or regulatory region for which this allergen declaration is applicable. Different jurisdictions have different allergen labeling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|GBR|DEU|FRA|ITA|ESP|AUS|NZL|JPN|CHN|BRA|ARG|IND — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this allergen declaration was reviewed for accuracy and compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allergen declaration record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next mandatory review of this allergen declaration.

attributes.name: precautionary_statement
attributes.description: The specific precautionary allergen labeling statement to be used on finished goods (e.g., 'May contain traces of peanuts', 'Processed in a facility that also processes milk'). Used for label generation.

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: The number of days between required reviews of this allergen declaration. Used to ensure declarations remain current and accurate.

attributes.name: shared_equipment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is processed on equipment that is also used for allergen-containing products. True if shared equipment is used, False otherwise.

attributes.name: shared_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is manufactured in a facility that also processes allergen-containing products. True if shared facility, False otherwise.

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this allergen declaration in the source operational system. Used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this allergen declaration record originated (e.g., TraceGains, SAP QM, Veeva Vault).

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: The specific analytical method or protocol used if the allergen declaration is based on laboratory testing (e.g., ELISA, PCR, mass spectrometry). Empty if not lab-tested.

products.name: formulation_line
products.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) line-item record linking a finished good or intermediate SKU to its constituent raw materials and sub-components. Captures BOM header reference (finished good SKU), BOM version, line item sequence, raw material reference, quantity per batch (UOM), yield factor %, scrap factor %, phase of addition (mixing, blending, coating, filling), and BOM status (active, draft, obsolete). Enables formulation management, COGS calculation, and nutritional panel computation. Sourced from SAP PP BOM and PLM formulation records.
products.reference: SAP PP Bill of Materials (BOM) — Ingredient Line Item

attributes.name: formulation_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for formulation_line

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Approval of BOM line items requires tracking which employee approved the formulation; the BOM approval report references approver_employee_id.

attributes.name: bill_of_materials_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent BOM header record representing the finished good or intermediate SKU. Links this line item to its parent formulation.

attributes.name: finished_good_sku_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Finished Good Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Identifier
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good or intermediate product SKU that this BOM line contributes to. Enables traceability from raw material to final product.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards

attributes.name: primary_formulation_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved supplier for this ingredient in this formulation. Links to the approved vendor list (AVL) for procurement and traceability.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material, ingredient, additive, flavor, preservative, or packaging component used in this formulation line. Links to the ingredient master data.

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ingredient specification document that defines quality parameters, tolerances, and acceptance criteria (e.g., Brix, pH, CFU limits).

attributes.name: addition_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this ingredient is added within its phase of addition. Ensures proper sequencing for recipe execution and quality control.

attributes.name: allergen_type
attributes.description: The specific allergen type if this ingredient is flagged as an allergen. Supports allergen declaration on nutritional panels and consumer safety. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: milk|eggs|fish|shellfish|tree_nuts|peanuts|wheat|soybeans|sesame|none — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this BOM line item was approved for production use. Required for regulatory compliance and quality management system (QMS) documentation.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this BOM line item. Controls whether the formulation can be used in production planning and manufacturing execution.

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the BOM formulation. Tracks changes to formulations over time for product lifecycle management (PLM) and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the change made to this BOM line item. Provides context for formulation modifications and supports regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: The business reason for creating or modifying this BOM line item. Supports change management and audit trail for formulation changes.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per unit. Supports multi-currency cost management for global operations.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The standard cost per unit of measure for this ingredient at the time of BOM creation. Used for cost of goods sold (COGS) calculation and margin analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line item record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM line item is no longer effective for production use. Nullable for open-ended formulations. Supports phase-out of ingredients and reformulation tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line item becomes effective for production use. Supports time-phased formulation changes and product reformulations.

attributes.name: is_allergen
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is a declared allergen or contains allergen components. Used for allergen matrix management and labeling compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: is_critical_ingredient
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is critical to product safety, quality, or regulatory compliance. Critical ingredients require enhanced traceability and certificate of analysis (COA) verification.

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is genetically modified or contains GMO components. Required for clean-label claims and regulatory compliance in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard

attributes.name: is_halal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is halal certified. Supports halal product formulation and labeling for Muslim consumers.
attributes.references: Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America (IFANCA)

attributes.name: is_kosher
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is kosher certified. Supports kosher product formulation and labeling.

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is certified organic. Required for organic product labeling and USDA National Organic Program (NOP) compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line item record was last modified in the lakehouse. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: line_item_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of the BOM line item within the parent BOM header. Determines the order of ingredient addition in manufacturing processes.

attributes.name: phase_of_addition
attributes.description: The manufacturing phase or stage at which this ingredient is added to the formulation (e.g., mixing, blending, coating, filling). Critical for manufacturing execution system (MES) scheduling and process control.

attributes.name: quantity_per_batch
attributes.description: The quantity of raw material required per production batch of the finished good. Used for material requirements planning (MRP) and cost of goods sold (COGS) calculation.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percent
attributes.description: The expected scrap or waste percentage for this ingredient during production. Used for accurate material planning and waste management tracking.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this BOM line item was sourced (e.g., SAP PP, PLM formulation system). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this BOM line item in the source operational system. Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity per batch field. Standardized to support accurate material planning and inventory management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|L|mL|oz|lb|gal|unit|each — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: yield_factor_percent
attributes.description: The expected yield percentage for this ingredient in the manufacturing process. Accounts for material loss during processing (e.g., evaporation, trimming). Used to calculate actual material requirements.

products.name: nutritional_profile
products.description: Nutritional composition record for each raw material, capturing per-100g and per-serving nutrient values required for finished goods nutritional labeling. Captures energy (kcal/kJ), total fat, saturated fat, trans fat, cholesterol, sodium, total carbohydrate, dietary fiber, total sugars, added sugars, protein, and micronutrients (vitamins A, C, D, calcium, iron, potassium) with unit of measure and analytical method. Supports FDA Nutrition Facts Panel and EU Regulation 1169/2011 nutritional declaration. Sourced from TraceGains and internal R&D lab data.
products.reference: FDA 21 CFR 101 / EU Reg 1169/2011 — Nutritional Composition

attributes.name: nutritional_profile_id
attributes.description: Primary key for nutritional_profile

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Nutritional panel approvals are recorded for compliance audits; linking to employee ensures traceability of the approving staff.

attributes.name: nutritional_raw_material_id
attributes.description: FK to ingredient.raw_material

attributes.name: primary_nutritional_raw_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the ingredient master record for which this nutritional profile is defined.

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Nutritional panels must conform to nutrition specifications; linking enables compliance dashboards.

attributes.name: added_sugars_g
attributes.description: Added sugar content in grams per serving size. Mandatory declaration under updated FDA Nutrition Facts Panel requirements.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date when the nutritional analysis was performed by the laboratory or R&D team.

attributes.name: analytical_method
attributes.description: Laboratory analytical method or protocol used to determine the nutritional composition. Examples include AOAC methods, wet chemistry, NIR spectroscopy, or chromatography techniques.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the nutritional profile was formally approved by quality assurance or regulatory affairs for use in finished goods labeling.

attributes.name: calcium_mg
attributes.description: Calcium content in milligrams per serving size. Essential mineral for bone health and mandatory FDA declaration.

attributes.name: cholesterol_mg
attributes.description: Cholesterol content in milligrams per serving size. Required for FDA Nutrition Facts Panel.

attributes.name: coa_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis document that contains the detailed nutritional test results for this ingredient batch or lot.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this nutritional profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin of the nutritional data. Indicates whether values are from direct laboratory analysis, supplier-provided specifications, USDA nutrient database, published literature, or calculated from recipe formulation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 101.9, Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dietary_fiber_g
attributes.description: Dietary fiber content in grams per serving size. Includes soluble and insoluble fiber components.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this nutritional profile becomes effective and valid for use in finished goods nutritional calculations and labeling.

attributes.name: energy_kcal
attributes.description: Energy content expressed in kilocalories (kcal) per serving size. Required for FDA Nutrition Facts Panel and EU nutritional declaration.

attributes.name: energy_kj
attributes.description: Energy content expressed in kilojoules (kJ) per serving size. Required for EU nutritional declaration and optional for FDA labeling.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this nutritional profile is no longer valid and should not be used for new product formulations or label declarations. Nullable for profiles with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: iron_mg
attributes.description: Iron content in milligrams per serving size. Essential mineral for blood health and mandatory FDA declaration.

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the laboratory or testing facility that performed the nutritional analysis. May be internal R&D lab or third-party accredited laboratory.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this nutritional profile record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or contextual information about the nutritional profile. May include notes on variability, seasonal differences, or analytical limitations.

attributes.name: nutritional_profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the nutritional profile record. Indicates whether the data is draft, approved for use in finished goods labeling, under regulatory review, expired, or superseded by a newer version.

attributes.name: potassium_mg
attributes.description: Potassium content in milligrams per serving size. Mandatory declaration under updated FDA Nutrition Facts Panel.

attributes.name: protein_g
attributes.description: Protein content in grams per serving size. Essential macronutrient for nutritional labeling.

attributes.name: saturated_fat_g
attributes.description: Saturated fatty acid content in grams per serving size. Required nutrient declaration for cardiovascular health labeling.

attributes.name: serving_size_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the serving size. Common values include grams (g), milliliters (ml), ounces (oz), or standardized serving units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: g|ml|oz|cup|tbsp|tsp|serving — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: serving_size_value
attributes.description: Numeric value representing the serving size for which nutritional values are declared. Typically expressed per 100g or per defined serving unit.

attributes.name: sodium_mg
attributes.description: Sodium content in milligrams per serving size. Critical for cardiovascular health and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: total_carbohydrate_g
attributes.description: Total carbohydrate content in grams per serving size, including sugars, starches, and dietary fiber.

attributes.name: total_fat_g
attributes.description: Total fat content in grams per serving size. Includes all fatty acids and lipid components.

attributes.name: total_sugars_g
attributes.description: Total sugar content in grams per serving size, including naturally occurring and added sugars.

attributes.name: trans_fat_g
attributes.description: Trans fatty acid content in grams per serving size. Mandatory declaration under FDA and many international regulations.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the nutritional profile record. Supports change tracking and audit trail for ingredient nutritional data updates.

attributes.name: vitamin_a_mcg
attributes.description: Vitamin A content in micrograms per serving size, expressed as retinol activity equivalents (RAE).

attributes.name: vitamin_c_mg
attributes.description: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) content in milligrams per serving size.

attributes.name: vitamin_d_mcg
attributes.description: Vitamin D content in micrograms per serving size. Mandatory declaration under updated FDA Nutrition Facts Panel.

products.name: organic_certification
products.description: Organic certification record for a raw material from a specific supplier, capturing certifying body (USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulation 2018/848, JAS, etc.), certificate number, certified scope (ingredient name as certified), certification grade (100% organic, organic, made with organic), certificate issue date, certificate expiry date, renewal status, and digital certificate document reference. Enables organic claim substantiation for finished goods labeling and USDA NOP audit trail. Sourced from TraceGains Document Management.
products.reference: USDA NOP / EU Organic Regulation 2018/848 — Organic Certificate

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organic certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material or ingredient that is certified organic.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier providing the certified organic ingredient.

attributes.name: approved_for_use_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certified organic ingredient is approved for use in production based on current certification status.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent organic compliance audit conducted by the certifying body.

attributes.name: certificate_document_reference
attributes.description: Digital document reference or file path to the scanned organic certificate stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: certificate_document_url
attributes.description: URL or hyperlink to access the digital organic certificate document in the document management system.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number issued by the certifying body for this organic certification.

attributes.name: certification_grade
attributes.description: The organic grade or classification level of the certified ingredient (100% Organic, Organic, Made with Organic).

attributes.name: certification_standard

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organic certification.

attributes.name: certified_ingredient_name
attributes.description: The ingredient name as it appears on the organic certificate, which may differ from internal nomenclature.

attributes.name: certified_scope
attributes.description: Description of the scope of certification, including specific products, processes, or operations covered by the certificate.

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the accredited organization that issued the organic certification (e.g., USDA NOP, ECOCERT, Soil Association, JAS).
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205, EU Organic Regulation 2018/848, JAS (Japanese Agricultural Standard)

attributes.name: certifying_body_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or accreditation number of the certifying body.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding organic compliance, audit findings, or special conditions of the certification.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The country where the certified organic ingredient was produced or grown, using 3-letter ISO country code.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organic certification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the organic certification becomes valid and can be used for organic claims.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification expires and must be renewed.

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Genetically Modified Organism status of the certified organic ingredient. Organic certification typically requires non-GMO status.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification was issued by the certifying body.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organic certification record was last modified.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Specific lot or batch number of the ingredient covered by this organic certification, enabling traceability.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next organic compliance audit.

attributes.name: non_compliance_flag

attributes.name: organic_percentage

attributes.name: renewal_status

attributes.name: traceability_code
attributes.description: Unique traceability code linking this organic certification to supply chain tracking systems for FSMA compliance.

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or team who last verified the organic certification.

products.name: test_result

products.reference: SAP QM Inspection Lot Results / Veeva Vault QMS — Lab Test Result

attributes.name: test_result_id
attributes.description: Primary key for test_result

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Certain key accounts require ingredient test results for regulatory compliance; linking test results to the account enables automated reporting.

attributes.name: analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Laboratory test results are generated by an analyst; analyst_employee_id links result to the responsible lab employee for QA.

attributes.name: claim_id

attributes.name: fsma_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.fsma_record. Business justification: Test results are reviewed against FSMA records; linking enables compliance dashboards linking lab results to regulatory filings.

attributes.name: ingredient_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific ingredient lot that was tested. Links to the raw material batch received from supplier.

attributes.name: original_test_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original test result record if this is a retest. Null for initial tests.

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Test results are evaluated against a defined specification; FK ties each result to its spec for audit.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master ingredient specification being tested against.

attributes.name: sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical sample taken from the ingredient lot for testing. Links laboratory result to sample chain of custody.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.shipment. Business justification: Quality Inspection Dashboard: test results are reported per shipment to verify compliance of shipped lots.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who provided the ingredient lot being tested.

attributes.name: coa_document_url
attributes.description: Link to the digital COA document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate of analysis document number issued by the testing laboratory or supplier. Primary business identifier for the test result.

attributes.name: coa_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the COA document was received from the supplier or testing laboratory.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes or observations from the analyst or reviewer regarding the test result or sample condition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this test result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test result triggered a quality deviation or non-conformance requiring investigation.

attributes.name: deviation_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the quality deviation or non-conformance record if the test failed specification.

attributes.name: hold_release_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the ingredient lot based on test results. Determines whether lot can be used in production.

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation
attributes.description: Accreditation standard or certification held by the testing laboratory (e.g., ISO 17025, A2LA, UKAS).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this test result record was last updated.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Disposition of the test result against specification limits. Determines whether the ingredient lot meets quality requirements.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that created this test result record (e.g., SAP QM, TraceGains, Veeva Vault, LIMS).

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test is mandated by regulatory authority (FDA, USDA, EFSA) versus internal quality control.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if the ingredient lot was rejected based on test results. Documents root cause of failure.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when the ingredient lot was released for use in production based on passing test results.

attributes.name: retest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test result is a retest of a previously failed or inconclusive test.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the test result was reviewed and approved by quality assurance.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality assurance reviewer who verified and approved the test result.

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the sample was collected from the ingredient lot for laboratory testing.

attributes.name: specification_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable value for the test parameter as defined in the ingredient specification. Null if no upper limit applies.

attributes.name: specification_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable value for the test parameter as defined in the ingredient specification. Null if no lower limit applies.

attributes.name: specification_target
attributes.description: Target or nominal value for the test parameter. Represents the ideal value within the acceptable range.

attributes.name: test_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the laboratory test was completed and results were finalized.

attributes.name: test_cost
attributes.description: Cost incurred for performing the laboratory test. Used for quality cost tracking and analysis.

attributes.name: test_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the test cost amount.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory test was performed. Principal business event timestamp for the test result.

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: Specific analytical method or protocol used to perform the test (e.g., AOAC 991.14, USP 621, ISO 4833). References standardized laboratory procedures.

attributes.name: test_parameter
attributes.description: Specific characteristic or property being measured (e.g., Total Plate Count, pH, Moisture Content, Brix, Salmonella, Aflatoxin).

attributes.name: test_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the test based on business urgency or regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: test_result_value

products.name: supplier_document

products.name: substitution
products.description: Approved ingredient substitution record defining authorized alternative raw materials that can replace a primary ingredient in a formulation when the primary is unavailable or out-of-spec. Captures primary raw material reference, substitute raw material reference, substitution type (full, partial, emergency), maximum substitution percentage, functional equivalence notes, sensory impact assessment (none, minor, significant), regulatory review required flag, approval status, approved by, and effective date range. Supports supply continuity planning and manufacturing flexibility.
products.reference: PLM Formulation Management — Approved Ingredient Substitution

attributes.name: substitution_id
attributes.description: Primary key for substitution

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Ingredient substitution approvals are signed by a responsible employee; approver_employee_id captures who authorized the substitution.

attributes.name: substitution_raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary raw material or ingredient that is being substituted. Links to the ingredient master data.

attributes.name: substitution_substitute_ingredient_raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved alternative raw material or ingredient that can replace the primary ingredient. Links to the ingredient master data.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: REQUIRED: Substitution approval workflow records which supplier provides the approved substitute ingredient.

attributes.name: allergen_equivalence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute ingredient has the same allergen profile as the primary ingredient. True = same allergen declaration, False = different allergen profile requiring label review.
attributes.references: FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) Allergen Control

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution rule was formally approved and authorized for use in production.

attributes.name: clean_label_compatible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute ingredient maintains clean label status (free from artificial additives, preservatives, and highly processed ingredients). Critical for products marketed as natural or clean label.

attributes.name: coa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis must be provided with each batch of the substitute ingredient. True for ingredients with critical quality or safety parameters.

attributes.name: cost_impact_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in raw material cost when using the substitute versus the primary ingredient. Positive values indicate cost increase, negative values indicate cost savings. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the substitution record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution rule expires or is no longer valid. Nullable for permanent substitutions. Used for temporary or emergency substitutions with defined time limits.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the substitution rule becomes active and can be used in manufacturing operations. Supports phased implementation and supply chain planning.

attributes.name: functional_equivalence_notes

attributes.name: gmo_status_match_flag

attributes.name: label_change_required_flag

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: manufacturing_impact_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes on how the substitution affects manufacturing processes, including equipment settings, processing times, temperature adjustments, and yield impacts.

attributes.name: maximum_substitution_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of the primary ingredient that can be replaced by the substitute in a formulation. Range 0.00 to 100.00. Critical for maintaining product quality and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the substitution rule. Calculated based on last review date and review frequency.

attributes.name: organic_certification_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute ingredient maintains the same organic certification status as the primary ingredient. Critical for products with USDA Organic or equivalent certifications.

attributes.name: priority_rank

attributes.name: regulatory_review_required_flag

attributes.name: review_frequency_days

attributes.name: sensory_impact_assessment

None = no detectable difference, Minor = slight variation within acceptable range, Moderate = noticeable but acceptable, Significant = substantial change requiring consumer testing.

attributes.name: substitution_code

attributes.name: substitution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the substitution rule. Tracks approval workflow and operational readiness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_review|approved|active|suspended|expired|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: substitution_type

products.name: cost
products.description: Single Source of Truth for all raw material pricing and cost data — current standard costs, contract prices, spot prices, AND complete historical purchase price records by supplier and purchasing organization. Captures standard cost per UOM, moving average price, last purchase price, planned price, contract price, spot price, index-linked price, invoice price, cost/price currency, validity period (from/to date), price type (standard, contract, spot, index-linked, historical), plant code, purchasing organization, supplier reference, commodity index reference (CME corn futures, ICE sugar, CBOT wheat), cost variance vs. standard, price variance vs. prior period, and price effective/expiry dates for time-series analysis. This is the SOLE authoritative source for both current and historical ingredient pricing — no other product in any domain stores raw material price records. Supports COGS calculation, formulation cost modeling, procurement negotiation benchmarking, commodity cost trend analysis, standard cost update cycles, and year-over-year price variance reporting. Sourced from SAP MM/CO standard cost estimates, purchase order history, and Oracle Procurement.
products.reference: SAP MM/CO Standard Cost Estimate — Raw Material Costing

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cost record was approved by the authorized approver. Part of cost governance and audit trail.

attributes.name: commodity_index_reference

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the purchasing contract number under which this cost is negotiated. Applies when price_type is contract.

attributes.name: contract_price
attributes.description: Negotiated contract price per unit of measure agreed with the supplier. Applies when price_type is contract.

attributes.name: cost_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this cost record: active (currently in use), pending (approved but not yet effective), expired (past expiry_date), superseded (replaced by newer record), or draft (not yet approved).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the cost is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: duty_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Import duty or tariff cost per unit of measure for this ingredient. Applies to imported raw materials and contributes to landed cost.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost record becomes valid and applicable for procurement and costing purposes. Start of the validity period.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost record ceases to be valid. End of the validity period. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_unit

attributes.name: incoterms_code

attributes.name: index_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the commodity index value to calculate the index-linked price. Used in formula: price = index_value * index_multiplier + base_adjustment.

attributes.name: invoice_price
attributes.description: Actual invoiced price per unit of measure from the supplier invoice. Represents the final settled price including any adjustments.

attributes.name: is_current_cost

attributes.name: landed_cost_per_unit

attributes.name: last_purchase_price

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity

attributes.name: moving_average_price

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Aligns with SAP payment terms master data.

attributes.name: planned_price
attributes.description: Forecasted or budgeted price per unit of measure for future procurement planning and cost modeling.

attributes.name: plant_code

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost record indicating the pricing mechanism: standard (standard cost estimate), contract (negotiated contract price), spot (market spot price), index_linked (commodity index-based price), moving_average (rolling average price), planned (forecasted future price), or historical (actual past purchase price). attributes.description: Percentage variance between current and prior period price, calculated as ((current_price - prior_price) / prior_price) * 100. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 5.25 for 5.25%).

attributes.name: price_variance_vs_prior_period
attributes.description: Variance between the current period price and the prior period price for the same ingredient and supplier. Used for trend analysis and price escalation tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the purchase order for this ingredient. Five-digit line item number.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order number associated with this cost record for historical purchase price records. Ten-digit SAP purchase order number.

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the purchasing organization responsible for procuring this ingredient. Aligns with SAP purchasing organization structure.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost record was first created in the data product. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost record was last modified or updated. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this cost record was sourced: SAP_MM (Material Management), SAP_CO (Controlling/Product Costing), Oracle_Procurement, Manual_Entry (manually entered by procurement), or Market_Feed (commodity market data feed).

attributes.name: spot_price

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for which the cost is expressed (e.g., KG for kilogram, LB for pound, LT for liter, EA for each). Aligns with SAP UOM master data.

attributes.name: update_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for the cost update or change (e.g., annual contract renewal, commodity price increase, supplier negotiation, standard cost cycle update).
