products.name: fsma_traceability
products.description: FSMA Section 204 Key Data Element (KDE) traceability record capturing Critical Tracking Events (CTEs) required for FDA Food Traceability Rule compliance for foods on the Food Traceability List (FTL). Captures CTE type (receiving, transformation, shipping), traceability lot code (TLC), TLC source reference, location description (FDA facility registration number, GLN), date of CTE, quantity and UOM, reference document type (BOL, PO, production record, ASN), reference document number, immediate previous source (IPS), and KDE data elements per FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S. This domain owns the ingredient-receiving CTE; manufacturing and distribution domains own transformation and shipping CTEs respectively. Enables 24-hour FDA traceability response capability as mandated by FSMA 204 (compliance deadline January 2026). Sourced from SAP Batch Management, TraceGains, and dedicated traceability platforms (FoodLogiQ, Rfxcel).

attributes.name: immediate_previous_source_phone

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: location_description

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: packing_date

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S - Key Data Elements for Specific Foods

attributes.name: product_description

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S - Key Data Elements

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the source document supporting this traceability record. Links the CTE to the originating business transaction or production event.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S - Reference Documents

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of source document supporting this traceability record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BOL|PO|ASN|production_record|COA|receiving_report|batch_record|shipping_manifest — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S - Reference Documents

attributes.name: tlc_source

attributes.name: tlc_source_reference

attributes.name: traceability_lot_code

attributes.name: traceability_plan_version

attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S - Traceability Plan

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., kg, lbs, gallons, cases). Required KDE for FSMA 204 compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S - Key Data Elements

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when this traceability record was last verified for accuracy and completeness. Supports audit readiness for FDA inspections.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of data verification for this traceability record. Indicates whether the record has been validated against source documents and supplier data.

products.name: religious_cert
products.description: Halal and Kosher certification record for a raw material from a specific supplier, capturing certification type (Halal, Kosher Pareve, Kosher Dairy, Kosher Meat, Kosher Passover), certifying body (Islamic Food and Nutrition Council, Orthodox Union, OK Kosher, Star-K, MUI, JAKIM), certificate number, certified scope, certificate issue date, certificate expiry date, renewal status, and digital certificate reference. Supports religious dietary compliance claims on finished goods and retailer/foodservice customer requirements.
products.reference: OU Kosher / IFANCA Halal — Religious Dietary Certification

attributes.name: religious_cert_id
attributes.description: Primary key for religious_cert

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Halal/Kosher certification approvals are signed off by a certifying employee; linking enables certification audit trails.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material or ingredient that is certified under this religious certification.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier providing the certified ingredient. Religious certifications are supplier-specific as different suppliers of the same ingredient may have different certification statuses.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certified ingredient was approved for use in production by internal quality or regulatory teams.

attributes.name: approved_for_use_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certified ingredient from this supplier is approved for use in production. True indicates approval; False indicates the certification exists but ingredient is not yet approved for use (e.g., pending internal review).

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent audit or inspection conducted by the certifying body to verify ongoing compliance with religious dietary standards.

attributes.name: certificate_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the digital copy of the certification certificate stored in the document management system. Enables traceability and audit support.

attributes.name: certificate_document_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) or hyperlink to access the digital certificate document. May point to internal document management system or external certifying body portal.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number or identifier issued by the certifying body. This is the externally-known business identifier for the certification.

attributes.name: certification_standard
attributes.description: The specific religious dietary standard or guideline under which the certification was granted. May reference specific Halal standards (e.g., MS 1500, SMIIC) or Kosher standards (e.g., OU standards, Star-K guidelines).
attributes.references: SMIIC Standards and Metrology Institute for Islamic Countries, MS 1500 Malaysian Halal Standard

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the religious certification. Active indicates the certification is valid and in effect. Expired indicates the certificate has passed its expiry date. Suspended indicates temporary hold. Pending Renewal indicates renewal process is underway. Revoked indicates certification was withdrawn. Under Review indicates certification is being audited or reassessed.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of religious dietary certification. Halal certifies compliance with Islamic dietary law. Kosher certifications include Pareve (neutral, contains no meat or dairy), Dairy (contains dairy or dairy equipment), Meat (contains meat or meat equipment), and Passover (meets additional Passover requirements).
attributes.references: Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America (IFANCA), Orthodox Union (OU)

attributes.name: certified_ingredient_name
attributes.description: The ingredient name as it appears on the religious certification certificate. May differ slightly from internal ingredient naming conventions.

attributes.name: certified_scope
attributes.description: Description of what is covered under this certification. May include specific production facilities, processes, product forms, or lot ranges that are certified.

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or authority that issued the religious certification. Examples include Islamic Food and Nutrition Council (IFNC), Orthodox Union (OU), OK Kosher Certification, Star-K, Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI), Department of Islamic Development Malaysia (JAKIM).

attributes.name: certifying_body_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or abbreviation for the certifying body. Examples: OU, OK, STAR-K, IFANCA, MUI, JAKIM. Used for efficient filtering and reporting.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: General free-text field for additional comments, notes, or context related to this religious certification that do not fit in other structured fields.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special conditions related to the religious certification. May include audit findings, special handling requirements, or restrictions.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country where the certified ingredient was produced or sourced. Religious certification requirements may vary by country of origin.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this certification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the religious certification becomes valid and can be used for compliance claims. May differ from issue date if there is a grace period or delayed activation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the religious certification expires and is no longer valid. Ingredients cannot be used with certification claims after this date unless renewed.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the religious certification certificate was issued by the certifying body.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent internal review of this certification record. Used to track compliance with review frequency requirements.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this certification record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Specific lot or batch number of the ingredient covered by this certification, if the certification is lot-specific. Supports traceability for FSMA Food Safety Modernization Act compliance.
attributes.references: FSMA Food Safety Modernization Act, FDA Food and Drug Administration

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next audit or inspection by the certifying body. Used for planning and ensuring continuous compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next internal review of this certification. Calculated based on last_review_date and review_frequency_days. Supports proactive compliance management.

attributes.name: non_compliance_details
attributes.description: Description of any non-compliance issues, deviations, or corrective actions required. Populated when non_compliance_flag is True.

attributes.name: non_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any non-compliance issues have been identified with this certification. True indicates non-compliance detected; False indicates no issues. Triggers investigation and corrective action.

attributes.name: production_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or facility where the certified ingredient is produced. May include state, province, or specific production site information.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was last renewed or is scheduled for renewal. Used for tracking renewal cycles and planning.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Status of the certification renewal process. Tracks whether renewal is required, underway, completed, or overdue. Critical for maintaining continuous certification coverage.

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled reviews of this certification. Defines the review cycle for ongoing compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this certification record in the source operational system. Enables cross-reference and reconciliation between lakehouse and source systems.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this certification record originated. Examples: TraceGains, SAP QM Quality Management, Veeva Vault. Supports data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: traceability_code
attributes.description: Unique traceability identifier linking this certification to supply chain traceability systems. Enables end-to-end tracking from raw material to finished goods for recall and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: FSMA Food Safety Modernization Act, GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was last verified or validated by internal quality assurance or regulatory teams. Supports ongoing compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who performed the most recent verification of the certification. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: ingredient_price_history
products.description: Historical purchase price record for each raw material by supplier and purchasing organization, capturing invoice price, contract price, spot price, price UOM, currency, effective date, expiry date, price type (contract, spot, index-linked), commodity index reference (e.g., CME corn futures, ICE sugar), and price variance vs. prior period. Supports commodity cost trend analysis, procurement negotiation benchmarking, and standard cost update cycles. Sourced from SAP MM purchase order history and Oracle Procurement.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchase Info Record / Oracle Procurement — Price History

attributes.name: ingredient_price_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each ingredient price history record.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Contract pricing management tracks historical ingredient prices per customer account for price‑agreement compliance and renegotiation.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id

attributes.name: raw_material_id

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price was approved for use in procurement transactions.

attributes.name: baseline_price
attributes.description: The baseline or reference price used for variance calculation. May represent prior period price, budget price, or standard cost.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, context, or special conditions related to this price record.

attributes.name: commodity_index_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the commodity index used for index-linked pricing (e.g., CME corn futures, ICE sugar No. 11, CBOT soybean oil). Enables tracking of price correlation to market indices.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The procurement contract number under which this price was agreed, if applicable.

attributes.name: contract_price
attributes.description: The negotiated contract price for this ingredient, if a contract is in place. May differ from invoice price due to adjustments or spot purchases.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this price history record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the price is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this price becomes effective and applicable for procurement transactions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price expires and is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended price agreement.

attributes.name: freight_cost_included_flag

attributes.name: incoterms

attributes.name: index_value
attributes.description: The value of the commodity index at the time this price was set, if index-linked pricing is used.

attributes.name: invoice_price

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this price history record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: lead_time_days

attributes.name: moq

attributes.name: negotiation_reference

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: price_approval_status

attributes.name: price_change_reason

attributes.name: price_condition_type

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: The source system or document from which this price record was captured (e.g., purchase order, contract, purchasing info record, invoice, market data feed, manual entry).

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this price record: active (currently in use), expired (past expiry date), superseded (replaced by newer price), pending (not yet effective), or cancelled (voided).

attributes.name: price_validity_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market for which this price is valid (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC). Supports multi-region procurement operations.

attributes.name: price_variance_amount

attributes.name: price_variance_percentage

attributes.name: tax_included_flag

products.name: material_asset_cleaning

Each record links one raw material to one asset and captures attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: Each raw material can be processed on many production assets and each asset can handle many raw materials. The company tracks cleaning frequency, cross‑contact risk level, and the last cleaned date for every material‑asset pair to ensure allergen control and GMP compliance. This relationship is actively managed and recorded by operators.

domains.name: manufacturing
domains.description: Manages production execution data including batch records, production orders, work centers, MES data (Aveva/Wonderware), OEE metrics, line performance, changeovers, GMP compliance events, HACCP critical control point logs, co-packing and toll manufacturing arrangements, production scheduling, and FIFO/FEFO inventory consumption with lot traceability.
domains.references: GMP, HACCP, ISO 22000, ISO 9001, MES Standards

products.name: production_order
products.description: Core manufacturing execution record representing a discrete production run, work order, or rework order issued against a finished goods SKU or semi-finished intermediate — serving as the complete lifecycle record from creation through confirmation and closure. Captures order type (standard, rework, trial), planned vs. actual quantities, scheduled start/end times, actual start/end times, production line assignment, shift, batch size, yield, scrap, rework quantities, order status (created, released, in-progress, confirmed, technically complete, closed), SAP PP production order number, MES work order reference, BOM version used, routing version, cost center, plant code, FIFO/FEFO lot consumption flags, rework reason code and originating order reference (if rework type), rework yield and disposition (if rework), confirmation number, confirmed quantity, yield variance percentage, scrap quantity confirmed, rework quantity confirmed, confirmation type (partial, final), goods movement document number, confirming operator ID, and confirmation datetime. Primary transactional anchor for manufacturing execution in SAP S/4HANA PP module. Rework orders are modeled as production orders with type=rework per SAP PP standard. Confirmations (CO11N) are lifecycle events on this entity — each production order carries its own confirmation records including partial and final confirmations, goods movements, and yield variance calculations.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production order. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Production Order Master

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Required for Order‑to‑Production traceability; production orders originate from customer sales orders, so linking to account enables order fulfillment reporting.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand performance report requires linking each production order to its brand for tracking volume and cost per brand.

attributes.name: carbon_footprint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_footprint. Business justification: Regulatory GHG reporting requires linking each production order to its calculated carbon footprint for traceability.

attributes.name: co_packer_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Co‑packer supplier must be recorded for FDA/HACCP traceability and allergen control.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for Manufacturing Cost Allocation Report to allocate production costs to the correct cost center; cost_center string is denormalized and replaced.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.demand_plan. Business justification: Production orders are created from demand plans; linking enables S&OP reconciliation and demand‑supply variance analysis.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID or badge number of the production operator or supervisor who posted the confirmation transaction.

attributes.name: formulation_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.formulation_version. Business justification: Manufacturing must reference the exact R&D formulation version approved for the SKU to satisfy compliance and quality audits.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Linking production_order to plant centralizes plant metadata and removes the redundant plant_code string.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Production order release requires verified product registration to ensure compliance with FDA/USDA regulations.

attributes.name: production_shift_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.production_shift. Business justification: Required for assigning each production order to a specific shift, enabling shift‑based labor planning and OTIF performance reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Supports Profitability Analysis per production order, linking manufacturing output to finance profit_center for reporting.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: Production Planning uses Promotion Events to drive order quantities; linking enables the Production Planning Report to allocate capacity to specific promotions.

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_contract. Business justification: Production runs are executed under specific supplier contracts; linking enables contract compliance reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: OTIF and cost tracking require linking each production order to the originating purchase order.

attributes.name: quality_haccp_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.haccp_plan. Business justification: HACCP plan execution is tracked per production order for compliance reporting and audit traceability.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Regulatory & cost reporting requires each production order to be linked to its originating R&D project for traceability and budgeting.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Order fulfillment process requires linking each production order to the originating sales order for traceability and scheduling.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished goods SKU or semi-finished intermediate being produced in this order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.work_center. Business justification: A production order is executed on a specific work center; linking to work_center provides hierarchy and eliminates the free‑text production_line column.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when production execution was completed and final confirmation posted. Captured from MES or CO11N transaction.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when production execution began on the shop floor. Captured from MES or manual confirmation.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: Standard or planned batch size for this production run. Represents the nominal production lot size for the SKU on the assigned line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Batch Management

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the BOM used for this production order. Ensures traceability of ingredient and component specifications used in production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - BOM Master

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: SAP PP confirmation document number generated by CO11N transaction. Links to detailed confirmation records including time, quantity, and goods movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Order Confirmation (CO11N)

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the production confirmation was posted in SAP PP via CO11N transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Confirmation Posting

attributes.name: confirmation_type
attributes.description: Type of production confirmation: partial (interim confirmation during production run) or final (completion confirmation closing the order).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Confirmation Processing

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity confirmed as produced via CO11N confirmation transaction. Represents good output quantity posted to inventory.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Order Confirmation (CO11N)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the production order record was first created in SAP S/4HANA PP system. Represents the beginning of the order lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Order Creation

attributes.name: fefo_lot_consumption_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Lot Consumption Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether raw material lot consumption for this order followed FEFO inventory management rules (consuming lots with nearest expiration first). True if FEFO was enforced, False otherwise. Critical for perishable food and beverage ingredients.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: fifo_lot_consumption_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Lot Consumption Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether raw material lot consumption for this order followed FIFO inventory management rules. True if FIFO was enforced, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Inventory Management Strategy

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this production order was executed in full compliance with GMP requirements. True if all GMP critical control points were met and documented, False if any deviations occurred.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: goods_movement_document
attributes.description: SAP MM material document number for the goods receipt posting (MIGO 101 movement type) that moved confirmed quantity into finished goods inventory.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Goods Movement

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_log_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Critical Control Point (CCP) Log Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the HACCP CCP monitoring log for this production order. Links to detailed records of critical control point measurements (temperature, pH, time, etc.) taken during production.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the production order record was last updated in the source system. Tracks the most recent change to order header data, status, or confirmations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Change Management

attributes.name: mes_work_order_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Work Order Reference
attributes.description: Work order identifier from Aveva/Wonderware MES system. Provides linkage between SAP PP production order and detailed MES execution records including real-time process data, equipment performance, and operator actions.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: SAP PP production order number - the externally-known business identifier for this manufacturing execution record. Typically 10-12 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Production Order Header

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production order: created (order created but not released to shop floor), released (released for execution), in_progress (active production), confirmed (production completed and confirmed via CO11N), technically_complete (all confirmations and goods movements posted), closed (order financially settled and closed), cancelled (order cancelled before completion). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|released|in_progress|confirmed|technically_complete|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Order Status Management

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production order: standard (regular production run), rework (reprocessing of non-conforming product), trial (R&D or NPD pilot batch), co-pack (third-party manufacturing arrangement), toll (toll manufacturing arrangement where customer provides materials).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Order Type Configuration

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Target quantity to be produced as specified in the production order header. Measured in base unit of measure for the SKU.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Order Header Quantity

attributes.name: rework_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition of reworked material: reprocessed (successfully reworked to original spec), downgraded (reworked to lower-grade product), scrapped (could not be salvaged), returned_to_vendor (raw material defect). Applicable only when order_type is rework.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module - Disposition Decision

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of product requiring rework or reprocessing. This quantity is typically moved to a rework order for corrective processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Rework Management

attributes.name: rework_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for rework when order_type is rework. Examples: quality defect, packaging error, labeling error, contamination, off-spec product. Null for non-rework orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module - Defect Catalog

attributes.name: routing_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the production routing or recipe used for this order. Defines the sequence of operations and process parameters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Routing Master

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for production order execution as determined by production scheduling or SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Production Scheduling

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for production order execution as determined by production scheduling or SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Production Scheduling

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of product scrapped or discarded during production due to quality defects, process failures, or other non-conformances. Measured in base unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Scrap Confirmation

attributes.name: shift
attributes.description: Shift during which the production order was executed: day, evening, night, or weekend shift.

attributes.name: toll_manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the toll manufacturing partner when order_type is toll. In toll arrangements, the customer provides raw materials and the toll manufacturer provides processing services. Null for non-toll orders.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for all quantities on this order (e.g., KG for kilograms, EA for each, LB for pounds, CS for cases). ISO standard unit codes.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Actual yield percentage calculated as (confirmed_quantity / planned_quantity) * 100. Measures production efficiency and material utilization.

attributes.name: yield_variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance between planned and actual yield, calculated as (actual_yield - planned_yield) / planned_yield * 100. Positive values indicate over-yield, negative values indicate under-yield.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Variance Analysis

products.name: batch_record
products.description: Electronic batch record (EBR) capturing the complete manufacturing history of a single production batch from raw material dispensing through finished goods release. Includes batch number (lot number), batch size, unit of measure, manufacturing date, expiry date, best-before date, shelf life days, batch status (in-process, pending QA, released, rejected, quarantine), GMP compliance flag, HACCP sign-off status, deviation count, operator IDs, line supervisor sign-off, co-packer flag, toll manufacturing flag, and regulatory hold indicator. Serves as the legal manufacturing record per FDA 21 CFR Part 211 and GMP requirements. Sourced from Aveva/Wonderware MES Batch Management module.
products.reference: EBR / FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Batch Record

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the electronic batch record. Primary key for the batch record entity. Serves as the system-generated surrogate key for tracking manufacturing batch execution history.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

attributes.name: co_packer_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the co-packer supplier who manufactured this batch. Populated only when co_packer_flag is True. Links to supplier master data for contract terms and quality agreements.
attributes.references: Supplier Master Data, TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved formulation (recipe) used for this batch. Links to the bill of materials and ingredient specifications.

attributes.name: formulation_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.formulation_version. Business justification: Batch traceability to the specific R&D formulation version used is required for product recall, shelf‑life, and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_shipment. Business justification: Batch traceability to the inbound shipment is required for recall, quality investigation, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Inspection results are recorded per batch; linking enables release decisions and traceability of quality inspections.

attributes.name: primary_batch_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary production operator responsible for executing this batch. Used for accountability, training verification, and performance tracking.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order that authorized this batch manufacturing run. Links the batch record to the planning and scheduling system.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: Batch records must be tied to the Promotion Event they fulfill for traceability, ROI analysis, and regulatory reporting of promotional batches.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Batch traceability to the source PO is required for recalls and cost allocation.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished goods SKU being manufactured in this batch. Identifies the specific product variant produced.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this batch was produced. Critical for multi-site traceability and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: tertiary_batch_qa_reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality assurance professional who reviewed and approved this batch for release. Required for batch disposition decision and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: waste_generation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.waste_generation. Business justification: Waste generation reports are produced per batch; linking batch_record to waste_record enables accurate waste accounting.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production line or work center where this batch was manufactured. Identifies the physical manufacturing resource.

attributes.name: actual_yield_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of finished goods produced and approved from this batch. May differ from batch size due to process losses, quality rejections, or overproduction.

attributes.name: allergen_statement
attributes.description: The allergen declaration for this batch as it appears on the product label. Lists all major allergens present (milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame) and may-contain statements for cross-contact allergens. Critical for consumer safety and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act), FDA 21 CFR Part 101.22

attributes.name: batch_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or special instructions related to this batch. May include process notes, quality observations, equipment issues, or other relevant information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a specific production batch. Also known as lot number. This is the externally-known business identifier used for traceability, recall management, and regulatory compliance. Must be unique across all production facilities and time periods.

attributes.name: batch_size_quantity
attributes.description: The planned or target quantity of finished goods to be produced in this batch. Represents the theoretical yield based on the formulation and production order.

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the batch record. Tracks the batch through manufacturing execution, quality approval, and release stages. In-process indicates active manufacturing; pending QA indicates awaiting quality approval; released indicates approved for distribution; rejected indicates failed quality checks; quarantine indicates isolated pending investigation; on hold indicates regulatory or quality hold.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192 - Production Record Review, GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: best_before_date
attributes.description: The date until which the product is expected to retain optimal quality characteristics. May differ from expiry date. Used for quality assurance and consumer guidance. Common in food and beverage products where safety extends beyond optimal quality period.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969, FDA Guidance on Food Labeling

attributes.name: co_packer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch was manufactured by a third-party co-packer (contract manufacturer) rather than in-house. True indicates co-packer production; False indicates internal manufacturing. Critical for supply chain visibility and quality accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this batch record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.
attributes.references: Data Governance Policy, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: deviation_count
attributes.description: The total number of manufacturing deviations, exceptions, or non-conformances recorded during batch execution. Includes process parameter excursions, equipment failures, and procedural deviations. Zero indicates perfect execution. Used for quality trending and CAPA analysis.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.192, ISO 9001:2015 - Nonconformity and Corrective Action

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the product should not be consumed or used. Calculated based on manufacturing date plus shelf life days. Critical for FEFO inventory management and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137, Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969

attributes.name: gluten_free_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch carries a gluten-free claim on the label. True indicates gluten-free claim present; False indicates no claim. Must meet FDA gluten-free standard of less than 20 ppm gluten. Requires testing and validation.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch was manufactured in full compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice requirements. True indicates all GMP controls were met; False indicates GMP deviations occurred. Critical for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice, WHO GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: haccp_signoff_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Sign-Off Status
attributes.description: Status of HACCP critical control point verification and approval for this batch. Indicates whether all critical control points were monitored and within acceptable limits. Pending indicates awaiting review; approved indicates all CCPs passed; rejected indicates CCP failure; not applicable for products not requiring HACCP.

attributes.name: halal_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is certified halal per Islamic dietary law. True indicates halal certified; False indicates not certified. Requires halal certificate and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Halal Certification Standards (IFANCA, HFA, JAKIM, etc.)

attributes.name: kosher_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is certified kosher by a recognized kosher certification agency. True indicates kosher certified; False indicates not certified. Requires kosher certificate and supervision records.
attributes.references: Kosher Certification Standards (OU, OK, Star-K, etc.)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this batch record was last updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes and data lineage.
attributes.references: Data Governance Policy, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The calendar date of batch production. This is the date printed on product labels and used for regulatory compliance. Typically the date manufacturing started or the date the batch was completed, per company policy.

attributes.name: manufacturing_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when batch manufacturing execution was completed. Marks the completion of all processing steps and final packaging. Used for cycle time analysis and OEE calculation.

attributes.name: manufacturing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when batch manufacturing execution began. Marks the start of raw material dispensing and processing. Critical for shelf life calculation and FIFO/FEFO inventory management.

attributes.name: non_gmo_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is verified as non-genetically modified organism (non-GMO) by a third-party certification program. True indicates non-GMO verified; False indicates not verified or contains GMO ingredients.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Verification, EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: organic_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is certified organic per USDA NOP or equivalent organic standards. True indicates certified organic; False indicates conventional. Requires organic certificate and audit trail.
attributes.references: USDA NOP (National Organic Program) 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Description of the primary and secondary packaging used for this batch. Includes package type, size, and material. Examples: 12oz PET bottle 24-pack, 500g stand-up pouch, 1L Tetra Pak carton. Links to packaging specification.

attributes.name: parent_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch number of the original batch from which reworked material was sourced. Populated only when rework_flag is True. Maintains traceability chain for reworked batches.

attributes.name: qa_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the quality assurance reviewer approved this batch for release to distribution. Marks the transition from pending QA to released status.

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is under regulatory hold pending investigation or approval from regulatory authorities (FDA, USDA, etc.). True indicates hold in place; False indicates no regulatory restriction. Prevents distribution until cleared.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.204 - Returned Drug Products, FSMA Preventive Controls

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for regulatory hold. Populated only when regulatory_hold_flag is True. Documents the specific regulatory concern, investigation, or pending approval.

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch includes reworked material from a previous batch. True indicates rework present; False indicates all new material. Rework must be documented per GMP requirements.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days from manufacturing date to expiry date. Defines the product stability period. Used to calculate expiry and best before dates. Derived from product specification and stability studies.

attributes.name: sterilization_method
attributes.description: The thermal or non-thermal sterilization process applied to this batch. Pasteurization indicates low-temperature short-time treatment; UHT indicates ultra-high temperature; retort indicates in-container sterilization; aseptic indicates sterile processing and packaging; none indicates no sterilization (e.g., dry goods); other for alternative methods. Critical for food safety and shelf life.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 113 - Thermally Processed Low-Acid Foods, Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: toll_manufacturing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch was produced under a toll manufacturing arrangement where the company provides raw materials and the toll manufacturer provides processing services. True indicates toll manufacturing; False indicates standard production. Distinct from co-packing where the manufacturer may source materials.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for batch size and yield quantities. Common values include KG (kilograms), LB (pounds), L (liters), GAL (gallons), EA (each), CS (cases). Must align with SKU base unit of measure.

products.name: work_center
products.description: Master data for all production work centers, lines, and cells within manufacturing plants. Captures work center code, description, plant, production area, line type (mixing, filling, packaging, pasteurization, fermentation, extrusion, co-packing), rated capacity (units/hour), standard cycle time, setup time, teardown time, OEE target, minimum run size, maximum run size, allergen capability flags, kosher/halal certification flag, clean-in-place (CIP) required flag, work center status (active, maintenance, decommissioned), and MES asset tag. SSOT for production line master data used in scheduling and OEE reporting. Sourced from SAP PP work center master and Aveva/Wonderware MES.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work center. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.asset. Business justification: Work centers are major machines; linking to maintenance asset enables preventive maintenance scheduling and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial cost center to which production costs and overhead for this work center are allocated.

attributes.name: environmental_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.environmental_instrument. Business justification: Renewable Energy Certificates are allocated to specific equipment/work centers for compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this work center is located.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_line. Business justification: Work center is part of a production line; adding production_line_id links work_center to its line and provides needed connectivity.

attributes.name: responsible_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: scada_node_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Node ID
attributes.description: SCADA system node identifier for real-time monitoring and control of this work center's automation equipment.

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: Date when this work center became operational and available for production scheduling.

attributes.name: active_to_date
attributes.description: Date when this work center was decommissioned or taken out of service. Null for currently active work centers.

attributes.name: allergen_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center is capable of processing products containing major food allergens (milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans). Critical for allergen control and production scheduling.

attributes.name: allergen_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific allergen types that this work center is approved to handle (e.g., milk, peanuts, tree nuts, soy). Empty if allergen_capable_flag is false. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: milk|eggs|fish|shellfish|tree_nuts|peanuts|wheat|soybeans|sesame|sulfites — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: available_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Total available production hours per day for this work center based on shift pattern and planned maintenance windows.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the rated capacity (e.g., cases per hour, bottles per minute, pounds per hour). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cases|bottles|cans|pounds|kilograms|liters|gallons|pallets — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes required to switch from one product or SKU to another, including teardown, cleaning, setup, and validation. Key metric for production efficiency and scheduling.

attributes.name: cip_cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard duration in minutes for a complete CIP cleaning cycle on this work center. Null if CIP is not required.

attributes.name: cip_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center requires automated clean-in-place procedures between production runs. Critical for liquid processing, dairy, and beverage lines.

attributes.name: co_packing_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center is approved for co-packing or toll manufacturing operations for third-party brands.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: GMP hygiene classification level of the work center determining the sanitation, personnel, and environmental control requirements.

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Critical Control Point (CCP) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center contains one or more HACCP critical control points requiring continuous monitoring and documentation.
attributes.references: HACCP Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center is certified for halal food production by a recognized halal certification body.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center is certified for kosher food production by a recognized kosher certification agency.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive maintenance or major service performed on this work center.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work center by its primary production process type. Determines the type of operations and products that can be manufactured on this line. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mixing|filling|packaging|pasteurization|fermentation|extrusion|co-packing|blending|bottling|canning — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: maximum_run_size
attributes.description: Maximum production quantity that can be manufactured on this work center in a single run due to equipment, storage, or process constraints.

attributes.name: mes_asset_tag
attributes.description: Unique asset identifier used by the MES system (Aveva/Wonderware) to track real-time production data, OEE metrics, and equipment performance for this work center.

attributes.name: minimum_run_size
attributes.description: Minimum production quantity that can be economically manufactured on this work center in a single run. Used to enforce MOQ constraints in production scheduling.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance shutdown for this work center. Used for production scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: oee_target_percent
attributes.description: Target OEE percentage for this work center representing the product of availability, performance, and quality rates. Industry benchmark for world-class manufacturing is 85%.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center is certified for organic food production under USDA NOP or equivalent organic standards.

attributes.name: production_area
attributes.description: Physical production area or zone within the plant where the work center is located (e.g., Mixing Room, Filling Hall, Packaging Wing, Cold Storage).

attributes.name: rated_capacity_units_per_hour
attributes.description: Maximum theoretical production capacity of the work center expressed in units per hour under optimal operating conditions. Used for production planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: run_size_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for minimum and maximum run sizes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cases|bottles|cans|pounds|kilograms|liters|gallons|batches — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to prepare the work center for a production run, including equipment configuration, material staging, and pre-operational checks.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing and Work Center

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Standard operating shift pattern for this work center determining its available production hours per day.

attributes.name: standard_cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to produce one unit or batch on this work center under normal operating conditions. Used for production scheduling and costing.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing and Work Center

attributes.name: teardown_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to clean, sanitize, and restore the work center after a production run. Critical for GMP compliance and allergen control.

attributes.name: work_center_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the work center by its functional role in the manufacturing process.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the work center used in production planning and scheduling systems. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: work_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the work center including its purpose, capabilities, and operational characteristics.

attributes.name: work_center_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the work center for human identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: work_center_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the work center indicating its availability for production scheduling and execution.

products.name: production_schedule
products.description: Forward-looking production schedule records generated by the planning system (SAP IBP / JDA Blue Yonder) and executed via MES. Captures schedule version, planning horizon, scheduled production order reference, work center assignment, SKU, planned quantity, scheduled start datetime, scheduled end datetime, schedule status (draft, firmed, released, executed, cancelled), schedule source (MRP, manual, IBP), changeover time allocated, sequence number on line, and last replanning timestamp. Enables sequencing optimization, changeover minimization, and OTIF performance tracking.

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Needed for Production Planning report; schedules are built around specific customer orders, linking to account provides accurate capacity planning per customer.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier for a production campaign (a series of related production runs for similar products to minimize changeovers). Used in campaign-based manufacturing strategies.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production planner or planning team responsible for creating or maintaining this schedule entry.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Scheduling must verify product registration status to avoid producing non‑compliant SKUs.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order that this schedule entry is planning for. Links to the production order master data.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: Production schedules are aligned with Promotion Events to ensure capacity meets promotional demand; required for the Promotion Capacity Planning report.

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Schedules reference the approved product specification to ensure correct parameters and compliance during execution.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that is scheduled to be produced in this schedule entry.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the co-packing or toll manufacturing partner if this production is outsourced. Null if production is internal.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (production line, machine, or manufacturing cell) where this production is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: allergen_changeover_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether allergen-related line clearance and deep cleaning is required before this production run due to allergen matrix considerations.

attributes.name: batch_size_target
attributes.description: Target batch size for this production run, expressed in the same UOM as planned quantity. Used for batch manufacturing and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Planned utilization percentage of the work center's available capacity for this schedule entry. Used for capacity planning and bottleneck analysis.

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes
attributes.description: Allocated time in minutes for changeover activities (cleaning, setup, line clearance) before this production run. Critical for sequencing optimization and minimizing downtime.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: crew_size_required
attributes.description: Number of operators or crew members required to execute this production schedule entry. Used for labor capacity planning.

attributes.name: execution_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the actual production execution for this schedule entry was completed and confirmed by the MES. Used for schedule vs. actual performance analysis.

attributes.name: forecast_demand_quantity
attributes.description: The forecasted demand quantity that this schedule entry is intended to fulfill. Used for demand-driven planning and forecast accuracy tracking.

attributes.name: frozen_zone_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this schedule entry falls within the frozen planning horizon where changes are restricted to maintain schedule stability.

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Critical Control Point (CCP) Applicable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this production schedule entry involves HACCP Critical Control Points that require monitoring and documentation per food safety regulations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production schedule record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_replanning_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this schedule entry was last revised or replanned. Used for tracking schedule stability and replanning frequency.

attributes.name: lot_number_planned
attributes.description: Pre-assigned lot number for traceability purposes. Enables First In First Out (FIFO) and First Expired First Out (FEFO) inventory consumption tracking and lot genealogy.

attributes.name: material_availability_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether all required raw materials and ingredients are available for this scheduled production. Confirmed indicates full availability; partial indicates some materials available; pending indicates materials not yet checked; shortage indicates insufficient inventory.

attributes.name: otif_target_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Date
attributes.description: The target delivery date for On Time In Full (OTIF) performance measurement. Used to track schedule adherence and customer service level.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU planned to be produced in this schedule entry, expressed in the base unit of measure for the SKU.

attributes.name: planned_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the planned quantity (e.g., cases, kilograms, liters, pallets). Aligns with SKU base UOM.

attributes.name: planning_horizon
attributes.description: The planning time bucket or horizon this schedule belongs to (e.g., weekly, daily, shift-level). Indicates the granularity of the planning cycle.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this schedule entry. Critical indicates customer-committed or regulatory deadline; high indicates tight inventory; normal indicates standard planning; low indicates buffer or make-to-stock.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this production run requires in-process or post-production quality inspection per Quality Management (QM) protocols.

attributes.name: released_to_mes_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Released to Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this schedule entry was released to the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for execution. Marks the transition from planning to execution.

attributes.name: replanning_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the most recent replanning event (e.g., demand change, material shortage, equipment breakdown, customer request). Used for root cause analysis of schedule instability.

attributes.name: safety_stock_target
attributes.description: Target safety stock level that this production schedule entry is intended to maintain or replenish. Used for inventory optimization.

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments from the planner regarding special considerations, constraints, or instructions for this schedule entry.

attributes.name: schedule_source
attributes.description: Origin system or method that generated this schedule entry. MRP indicates Material Requirements Planning; manual indicates planner override; IBP indicates Integrated Business Planning system; demand_sensing indicates real-time demand signal; optimization indicates algorithmic sequencing.
attributes.references: SAP IBP / JDA Blue Yonder Planning Source

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production schedule entry. Draft indicates preliminary planning; firmed indicates committed plan; released indicates sent to MES for execution; executed indicates production completed; cancelled indicates schedule entry voided.

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the production schedule. Allows tracking of schedule revisions and replanning iterations (e.g., V1, V2, V2.1).

attributes.name: scheduled_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total planned production duration in minutes, including run time but excluding changeover time. Used for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) baseline calculations.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_datetime
attributes.description: The planned date and time when production for this schedule entry is expected to be completed. Used for capacity planning and On Time In Full (OTIF) tracking.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime
attributes.description: The planned date and time when production for this schedule entry is expected to begin. Used for capacity planning and sequencing.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: The order position of this schedule entry within the work center's production sequence for the planning period. Used for sequencing optimization and changeover minimization.

attributes.name: setup_instructions
attributes.description: Special setup or configuration instructions for the work center to execute this schedule entry. May reference standard operating procedures (SOPs) or work instructions.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the production shift during which this schedule entry is planned (e.g., Day, Night, Swing). Used for labor planning and shift performance analysis.

products.name: oee_event
products.description: Granular OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) event records captured from Aveva/Wonderware MES Performance Analytics module, encompassing all availability, performance, and quality loss events including unplanned line stoppages with full lifecycle tracking from occurrence through maintenance response to resolution. Each record represents a discrete loss event on a work center during a production run. Captures event type (downtime, speed loss, minor stoppage, quality reject, planned maintenance, changeover, mechanical failure, electrical fault, material shortage, utility failure, operator error, quality hold, sanitation hold), event start/end timestamp, duration minutes, loss category (planned/unplanned), loss reason code, fault code, equipment tag, stoppage category for downtime events, maintenance work order raised flag, maintenance work order number, production loss units, affected production order, work center, shift, operator-entered root cause, resolution action, operator-entered notes, and OEE component impacted (availability, performance, quality). This is the single source of truth for ALL production line downtime and loss events — both brief speed losses and extended stoppages requiring maintenance intervention. Foundation for OEE calculation, reliability KPIs, MTBF/MTTR analysis, and continuous improvement programs.

attributes.name: oee_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the OEE event record. Primary key for the OEE event entity.

attributes.name: equipment_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.equipment_master. Business justification: OEE events are tied to a specific equipment asset; linking to equipment_master gives full asset details and eliminates the loosely typed equipment_tag.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this OEE event occurred.

attributes.name: primary_oee_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production operator who was responsible for the work center when the event occurred.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order that was active when this OEE event occurred.

attributes.name: production_shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this OEE event occurred.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product (SKU) that was being manufactured when this OEE event occurred.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (production line or equipment) where this OEE event occurred.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The production batch or lot number that was being processed when the OEE event occurred, enabling full traceability per FIFO/FEFO requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OEE event record was first created in the MES system, representing when the event was initially captured.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the OEE loss event in minutes, calculated as the difference between event_end_timestamp and event_start_timestamp.

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the OEE loss event ended and normal production resumed, captured from the MES system.

attributes.name: event_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the source system that captured and reported this OEE event (e.g., Aveva Wonderware MES, SCADA system, manual entry).

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the OEE loss event began, captured from the MES system in real-time.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OEE event from occurrence through resolution. Tracks the event from initial detection through maintenance response to final closure.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the OEE loss event type. Determines which OEE component (availability, performance, quality) is impacted.

attributes.name: fault_code
attributes.description: Technical fault code or alarm code captured from the equipment control system at the time of the event, used for detailed troubleshooting and maintenance analysis.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OEE event triggered a GMP compliance review or documentation requirement. True if GMP review is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_impacted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Critical Control Point (CCP) Impacted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OEE event impacted a HACCP Critical Control Point, requiring food safety review and documentation. True if CCP was impacted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OEE event record was last updated, tracking changes to root cause, resolution actions, or status updates.

attributes.name: loss_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loss event was planned (scheduled maintenance, changeover) or unplanned (breakdown, quality issue, material shortage).

attributes.name: loss_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code from MES that categorizes the root cause of the loss event (e.g., mechanical failure, electrical fault, material shortage, utility failure, operator error, quality hold, sanitation hold).

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_number
attributes.description: The work order number from the maintenance management system if a maintenance work order was raised in response to this event. Null if no work order was created.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_raised_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a maintenance work order was created in response to this OEE event. True if a work order was raised, False otherwise.

attributes.name: oee_component_impacted
attributes.description: Identifies which of the three OEE components (availability, performance, quality) is primarily impacted by this loss event.

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the production operator providing additional context, observations, or details about the OEE event.

attributes.name: production_loss_units
attributes.description: Quantity of production units lost or not produced due to this OEE event, measured in the unit of measure of the product being manufactured.

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken to resolve the OEE event and restore normal production, entered by operator or maintenance personnel.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Operator-entered or maintenance technician-entered description of the root cause of the OEE loss event, captured for continuous improvement analysis.

attributes.name: stoppage_category
attributes.description: Detailed classification of downtime events into categories such as mechanical failure, electrical fault, material shortage, utility failure, operator error, quality hold, or sanitation hold. Applicable only when event_type is downtime.

products.name: changeover
products.description: Records each line changeover, sanitation, and cleaning event between or during production runs on a work center — serving as the single source of truth for all line clearance activities including both product changeovers and standalone sanitation events. Captures event type (flavor-to-flavor changeover, allergen-to-allergen, allergen-to-non-allergen, format change, CIP — Clean-in-Place, COP — Clean-out-of-Place, dry clean, full sanitation, allergen clean, scheduled sanitation, unscheduled sanitation), from-SKU, to-SKU, work center, plant, planned vs. actual duration, start/end timestamps, production order from/to, event status (planned, in-progress, completed, verified), CIP cycle completed flag, allergen clearance verified flag, sanitation procedure code, chemical agents used, concentration levels, rinse verification result, ATP swab test result, microbiological swab result (CFU count), pass/fail status, QA sign-off operator, sanitation crew lead, production clearance granted flag, deviation from standard time, and schedule reference. Critical for scheduling optimization, allergen management, GMP/HACCP/FSMA compliance, and line clearance verification.

attributes.name: changeover_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the changeover event. Primary key for the changeover data product.

attributes.name: changeover_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the QA (Quality Assurance) operator who signed off on the changeover verification.

attributes.name: changeover_production_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production order that was running before the changeover event.

attributes.name: changeover_production_order_to_production_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production order that will run after the changeover event.

attributes.name: changeover_sanitation_crew_lead_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the sanitation crew lead responsible for executing the changeover and cleaning procedures.

attributes.name: changeover_sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that was being produced before the changeover.

attributes.name: changeover_sku_to_sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that will be produced after the changeover.

attributes.name: plant_id
