attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing plant where the changeover occurred.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center or production line where the changeover occurred.

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual duration of the changeover event in minutes from start to completion.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual end date and time when the changeover event was completed in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual start date and time when the changeover event began in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: allergen_clearance_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether allergen clearance was verified and approved. True if verified, False if not applicable or not verified.

attributes.name: allergen_from
attributes.description: Allergen present in the SKU being produced before the changeover. Used for allergen management and clearance verification.
attributes.references: FDA Food and Drug Administration Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_to
attributes.description: Allergen present in the SKU being produced after the changeover. Used for allergen management and clearance verification.
attributes.references: FDA Food and Drug Administration Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: atp_rlu_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP) Relative Light Units (RLU) Value
attributes.description: Numeric RLU (Relative Light Units) value from the ATP swab test. Lower values indicate cleaner surfaces.

attributes.name: atp_swab_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the ATP (Adenosine Triphosphate) swab test used to detect organic contamination on surfaces.

attributes.name: cfu_count
attributes.description: CFU (Colony Forming Units) count from the microbiological swab test. Indicates the level of bacterial contamination.

attributes.name: chemical_agent_used
attributes.description: Name or code of the chemical cleaning agent used during the sanitation process.

attributes.name: chemical_concentration_percent
attributes.description: Concentration level of the chemical agent used, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: cip_cycle_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CIP (Clean-in-Place) cycle was completed successfully. True if completed, False if not applicable or incomplete.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the changeover record was first created in the system in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: deviation_minutes
attributes.description: Deviation from planned duration in minutes. Positive values indicate the changeover took longer than planned; negative values indicate it was faster.

attributes.name: deviation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining any deviations, issues, or special circumstances encountered during the changeover.

attributes.name: deviation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any deviation from the planned changeover duration or procedure.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the changeover event.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of changeover event. CIP = Clean-in-Place, COP = Clean-out-of-Place. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flavor_to_flavor|allergen_to_allergen|allergen_to_non_allergen|non_allergen_to_allergen|format_change|cip|cop|dry_clean|full_sanitation|allergen_clean|scheduled_sanitation|unscheduled_sanitation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the changeover record was last modified in the system in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: line_clearance_checklist_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the line clearance checklist was completed. True if completed, False if incomplete.

attributes.name: microbiological_swab_result
attributes.description: Result of the microbiological swab test to detect bacterial contamination.
attributes.references: HACCP Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points

attributes.name: overall_pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Overall pass or fail status of the changeover event based on all verification tests and procedures.

attributes.name: planned_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration of the changeover event in minutes based on standard operating procedures.

attributes.name: production_clearance_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether production clearance was granted to resume operations after the changeover. True if granted, False if pending or denied.

attributes.name: rinse_verification_result
attributes.description: Result of the rinse verification test to ensure all chemical residues have been removed.
attributes.references: HACCP Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points

attributes.name: sanitation_procedure_code
attributes.description: Standard operating procedure code for the sanitation method used during the changeover.

attributes.name: sanitation_type
attributes.description: Type of sanitation procedure performed during the changeover event. None indicates no sanitation was required.
attributes.references: HACCP Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points

attributes.name: schedule_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking the changeover event to the production schedule or planning system.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned end date and time for the changeover event in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned start date and time for the changeover event in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: haccp_ccp_log
products.description: Real-time and operator-entered log of HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) critical control point (CCP) monitoring records for each production batch. Captures CCP identifier, CCP name (e.g., pasteurization temperature, metal detection, pH check, Brix measurement), production order, batch number, work center, monitoring timestamp, measured value, unit of measure, critical limit lower bound, critical limit upper bound, in-limit flag, corrective action required flag, corrective action taken description, verified by operator ID, and regulatory hold triggered flag. Mandatory for FDA FSMA compliance and GFSI certification. Sourced from Aveva/Wonderware MES and manual entry. SSOT boundary: This entity owns real-time CCP monitoring readings and corrective actions during production execution. The quality domain owns the HACCP plan definition, hazard analysis, and CCP validation/verification programs.
products.reference: HACCP CCP Monitoring Log / FDA FSMA

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_log_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) CCP (Critical Control Point) Log ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the HACCP critical control point monitoring log entry. Primary key for the log record.

attributes.name: equipment_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific equipment or instrument used to perform the CCP monitoring (e.g., thermometer serial number, metal detector unit ID). Critical for calibration traceability.

attributes.name: primary_haccp_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator or quality technician who performed and verified the CCP monitoring. Establishes accountability and traceability for compliance audits.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order under which this CCP monitoring occurred. Links the CCP log to the manufacturing execution context.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production line where the CCP monitoring took place. Enables location-specific analysis of control point performance.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The production batch identifier for which this CCP monitoring was performed. Critical for lot traceability and recall management.

attributes.name: ccp_identifier
attributes.description: The unique code or identifier for the critical control point as defined in the HACCP plan (e.g., CCP-1, CCP-2-PASTEURIZE).

attributes.name: ccp_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the critical control point being monitored (e.g., Pasteurization Temperature, Metal Detection, pH Check, Brix Measurement, Allergen Verification).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context related to the CCP monitoring event. May include operator observations, environmental conditions, or other relevant details.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a corrective action is required based on the CCP monitoring result (True = corrective action needed, False = no action needed).

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action(s) taken in response to a CCP deviation. Documents the specific steps taken to bring the process back into control and disposition of affected product.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117.150, GFSI Corrective Action Requirements

attributes.name: critical_limit_lower
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable value for this CCP as defined in the HACCP plan. Values below this threshold indicate a deviation requiring corrective action.
attributes.references: HACCP Plan Critical Limits, FDA FSMA

attributes.name: critical_limit_upper
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable value for this CCP as defined in the HACCP plan. Values above this threshold indicate a deviation requiring corrective action.
attributes.references: HACCP Plan Critical Limits, FDA FSMA

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The origin of the CCP monitoring data (mes_automated = automatically captured from Aveva/Wonderware MES, manual_entry = operator-entered, laboratory_system = from LIMS, sensor_network = from IoT sensors).
attributes.references: MES Integration Standards, GMP Data Integrity

attributes.name: deviation_severity
attributes.description: Classification of the severity of the CCP deviation if one occurred (minor = slight deviation with low risk, major = significant deviation requiring investigation, critical = severe deviation with immediate food safety risk).
attributes.references: GFSI Deviation Management, FDA Risk-Based Preventive Controls

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: The category of food safety hazard that this CCP is designed to control (biological, chemical, physical, or allergen).
attributes.references: HACCP Principle 1 - Hazard Analysis, Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: in_limit_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the measured value falls within the defined critical limits (True = within limits, False = out of specification).

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual measured or observed value at the critical control point (e.g., temperature reading, pH level, Brix degree, metal detector sensitivity test result).

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency of monitoring for this CCP as defined in the HACCP plan (e.g., continuous, every 15 minutes, every batch, hourly).

attributes.name: monitoring_method
attributes.description: The method or procedure used to monitor this CCP (e.g., calibrated thermometer, pH meter, metal detector test, visual inspection, laboratory analysis).

attributes.name: monitoring_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the CCP measurement or observation was recorded. Critical for establishing real-time compliance and traceability.

attributes.name: product_disposition
attributes.description: The final disposition decision for product affected by this CCP monitoring event (released = approved for distribution, rework = reprocessed to meet specifications, reprocess = returned to earlier production step, destroyed = disposed of, quarantine = held pending investigation).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this CCP log record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data integrity and compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GMP Data Integrity

attributes.name: record_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this CCP log record was last modified. Critical for audit trail and data integrity compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GMP Data Integrity

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this CCP deviation triggered a regulatory hold on the batch, preventing release until investigation and disposition are complete (True = hold triggered, False = no hold).

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the supervisor or quality manager completed their review of this CCP log entry.

attributes.name: supervisor_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this CCP log entry requires supervisor or quality manager review due to deviation or other exceptional circumstances (True = review required, False = no review needed).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the measured value is expressed (e.g., Celsius, Fahrenheit, pH units, Brix degrees, ppm, CFU/g).

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the CCP monitoring record was verified and signed off by the responsible operator or quality personnel.

products.name: gmp_event
products.description: Records of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) compliance events, observations, and deviations captured during production operations. Captures event type (deviation, observation, non-conformance, corrective action, preventive action), severity level (critical, major, minor), event datetime, production order, batch number, work center, plant, description, root cause category, immediate action taken, CAPA reference number, regulatory reportable flag, FDA/USDA notification required flag, event status (open, under investigation, closed), and closure datetime. Supports GMP audit readiness and regulatory inspection response. Managed in Veeva Vault QMS. SSOT boundary: This entity owns production-floor GMP events and deviations observed during manufacturing execution. The quality domain owns GMP audit programs, audit findings, supplier GMP assessments, and CAPA lifecycle management.

attributes.name: gmp_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the GMP compliance event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the GMP event occurred. Supports multi-site compliance tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: primary_gmp_reported_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who reported or documented the GMP event. Supports accountability and recognition of quality culture.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order during which the GMP event occurred. Links the event to the specific manufacturing run.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product being manufactured when the GMP event occurred. Enables product-specific compliance tracking and risk assessment.

attributes.name: tertiary_gmp_closed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or quality manager who approved closure of the GMP event. Null if event is not yet closed.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production line where the GMP event was observed. Enables analysis of event patterns by production area.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number of the product being manufactured when the GMP event occurred. Critical for traceability and potential recall scenarios.

attributes.name: capa_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number linking this GMP event to a formal CAPA record in the quality management system. Null if no CAPA was initiated.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 9001, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: ccp_number
attributes.description: The specific HACCP Critical Control Point number if this event relates to a CCP. Null if the event does not involve a CCP.

attributes.name: closure_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time when the GMP event was formally closed after all corrective actions were verified as effective. Null if event is not yet closed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this GMP event record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: event_datetime
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Event Date and Time
attributes.description: The date and time when the GMP event was observed or occurred on the production floor. This is the actual event timestamp, distinct from when it was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the GMP event, typically formatted as GMP-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external reference and audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GMP event. Open indicates newly reported, under investigation indicates active root cause analysis, pending approval indicates awaiting management review, closed indicates investigation complete and actions implemented, cancelled indicates event was determined invalid or duplicate.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the GMP event indicating the nature of the compliance issue or action. Deviation indicates departure from approved procedures, observation is a potential issue noted, non-conformance is a failure to meet requirements, corrective action addresses existing problems, preventive action prevents potential problems, and near miss is an event that could have resulted in a deviation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements, ISO 22000

attributes.name: external_audit_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this GMP event to an external audit finding from FDA, USDA, GFSI auditor, or customer audit. Null if not related to an external audit.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: fda_notification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMP event requires specific notification to the FDA under food safety regulations. True if FDA notification is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual financial impact of the GMP event, including costs of rework, scrap, investigation, and potential regulatory penalties. Measured in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: gmp_event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the GMP event, including what was observed, the circumstances, and any immediate context. This field captures the full story of the event for investigation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Critical Control Point (CCP) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMP event occurred at or relates to a HACCP Critical Control Point. True if the event involves a CCP, false otherwise. Critical for food safety risk assessment.

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of the immediate containment or corrective actions taken at the time the GMP event was discovered. Documents the initial response to prevent further impact.

attributes.name: impact_assessment
attributes.description: Detailed assessment of the potential or actual impact of the GMP event on product quality, food safety, regulatory compliance, and business operations. Documents the risk evaluation performed.

attributes.name: investigation_completion_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time when the investigation of the GMP event was completed and root cause determined. Null if investigation is still in progress.

attributes.name: investigation_start_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time when formal investigation of the GMP event began. Used to track investigation cycle time and compliance with internal SLAs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this GMP event record was last updated in the data platform. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: previous_event_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the event number of a previous related GMP event if this is a recurrence. Null if this is a first occurrence or not linked to a prior event.

attributes.name: product_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the product batch affected by the GMP event. Released indicates product approved for distribution, rework indicates product requires reprocessing, regrade indicates product downgraded to alternate use, quarantine indicates product held pending further evaluation, destroy indicates product must be disposed of, under evaluation indicates disposition not yet determined.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, ISO 22000, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: quantity_affected
attributes.description: The quantity of product affected by the GMP event, measured in the product's base unit of measure. Used to assess the scale of impact and potential financial exposure.

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity affected field. Common units include kg (kilograms), lb (pounds), l (liters), gal (gallons), ea (each), case, or pallet. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|lb|l|gal|ea|case|pallet — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMP event is a recurrence of a previously documented event with the same or similar root cause. True if recurrence, false if first occurrence. Used to identify systemic issues.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMP event meets the criteria for mandatory reporting to regulatory authorities such as FDA or USDA. True if reportable, false otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, FSMA, USDA FSIS Regulations

attributes.name: reported_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time when the GMP event was formally reported and recorded in the quality management system. May differ from event_datetime if there was a delay in reporting.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause of the GMP event. Used for trend analysis and identification of systemic issues requiring corrective action. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|human_error|material_defect|process_deviation|environmental_condition|documentation_error|training_gap|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Event Severity Level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the GMP event. Critical indicates potential for serious harm to consumers or significant regulatory impact, major indicates substantial deviation from GMP requirements, and minor indicates low-impact deviation with minimal risk.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: usda_notification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMP event requires specific notification to the USDA, typically for meat, poultry, or egg product manufacturing. True if USDA notification is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the master document record in Veeva Vault QMS where the complete GMP event investigation file, attachments, and audit trail are stored.

products.name: lot_consumption
products.description: Transactional records of raw material, ingredient, and packaging component lot consumption against production orders, implementing FIFO/FEFO inventory management. Captures production order, batch record, consumed material code, consumed lot number, consumption quantity, unit of measure, consumption timestamp, FIFO/FEFO sequence number, expiry date of consumed lot, warehouse storage location, consumption type (standard, rework, trial), variance from BOM quantity, and confirmation status. Provides full lot traceability from raw material to finished goods batch. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM goods movement and MES batch management.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Movement / FIFO-FEFO Lot Traceability

attributes.name: lot_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot consumption transaction record. Primary key for the lot consumption entity.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the batch record documenting the production run. Links lot consumption to the specific batch manufacturing execution record for GMP compliance and traceability.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) Batch Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Needed for Material Consumption Costing and variance analysis; cost_center_code is a denormalized code that should reference finance.cost_center.

attributes.name: ingredient_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ingredient.lot. Business justification: REQUIRED: Enables lot‑level traceability for recalls and FDA FSMA reporting by linking each consumption record to the specific ingredient lot used.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Lot consumption records occur at a plant; linking to plant provides authoritative plant data and removes the free‑text plant_code.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Linking consumption to a specific PO line enables variance analysis and accurate spend tracking.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order against which this lot consumption occurred. Links consumption to the manufacturing order that triggered the material usage.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: Material consumption is allocated to specific promotions for accurate cost‑of‑goods‑sold and promotional spend reconciliation.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: REQUIRED: Links each consumption event to the exact inventory lot consumed, supporting lot traceability, regulatory reporting, and OTIF calculations.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Identifying the supplier of each consumed lot supports quality audits and allergen compliance.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production line where the material was consumed. Links consumption to the specific manufacturing resource.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center Master

attributes.name: allergen_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the consumed material contains or may contain allergens as defined by FDA and FALCPA regulations. Used for allergen control and cross-contamination prevention.
attributes.references: FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this consumption was automatically backflushed based on production confirmation (True) or manually posted (False). Backflushing automates material consumption based on BOM and production output.

attributes.name: bom_quantity
attributes.description: The planned or standard quantity of this material specified in the Bill of Materials for the production order. Used to calculate consumption variance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Bill of Materials

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the consumption transaction in the system workflow: confirmed (posted to inventory), pending (awaiting approval), rejected (not accepted), or reversed (cancelled after posting).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement Status

attributes.name: consumption_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material consumed from the specified lot during production. Recorded in the unit of measure specified in the unit_of_measure field.

attributes.name: consumption_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the material lot was consumed in the production process. Critical for FIFO/FEFO compliance and production timeline tracking.
attributes.references: MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Time Stamping Standard

attributes.name: consumption_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consumption event indicating the purpose or nature of material usage: standard production, rework/reprocessing, trial run, quality sample, or waste/scrap.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who created this consumption record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lot consumption record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the cost values are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: fifo_fefo_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: FIFO/FEFO (First In First Out/First Expired First Out) Sequence Number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order in which lots were consumed according to FIFO or FEFO inventory management rules. Lower numbers indicate earlier consumption priority.

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Classification of the consumed material regarding genetically modified organism content: GMO (contains GMO), non-GMO (verified non-GMO), or unknown (not tested/declared).
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard and FDA GMO Labeling Guidance

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the consumed lot is certified halal according to Islamic dietary law. Required for halal product manufacturing and labeling.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the consumed lot is certified kosher by a recognized kosher certification agency. Required for kosher product manufacturing and labeling.

attributes.name: lot_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the consumed lot. Used to enforce FEFO consumption rules and ensure materials are used before expiration.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling and Shelf Life Requirements

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The unique document number generated by the ERP system for this goods movement transaction. Used for audit trail and transaction traceability.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the material document was posted. Combined with material_document_number forms a unique key in the source system.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who last modified this consumption record. Used for accountability and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lot consumption record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: The SAP movement type code that classifies the inventory transaction (e.g., 261 for goods issue to production order, 262 for reversal). Determines how the consumption affects inventory and financial accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Movement Type Configuration

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the consumed lot is certified organic according to USDA NOP or equivalent organic certification standards. Critical for organic product integrity and labeling compliance.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consumption transaction was posted to the financial and inventory ledgers. May differ from consumption_timestamp for backdated postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Posting Date Logic

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: The material reservation document number that allocated this lot for consumption against the production order. Links consumption to the planned material requirement.

attributes.name: supplier_lot_number
attributes.description: The original lot or batch number assigned by the supplier for the consumed material. Critical for traceability back to the raw material source and supplier quality investigations.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability and Supplier Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of the consumed quantity, calculated as consumption_quantity * unit_cost. Represents the material cost component of the production order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Production Order Costing

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The standard or actual cost per unit of measure for the consumed material at the time of consumption. Used for production cost calculation and COGS determination.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the consumption quantity is measured (e.g., KG, LB, EA, L, GAL). Must align with the material master unit of measure.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The consumption variance expressed as a percentage of the BOM quantity. Calculated as (variance_quantity / bom_quantity) * 100.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between actual consumption quantity and the BOM planned quantity. Positive values indicate over-consumption; negative values indicate under-consumption.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_code
attributes.description: The storage location or warehouse from which the material lot was withdrawn for consumption. Links to the warehouse management system location master.

products.name: copacking_order
products.description: Master and transactional record for co-packing and toll manufacturing arrangements where production is outsourced to a third-party co-manufacturer (co-packer). Captures co-packing order number, co-packer supplier ID, co-packer facility name and location, SKU being co-packed, planned quantity, actual quantity produced, planned production date, actual production date, BOM version supplied, raw materials supplied by (us vs. co-packer), quality hold status, co-packer batch number, our internal batch number assigned, GMP audit status of co-packer, SQF/GFSI certification status, order status (planned, in-production, received, quality-hold, closed), and landed cost per unit. Links to procurement and quality domains.

attributes.name: copacking_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the co-packing or toll manufacturing order. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: bill_of_materials_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific BOM record used for this co-packing order.

attributes.name: copacker_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party co-manufacturer (co-packer) supplier who will execute the production. Links to procurement supplier master.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Co‑packing orders occur at a plant; linking to plant centralizes location data and removes redundant facility name/location fields.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: Co‑packing orders are often executed to supply promotional SKUs; linking enables Promo fulfillment tracking and cost allocation.

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master co-packing or toll manufacturing contract governing this order.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order record in the procurement system for this co-packing service.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Co‑packing operations are triggered by specific sales orders; linking enables order‑to‑batch traceability and accurate delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product master record for the SKU being co-packed.

attributes.name: actual_production_date
attributes.description: The actual date when production was completed by the co-packer.

attributes.name: actual_quantity_produced
attributes.description: The actual quantity of finished goods units produced by the co-packer upon order completion.

attributes.name: allergen_control_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether allergen control procedures at the co-packer facility have been verified for this order. True if verified, False if not verified.

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the BOM (Bill of Materials) supplied to the co-packer for production execution.

attributes.name: copacker_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned by the co-packer to the production run.

attributes.name: copacking_order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique order number for the co-packing arrangement, used for external communication with co-packer and internal tracking.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this co-packing order record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this co-packing order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the landed cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The calculated expiration date for the co-packed product batch based on production date and shelf life.

attributes.name: fsma_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the co-packer facility is compliant with FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) requirements. True if compliant, False if non-compliant.
attributes.references: FSMA Preventive Controls Rule (21 CFR Part 117)

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme
attributes.description: The specific GFSI-recognized certification scheme held by the co-packer (e.g., SQF, BRC, FSSC 22000, IFS).

attributes.name: gmp_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent GMP audit conducted at the co-packer facility.

attributes.name: gmp_audit_status
attributes.description: Status of the co-packer facility's GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) audit: current (audit valid), expired (audit needs renewal), pending (audit scheduled), not-audited (no audit on file).

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date when the co-packed finished goods were received into our inventory.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number generated when the co-packed finished goods are received into inventory.

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) CCP Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the co-packer has documented compliance with HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) critical control points for this production run. True if compliant, False if non-compliant or not verified.

attributes.name: internal_batch_number
attributes.description: Our internal batch or lot number assigned to the co-packed production for traceability and inventory management.

attributes.name: landed_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The total landed cost per unit for the co-packed product, including manufacturing cost, raw materials (if supplied by us), logistics, and any other charges. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this co-packing order record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this co-packing order record was last updated.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the co-packing order: planned (order created), in-production (manufacturing underway), received (goods received), quality-hold (pending quality clearance), closed (order completed), cancelled (order terminated).

attributes.name: planned_production_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date when production is planned to start or be completed at the co-packer facility.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of finished goods units to be produced by the co-packer as per the order.

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific production line at the co-packer facility used for this order.

attributes.name: quality_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for quality hold if applicable (e.g., failed inspection, documentation incomplete, sensory deviation).

attributes.name: quality_hold_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the co-packed goods are currently on quality hold pending inspection and release. True if on hold, False if released or not applicable.

attributes.name: raw_materials_supplied_by
attributes.description: Indicates who supplies the raw materials for production: us (we supply), copacker (co-packer supplies), or mixed (both parties supply components).

attributes.name: receiving_warehouse_code
attributes.description: Code of the warehouse or distribution center where the co-packed goods are received.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The shelf life in days assigned to the co-packed product batch from production date.

attributes.name: sqf_certification_level
attributes.description: The level of SQF certification held by the co-packer (Level 1: Food Safety Fundamentals, Level 2: Food Safety Plans, Level 3: Comprehensive Food Safety and Quality).

attributes.name: sqf_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of the co-packer's SQF (Safe Quality Food) or GFSI (Global Food Safety Initiative) certification: certified (valid certification), expired (needs renewal), pending (application in progress), not-certified (no certification).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the planned and actual quantities (e.g., cases, units, pallets, kg). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cases|units|pallets|kg|lbs|liters|gallons — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: manufacturing_production_bom
products.description: Manufacturing Bill of Materials (BOM) master data defining the ingredient and packaging component composition for each SKU at a specific plant and BOM version — including both header-level BOM metadata and all component line items as a single integrated entity. Header captures SKU, plant, BOM version, valid-from/to dates, batch size basis, yield percentage, BOM status (active, superseded, trial, obsolete), approved-for-production flag, allergen declaration flag, clean label compliance flag, and last reviewed date. Component lines capture line number, material code, material description, component type (raw material, packaging, semi-finished, by-product), quantity per batch, unit of measure, scrap percentage, issue method (backflush, manual), allergen flag, critical ingredient flag, approved substitutes list, storage conditions required, lead time days, and phantom item flag. This is the single source of truth for all production-executable BOM data (header + all component lines), distinct from the R&D/PLM formulation BOM owned by the product domain. Sourced from SAP PP BOM master (CS01/CS02). Enables precise MRP explosion, lot traceability at the component level, and allergen cross-contact analysis.

attributes.name: manufacturing_production_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production BOM record. Primary key for the production BOM entity.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Links BOM to the plant where it is valid, supporting plant‑specific formulation control and compliance with local regulations.

attributes.name: primary_manufacturing_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the quality or production manager who approved this BOM for production use.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Ensures each production BOM version is tied to the SKU it produces, critical for traceability in batch release and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM contains any of the major allergens requiring declaration per FDA and FSMA regulations.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA), FSMA

attributes.name: alternative_bom_group
attributes.description: Groups alternative BOMs for the same SKU (e.g., seasonal formulations, regional variants, equipment-specific recipes). Null if no alternatives exist.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this BOM received final approval for production execution.

attributes.name: approved_for_production_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM has passed all quality, regulatory, and operational reviews and is authorized for commercial production.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The standard batch size for which component quantities are defined. Typically expressed in production units (e.g., 1000 kg, 500 cases).

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the base quantity. Must align with the SKU's primary production UOM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|EA|CS|CASE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: batch_record_template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the master batch record template used for GMP documentation when executing this BOM.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM. Only active BOMs are available for production order creation.

attributes.name: bom_usage_type
attributes.description: The primary purpose of this BOM. Production BOMs are executable; costing BOMs are used for standard cost calculation; engineering BOMs are R&D prototypes.

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this BOM configuration. Increments with each formulation change or process improvement.

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes
attributes.description: The expected time in minutes required to changeover equipment from the previous product to this BOM. Critical for production scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: clean_label_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM meets clean label criteria (no artificial ingredients, preservatives, or additives) for marketing and consumer transparency.

attributes.name: co_packing_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM is executed under a co-packing or toll manufacturing arrangement with a third-party manufacturer (3PL).

attributes.name: cost_estimate_version
attributes.description: Links to the standard cost estimate version used for COGS calculation based on this BOM's component costs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this BOM record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM has been validated for GMP compliance including proper sequencing, critical control points, and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), FDA 21 CFR Part 110

attributes.name: haccp_critical_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Critical Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM includes HACCP critical control points requiring enhanced monitoring and documentation during production.
attributes.references: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP), FDA FSMA

attributes.name: inventory_consumption_method
attributes.description: The method used to consume component inventory during production. FIFO (First In First Out) or FEFO (First Expired First Out) are standard for food and beverage to ensure freshness and minimize waste.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this BOM record was last modified. Tracks all changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The date when this BOM was last reviewed for accuracy, regulatory compliance, and cost optimization. BOMs should be reviewed annually or upon ingredient changes.

attributes.name: lot_traceability_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether full lot-level traceability is required for all components per FSMA traceability rules or customer requirements.

attributes.name: plm_formulation_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the R&D formulation record in the PLM system from which this production BOM was derived. Maintains traceability from innovation to manufacturing.

attributes.name: production_line_assignment
attributes.description: The specific production line or work center where this BOM is typically executed. Supports line-specific BOMs for equipment constraints.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: The FDA, USDA, or other regulatory body approval or registration number for this BOM formulation, if required for the product category.
attributes.references: FDA Registration, USDA FSIS Establishment Number

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The guaranteed shelf life in days for the finished product produced from this BOM, from production date to expiration.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling, FEFO Inventory Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this BOM data originated (e.g., SAP PP, Oracle ERP, Aveva MES).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this BOM in the source system. Enables traceability back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: standard_cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: The expected production cycle time in minutes to produce one base quantity batch. Used for capacity planning and OEE calculation.
attributes.references: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), SAP PP Routing

attributes.name: storage_conditions_required
attributes.description: The required storage conditions for the finished product (e.g., ambient, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen below -18°C). Critical for warehouse management and distribution planning.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM version becomes effective for production scheduling and execution.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM version is no longer valid for new production orders. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Expected yield percentage accounting for normal production losses, evaporation, and waste. Used for accurate material requirements planning (MRP).

products.name: routing
products.description: Production routing master data defining the sequence of manufacturing operations (work center steps) required to produce a SKU. Captures routing number, routing version, SKU, plant, valid-from/to dates, routing status, total standard production time, and the ordered list of operations with their work center assignments, standard times (setup, machine, labor), and operation descriptions (e.g., mixing, pasteurization, filling, capping, labeling, palletizing). Sourced from SAP PP routing master. Distinct from the BOM (what goes in) — the routing defines how it is made and in what sequence.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production routing master record.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this routing is executed.

attributes.name: routing_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this routing for production use.

attributes.name: routing_created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who created this routing record.

attributes.name: routing_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production planner or scheduler responsible for maintaining this routing and resolving production issues.

attributes.name: routing_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who last modified this routing record.

attributes.name: routing_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party co-packing supplier if this routing represents externally manufactured production. Null for internal production.

attributes.name: routing_toll_manufacturer_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the toll manufacturing supplier if this routing represents production where the company provides raw materials and the supplier provides processing. Null for internal or co-packed production.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good SKU that this routing produces.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary production line or work center group where this routing is executed. Used for capacity planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: allergen_handling_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this routing requires special allergen handling procedures, such as line changeover cleaning or dedicated equipment, to prevent cross-contact.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval state of this routing. Approved routings are released for production use; pending routings await engineering or quality approval; rejected routings require rework; expired routings have passed their review date.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this routing was approved for production use.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The standard production lot size for which the routing times are defined. Actual production order times are scaled proportionally from this base.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the base quantity (e.g., KG, LB, EA, CS). Aligns with the SKU primary UOM.

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes
attributes.description: The standard time required to change over the production line from the previous SKU to this routing, including cleaning, setup, and first-article inspection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this routing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this routing has been validated for GMP compliance. True means all operations meet GMP documentation, training, and control requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110 - Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: haccp_critical_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Critical Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this routing contains one or more HACCP critical control points (CCPs) that require monitoring and documentation per the food safety plan.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this routing was last reviewed and validated by engineering or production management.

attributes.name: lot_size_from
attributes.description: The minimum production lot size for which this routing is valid. Supports lot-size-dependent routing selection.

attributes.name: lot_size_to
attributes.description: The maximum production lot size for which this routing is valid. Null indicates no upper limit.

attributes.name: maximum_batch_size
attributes.description: The largest production quantity that can be produced in a single batch using this routing, constrained by equipment capacity or process limits.

attributes.name: minimum_batch_size
attributes.description: The smallest production quantity that can be economically or technically produced using this routing, expressed in the base UOM.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this routing record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this routing to ensure continued accuracy and compliance.

attributes.name: operation_count
attributes.description: The total number of sequential operations (work center steps) defined in this routing.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this routing is certified for organic production under USDA NOP or equivalent standards, requiring segregation and documentation.

attributes.name: rework_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether non-conforming product from this routing can be reworked through a defined rework operation sequence.

attributes.name: routing_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the routing, typically summarizing the production method or key process characteristics (e.g., 'High-speed aseptic filling line', 'Manual batch mixing and packaging').

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the routing. The externally-known unique code used to reference this routing in production planning and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: routing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the routing. Active routings are available for production order creation; draft and under-review routings are in development; inactive and obsolete routings are no longer used.

attributes.name: routing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the routing. Standard routings are the default production method; alternative routings provide flexibility for capacity or material constraints; trial routings support NPD; co-packing and toll manufacturing routings reflect external production arrangements.

attributes.name: scrap_percentage
attributes.description: The expected percentage of material loss or waste across all operations in this routing, used for material planning and costing.

attributes.name: total_standard_production_time_minutes
attributes.description: The sum of all operation standard times (setup, machine, labor) across the routing, expressed in minutes. Used for capacity planning and production scheduling.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: The business purpose for which this routing is maintained. Production routings drive MES execution; costing routings feed standard cost calculations; maintenance and quality inspection routings support non-production work orders.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this routing version becomes effective for production planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this routing version remains effective. Null indicates open-ended validity.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the routing. Allows multiple versions of the same routing to coexist for different time periods or production scenarios.

products.name: process_parameter
products.description: Time-series process parameter readings captured from Aveva/Wonderware MES historian for critical in-process control points during production. Captures parameter tag name, parameter description, work center, production order, batch number, reading timestamp, measured value, engineering unit, target value, lower control limit, upper control limit, in-spec flag, parameter category (temperature, pressure, pH, Brix, flow rate, speed, torque, humidity, CFU count, ABV), and data source (automated sensor, manual entry). Enables process capability analysis, SPC (Statistical Process Control), and regulatory traceability for parameters like pasteurization temperature and pH.

attributes.name: process_parameter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process parameter reading record.

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrective action record initiated in response to this out-of-spec parameter reading, if applicable.
attributes.references: Quality Management System, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) Process

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production operator or technician who was responsible for the process at the time of reading, or who manually entered the value. Required for GMP audit trail.

attributes.name: equipment_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production equipment, vessel, or machine from which this parameter was measured.
attributes.references: Equipment Master Data, Maintenance Management System

attributes.name: formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production recipe or formulation being executed at the time of this parameter reading.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order during which this parameter was measured.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good or intermediate product being manufactured when this parameter was captured, enabling product-specific process analysis.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production line where the parameter was captured.

attributes.name: alarm_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this parameter reading triggered an alarm or alert in the MES system due to exceeding control limits or deviation thresholds.
attributes.references: MES Alarm Management, HACCP Monitoring Procedures

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch or lot number associated with this parameter reading, enabling full traceability per FIFO/FEFO and GMP requirements.
attributes.references: GMP Batch Record Requirements, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled calibration date for the sensor or instrument at the time of reading, in format yyyy-MM-dd. Ensures measurement validity per GMP and ISO 9001 requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Calibration Requirements, GMP Equipment Qualification

attributes.name: ccp_number
attributes.description: HACCP plan reference number for this Critical Control Point, if applicable (e.g., 'CCP-1', 'CCP-2A'). Used for regulatory audit traceability.
attributes.references: HACCP Plan Documentation, FDA FSMA Compliance

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this out-of-spec reading requires formal corrective action documentation per HACCP or quality management procedures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this process parameter record was first created in the data platform, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Distinct from reading_timestamp which captures the actual measurement time.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Assessment of the reliability of this parameter reading: valid (normal operation), suspect (potential sensor issue), invalid (known bad data), or estimated (interpolated due to sensor failure).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin of the parameter reading: automated_sensor (captured directly from MES historian) or manual_entry (operator-entered value).

attributes.name: deviation_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated percentage deviation of the measured value from the target value, enabling quick assessment of process variation and capability.

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the parameter value (e.g., Celsius, Fahrenheit, PSI, bar, pH units, degrees Brix, liters/min, RPM, Nm, percent RH, CFU/ml, percent ABV).

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this parameter is designated as a HACCP Critical Control Point requiring enhanced monitoring and documentation per food safety regulations.
attributes.references: HACCP Principles, FSMA Preventive Controls, Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: in_spec_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the measured value falls within the acceptable control limits (LCL to UCL). False indicates an out-of-spec event requiring investigation.

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable value for this parameter; readings below this threshold indicate an out-of-specification condition requiring corrective action per SPC and HACCP protocols.
attributes.references: SPC (Statistical Process Control) Standards, HACCP Critical Limits

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual numeric value recorded for this process parameter at the reading timestamp.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this process parameter record was last updated in the data platform, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or quality technician comments regarding this parameter reading, including context for deviations, corrective actions taken, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: parameter_category
attributes.description: Classification of the parameter type: temperature, pressure, pH (acidity measure), Brix (sugar content), flow rate, speed, torque, humidity, CFU (Colony Forming Units) count, or ABV (Alcohol by Volume). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: temperature|pressure|ph|brix|flow_rate|speed|torque|humidity|cfu_count|abv — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HACCP Critical Control Point Categories, FDA Process Controls

attributes.name: parameter_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the process parameter being measured (e.g., 'Pasteurization Tank 3 Temperature', 'Filling Line 2 pH Probe').

attributes.name: parameter_tag_name
attributes.description: Unique tag identifier from the MES historian system (Aveva/Wonderware) representing the specific sensor or control point.
attributes.references: Aveva/Wonderware MES Historian Tag Naming Convention

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing facility or plant identifier where this parameter was measured, enabling multi-site process comparison and benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP Plant Master Data, ERP Organization Structure

attributes.name: process_phase
attributes.description: Stage or phase of the production process during which this parameter was measured (e.g., 'mixing', 'pasteurization', 'cooling', 'filling', 'packaging'). Enables phase-specific process capability analysis.

attributes.name: quality_status
attributes.description: Quality disposition of the batch or production run based on this parameter reading: approved (within spec), rejected (out of spec, product quarantined), under_review (pending quality review), or conditional (approved with restrictions).
attributes.references: Quality Management System, Batch Release Procedures

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the parameter measurement was captured from the sensor or manually entered, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard, 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this parameter reading must be included in regulatory submissions or audit documentation per FDA, USDA, or other governing body requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Reporting Requirements, FSMA Documentation Standards

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Laboratory or in-process sample identifier if this parameter reading was associated with a physical sample taken for testing or verification.

attributes.name: sensor_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical sensor or instrument that captured the measurement, enabling calibration traceability and maintenance tracking.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Production shift identifier during which this parameter was captured (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C', 'Day', 'Night'). Enables shift-based performance analysis and OEE tracking.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The intended or setpoint value for this parameter as defined in the production recipe or process specification.
attributes.references: Recipe Management System, Process Specification Documents

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable value for this parameter; readings above this threshold indicate an out-of-specification condition requiring corrective action per SPC and HACCP protocols.
attributes.references: SPC (Statistical Process Control) Standards, HACCP Critical Limits

products.name: plant
products.description: Master data for all manufacturing plants, co-packing facilities, and production sites operated or contracted by the business. Captures plant code, plant name, plant type (owned manufacturing, co-packer, toll manufacturer, pilot plant, R&D facility), address, country, region, plant manager, plant capacity (units/day), number of production lines, GMP certification status, GFSI scheme (SQF, BRC, FSSC 22000), certification expiry date, FDA registration number, USDA establishment number, kosher certification flag, halal certification flag, organic certification flag, plant status (active, idle, decommissioned), and ERP plant code. SSOT for manufacturing facility master data.
products.reference: SAP Plant Master / FDA Facility Registration

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing plant, co-packing facility, or production site. Primary key for the plant master data product.

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Each plant must be linked to its regulatory establishment registration for audit and reporting.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Links plant manager to employee record for compliance, audit trails, and hierarchical reporting in plant‑level dashboards.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Logistics planning maps each plant to a distribution network node for transportation scheduling and OTIF performance reporting.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: REGIONAL PRICING: Plant location determines applicable price zone for pricing rules; price zone assignment is required for price list selection and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the plant location including street number and name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building number, suite, or floor.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the daily capacity metric (e.g., cases, pallets, kilograms, pounds, liters, gallons) aligned with the primary output of the facility.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the plant is located.

attributes.name: cold_storage_capacity_pallets
attributes.description: Refrigerated and frozen storage capacity at the plant site measured in standard pallet positions for temperature-sensitive products and ingredients.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the plant was first commissioned and began commercial production operations.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country where the plant is located (e.g., USA, MEX, CAN, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this plant master data record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daily_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum daily production capacity of the plant measured in standard production units per day. Used for capacity planning, demand allocation, and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculations.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the plant was permanently closed and ceased all production operations. Null for active facilities.

attributes.name: erp_plant_code
attributes.description: Plant code or site identifier used in the primary ERP system (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud ERP) for transactional processing, inventory management, and financial reporting. May differ from the business plant_code for legacy integration reasons.

attributes.name: fda_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Registration Number
attributes.description: FDA facility registration number required for food manufacturing facilities under FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) regulations. Mandatory for US-based facilities and importers.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Section 102 Food Facility Registration

attributes.name: gfsi_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current GFSI certification requiring renewal to maintain compliance and customer approval status.
attributes.references: GFSI Global Food Safety Initiative Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme
attributes.description: The GFSI-benchmarked food safety certification scheme held by the plant. SQF (Safe Quality Food), BRC (British Retail Consortium), FSSC 22000 (Food Safety System Certification), IFS (International Featured Standards), or none if not certified.
attributes.references: GFSI Global Food Safety Initiative Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: gmp_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the plant holds current GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) certification required for food and beverage manufacturing quality standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117 Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the plant holds halal certification from a recognized Islamic authority enabling production of halal-certified products.
attributes.references: Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America (IFANCA) Standards

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the plant holds kosher certification from a recognized rabbinical authority enabling production of kosher-certified products.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this plant master data record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the plant location in decimal degrees format for mapping and logistics optimization.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the plant location in decimal degrees format for mapping and logistics optimization.

attributes.name: mes_site_code
attributes.description: Site or facility identifier used in the Manufacturing Execution System (Aveva/Wonderware MES) for production scheduling, batch management, and OEE tracking.

attributes.name: number_of_production_lines
attributes.description: Total count of active production lines or manufacturing lines within the plant used for production scheduling and line allocation.

attributes.name: operating_days_per_week
attributes.description: Standard number of operating days per week for the plant (typically 5, 6, or 7) used for production planning and capacity calculations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Standard operating hours per day for the plant used for capacity planning and OEE calculations. Typically 8, 16, or 24 hours depending on shift structure.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the plant holds organic certification (USDA Organic, EU Organic, or equivalent) enabling production of certified organic products.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205 National Organic Program

attributes.name: organic_certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the accredited organic certification body that issued the organic certification (e.g., QAI, CCOF, Oregon Tilth, Ecocert).
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205 National Organic Program

attributes.name: plant_code
