attributes.description: Business identifier code for the plant used across operational systems. Typically a 4-10 character alphanumeric code used in ERP systems (SAP plant code, Oracle site code).

attributes.name: plant_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the manufacturing plant or production facility.

attributes.name: plant_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the plant in its lifecycle. Active indicates full production operations, idle indicates temporarily not producing but maintained, decommissioned indicates permanently closed, under construction indicates new facility being built, and temporarily closed indicates short-term shutdown for maintenance or seasonal operations.

attributes.name: plant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the facility type indicating ownership and operational model. Owned manufacturing indicates company-operated production facilities, co-packer indicates third-party contract manufacturing, toll manufacturer indicates facilities where the company provides ingredients and the manufacturer provides processing, pilot plant indicates small-scale testing facilities, R&D facility indicates research and development sites, and distribution center indicates warehousing and logistics hubs.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the plant address used for mail delivery and logistics routing.

attributes.name: primary_product_category
attributes.description: Primary product category or product line manufactured at this plant (e.g., beverages, snacks, dairy, bakery, confectionery) used for portfolio planning and specialization tracking.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Business-defined geographic region or market area for reporting and planning purposes (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC, Latin America).

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division where the plant is located.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the plant location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Shanghai) used for production scheduling and shift management.

attributes.name: usda_establishment_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Establishment Number
attributes.description: USDA establishment number assigned to facilities that process meat, poultry, or egg products under USDA inspection. Required for facilities producing USDA-regulated products.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS 9 CFR Part 304 Application for Inspection

attributes.name: warehouse_capacity_pallets
attributes.description: Total warehouse storage capacity at the plant site measured in standard pallet positions for finished goods and raw material inventory management.

products.name: equipment_master
products.description: Master data for all production equipment assets within manufacturing plants — filling machines, mixers, blenders, pasteurizers, extruders, packaging lines, labelers, metal detectors, checkweighers, and CIP systems. Captures equipment tag number, equipment name, equipment type, manufacturer, model, serial number, plant, work center assignment, installation date, commissioning date, rated capacity, current status (operational, under maintenance, decommissioned), preventive maintenance schedule reference, last calibration date, next calibration due date, calibration certificate number, OEE baseline target, and MES asset tag. SSOT for production equipment master data used in OEE, maintenance, and calibration tracking.
products.reference: SAP PM Equipment Master / MES Asset

attributes.name: equipment_master_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production equipment asset record. Primary key for the equipment master data product.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.asset. Business justification: Unifies equipment master with maintenance asset for shared calibration, inspection, and reliability data.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Assigns a primary maintenance owner to each equipment, supporting preventive‑maintenance scheduling and CAPA accountability.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing plant where this equipment is physically located and operated.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center or production area within the plant where this equipment is assigned for production scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase price or total capitalized cost of acquiring and installing the equipment, used for asset valuation and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: acquisition_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the acquisition cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: allergen_handling_capability
attributes.description: Description of allergen types this equipment is qualified to handle, or designation as allergen-free equipment. Critical for allergen control and production scheduling to prevent cross-contamination.

attributes.name: asset_owner_department
attributes.description: Department or business unit responsible for the ownership, budgeting, and strategic decisions related to this equipment asset.

attributes.name: calibration_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the most recent calibration certificate documenting the equipment's measurement accuracy and compliance with specifications.

attributes.name: calibration_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between required calibration activities as defined by regulatory requirements, manufacturer specifications, or internal quality standards.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the rated capacity value, indicating how production throughput is quantified for this equipment.

attributes.name: cip_capable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this equipment is designed for automated clean-in-place sanitation without disassembly, enabling efficient changeover and sanitation cycles.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment was validated, qualified, and approved for production use following installation and testing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment master record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: criticality_level
attributes.description: Business criticality classification of the equipment based on its impact to production continuity, safety, and quality. Critical equipment requires highest priority maintenance and monitoring.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment was permanently removed from service and decommissioned, marking the end of its operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: decommission_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for decommissioning the equipment (e.g., end of life, obsolescence, facility closure, technology upgrade).

attributes.name: energy_consumption_rating_kwh
attributes.description: Rated or average energy consumption of the equipment per operating hour, used for sustainability tracking and operational cost analysis.

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of equipment by operational category for reporting and analysis purposes.

attributes.name: equipment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the equipment asset (e.g., 'Line 3 Filling Machine', 'Pasteurizer Unit A').

attributes.name: equipment_tag_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the equipment asset for operational tracking and maintenance purposes. This is the externally-known business identifier used in MES systems, work orders, and maintenance schedules.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the equipment by its primary production function within the manufacturing process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filling_machine|mixer|blender|pasteurizer|extruder|packaging_line|labeler|metal_detector|checkweigher|cip_system|oven|cooler|conveyor|palletizer|wrapper|sealer — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: food_contact_surface_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this equipment has surfaces that come into direct contact with food products, requiring specific sanitation and material compliance standards.

attributes.name: gmp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this equipment is classified as GMP-critical, requiring enhanced documentation, validation, and change control procedures.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment was physically installed at the manufacturing facility.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment was last calibrated or verified for measurement accuracy, applicable to equipment requiring calibration per GMP or quality standards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment master record was last updated, supporting change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) who produced the equipment asset.

attributes.name: mes_asset_tag
attributes.description: Unique identifier used by the MES system (Aveva/Wonderware) to track this equipment in real-time production monitoring, batch execution, and performance analytics.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model designation for the equipment, used for parts ordering and technical documentation reference.

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required calibration or verification activity to maintain equipment qualification status.

attributes.name: notes

products.name: haccp_plan
products.description: Master record for Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) plans per production facility and product category, including all associated process validation, cleaning validation, and equipment qualification studies. Captures plan version, scope, hazard categories (biological, chemical, physical, radiological), regulatory basis (FDA FSMA Preventive Controls, USDA FSIS HACCP, Codex Alimentarius), approval status, effective dates, and responsible food safety team. Includes validation records: validation type (process/thermal, cleaning/CIP, equipment IQ/OQ/PQ, aseptic), scope, protocol reference, execution dates, acceptance criteria, test results summary, statistical confidence level, outcome (validated/failed), revalidation trigger conditions, and approval authority. Covers allergen changeover cleaning validation. SSOT for HACCP program governance, preventive control validation, process/cleaning/equipment qualification, and food safety plan management across all manufacturing sites.

products.name: critical_control_point
products.description: Master entity defining each Critical Control Point (CCP) within a HACCP plan, plus all associated real-time monitoring observations recorded during production. Records the CCP number, process step, hazard type, critical limits (temperature, pH, Brix, water activity, time, metal detector sensitivity), monitoring method, monitoring frequency, corrective action procedure, verification activity, and responsible operator. domains.name: supply
domains.description: Governs end-to-end supply chain planning and execution — demand sensing, IBP/S&OP cycles (SAP IBP), inventory optimization, safety stock parameters, FIFO/FEFO rotation policies, replenishment signals, supply-demand balancing, inbound logistics, MOQ management, and network design across DC network and 3PL partners.
domains.references: APICS SCOR Model, SAP IBP, ISO 28000, GS1 Standards

products.name: demand_plan
products.description: Statistical and consensus-based demand forecast at SKU/DC/time-period granularity, serving as the primary input to supply planning and inventory optimization. Captures baseline statistical forecast, adjusted forecast, consensus volume, demand sensing signals (POS data, syndicated data, customer orders), uplift/downlift factors, confidence intervals, and sensing horizon. Supports both monthly S&OP planning horizons and daily/weekly demand signal refresh for near-term supply execution. Generated through demand sensing and S&OP consensus cycles.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each demand plan record at the SKU/DC/time-period granularity. Primary key for the demand_plan data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning Object Model

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or channel account for which the demand plan is generated, when the plan is customer-specific (e.g., key account demand plan). Nullable for aggregate/market-level plans.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Distribution Center (DC) or warehouse location for which the demand plan is generated. Supports network-level demand disaggregation across the DC network and 3PL partners.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning Network

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the business stakeholder (e.g., Demand Planning Manager, VP Supply Chain) who approved the consensus forecast during the S&OP cycle. Supports governance and audit trail for plan approval workflows.
attributes.references: SAP IBP S&OP Workflow; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning Approval

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific planning version or scenario under which this demand plan record was generated (e.g., baseline, consensus, adjusted). Supports multi-version S&OP cycle management.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Demand planning incorporates product registration status to avoid forecasting for items pending regulatory approval.

attributes.name: promotion_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_plan. Business justification: Demand Planning incorporates promotion plans to adjust forecasted demand; linking enables the Demand Impact Forecast report.

attributes.name: sales_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Demand forecasting uses qualified sales opportunities as drivers; the Opportunity‑Based Forecasting report requires this link.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for which the demand plan is generated. The SKU is the lowest-level product identifier used in demand planning and inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 GTIN Standard

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID
attributes.description: Reference to the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) / Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycle in which this demand plan record was generated or last updated. Enables traceability of demand plan versions to specific planning cycles.

attributes.name: adjusted_forecast_qty
attributes.description: Demand forecast quantity after planner-applied manual adjustments, overrides, or market intelligence inputs on top of the statistical baseline. Reflects demand planner judgment before consensus alignment.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the demand plan record was formally approved during the S&OP consensus cycle. Supports audit trail, SLA compliance tracking, and planning cycle performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP IBP S&OP Cycle; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: baseline_forecast_qty
attributes.description: Underlying demand forecast quantity representing the expected sell-through volume excluding any promotional uplift, new product launch effects, or extraordinary events. Used as the reference point for uplift/downlift factor calculation.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Baseline Demand

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Trade channel for which this demand plan is generated (e.g., retail, foodservice, direct-to-consumer, e-commerce). Supports channel-level demand disaggregation and channel-specific supply planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|foodservice|direct_to_consumer|ecommerce|club|convenience|drug|mass — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: consensus_forecast_qty
attributes.description: Final agreed demand volume (in selling units) resulting from the cross-functional S&OP consensus process, incorporating inputs from Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain. This is the primary input to supply planning and inventory optimization.
attributes.references: SAP IBP S&OP Consensus; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this demand plan record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Databricks Delta Lake Audit

attributes.name: customer_order_qty
attributes.description: Confirmed customer purchase order quantity for the SKU/DC/period, sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD or EDI order feeds. Represents committed demand and is used to override or supplement statistical forecasts in the near-term horizon.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Order; EDI 850 Purchase Order Standard

attributes.name: demand_class
attributes.description: Classification of the demand type for supply planning purposes. 'regular' = baseline replenishment demand; 'promotional' = trade promotion-driven demand; 'new_product' = NPD launch demand; 'phase_out' = end-of-life demand; 'safety_stock' = buffer stock demand.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Classification

attributes.name: demand_sensing_qty
attributes.description: Near-term demand signal quantity derived from high-frequency data inputs including Point of Sale (POS) data, customer orders, and syndicated data (Nielsen/IRI). Used for daily/weekly supply execution and short-horizon replenishment decisions.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter number) within the fiscal year to which this demand plan record belongs. Supports period-over-period demand trend analysis and S&OP cycle alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Period; SAP IBP Planning Calendar

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this demand plan record belongs, as defined by the company's financial calendar. Used for annual budgeting, S&OP alignment, and year-over-year demand comparison.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; SAP IBP Planning Calendar

attributes.name: forecast_algorithm
attributes.description: Statistical or machine learning algorithm used to generate the baseline statistical forecast for this SKU/period. Used for model governance, accuracy benchmarking, and algorithm selection optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exponential_smoothing|arima|moving_average|machine_learning|croston|holt_winters|causal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IBP Statistical Forecasting Engine; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: forecast_confidence_pct
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level (expressed as a percentage, 0–100) associated with the demand forecast, indicating the reliability of the forecast model output. Used to flag low-confidence forecasts for planner review and safety stock buffer sizing.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Forecast Accuracy

attributes.name: forecast_error_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Forecast Error Percentage (Mean Absolute Percentage Error)
attributes.description: Historical Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of the forecasting model for this SKU/DC combination, expressed as a percentage. Used to assess forecast model accuracy, trigger model recalibration, and size safety stock buffers.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Forecast Accuracy KPI; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning Analytics

attributes.name: forecast_lower_bound_qty
attributes.description: Lower confidence interval bound for the demand forecast quantity, representing the low-end demand scenario. Used for inventory optimization, downside risk assessment, and supply-demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Probabilistic Forecasting

attributes.name: forecast_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which all forecast quantity fields are expressed (e.g., CS = cases, EA = each, LB = pounds, KG = kilograms). Aligns with the selling unit of measure defined in the SAP S/4HANA material master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CS|EA|LB|KG|OZ|GAL|L|MT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; GS1 Unit of Measure Standard

attributes.name: forecast_upper_bound_qty
attributes.description: Upper confidence interval bound for the demand forecast quantity, representing the high-end demand scenario. Used for safety stock calculation, capacity planning, and supply risk management.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Probabilistic Forecasting

attributes.name: is_frozen
attributes.description: Indicates whether the demand plan record is frozen (locked) for supply execution and cannot be modified by planners. Frozen plans are used as firm inputs to production scheduling and procurement within the planning fence horizon.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Planning Fence; JDA/Blue Yonder Frozen Horizon

attributes.name: is_new_product
attributes.description: Indicates whether this demand plan record is for a New Product Development (NPD) / new SKU launch, where no historical sales data exists for statistical forecasting. Triggers use of analogous product forecasting or market-based estimation methods.
attributes.references: SAP IBP New Product Introduction; JDA/Blue Yonder NPD Forecasting

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the demand plan record, formatted as DP-YYYY-MM-NNNNNN. Used for cross-system traceability between SAP IBP, JDA/Blue Yonder, and ERP systems.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: plan_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the planning time bucket to which this demand plan record applies. Together with plan_period_start_date, defines the demand planning horizon window.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Time Profile; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: plan_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the planning time bucket (day, week, or month) to which this demand plan record applies. Used to align demand signals with supply planning and inventory replenishment cycles.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Time Profile; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the demand plan record within the S&OP consensus cycle. 'statistical' = system-generated baseline; 'adjusted' = planner-modified; 'consensus' = cross-functional agreed; 'approved' = executive-signed-off; 'frozen' = locked for supply execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|statistical|adjusted|consensus|approved|frozen|superseded — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IBP S&OP Cycle; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning Workflow

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand plan by its generation method and purpose. 'statistical' = algorithm-generated baseline; 'consensus' = S&OP agreed volume; 'customer_order' = customer-committed orders; 'demand_sensing' = near-term POS/syndicated signal; 'promotional' = uplift-adjusted plan. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: statistical|consensus|customer_order|demand_sensing|promotional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: planner_notes
attributes.description: Free-text commentary entered by the demand planner to document the rationale for manual forecast adjustments, market intelligence inputs, or exceptions. Supports audit trail and knowledge transfer within the S&OP process.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: planning_horizon
attributes.description: Time granularity of the demand plan bucket. 'daily' and 'weekly' are used for near-term demand sensing and supply execution; 'monthly' is used for S&OP and IBP cycles; 'quarterly' for long-range planning.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: pos_sales_qty
attributes.description: Actual Point of Sale (POS) sell-through quantity for the SKU during the plan period, sourced from retailer POS data feeds. Used as a demand sensing input signal to update near-term forecasts and detect demand shifts.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; SAP IBP Demand Sensing POS Integration

attributes.name: promotional_uplift_qty
attributes.description: Incremental demand volume (in selling units) attributed to planned trade promotions, marketing campaigns, or temporary price reductions above the baseline forecast. Sourced from Trade Promotion Management (TPM) systems and applied as an uplift factor.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder TPO Integration

attributes.name: seasonality_index
attributes.description: Seasonal index factor for the SKU/period combination, representing the ratio of period demand to average annual demand. Values >1.0 indicate above-average seasonal demand; <1.0 indicate below-average. Used in statistical forecasting model decomposition.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Statistical Forecasting; JDA/Blue Yonder Seasonal Profile

attributes.name: sensing_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days into the future covered by the demand sensing signal for this plan record. Typically 1–14 days for near-term POS-driven demand sensing. Distinguishes short-horizon sensing from longer-horizon statistical forecasts.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Sensing

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system from which this demand plan record was generated or ingested. Used for data lineage tracking and cross-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; JDA/Blue Yonder; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: statistical_forecast_qty
attributes.description: System-generated baseline demand forecast quantity (in selling units) produced by the statistical forecasting algorithm (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, machine learning) in SAP IBP or JDA/Blue Yonder, prior to any manual adjustment or consensus override.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Statistical Forecasting

attributes.name: syndicated_market_qty
attributes.description: Market-level demand quantity derived from syndicated data sources (Nielsen/IRI market tracking or SPINS natural channel data) for the SKU/period. Used to calibrate statistical forecasts against total market consumption trends.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; SPINS Specialty Product Intelligence

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this demand plan record was last modified, including planner adjustments, consensus overrides, or system recalculations. Used for change tracking and incremental Silver Layer processing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Databricks Delta Lake Audit

attributes.name: uplift_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative factor applied to the baseline forecast to account for demand uplift (>1.0) or downlift (<1.0) from events such as trade promotions, new product launches, distribution gains/losses, or market disruptions. A value of 1.0 indicates no adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder TPO Integration

attributes.name: uplift_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code explaining the cause of the uplift or downlift factor applied to the baseline forecast. Used for demand decomposition analysis and post-event forecast accuracy review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promotion|new_product_launch|distribution_gain|distribution_loss|seasonality|event|competitor_action|price_change|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

products.name: plan
products.description: Constrained supply plan defining planned production quantities, planned receipts, planned shipments, and supply-demand balance positions at SKU/plant/DC level across the planning horizon. Supports full version management with plan snapshots for cycle-over-cycle comparison, version numbering, creation timestamps, planning cycle references, planner attribution, approval workflows, and plan-vs-plan variance analysis. Drives replenishment signals, production scheduling, and allocation decisions when supply is constrained. Each plan instance captures approval status, key volume metrics (total planned production, total planned receipts), and maintains audit trail for IBP governance.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the supply plan record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain manager or S&OP lead who approved this supply plan version. Required for IBP governance and approval workflow audit trail.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand‑level supply planning aligns production, inventory, and distribution with the brand’s marketing objectives and sales targets.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Distribution Center (DC) or 3PL node in the supply network for which this plan defines planned receipts and shipments.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost allocation of a production plan to an internal cost center for monthly financial reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Posting of production costs from the supply plan to the appropriate GL account for accounting.

attributes.name: ibp_scenario_id
attributes.description: The scenario identifier from SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning) under which this supply plan was generated. Enables traceability back to the source IBP planning run and scenario.

attributes.name: plan_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply chain planner or IBP user responsible for authoring and owning this supply plan. Supports planner attribution and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); Workday HCM

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific version snapshot of this supply plan, enabling cycle-over-cycle comparison and plan-vs-plan variance analysis.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility associated with this supply plan record. Used for SKU/plant-level planning granularity.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis of each supply plan by profit center to support P&L statements.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Supply Plan aligns production with a specific New Product Development project; planners need the project ID to sync supply with product launch roadmap.

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Supply planning must honor contracted volumes; linking supply_plan to sales_contract enables the Contract‑Based Production Planning process.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for which this supply plan is generated. Drives replenishment signals and production scheduling at the SKU level.

attributes.name: allocation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supply allocation decisions are required for this SKU/DC due to constrained supply. When true, the supply plan drives allocation logic in the order management and trade management systems.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); SAP S/4HANA SD (Sales and Distribution)

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supply plan was formally approved by the designated S&OP approver. Null if the plan has not yet been approved. Part of IBP governance audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: closing_inventory_qty
attributes.description: Projected on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the end of the planning horizon after accounting for planned production, receipts, and shipments. Indicates supply-demand balance position.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: co_packing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the planned production quantity for this SKU involves co-packing or toll manufacturing arrangements with a third-party contract manufacturer, affecting supply lead times and MOQ constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning); TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply plan record was first captured in the data platform. Used for audit trail and IBP governance.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); ISO 22000 Food Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: demand_qty
attributes.description: Total planned demand quantity for the SKU over the planning horizon as consumed from the demand plan. Represents the demand signal used for supply-demand balancing in IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: demand_sensing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the demand quantity in this supply plan was derived from SAP IBP Demand Sensing (short-horizon statistical signal) rather than the standard statistical forecast. Affects plan accuracy benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning) Demand Sensing

attributes.name: horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the end boundary for planned production, receipts, and shipment quantities.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the start boundary for planned production, receipts, and shipment quantities.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total supply lead time in calendar days for the SKU from production order release to DC receipt. Used in replenishment signal timing and safety stock calculations.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: lot_size
attributes.description: Standard production lot size for the SKU at the plant, used to round planned production quantities to feasible manufacturing batch sizes in the constrained supply plan.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning); Aveva/Wonderware MES

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) constraint applied to this SKU in the supply plan. Ensures production and procurement orders meet supplier or manufacturing minimum thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management); SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning)

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Identifies the tier of the supply network node (plant, primary DC, secondary DC, 3PL, cross-dock) for which this supply plan record is generated. Supports network design analytics.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or commentary entered by the planner or approver describing key assumptions, constraints, or exceptions relevant to this supply plan version. Supports IBP governance documentation.

attributes.name: opening_inventory_qty
attributes.description: On-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the start of the planning horizon. Used as the baseline for supply-demand balance position calculations.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management)

attributes.name: plan_date
attributes.description: The real-world business event timestamp when this supply plan version was generated or published in the IBP system. Distinct from the audit record creation timestamp.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the supply plan, used in IBP, ERP, and cross-functional S&OP communications. Follows the SP-{alphanumeric} naming convention.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supply plan within the IBP approval workflow. Drives downstream replenishment signal release and production scheduling actions.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply plan indicating whether it reflects capacity-constrained production, unconstrained demand, consensus S&OP output, baseline reference, or simulation scenario.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: planned_production_qty
attributes.description: Total planned production quantity for the SKU at the plant over the planning horizon, expressed in the SKU's base unit of measure. Key volume metric driving MES scheduling and capacity allocation.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning); Aveva/Wonderware MES

attributes.name: planned_receipts_qty
attributes.description: Total planned inbound receipts quantity for the SKU at the DC over the planning horizon, including transfers from plants and external supplier deliveries. Key volume metric for supply-demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: planned_shipments_qty
attributes.description: Total planned outbound shipments quantity for the SKU from the DC over the planning horizon. Drives replenishment signals and allocation decisions when supply is constrained.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: planning_cycle
attributes.description: Identifies the IBP/S&OP planning cycle (e.g., monthly-2024-06) to which this supply plan belongs. Enables cycle-over-cycle comparison and governance tracking.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text reason provided by the approver when a supply plan is rejected in the IBP approval workflow. Null when plan_status is not 'rejected'. Supports governance audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: replenishment_signal_released
attributes.description: Indicates whether the replenishment signal derived from this supply plan has been released to the ERP or WMS for execution. Tracks plan-to-execution handoff status.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management)

attributes.name: rotation_policy
attributes.description: Inventory rotation policy applied to this SKU in the supply plan. FIFO (First In First Out) and FEFO (First Expired First Out) are standard in food and beverage to minimize waste and ensure food safety compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); ISO 22000 Food Safety Management Systems; GFSI

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Minimum buffer inventory quantity for the SKU at the DC/plant, set to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Drives replenishment trigger signals in IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Remaining shelf life in days for the SKU as applied in this supply plan. Governs FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation policy and constrains planned shipment sequencing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM (Quality Management); FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); ISO 22000

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this supply plan record originated. Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: supply_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supply plan record reflects a constrained supply scenario where planned production or receipts are insufficient to fully satisfy planned demand. Triggers allocation decision workflows.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: supply_demand_balance_qty
attributes.description: Net supply-demand balance position for the SKU over the planning horizon (planned supply minus planned demand). Positive values indicate surplus; negative values indicate a supply gap requiring allocation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for all quantity fields in this supply plan record (e.g., CS=Case, EA=Each, KG=Kilogram). Aligns with the SKU's base UOM in SAP S/4HANA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CS|EA|KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|OZ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management); ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply plan record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks revisions and supports audit trail for IBP governance.
attributes.references: SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer version number of this supply plan snapshot within a planning cycle. Increments with each revision, enabling plan-vs-plan variance analysis.

products.name: replenishment_order
products.description: Planned or released replenishment order generated by MRP or supply planning to move finished goods or raw materials between plants, DCs, and 3PL locations. Captures order type (stock transfer, purchase requisition, planned order), source and destination locations, requested quantity, MOQ compliance, priority, and order status lifecycle (planned → firmed → released → received). Foundation for inbound shipment creation and OTIF measurement.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Stock Transfer Order / Planned Order

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the replenishment order record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete supply chain planning event with a full lifecycle (planned → firmed → released → received).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Stock Transport Order / Planned Order

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Replenishment Order Execution Report ties each order to the retailer account that generated demand, enabling OTIF performance tracking and cost allocation.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Promotional replenishment orders are created from active campaigns to ensure inventory availability for campaign‑driven sales.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics carrier or 3PL partner assigned to transport this replenishment order. Used for carrier performance tracking, freight cost allocation, and SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Freight Vendor; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_center. Business justification: Replenishment Order Execution process requires identifying the target DC to restock; linking ensures accurate inventory allocation and DC‑level reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assign order processing and procurement costs to a cost center for internal budgeting.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand plan or forecast that drove the generation of this replenishment order. Links supply execution back to the demand sensing or S&OP cycle, enabling supply-demand balancing analysis and forecast accuracy measurement.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: destination_location_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving plant, Distribution Center (DC), or 3PL facility where inventory is to be delivered. Drives inbound shipment creation, receiving dock scheduling, and inventory position updates at the destination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Receiving Plant; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Record the financial impact of replenishment orders in the appropriate GL account.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound shipment or Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) created from this replenishment order upon release. Links the supply order to physical logistics execution for tracking, dock scheduling, and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Inbound Delivery (VL31N); EDI 856 ASN

attributes.name: primary_replenishment_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating plant, Distribution Center (DC), or 3PL facility from which inventory will be shipped or transferred. Used for network design analysis, inbound logistics planning, and supply-demand balancing across the DC network.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Plant/Storage Location Master; JDA/Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Replenishment orders are converted to external purchase orders; linking tracks the conversion and order lifecycle.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good, raw material, or packaging material being replenished. Links to the material master for product specifications, shelf life parameters, and FIFO/FEFO rotation rules applicable to this order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master (MARA/MARC); FDA 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Order‑driven replenishment: each replenishment order is generated to satisfy a specific sales order, required for the Replenishment Execution Report.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: REQUIRED: Replenishment order processing and regulatory traceability need a direct FK to the SKU; experts expect sku_id on order for cost, shelf‑life, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Order fulfillment process tracks which inventory stock position is being replenished, enabling OTIF and inventory aging analysis.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor party fulfilling this replenishment order for external procurement types (purchase requisition, purchase order). For internal stock transfers, this references the supplying plant or DC as a party. Maps to PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1); TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods were physically received at the destination location (goods receipt posting date). Used to calculate On Time In Full (OTIF) performance, lead time actuals, and delivery variance against requested and confirmed dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt Date (MIGO); OTIF KPI

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: The Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) number transmitted by the supplier or source location confirming shipment of this replenishment order. Enables proactive receiving dock scheduling, WMS pre-receipt processing, and shipment tracking. Transmitted via EDI 856.
attributes.references: EDI 856 ASN Standard; GS1 Supply Chain Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM — Inbound Delivery

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The production batch or lot number associated with the material being replenished. Enables batch-level traceability for food safety recall management, FEFO rotation enforcement, and quality hold management. Populated when the replenishment order is linked to a specific production batch.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117 — FSMA Traceability; ISO 22000; HACCP

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the supplier or supplying location. May differ from requested_delivery_date. Used to calculate delivery date variance, assess OTIF risk, and trigger escalation workflows when confirmation is later than requested.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Confirmed Delivery Date; EDI 855

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity confirmed by the supplier or supplying location as available and committed for fulfillment. May differ from ordered_quantity due to partial availability, capacity constraints, or MOQ adjustments. Used for supply-demand gap analysis and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Confirmed Quantity; EDI 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgment

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this replenishment order record was first captured in the data platform. Distinct from order_date (business event time). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of data freshness. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA MM — Change Document

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the unit_cost and total_order_value are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency procurement and financial consolidation across global operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the batch being replenished. Used to enforce FEFO rotation policy, calculate shelf_life_days_remaining, and ensure compliance with customer minimum remaining shelf life requirements. Critical for food safety and waste reduction.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117; Codex Alimentarius — Food Labeling; ISO 22000

attributes.name: ibp_plan_version
attributes.description: The SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) plan version or S&OP cycle version under which this replenishment order was generated (e.g., 'BASELINE_2024Q3', 'CONSENSUS_V2'). Enables comparison of supply proposals across planning scenarios and IBP consensus cycles.
attributes.references: SAP IBP — Integrated Business Planning; S&OP Process

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The planned lead time in calendar days from order release to expected goods receipt at the destination location. Derived from the purchasing info record or supply planning parameters. Used for replenishment timing calculations, safety stock parameter setting, and supply planning optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record Lead Time; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: moq_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ordered_quantity meets or exceeds the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) requirement for this material-supplier combination. True = compliant; False = below MOQ threshold, requiring buyer review or rounding up before release.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — MOQ Check; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: The Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) applicable to this replenishment order as defined in the purchasing info record or supply planning parameters. Ensures ordered_quantity meets supplier or logistics minimum thresholds. Critical for procurement compliance and cost optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record (EINA/EINE); MOQ Policy

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: The MRP controller code or planner identifier responsible for managing the replenishment of this material at the source plant. Used for workload assignment, exception management, and accountability tracking in supply planning operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — MRP Controller (DISPO); MD04 MRP List

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, buyer comments, exception explanations, or special handling instructions associated with this replenishment order. Used by supply planners and procurement teams to document non-standard situations, escalations, or supplier communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Text

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the replenishment order was created or generated by the MRP/supply planning system. Represents the principal real-world event time for this transaction. Used for aging analysis, lead time calculation, and OTIF measurement baseline. Maps to BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — ME21N Order Date; SAP IBP Demand Sensing

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the replenishment order as assigned by the ERP or supply planning system (e.g., SAP purchase order number, stock transport order number, or MRP planned order number). Used for cross-system traceability and communication with suppliers and logistics partners. Maps to BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — ME21N / MD04; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the replenishment order. Tracks progression from MRP-generated planned order through firming, release to warehouse/supplier, in-transit movement, and final goods receipt. Cancelled indicates the order was voided before fulfillment. Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Stock Transport Order Status; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment order by its procurement mechanism. Stock Transfer Order (STO) moves inventory between internal plants or DCs. Purchase Requisition is a request to procure from an external supplier. Planned Order is an MRP-generated supply proposal. Purchase Order is a confirmed external procurement. Intercompany Transfer moves goods between legal entities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock_transfer_order|purchase_requisition|planned_order|purchase_order|intercompany_transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Order Type Configuration; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material requested in the replenishment order, expressed in the base unit of measure (e.g., cases, pallets, kg). This is the gross supply proposal quantity generated by MRP or supply planning before any MOQ rounding or adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Order Quantity (MENGE); SAP IBP Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: planned_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which goods are to be issued from the source location (outbound shipment departure). Used for outbound logistics scheduling, warehouse pick/pack planning, and lead time calculation between goods issue and goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Planned Goods Issue Date (STO); JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management

attributes.name: planning_run_code
attributes.description: Reference to the MRP or supply planning run that generated this replenishment order. Enables traceability of supply proposals back to the specific planning cycle, demand signal, and parameter set used. Supports audit of planning decisions and scenario comparison.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — MRP Run (MD01/MD02); SAP IBP Planning Run

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the replenishment order to govern fulfillment sequencing when supply is constrained. Critical = immediate action required (e.g., stockout risk); High = elevated urgency; Medium = standard planning cycle; Low = opportunistic or forward-buy.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Supply Planning — Priority; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: quality_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order or the associated batch is subject to a quality hold that prevents goods receipt or putaway at the destination. True = quality hold active; False = no hold. Integrates with QM module and HACCP/GMP compliance processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Quality Hold; HACCP; GMP; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of material received at the destination location upon goods receipt. Used to calculate fill rate, identify short shipments, and trigger OTIF performance measurement against the confirmed quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt (MIGO); OTIF Measurement

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the replenishment order is required to arrive at the destination location to meet demand or safety stock targets. Drives supplier scheduling, transportation booking, and OTIF measurement. Set by supply planning based on demand signals and inventory parameters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Delivery Date; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: rotation_policy
attributes.description: The inventory rotation policy applicable to this replenishment order. FIFO (First In First Out) = oldest stock consumed first; FEFO (First Expired First Out) = stock with earliest expiry date consumed first (critical for perishable food and beverage products); LIFO (Last In First Out) = rarely used in food industry.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117 — FSMA; GFSI; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: safety_stock_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order was triggered by a safety stock breach (projected inventory falling below safety stock level) rather than a standard demand-driven replenishment signal. True = safety stock replenishment; False = demand-driven or scheduled replenishment.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization — Safety Stock; SAP S/4HANA MM — MRP Safety Stock

attributes.name: shelf_life_days_remaining
attributes.description: The number of days of remaining shelf life on the material at the time of order creation, based on the production date and expiry date of the batch being replenished. Critical for FEFO compliance, quality assurance, and ensuring product arrives at destination with sufficient remaining shelf life to meet customer requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117; ISO 22000; GFSI — Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: total_order_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the replenishment order calculated as ordered_quantity multiplied by unit_cost. Used for procurement spend analysis, inventory investment tracking, and financial planning. Expressed in the order currency. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Value; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transportation used to move the replenishment order from source to destination location. Drives freight cost estimation, lead time calculation, and carbon footprint reporting for sustainability compliance.
attributes.references: JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The standard or purchase cost per unit of measure for the material in this replenishment order. Used to calculate total order value, Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) impact, and inventory valuation. Classified as confidential as it reflects procurement pricing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Standard Cost; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which ordered, confirmed, and received quantities are expressed (e.g., CS=Cases, EA=Each, KG=Kilograms, LB=Pounds, PAL=Pallets, L=Liters, GAL=Gallons). Aligns with the material master UOM configuration in SAP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CS|EA|KG|LB|PAL|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Unit of Measure Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure (MEINS)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this replenishment order record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks changes to order quantity, status, dates, or routing. Used for incremental data processing and audit compliance. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA MM — Change Document

products.name: safety_stock_policy
products.description: Inventory buffer policy defining safety stock levels and reorder parameters per SKU per location across the DC network. Captures safety stock quantity, safety days of supply, reorder point, maximum stock level, min/max replenishment bands, and calculation method (statistical, manual, days-of-supply). Governs when replenishment is triggered and how much buffer inventory is maintained to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty.
products.reference: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization / Safety Stock

attributes.name: safety_stock_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the safety stock policy record. Primary key for the safety_stock_policy data product in the supply domain.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Safety‑stock policies are often set per brand to mitigate demand spikes generated by brand‑specific marketing promotions.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Track safety‑stock holding costs against the cost center responsible for inventory.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DC (Distribution Center) or warehouse location where this safety stock policy applies. Supports multi-node DC network and 3PL partner locations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning Network

attributes.name: primary_safety_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supply planner or demand planner responsible for owning and maintaining this safety stock policy. Supports accountability in the IBP/S&OP cycle and manual override workflows.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; Workday HCM

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Safety‑stock calculations must respect product‑specific regulatory limits (e.g., maximum allowable stock for allergen‑controlled items).

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) governed by this safety stock policy. Links to the product master to identify the specific finished good or semi-finished item.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 GTIN Standard

attributes.name: spec_quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Safety‑stock calculations depend on product specs (shelf‑life, storage) defined in SPECIFICATION; required for inventory planning reports.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Safety‑stock policy execution needs the specific stock position to apply reorder points and safety‑stock quantities per location.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC classification of the SKU based on demand volume or revenue contribution. 'A' items are high-value/high-velocity requiring tighter safety stock management; 'C' items are low-velocity with broader buffers. Used to prioritize inventory management effort.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this safety stock policy was formally approved by the designated supply chain authority. Part of the S&OP governance and change management audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 9001

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to derive the safety stock quantity. 'statistical' uses demand variability and service level targets; 'days_of_supply' uses a fixed days-of-supply multiplier; 'manual' is planner-set; 'min_max' uses min/max replenishment bands; 'demand_driven' uses demand sensing signals from SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for the most recent change to this safety stock policy (e.g., 'Seasonal uplift for Q4 holiday demand', 'Supplier lead time increase', 'Post-launch NPD recalibration'). Required for audit and S&OP governance.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 9001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety stock policy record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning

attributes.name: demand_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of forward-looking days of demand used in the safety stock calculation. Defines the planning horizon over which demand variability is measured for statistical safety stock methods.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: demand_variability_factor
attributes.description: Standard deviation or coefficient of variation of demand used in statistical safety stock calculations. Derived from historical demand sensing data in SAP IBP. Higher values result in larger safety stock buffers.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this safety stock policy becomes binding and governs replenishment decisions for the SKU-location combination. Aligns with IBP/S&OP planning cycle activation.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 22000 Supply Chain Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this safety stock policy ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended policy with no planned expiration. Used to manage seasonal or promotional policy windows.

attributes.name: ibp_policy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Policy ID
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this safety stock policy record in SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning). Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the SAP IBP operational system.

attributes.name: is_new_product
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety stock policy applies to a new product introduction (NPD/NPI). New products typically use manual or days-of-supply methods due to absence of historical demand data. Triggers enhanced monitoring during launch phase.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; NPD; PLM

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy includes a promotional uplift buffer to support planned trade promotions (TPM/TPO events). When True, additional safety stock is pre-positioned at the DC ahead of promotional periods.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning; TPM

attributes.name: is_seasonal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety stock policy incorporates seasonal demand adjustments. When True, the safety stock quantity and days of supply parameters are adjusted based on seasonal demand patterns from the demand planning system.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Sensing; JDA/Blue Yonder Demand Planning

attributes.name: jda_policy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning Policy ID
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this safety stock policy record in JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning. Populated when JDA is the system of record for replenishment planning at the DC network level.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this safety stock policy was last reviewed by the supply planning team. Supports periodic review cadence governance within the IBP/S&OP cycle. Policies not reviewed within the review cycle may be flagged for recalibration.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average replenishment lead time in days from order placement to receipt at the DC location. Used in reorder point and statistical safety stock calculations. Sourced from supplier SLA agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; JDA/Blue Yonder Transportation Management; SLA

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days
attributes.description: Standard deviation of replenishment lead time in days. Used in statistical safety stock calculations to account for supply uncertainty. Higher variability increases the required safety stock buffer.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: max_stock_qty
attributes.description: Maximum allowable on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the location. Defines the upper bound of the min/max replenishment band. Replenishment orders are sized to bring inventory up to this level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: min_stock_qty
attributes.description: Minimum allowable on-hand inventory quantity for the SKU at the location. Defines the lower bound of the min/max replenishment band. Replenishment is triggered when inventory falls to or below this level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity constraint applied to replenishment orders for this SKU-location policy. Sourced from supplier agreements or manufacturing run minimums. Replenishment orders cannot be placed below this quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this safety stock policy. Drives the supply planning review calendar and ensures policies remain calibrated to current demand and supply conditions.

attributes.name: planning_segment
attributes.description: Supply chain planning segment classification for the SKU-location combination. Determines the applicable replenishment and safety stock strategy. 'make_to_stock' is most common for CPG/food and beverage finished goods.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this safety stock policy record across systems (e.g., SAP IBP, JDA/Blue Yonder). Used for cross-system reconciliation and EDI references.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the safety stock policy, typically referencing the SKU, location, or planning segment it governs (e.g., 'RTD Beverage - DC East - Statistical SS').

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety stock policy. 'active' means the policy is live and governing replenishment; 'draft' means under configuration; 'pending_review' means awaiting S&OP approval; 'suspended' means temporarily disabled.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the safety stock policy record, incremented each time the policy parameters are updated. Supports policy change history tracking and audit trail requirements within the supply planning governance framework.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: remaining_shelf_life_min_pct
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable remaining shelf life percentage at time of receipt or shipment from the DC. Ensures safety stock inventory meets customer and retailer freshness requirements. Expressed as a percentage of total shelf life (e.g., 66.67 means at least 2/3 of shelf life must remain).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; GFSI; ISO 22000; Codex Alimentarius; GMP

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment order is triggered for the SKU at the specified location. Calculated as safety stock plus expected demand during replenishment lead time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: replenishment_qty
attributes.description: Standard replenishment order quantity triggered when the reorder point is reached. May be constrained by MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) or pallet/layer rounding rules from the supplier or DC network.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: Frequency in days at which inventory position is reviewed and replenishment decisions are made. Relevant for periodic review systems. Impacts the safety stock calculation for periodic review models.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: rotation_policy
attributes.description: Inventory rotation rule applied at the DC location for this SKU. FIFO (First In First Out) is standard for ambient products; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is mandatory for perishable, chilled, and frozen food and beverage products to minimize waste and ensure food safety compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; GFSI; ISO 22000; HACCP; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: safety_days_of_supply
attributes.description: Safety stock expressed as number of days of forward demand coverage. Used when calculation_method is 'days_of_supply'. Provides a demand-relative buffer measure aligned with FIFO/FEFO rotation policies.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: safety_factor
attributes.description: Statistical safety factor (z-score) corresponding to the target service level. Applied to demand and lead time variability to compute the safety stock quantity in statistical calculation methods. Derived from the normal distribution at the specified service level target.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: The calculated or manually set safety stock quantity (in base unit of measure) that must be maintained as a buffer to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty. Principal quantitative fact of this policy record.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: service_level_target_pct
