attributes.description: Indicates whether unfulfilled quantity from this line was placed on backorder for future fulfillment. Used for backorder management and customer service.

attributes.name: carton_count
attributes.description: Number of cartons or cases used to fulfill this line. Used for packaging and freight calculation.

attributes.name: catch_weight_actual
attributes.description: Actual weight for catch-weight items where weight varies by unit. Used for variable-weight products like fresh produce, meat, or cheese.

attributes.name: catch_weight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for catch weight. Defines whether weight is expressed in pounds, kilograms, ounces, or grams.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU confirmed for fulfillment and actually picked. May differ from ordered quantity due to inventory availability or allocation rules.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fulfillment order line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the line amount. Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-by date for the lot being fulfilled. Used for FEFO picking logic and shelf life management.

attributes.name: fefo_pick_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Pick Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line was picked using FEFO logic to ensure oldest expiration dates are shipped first. Critical for perishable food and beverage products.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global trade item number (UPC/EAN) for the product. Standardized identifier used across the supply chain for product identification.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling and shipping compliance. Relevant for certain cleaning chemicals or alcohol products.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the fulfillment order. Determines the ordering and position of this line item in the order.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of the order line. Tracks the line through the warehouse execution lifecycle from allocation to shipment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|allocated|picked|packed|shipped|cancelled|short_shipped — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value for this line (quantity × unit price). Used for order value calculation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fulfillment order line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU originally ordered by the customer. Represents the requested amount before any adjustments or shortages.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: Original SKU that was ordered if a substitution was made. Null if no substitution occurred.

attributes.name: packed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the line was packed for shipment. Used for packing efficiency and order completion tracking.

attributes.name: pick_zone
attributes.description: Warehouse zone or area where the product was picked. Used for labor planning and zone-based picking strategies.

attributes.name: picked_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the line was physically picked from warehouse inventory. Used for pick productivity and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Date the product was manufactured or packaged. Used for shelf life calculation and quality tracking.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Trade promotion or discount code applied to this line. Used for TPM tracking and promotional effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line underwent quality inspection before shipment. Used for quality assurance and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items. Used for high-value products requiring individual unit tracking.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the SKU shipped to the customer. Final quantity that left the distribution center.

attributes.name: shipped_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the line was shipped from the distribution center. Used for OTIF calculation and ASN generation.

attributes.name: short_ship_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the line was short-shipped or not fully fulfilled. Used for fill rate analysis and root cause investigation.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit code identifying the specific product variant being fulfilled. Used for inventory tracking and warehouse operations.

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a product substitution was made for this line due to stockout or customer approval. Used for substitution rate tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature zone for the product. Critical for cold chain compliance and proper storage of perishable food and beverage items.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit for this line item. Used for invoice generation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the line quantity. Defines whether quantities are expressed in cases, eaches, pallets, or other packaging units.

attributes.name: warehouse_location
attributes.description: Specific warehouse bin or location from which the product was picked. Used for inventory accuracy and slotting optimization.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Physical shipment record consolidating one or more fulfillment orders onto a single carrier move, including load configuration details. Captures shipment number, carrier, service level, trailer/container number, seal number, origin DC, destination, scheduled/actual pickup and delivery datetimes, total weight, total cube, pallet count, utilization percentage, loading sequence, freight cost, temperature requirement (ambient/refrigerated/frozen), temperature zone segregation, and shipment status. Supports outbound logistics execution, carrier performance tracking, freight cost management, and cold chain compliance documentation.
products.reference: Shipment / Freight Order (JDA TMS, SAP S/4HANA SD)

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical shipment record. Primary key for the shipment entity.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: Regulatory batch traceability links shipments to the originating batch record for recall management.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand KPI report requires each shipment linked to its primary brand for on‑time‑in‑full and cost analysis.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Campaign fulfillment tracking needs to tie shipments generated by a specific marketing campaign to measure lift and ROI.

attributes.name: carbon_footprint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_footprint. Business justification: Required for logistics GHG reporting per shipment (Scope 3 emissions) used in ESG disclosures and carbon accounting.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for moving the shipment.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or warehouse from which the shipment originates.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for freight cost allocation to internal cost centers for accurate expense reporting per shipment.

attributes.name: delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the delivery route or multi-stop tour that this shipment is part of, used for route optimization and DSD operations.

attributes.name: driver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed to assign internal drivers to shipments for safety incident tracking and driver performance dashboards.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Needed to post freight expense of each shipment to the appropriate GL account for financial statements.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Logistics planning requires knowing the originating plant for each shipment.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Associates shipments with the pricing zone of origin, needed for freight cost allocation and OTIF compliance reporting by zone.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Required for New Product Launch Shipment Tracking report linking each shipment to its originating R&D project.

attributes.name: retailer_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.retailer_agreement. Business justification: Compliance reporting requires each shipment to be linked to the retailer agreement governing delivery windows, fees, and penalties.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Required for Shipment‑Order reconciliation report used in OTIF compliance; each shipment must be tied to the originating sales order.

attributes.name: ship_to_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination location (customer site, retail store, or receiving facility) for the shipment.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Inbound receipt of goods from a supplier to a distribution center is tracked in shipments for inventory, quality, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_datetime
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the shipment was delivered to the destination location, used for OTIF and SLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: actual_pickup_datetime
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the carrier picked up the shipment from the origin DC, used for OTIF performance tracking.

attributes.name: asn_sent_datetime
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) Sent Date and Time
attributes.description: Date and time when the ASN was transmitted to the customer, used for EDI compliance and customer notification tracking.

attributes.name: asn_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an EDI 856 Advanced Shipping Notice has been transmitted to the customer or receiving facility.

attributes.name: case_count
attributes.description: Total number of cases or cartons included in the shipment across all pallets.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipment record was first created in the WMS or TMS system.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment was processed through a cross-docking operation without long-term storage at the DC.

attributes.name: delivery_exception_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any delivery exception or issue encountered during shipment (e.g., damaged product, refused delivery, address error, weather delay).

attributes.name: delivery_exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing any delivery exceptions, issues, or special circumstances encountered during shipment execution.

attributes.name: dsd_route_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment is part of a DSD route where products are delivered directly to retail stores, bypassing retailer DCs.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight cost charged by the carrier for this shipment, used for freight spend analysis and accrual.

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the freight cost amount.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and carrier certification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipment record was last updated, used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: loading_sequence
attributes.description: Instructions or sequence identifier for how pallets should be loaded into the trailer to optimize delivery route and unloading efficiency.

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Celsius for the shipment to maintain product quality and safety during transit.

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Celsius for the shipment to maintain product quality and safety during transit.

attributes.name: otif_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment met OTIF performance criteria (delivered on time and with complete order quantity), a key supply chain KPI.

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Total number of pallets or handling units included in the shipment.

attributes.name: pod_signature_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who signed for the delivery at the destination location, captured as part of proof of delivery.

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the proof of delivery was captured, typically matching or closely following the actual delivery datetime.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether proof of delivery documentation (signature, photo, or electronic confirmation) has been received from the carrier or customer.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_datetime
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the shipment is scheduled to arrive at the destination location.

attributes.name: scheduled_pickup_datetime
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the carrier is scheduled to pick up the shipment from the origin DC.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number applied to the trailer or container to ensure tamper-evidence and cargo integrity during transit.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: The transportation service level or speed tier selected for this shipment (e.g., standard ground, expedited, next-day).

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shipment, used for tracking and communication with carriers and customers.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shipment in the outbound logistics workflow.

attributes.name: stop_sequence
attributes.description: The sequence number of this delivery stop within the overall route, used for route planning and driver instructions.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Temperature control requirement for the shipment to maintain cold chain compliance and product quality (ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or controlled).

attributes.name: temperature_zone_segregation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains products requiring segregation into multiple temperature zones within the same trailer.

attributes.name: third_party_logistics_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment was fulfilled by a third-party logistics provider rather than a company-owned distribution center.

attributes.name: total_cube_m3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Shipment Cube in Cubic Meters
attributes.description: Total volumetric cube of the shipment in cubic meters, used for load planning and carrier billing.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including product, packaging, and pallets.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: The trailer, container, or vehicle identification number assigned to this shipment for physical transport.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of trailer or container capacity utilized by this shipment, calculated based on weight or cube constraints.

products.name: shipment_stop
products.description: Individual stop on a multi-stop shipment or DSD route, representing a delivery or pickup event at a specific customer location. Captures stop sequence, stop type (delivery, pickup, cross-dock), customer location, scheduled arrival window, actual arrival time, actual departure time, cases delivered, cases refused, POD signature captured flag, and stop status. Enables route execution tracking and OTIF measurement at the stop level.
products.reference: Delivery Stop / Route Stop (JDA TMS, DSD Route Management)

attributes.name: shipment_stop_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shipment stop record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or location receiving the delivery or providing the pickup. Links to the customer master for account and contact details.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle (truck, van, trailer) used for this stop. Used for vehicle utilization, maintenance scheduling, and cold chain equipment tracking.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) provider executing this stop. Used for carrier performance tracking and cost allocation.

attributes.name: delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned route or DSD (Direct Store Delivery) route that this stop belongs to. Used for route optimization and performance analysis.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver who executed this stop. Used for driver performance tracking, training needs, and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment or route that this stop belongs to. Links to the shipment header for multi-stop delivery routes.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Required for dock planning and inventory visibility: each shipment stop must be linked to a defined storage location in inventory.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: Each inbound shipment stop occurs at a supplier site; linking enables logistics planning and carrier‑supplier coordination.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time the vehicle arrived at the stop location. Captured via driver mobile app, GPS telematics, or manual entry. Used for OTIF calculation.

attributes.name: actual_cases_delivered
attributes.description: Number of cases actually delivered and accepted at this stop. Used for fill rate and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: actual_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time the vehicle departed from the stop location after completing delivery or pickup. Used for dwell time and route efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: actual_volume_m3
attributes.description: Actual volume in cubic meters of goods delivered or picked up at this stop. May differ from planned due to refusals or adjustments.

attributes.name: actual_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual weight in kilograms of goods delivered or picked up at this stop. May differ from planned due to refusals or adjustments.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Shipping Notice number sent to the customer prior to delivery via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Used for customer receiving preparation and cross-reference.

attributes.name: cases_picked_up
attributes.description: Number of cases picked up from the customer location (e.g., returns, empties, reverse logistics). Applicable when stop_type is pickup or return.

attributes.name: cases_refused
attributes.description: Number of cases refused by the customer at delivery due to damage, temperature excursion, incorrect product, or other quality issues. Triggers return and credit processes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shipment stop record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for the driver at this stop (e.g., use rear entrance, call upon arrival, leave at loading dock). Provided by customer or route planner.

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes spent at the stop location, calculated as the difference between actual_arrival_timestamp and actual_departure_timestamp. Used for route efficiency and driver productivity analysis.

attributes.name: failure_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the failure reason in detail. Captured by driver or dispatcher when a stop cannot be completed.

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the stop failed if stop_status is failed. Used for root cause analysis and service improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_closed|access_denied|address_incorrect|product_refused|vehicle_breakdown|weather|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the full planned quantity was delivered (True = actual_cases_delivered equals planned_cases_delivered, False = short delivery). Used for OTIF KPI calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shipment stop record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stop was completed on time (True = arrival within scheduled window, False = late or early outside tolerance). Used for OTIF KPI calculation.

attributes.name: planned_cases_delivered
attributes.description: Number of cases scheduled for delivery at this stop according to the route plan. Used for load planning and fill rate calculation.

attributes.name: planned_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total planned volume in cubic meters of goods to be delivered or picked up at this stop. Used for vehicle capacity planning and cube utilization.

attributes.name: planned_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total planned weight in kilograms of goods to be delivered or picked up at this stop. Used for vehicle load planning and compliance with weight regulations.

attributes.name: pod_photo_captured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Proof of Delivery (POD) Photo Captured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a photo proof of delivery was captured at this stop (True = photo taken, False = no photo). Used for contactless delivery verification.

attributes.name: pod_signature_captured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Proof of Delivery (POD) Signature Captured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a proof of delivery signature was captured at this stop (True = signature obtained, False = no signature). Required for delivery confirmation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: pod_signature_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who signed for the delivery. Captured via driver mobile app or paper manifest. Used for delivery verification.

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the proof of delivery was captured. May differ slightly from actual_departure_timestamp if signature is obtained before final vehicle departure.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned date for arrival at the stop location. Used for customer communication and route planning.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_time_end
attributes.description: End of the scheduled arrival time window. Defines the latest acceptable arrival time for on-time performance measurement.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_time_start
attributes.description: Beginning of the scheduled arrival time window. Used for customer appointment scheduling and OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement.

attributes.name: stop_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the stop, typically a sequential or formatted code used in route planning and driver manifests.

attributes.name: stop_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this stop within the shipment route. Used for route optimization and execution order (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

attributes.name: stop_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stop: scheduled (planned but not started), in_transit (en route), arrived (vehicle at location), completed (delivery/pickup finished), failed (unable to complete), cancelled (stop removed from route).

attributes.name: stop_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stop activity: delivery (outbound to customer), pickup (inbound from supplier or return), cross-dock (transfer between vehicles), return (product return), or inspection (quality check point).

attributes.name: temperature_at_delivery_c
attributes.description: Product temperature in Celsius recorded at the time of delivery. Captured via temperature monitoring device or manual thermometer reading. Required for cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery maintained required cold chain temperature throughout the stop (True = compliant, False = excursion detected). Critical for food safety and FSMA compliance.

products.name: proof_of_delivery
products.description: Electronic or paper Proof of Delivery (POD) record confirming receipt of goods at the customer location. Captures POD number, shipment reference, stop reference, delivery datetime, receiver name, receiver signature (digital), cases received, cases refused, refusal reason, temperature at delivery (cold chain), condition notes, and POD capture method (ePOD, paper scan, EDI 214). Critical for OTIF measurement, dispute resolution, and invoice matching.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the proof of delivery record.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who received the delivery.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or third-party logistics (3PL) provider that executed the delivery.

attributes.name: delivery_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery order fulfilled by this delivery.

attributes.name: delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery route on which this delivery was executed, used for Direct Store Delivery (DSD) route management.

attributes.name: ship_to_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific delivery location (store, warehouse, distribution center) where goods were received.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment that this proof of delivery confirms.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the delivery was completed and goods were received, critical for OTIF measurement and invoice matching.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Shipping Notice number associated with this delivery, used for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) processing and pre-receipt notification.

attributes.name: cases_delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual number of cases successfully delivered and accepted by the receiver, used for fill rate calculation.

attributes.name: cases_ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of cases that were originally ordered and scheduled for delivery.

attributes.name: cases_refused_quantity
attributes.description: Number of cases refused or rejected by the receiver at the time of delivery.

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery met cold chain temperature requirements throughout transit and at delivery, ensuring food safety and quality for perishable products.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proof of delivery record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_condition_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the overall condition of the delivered goods at the time of receipt.

attributes.name: delivery_condition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the condition of the delivered goods, including any damage, quality concerns, or packaging issues observed at delivery.

attributes.name: delivery_photo_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographic evidence of the delivery was captured via mobile device or ePOD system.

attributes.name: delivery_photo_url
attributes.description: URL or storage path to the delivery photo image file, used for proof of delivery and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current status of the delivery in its lifecycle workflow.

attributes.name: dispute_raised
attributes.description: Indicates whether a delivery dispute has been raised by the customer or carrier regarding this proof of delivery.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate captured at the time of delivery, used for delivery verification and route optimization analytics.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate captured at the time of delivery, used for delivery verification and route optimization analytics.

attributes.name: in_full_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the full ordered quantity was delivered without shortages, used for fill rate and in-full delivery KPI measurement.

attributes.name: invoice_matched
attributes.description: Indicates whether the proof of delivery has been successfully matched to the corresponding invoice for three-way matching (PO, receipt, invoice).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proof of delivery record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: on_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery was completed within the scheduled time window, used for on-time delivery KPI measurement.

attributes.name: otif_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery met On Time In Full (OTIF) performance criteria: delivered on scheduled date within time window and with full ordered quantity.

attributes.name: pod_capture_method
attributes.description: Method used to capture the proof of delivery: electronic POD device, paper scan, EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message, mobile application, or no signature required.

attributes.name: pod_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the proof of delivery document, used for tracking and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: receiver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who received and signed for the delivery at the customer location.

attributes.name: receiver_signature_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether a digital or physical signature was captured from the receiver as proof of receipt.

attributes.name: receiver_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual who received the delivery (e.g., Store Manager, Receiving Clerk, Warehouse Supervisor).

attributes.name: refusal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for refusal or rejection of delivered goods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damaged|expired|wrong_product|overage|quality_issue|no_order|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refusal_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional detail about the reason for refusal, used for dispute resolution and quality investigation.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the delivery, used for On Time In Full (OTIF) measurement and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_time_window_end
attributes.description: End of the scheduled delivery time window, used for precise delivery appointment tracking.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_time_window_start
attributes.description: Start of the scheduled delivery time window, used for precise delivery appointment tracking.

attributes.name: signature_image_url
attributes.description: URL or storage path to the digital signature image file captured via electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) device.

attributes.name: stop_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential stop number on the delivery route, used for route optimization and last-mile logistics tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_at_delivery_celsius
attributes.description: Recorded temperature of the delivery at the time of receipt, critical for cold chain compliance and food safety verification for refrigerated and frozen products.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), HACCP

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion (deviation from acceptable range) occurred during transit or at delivery, requiring quality review.

products.name: advance_ship_notice
products.description: Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) record transmitted to customers or received from suppliers/co-packers prior to shipment arrival. Captures ASN number, ASN type (outbound to customer, inbound from supplier), trading partner, shipment reference, expected arrival date, SKU/GTIN list, lot numbers, quantities, pallet labels (SSCC), and EDI 856 transaction status. Supports retailer compliance, DC receiving, and FSMA traceability requirements.

attributes.name: advance_ship_notice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advanced shipping notice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for delivering this shipment.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns ASN processing costs to a cost center, enabling accurate cost allocation for inbound logistics.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tracks the employee responsible for ASN creation, required for traceability and regulatory audit reports.

attributes.name: edi_trading_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the trading partner (customer, retailer, supplier, or co-packer) associated with this ASN. For outbound ASNs, this is the recipient; for inbound ASNs, this is the sender.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment order that this ASN is fulfilling. Links ASN to the originating customer order or purchase order.

attributes.name: ship_from_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating facility (distribution center, manufacturing plant, co-packer, or supplier warehouse) from which goods are shipped.

attributes.name: ship_to_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination facility (customer DC, retail store, foodservice location, or receiving warehouse) where goods will be delivered.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical shipment record associated with this ASN. Links ASN to warehouse management and transportation execution systems.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: ASN processing uses SKU to validate shipment contents, enabling accurate inventory allocation and regulatory compliance checks.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: ASN originates from the supplying vendor; linking to supplier supports performance tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the shipment departed from the origin facility. Used for OTIF performance measurement.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the ASN transmitted to customers or received from suppliers. Externally-known unique reference number.

attributes.name: asn_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ASN. Tracks progression from creation through transmission, acknowledgment, and final receipt or rejection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|transmitted|acknowledged|in_transit|received|rejected|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asn_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ASN direction and purpose. Outbound ASNs are sent to customers/retailers; inbound ASNs are received from suppliers, co-packers, or contract manufacturers.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Carrier-issued bill of lading number for the shipment. Legal document serving as receipt and contract of carriage.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether continuous temperature monitoring and cold chain documentation is required for this shipment.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Section 204

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ASN record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: edi_acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the trading partner acknowledged receipt of the ASN via EDI 997 functional acknowledgment.

attributes.name: edi_control_number
attributes.description: Unique control number assigned to the EDI 856 transaction for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: EDI transaction set identifier. ASNs use the 856 Ship Notice/Manifest transaction set.

attributes.name: edi_transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ASN was transmitted via EDI to the trading partner. Used for compliance and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the shipment will arrive at the destination facility. Critical for DC receiving planning and retailer compliance.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_time_window_end
attributes.description: End of the delivery appointment window. Late arrivals may result in chargebacks or rejected shipments.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_time_window_start
attributes.description: Start of the delivery appointment window. Many retailers require precise time-slot delivery for dock scheduling.

attributes.name: expected_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the shipment will depart from the origin facility.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and documentation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ASN record was last modified. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Customer or supplier purchase order number that this ASN is fulfilling. Used for cross-reference and compliance validation.

attributes.name: ship_to_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the destination location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: ship_to_city
attributes.description: City of the destination location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the destination location.

attributes.name: ship_to_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the destination location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: ship_to_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code of the destination location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature control zone for the shipment. Critical for cold chain compliance and food safety.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Section 204

attributes.name: total_carton_count
attributes.description: Total number of cartons or cases included in this shipment. Used for receiving verification and inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: total_pallet_count
attributes.description: Total number of pallets included in this shipment. Used for dock space planning and receiving resource allocation.

attributes.name: total_volume
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the shipment. Used for trailer utilization and warehouse space planning.

attributes.name: total_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the shipment including packaging. Used for freight cost validation and carrier capacity planning.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for real-time shipment visibility and proof of delivery.

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for shipment volume. CF=cubic feet, CBM=cubic meters, L=liters.

attributes.name: weight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for shipment weight. LB=pounds, KG=kilograms, TON=US tons, MT=metric tonnes.

products.name: wms_transaction
products.description: Granular WMS (Warehouse Management System) transaction record capturing all warehouse movements within a DC — receipts, putaways, picks, replenishments, transfers, cycle counts, adjustments, wave/batch releases, and dock door loading events. Captures transaction type, transaction datetime, DC, storage location (zone/aisle/bay/level), SKU, lot, quantity, UOM, operator ID, equipment ID, wave/batch ID, dock door reference, and WMS source system reference. Wave/batch release transactions serve as the operational record for wave planning within the DC (wave ID, wave release time, orders in wave, wave completion status). Provides the operational audit trail for all inventory movements, pick operations, and wave execution within distribution facilities. Supports lot traceability, FEFO compliance verification, DC productivity measurement, and wave performance analysis.
products.reference: WMS Transaction / Warehouse Task (SAP S/4HANA WM, WMS)

attributes.name: wms_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the WMS transaction record. Primary key for all warehouse movement events within distribution centers.

attributes.name: carton_id
attributes.description: Carton or case identifier for case-level tracking. Used for serialized shipment tracking and ASN generation.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center where this transaction occurred.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allocates labor and equipment costs captured in WMS transactions to the responsible cost center for internal cost tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse operator or picker who executed this transaction. Used for productivity tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: experimental_formula_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_formula. Business justification: Enables inventory traceability of experimental formula batches during pilot manufacturing.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment order associated with this transaction. Populated for pick, loading, and wave release transactions.

attributes.name: ingredient_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ingredient.lot. Business justification: Warehouse Transaction Traceability: linking WMS moves to ingredient lot supports audit of lot handling.

attributes.name: lifecycle_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.lifecycle_assessment. Business justification: Links warehouse transactions to product LCA data to calculate real‑time carbon intensity per move.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Warehouse transaction reconciliation with production orders ensures inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: WMS transactions record receipt and movement of inventory against a specific purchase order for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: WMS transaction reporting requires linking each inventory movement to the master SKU for traceability, costing, and compliance reports.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Regulatory and audit need: WMS transaction must reference the specific stock position moved to ensure traceability and accurate valuation.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Advanced Shipping Notice number for inbound receipt transactions. Links WMS receipts to supplier shipment notifications via EDI.

attributes.name: catch_weight
attributes.description: Actual weight for variable-weight products (meat, produce, cheese). Used when product weight varies from standard case weight.

attributes.name: catch_weight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for catch weight: lb (pounds), kg (kilograms), oz (ounces), g (grams).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was first created in the data lakehouse. Audit field for data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dock_door
attributes.description: Dock door number for receipt and loading transactions. Used for yard management and carrier coordination.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-by date. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) picking logic and shelf life management.

attributes.name: fefo_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pick transaction followed FEFO logic (picking the lot with the nearest expiration date first). Critical for food safety and waste reduction.
attributes.references: FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) Traceability Rule

attributes.name: from_location
attributes.description: Source warehouse location for the transaction. Format typically zone-aisle-bay-level (e.g., A-12-05-C). Null for receipt transactions.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number for the product. Standardized product identifier used across the supply chain (GTIN-8, UPC-12, EAN-13, or GTIN-14 format).

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product in this transaction is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling and storage.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was last modified in the data lakehouse. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: pallet_code
attributes.description: License plate or pallet identifier for the handling unit. Used for pallet-level tracking and cross-docking operations.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number for receipt transactions. Links warehouse receipts to procurement orders.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction triggered or required a quality inspection. Used for GMP and HACCP compliance tracking.
attributes.references: HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of product moved in this transaction. Positive for receipts and putaways, negative for picks and adjustments out.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code for adjustment and transfer transactions: damage (product damage), expiration (expired product), quality_hold (QA hold), customer_return (returned goods), overage (excess inventory), shortage (missing inventory), cycle_count_variance (count discrepancy), system_correction (ERP sync adjustment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damage|expiration|quality_hold|customer_return|overage|shortage|cycle_count_variance|system_correction — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Original transaction identifier from the source WMS system. Used for audit trail and reconciliation with operational WMS.

attributes.name: storage_zone
attributes.description: Warehouse zone classification for the transaction location: reserve (long-term storage), pick_face (active picking area), bulk (pallet storage), cross_dock (direct transfer), quarantine (quality hold), staging (outbound prep), returns (customer returns), damaged (defective goods). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reserve|pick_face|bulk|cross_dock|quarantine|staging|returns|damaged — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control zone for cold chain compliance: ambient (room temperature), refrigerated (35-45°F), frozen (0°F or below), controlled (specific temperature range). Critical for food safety and quality assurance.
attributes.references: HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) Guidelines

attributes.name: to_location
attributes.description: Destination warehouse location for the transaction. Format typically zone-aisle-bay-level (e.g., B-08-12-A). Null for pick and loading transactions.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the WMS transaction: pending (queued for execution), in_progress (being executed), completed (successfully finished), cancelled (aborted), error (system failure).

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the warehouse transaction was executed in the WMS. This is the operational event time, distinct from audit timestamps.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of warehouse movement transaction: receipt (inbound goods arrival), putaway (placement into storage), pick (order fulfillment selection), replenishment (stock movement to pick face), transfer (location-to-location movement), cycle_count (inventory verification), adjustment (inventory correction), wave_release (batch order release), loading (dock door staging). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: receipt|putaway|pick|replenishment|transfer|cycle_count|adjustment|wave_release|loading — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the transaction quantity: each (individual unit), case (shipping case), pallet (full pallet), layer (pallet layer), inner_pack (multi-pack), display_unit (retail display).

attributes.name: wave_code
attributes.description: Wave or batch identifier for grouped order fulfillment. Links pick transactions to wave planning and release events. Null for non-pick transactions.

attributes.name: wms_source_system
attributes.description: Source WMS system identifier (e.g., Manhattan, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM, HighJump). Used for multi-WMS environments and data lineage.

products.name: cold_chain_event
products.description: Temperature monitoring event record for cold chain compliance during storage and transit. Captures event datetime, asset type (trailer, DC zone, reefer unit), asset identifier, sensor ID, recorded temperature (°F/°C), target temperature range (min/max), Brix or pH if applicable, excursion flag, excursion duration (minutes), corrective action taken, and FSMA/HACCP compliance status. Critical for food safety regulatory compliance and cold chain SLA management.
products.reference: Temperature Log / Cold Chain Record (FSMA Sanitary Transportation, HACCP)

attributes.name: cold_chain_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cold chain monitoring event record.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: Cold‑chain compliance monitoring per batch requires linking temperature events to the batch record.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Temperature compliance reports are often brand‑specific; linking events to brand enables brand‑wise quality monitoring.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transportation carrier responsible for the cold chain asset during transit.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the quality assurance or food safety personnel who reviewed the cold chain event and made the disposition decision.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Temperature excursion reports must reference the product registration to satisfy FDA and FSMA traceability requirements.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shipment or load associated with this cold chain monitoring event.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Cold‑chain monitoring must associate temperature excursions with the specific SKU to satisfy FSMA/HACCP audit and product recall processes.

attributes.name: alert_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether an automated alert notification was sent to responsible personnel when the excursion was detected (True if sent, False if not sent).

attributes.name: alert_recipient_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses or user IDs that received the temperature excursion alert notification.

attributes.name: asset_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier or code for the specific cold chain asset (e.g., trailer number, zone code, reefer unit serial number).

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Type of cold chain asset being monitored (trailer, distribution center zone, reefer unit, container, warehouse room, or transport vehicle).

attributes.name: brix_measurement
attributes.description: Sugar content measurement in degrees Brix if applicable to the product being monitored (primarily for beverages and fruit products).

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action implemented in response to a temperature excursion or monitoring alert.

attributes.name: corrective_action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when corrective action was initiated in response to the temperature excursion.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cold chain event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the destination location (retail store, distribution center, or customer site) for the cold chain shipment.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the product following temperature excursion review (approved for sale, rejected, quarantined, pending review, or destroyed).

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the temperature monitoring event was recorded in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: excursion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes that the temperature remained outside the acceptable range during the excursion event.

attributes.name: excursion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the recorded temperature exceeded the acceptable range (True if excursion occurred, False if within range).

attributes.name: excursion_severity
attributes.description: Classification of the temperature excursion severity based on duration and deviation magnitude (minor, moderate, major, or critical).

attributes.name: fsma_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the cold chain event monitoring and response met FSMA compliance requirements (True if compliant, False if non-compliant).

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the cold chain asset at the time of the temperature reading.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the cold chain asset at the time of the temperature reading.

attributes.name: haccp_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the cold chain event monitoring and response met HACCP critical control point requirements (True if compliant, False if non-compliant).

attributes.name: humidity_percentage
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage in the cold chain environment if monitored alongside temperature.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the product being monitored for traceability purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cold chain event record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the cold chain event, excursion circumstances, or corrective actions taken.

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the origin location (distribution center, manufacturing plant, or warehouse) where the cold chain monitoring began.

attributes.name: ph_measurement
attributes.description: Acidity or alkalinity measurement on the pH scale if applicable to the product being monitored (critical for food safety and quality).

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level category of food or beverage product being transported or stored in the cold chain asset. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dairy|beverage|frozen|fresh_produce|meat|seafood|prepared_foods — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the product was placed on quality hold due to the temperature excursion (True if on hold, False if released).

attributes.name: recorded_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading captured by the sensor in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: recorded_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading captured by the sensor in degrees Fahrenheit.

products.name: otif_record
products.description: On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance measurement record capturing delivery performance against customer-committed windows at the shipment or fulfillment order level. Captures measurement date, customer account, retailer OTIF program (Walmart OTIF, Target In-Stock, Kroger OTD, Costco delivery compliance), shipment reference, fulfillment order reference, committed delivery window, actual delivery datetime, on-time flag, in-full flag, OTIF composite score, cases ordered, cases delivered, fill rate percentage, penalty/fine amount, chargeback reference, root cause code for misses (carrier delay, DC late release, inventory short, weather), and corrective action reference. products.name: order
products.description: Complete sales order document capturing all commercial sales transactions across retail, foodservice, and DTC channels, including both header-level and line-level detail in a single authoritative record. Header: order number, order date, requested delivery date, order type (standard, rush, blanket, standing), order status, channel, customer account reference, ship-to and bill-to locations, currency, payment terms, incoterms, total order value, EDI 850 reference, and ERP sales document number. products.name: sales_contract
products.description: Master commercial agreement between Food Beverage and a customer (retailer, foodservice operator, distributor) governing pricing, volume commitments, promotional terms, slotting fees, and service levels. Captures contract number, contract type (volume rebate, pricing agreement, distribution agreement, co-packing agreement, slotting agreement), effective dates, contracted volume, RSP commitments, EDLP pricing tiers, payment terms, exclusivity clauses, auto-renewal flag, and Salesforce CRM opportunity reference. For slotting-type contracts: includes retailer account, SKU/GTIN, store count, fee per store, total commitment, payment schedule, shelf section, launch date, minimum shelf duration, and velocity-based performance clauses. ADR: Slotting agreements are modeled as a contract_type within this product (not as a separate entity) because they are negotiated by sales/category teams during new item sell-in and directly tied to distribution point creation. Trade domain owns broader promotional agreements (TPM/TPO); this product owns the commercial commitment for shelf placement fees. Commission/incentive compensation calculation is owned by the finance/workforce domain; sales provides quota attainment data as input.

products.name: pos_transaction
products.description: Point-of-sale scan data record capturing consumer purchase activity at the retail store level, sourced from retailer POS feeds, syndicated data providers (Nielsen/IRI/Circana/SPINS), and direct retailer data sharing programs (e.g., Walmart Luminate, Kroger 84.51°). products.name: distribution_point

domains.description: Trade promotion management and optimization (TPM/TPO) including promotional planning, accruals, deductions, chargebacks, slotting fees, retailer agreement terms, category captain agreements, trade spend analytics, and promotional ROI measurement.

products.name: promotion_plan
products.description: Master record for trade promotion plans created by sales/trade marketing teams. Defines the complete promotional event including promotion type (TPR, display, feature ad, BOGO, scan-back), planned start/end dates, target retailer accounts, participating SKUs, funding source, promotional mechanic, approval status, and volume/ROI forecast. Includes planning-stage forecasts: baseline volume, incremental lift estimate, total promoted volume, net revenue impact, trade spend investment, estimated ROI, forecast method (statistical model, historical analogy, sales rep input), and forecast version. Serves as the authoritative header for all downstream execution, accrual, deduction, and settlement tracking. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD, TPM modules, and SAP IBP demand sensing.

attributes.description: Flavor profile the consumer favors (e.g., sweet, salty, spicy). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sweet|salty|spicy|sour|umami|bitter|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preferred_pack_size

attributes.name: preferred_product_category
attributes.description: Primary product category the consumer prefers (e.g., snacks, beverages, dairy). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: snacks|beverages|dairy|convenience|organic|health|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: preferred_purchase_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the consumer most often purchases.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: sugar_content_preference

attributes.name: sustainable_packaging_preference_flag

attributes.name: timezone_preference
attributes.description: Preferred timezone of the consumer.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: edi_trading_partner
products.description: EDI trading partner configuration for B2B customers — EDI partner ID, EDI standard (ANSI X12, EDIFACT), supported transaction sets (850 PO, 855 PO Ack, 856 ASN, 810 Invoice), communication protocol (AS2, SFTP, VAN), test vs production flag, EDI contact, and onboarding status. Manages electronic commerce connectivity for retail and distributor accounts.

attributes.name: edi_trading_partner_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the EDI trading partner configuration.

attributes.name: communication_endpoint
attributes.description: URL or network address of the partner's EDI gateway.

attributes.name: communication_protocol

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Regulatory or industry compliance constraints applicable to the partner (e.g., FDA, GFSI).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: edi_contact_email

attributes.name: edi_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the technical contact responsible for EDI integration.

attributes.name: edi_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the technical EDI contact.

attributes.name: edi_standard
attributes.description: Standard used for EDI messages with this partner.

attributes.name: edi_trading_partner_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the trading partner configuration.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: is_test_environment

attributes.name: last_onboarded_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current status of the partner's EDI onboarding process.

attributes.name: partner_code
attributes.description: Business‑assigned code used to reference the partner in internal systems.

attributes.name: partner_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the trading partner organization.

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Category of the partner based on its role in the supply chain.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact for EDI communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_method
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for the primary contact.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the main person to contact at the trading partner organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact for EDI communications.

attributes.name: supported_transaction_sets
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of EDI transaction sets (e.g., 850,855,856,810) supported for this partner.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the trading partner record.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the partner configuration record.

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Data privacy and marketing consent records for DTC and B2C consumers — consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling), consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent date, withdrawal date, consent source (web form, mobile app, in-store), regulatory jurisdiction (GDPR, CCPA, CASL), and consent version. Supports FDA, FTC, and global privacy compliance obligations.

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the consent record.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the consumer to whom the consent applies.

attributes.name: consent_given_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the consent was granted.

attributes.name: consent_source
attributes.description: Origin of the consent capture (e.g., web form, mobile app, in‑store, call center).

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of the consent record.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent (e.g., marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling).

attributes.name: consent_version

attributes.name: consent_withdrawn_timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_processing_purpose

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until

attributes.name: jurisdiction

attributes.name: legal_basis

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: privacy_policy_version
attributes.description: Version of the overall privacy policy referenced by this consent.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the consent record.

products.name: recall_notification
products.description: Represents the notification sent from the company to a customer account about a specific recall event, capturing when the notification was sent and whether the account acknowledged it.. Existence Justification: Each recall event can affect many customer accounts, and a single account can be impacted by multiple recall events over time. The business actively tracks the date a notification was sent to an account and whether the account has acknowledged the recall. This information is managed as a distinct record linking an account to a recall event.

attributes.name: recall_notification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the RecallNotification association

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer account

attributes.name: recall_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the recall event

attributes.name: acknowledgment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the account's acknowledgment of the recall notification

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date and time the recall notification was sent to the account

products.name: sponsorship
products.description: Represents the contractual sponsorship relationship between a customer account and an R&D project. Each record captures the amount contributed, the period of sponsorship, and the role of the sponsor.. Existence Justification: An account (customer) can sponsor multiple R&D projects and a single R&D project can receive sponsorship from multiple accounts. The sponsorship relationship is actively managed, with amounts, dates, and roles recorded for each sponsorship, and stakeholders track these records for revenue sharing and strategic reporting.

attributes.name: sponsorship_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the Sponsorship association

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sponsoring account

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sponsored R&D project

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary contribution of the account to the project

domains.name: marketing
domains.description: Brand management, consumer engagement, campaigns, advertising spend, marketing claims (FTC compliance), digital and shopper marketing, social media, influencer partnerships, market research, Nielsen/IRI/SPINS syndicated data, consumer insights, private label program data, and brand equity tracking. Supports Salesforce Marketing Cloud execution.
domains.references: FTC Truth in Advertising, FDA Claim Substantiation, GDPR, CCPA

products.name: brand
products.description: Master record for each brand in the F&B portfolio — captures brand identity, positioning, tier (premium, mainstream, value), brand architecture (masterbrand, sub-brand, endorsed), target consumer segment, brand equity score inputs, launch date, and lifecycle status. SSOT for brand identity across the enterprise. Supports brand equity tracking and PLM alignment.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each brand record in the Food Beverage portfolio. Primary key for the brand master data product. Serves as the enterprise-wide SSOT reference for brand identity across PLM, ERP, CRM, and marketing systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Brand Master; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Brand manager assignment is tracked for brand strategy decisions; linking to employee enables Brand Manager performance reports.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Capacity planning and brand‑level supply chain reporting need a primary plant reference for each brand.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Brand performance is aggregated in profit centers for P&L reporting; FK enables profit‑center level analysis.

attributes.name: target_consumer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Brand strategy defines a target consumer segment; FK replaces the denormalized segment name, enabling segment‑based budgeting and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: allergen_free_claims
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allergen-free claims associated with the brand (e.g., 'gluten-free, nut-free, dairy-free'). Derived from the allergen matrix managed in TraceGains. Must comply with FDA FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act) and FSMA requirements. Used in consumer marketing and retail planogram placement.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA 21 USC 343; FSMA 2011; Codex Alimentarius Allergen Standards; TraceGains Allergen Matrix

attributes.name: annual_marketing_budget
attributes.description: Total approved annual marketing investment budget allocated to the brand, expressed in the functional currency. Includes above-the-line (ATL) advertising, below-the-line (BTL) shopper marketing, digital, and trade promotion spend. Confidential financial data managed in Oracle Cloud ERP Financials and SAP CO cost centers.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; EBITDA Reporting Framework

attributes.name: architecture_type
attributes.description: Classification of the brand within the corporate brand architecture hierarchy. 'masterbrand' = umbrella brand covering multiple product lines; 'sub_brand' = brand operating under a masterbrand; 'endorsed' = independent brand with parent brand endorsement; 'standalone' = fully independent brand; 'private_label' = retailer-owned brand manufactured by Food Beverage under co-packing or toll manufacturing arrangements.
attributes.references: Brand Architecture Framework; Nielsen/IRI Brand Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: awareness_pct
attributes.description: Unaided or total brand awareness percentage among the target consumer segment, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Sourced from Nielsen/IRI consumer panel studies or commissioned brand health tracking research. Key input to brand equity score calculation and marketing investment justification.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Panel Data; Codex Alimentarius Consumer Research Standards

attributes.name: brand_category
attributes.description: Primary consumer product category to which the brand belongs (e.g., 'Snacks', 'Beverages', 'Dairy', 'Packaged Foods', 'RTD Coffee', 'RTE Cereals'). Aligns with Nielsen/IRI/SPINS syndicated data category taxonomy for market tracking and ACV/TDP reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: snacks|beverages|dairy|packaged_foods|rte_cereals|rtd_beverages|condiments|frozen_foods|confectionery|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Category Taxonomy; SPINS Natural Channel Data; GS1 Product Classification

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the brand, used across SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP, and trade systems. Serves as the natural key for cross-system integration and EDI transactions. Example: 'SNKBR-001', 'BEV-RTD-02'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Brand Master; GS1 GTIN Standards

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Official commercial name of the brand as registered and used in consumer-facing marketing, packaging, and trade communications. This is the primary human-readable identifier for the brand (e.g., 'SunCrisp', 'HydraFlow'). Must align with FTC-approved marketing claims and FDA labeling requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Food Labeling

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the annual marketing budget (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Ensures correct financial reporting and multi-currency consolidation in Oracle Cloud ERP and SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: clean_label_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand carries a clean label certification or commitment (no artificial colors, flavors, preservatives, or GMO ingredients). Drives consumer marketing claims, shelf placement in natural/organic sections, and SPINS natural channel data eligibility. Must be substantiated per FTC claim guidelines.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 255; FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Clean Label; GFSI Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand record was first created in the enterprise data platform (Databricks Silver Layer). Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements 21 CFR Part 1.337

attributes.name: crm_brand_code
attributes.description: Brand identifier as recorded in Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud / Marketing Cloud). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse brand master and Salesforce campaign and consumer engagement records. Enables brand-level marketing performance attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: digital_presence_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL for the brand's consumer-facing digital presence (e.g., 'https://www.suncrisp.com'). Used in Salesforce Marketing Cloud digital campaign management, SEO tracking, and consumer engagement analytics.
