attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Digital Marketing; FTC Online Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the brand was officially discontinued or withdrawn from the market. Null if the brand is currently active. Used for portfolio rationalization analysis, regulatory deregistration, and historical reporting in Nielsen/IRI market tracking.
attributes.references: SAP PLM Lifecycle Management; FDA FSMA Product Withdrawal

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary route-to-market channel through which the brand's products are sold. 'retail' = traditional grocery/mass/drug; 'foodservice' = restaurants/institutions; 'dsd' = Direct Store Delivery; 'dtc' = Direct-to-Consumer; 'ecommerce' = online retail; 'club' = club/warehouse channel. Drives trade promotion strategy (TPM/TPO) and supply chain configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel; JDA Blue Yonder Supply Planning; TPM Framework

attributes.name: equity_score
attributes.description: Composite brand equity score derived from consumer research inputs including awareness, consideration, preference, and loyalty metrics. Scored on a 0-100 scale. Sourced from Nielsen/IRI brand health tracking studies and internal NPS panel data. Confidential strategic metric used in portfolio investment decisions and brand valuation.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Brand Health Tracking; ISO 10668 Brand Valuation; Salesforce Marketing Cloud NPS

attributes.name: erp_brand_code
attributes.description: Brand identifier as recorded in the source ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Cloud ERP). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer brand master and operational ERP brand records. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Oracle Cloud ERP Supply Chain

attributes.name: gfsi_certification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Scheme
attributes.description: GFSI-benchmarked food safety certification scheme applicable to the brand's manufacturing operations. 'sqf' = Safe Quality Food (SQF); 'brc' = British Retail Consortium Global Standard; 'fssc_22000' = Food Safety System Certification 22000; 'ifs' = International Featured Standards; 'global_gap' = GlobalG.A.P.; 'none' = no GFSI certification. Tracked in Veeva Vault and TraceGains supplier compliance.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FSSC 22000; SQF Code; BRC Global Standard; ISO 22000

attributes.name: haccp_plan_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Plan Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the HACCP plan document associated with the brand's manufacturing process, stored in Veeva Vault Document Control. HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) is a mandatory food safety management system under FDA FSMA and USDA FSIS regulations. Used for audit traceability and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; USDA FSIS HACCP Regulations 9 CFR Part 417; Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the brand was first commercially launched and made available to consumers in its primary market. Used for brand age calculations, anniversary marketing campaigns, and PLM lifecycle tracking. Aligns with SAP PLM product launch milestones.
attributes.references: SAP PLM NPD Launch Management; FDA FSMA Product Registration

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Legally registered name of the brand as filed with trademark authorities (USPTO, EUIPO, etc.). May differ from the commercial brand name. Used for regulatory filings, contract management, and IP protection tracking.
attributes.references: USPTO Trademark Registration; EUIPO Brand Registry; FDA 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the brand within its commercial lifecycle. 'active' = currently marketed and sold; 'discontinued' = no longer produced or sold; 'pipeline' = in NPD/R&D phase, not yet launched; 'divested' = sold or transferred to another entity; 'archived' = historical record retained for compliance. Drives PLM alignment and portfolio management decisions.
attributes.references: SAP PLM Brand Lifecycle; Veeva Vault Quality Management; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: logo_asset_url
attributes.description: URL pointing to the master brand logo asset stored in the digital asset management (DAM) system. Used by Salesforce Marketing Cloud, packaging design teams, and agency partners for consistent brand identity application across all consumer touchpoints.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder; Brand Identity Standards

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the brand, measuring consumer likelihood to recommend on a -100 to +100 scale. Sourced from consumer panel surveys and Salesforce Marketing Cloud feedback programs. Used as a leading indicator of brand health and consumer loyalty in brand equity tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Service Cloud; Nielsen Panel Data; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand holds USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification or equivalent international organic certification (e.g., EU Organic). Enables organic marketing claims on packaging and in trade communications. Tracked in TraceGains supplier compliance and Veeva Vault document control.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; EU Organic Regulation 2018/848

attributes.name: owner_division
attributes.description: Internal business division or operating unit that owns and manages the brand (e.g., 'North America Snacks', 'Global Beverages', 'International Dairy'). Used for P&L attribution, marketing budget allocation, and organizational reporting in SAP CO and Oracle Financials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: plm_product_line_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Product Line Code
attributes.description: Reference code linking the brand to its associated product line in the PLM system (SAP PLM or equivalent). Enables traceability between brand master data and the SKU/product hierarchy managed in PLM. Used for NPD pipeline tracking and BOM management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM PLM Integration; Oracle Cloud ERP Supply Chain PLM

attributes.name: positioning_statement
attributes.description: Internal strategic statement articulating the brand's unique value proposition, competitive differentiation, and reason-to-believe for the target consumer segment. Confidential business strategy document used in brand planning, NPD briefs, and agency briefings. Not for external distribution.
attributes.references: Brand Management Framework; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_color_hex
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for the brand's primary brand color as defined in the brand identity guidelines (e.g., '#FF6B35'). Used for consistent visual identity application across digital marketing, packaging, and trade materials in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and design systems.
attributes.references: Brand Identity Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder

attributes.name: primary_market
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the brand's primary commercial market (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (FDA, EFSA, USDA), labeling requirements, and market data sourcing (Nielsen/IRI for USA, SPINS for natural channel).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FDA 21 CFR; EFSA EU Food Safety Regulation

attributes.name: promise
attributes.description: Consumer-facing articulation of the core benefit or commitment the brand makes to its consumers (e.g., 'Real ingredients, real taste'). Used in marketing communications, packaging copy, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud campaign messaging. Must comply with FTC advertising claim substantiation requirements.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 255 Advertising Claims; FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Labeling

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of regulatory approval for the brand's product claims and labeling across applicable jurisdictions. 'approved' = all required regulatory approvals obtained; 'pending' = applications submitted, awaiting decision; 'under_review' = regulatory authority review in progress; 'rejected' = approval denied, remediation required; 'not_required' = no regulatory approval needed for this brand type. Managed in Veeva Vault Quality Management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; EFSA EU Food Safety Regulation; USDA FSIS; Veeva Vault QMS; FSMA 2011

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Sub-category or segment within the broader product category (e.g., 'Salty Snacks', 'Energy Drinks', 'Greek Yogurt', 'Plant-Based'). Used for granular market share analysis via IRI/SPINS syndicated data and for internal portfolio segmentation reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Segment Taxonomy; SPINS Specialty Product Intelligence

attributes.name: social_media_handle
attributes.description: Primary social media handle or username for the brand's official social media presence (e.g., '@SunCrispSnacks'). Used for social media monitoring, influencer partnership management, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud social engagement tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Social Studio; FTC Influencer Marketing Guidelines 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: sustainability_claim
attributes.description: Sustainability or environmental claim associated with the brand (e.g., 'Carbon Neutral', 'Rainforest Alliance Certified', 'B Corp Certified', 'Recyclable Packaging'). Must be substantiated per FTC Green Guides (16 CFR Part 260) and EPA environmental compliance standards. Supports ESG reporting and consumer engagement.
attributes.references: FTC Green Guides 16 CFR Part 260; EPA Environmental Compliance; ISO 14001

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Commercial positioning tier of the brand within the portfolio pricing and consumer value ladder. 'super_premium' = ultra-high-end, limited distribution; 'premium' = above-mainstream RSP positioning; 'mainstream' = mass-market EDLP positioning; 'value' = price-entry or economy positioning. Drives RSP strategy, trade promotion investment, and retail planogram placement.
attributes.references: Revenue Management and Pricing Strategy; Nielsen/IRI Price Tier Classification

attributes.name: trademark_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the brand's trademark registration expires and must be renewed to maintain legal protection. Used for IP lifecycle management and legal compliance tracking. Triggers renewal workflows in legal management systems.
attributes.references: USPTO Trademark Renewal Requirements; EUIPO Trademark Renewal; WIPO Madrid Protocol

attributes.name: trademark_registration_number
attributes.description: Official trademark registration number issued by the relevant intellectual property authority (e.g., USPTO, EUIPO, WIPO). Used for IP management, legal protection, and brand licensing agreements. Confidential business identifier managed in legal systems.
attributes.references: USPTO Trademark Act 15 USC 1051; EUIPO EU Trademark Regulation 2017/1001; WIPO Madrid Protocol

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the brand record in the enterprise data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements 21 CFR Part 1.337

products.name: campaign
products.description: Master record for each marketing campaign executed across channels — TV, digital, shopper, social, influencer, in-store. Captures campaign name, type (awareness, trial, loyalty, trade), objective, target audience, start/end dates, budget, status, owning brand, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud campaign ID. Supports Brand Marketing and Consumer Engagement process.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each marketing campaign record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: FK to marketing.agency

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the owning brand under which this campaign is executed. Links to the brand master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Brand Hierarchy; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Campaign budgets are charged to cost centers; linking enables budget vs. actual financial analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Campaign financial transactions need a GL account for posting; creates traceable accounting entries.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Campaign manager ownership is required for campaign budgeting and ROI analysis; FK supports Campaign Manager accountability reports.

attributes.name: primary_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Campaign planning uses a primary SKU for messaging and budgeting; the Primary SKU field drives the Campaign Brief and media allocation.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Campaign planning aligns with a specific R&D project to synchronize messaging with product availability.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Campaign planning uses defined customer segments for targeting; linking enables segment‑level ROI reporting and compliance with marketing segmentation policies.

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: Marketing campaigns are aligned to sustainability targets (e.g., low‑carbon product launch); linking enables target‑aligned spend tracking.

attributes.name: actual_spend_usd
attributes.description: Total actual expenditure incurred for the campaign in US dollars as of the latest financial close. Compared against planned_budget_usd to track budget utilization and variance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: acv_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of All Commodity Volume (ACV) distribution coverage for the campaign's featured products. ACV % is a standard food and beverage industry metric for measuring retail distribution breadth.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI ACV Distribution Metrics; SPINS Specialty Product Intelligence

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state of the campaign record: pending (awaiting review), approved (cleared for execution), rejected (not approved), or under_review (in active review). Supports governance and compliance workflows.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Quality Management; SAP S/4HANA Workflow

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the campaign received final business approval to proceed. Used for governance audit trails and time-to-market measurement.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Control; SAP S/4HANA Workflow

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric business identifier for the campaign used in ERP cost tracking, trade promotion management (TPM), and cross-system reconciliation. Follows internal naming convention (e.g., 'CAMP-2024-BEV-001').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order; Trade Promotion Management (TPM)

attributes.name: campaign_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the campaign, including creative concept, key messages, promotional mechanics, and strategic rationale. Used for stakeholder briefings and campaign documentation.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the marketing campaign (e.g., 'Summer Refresh 2024 — National TV Burst'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and stakeholder communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the campaign: draft (in development), planned (approved, not yet live), active (currently running), paused (temporarily halted), completed (finished), or cancelled (terminated before completion).

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Classification of the campaign by its primary marketing objective: awareness (brand building), trial (new consumer acquisition), loyalty (retention), trade (retailer/channel incentive), shopper (in-store activation), or influencer (creator-led). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: awareness|trial|loyalty|trade|shopper|influencer|sponsorship|sampling|digital|event — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; FTC Guidelines on Marketing Claims

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary media or activation channel through which the campaign is executed (e.g., tv, digital, shopper, social, influencer, in_store). Drives channel-level spend and performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tv|digital|shopper|social|influencer|in_store|radio|print|out_of_home|email|event — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the campaign record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and governance requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; ISO 22000 Record Keeping

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this campaign record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency reporting for global campaigns.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the campaign officially concludes and all media/activation ceases. Nullable for always-on campaigns. Used for budget reconciliation and post-campaign analysis.

attributes.name: fda_claims_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Claims Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all product claims featured in the campaign (e.g., health claims, nutrient content claims, clean label statements) comply with FDA regulations. True = compliant; False = non-compliant or under review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Food Labeling; FDA Guidance on Health Claims

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number within the fiscal year, 1–13) in which the campaign is primarily budgeted. Used for period-level financial reporting and budget pacing in SAP S/4HANA CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Fiscal Period; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the campaign budget is allocated and financial performance is reported (e.g., 2024). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA CO fiscal year for cost center and internal order reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Fiscal Year; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: ftc_claims_reviewed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Claims Reviewed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all marketing claims in this campaign have been reviewed for compliance with FTC guidelines on advertising and marketing claims (e.g., substantiation of health/nutrition claims). True = reviewed and cleared; False = not yet reviewed.
attributes.references: FTC Guidelines on Advertising and Marketing Claims; FDA Labeling Regulations

attributes.name: influencer_partnership
attributes.description: Indicates whether this campaign includes a paid influencer or creator partnership component. True = influencer partnership present; False = no influencer component. Supports FTC disclosure compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides (16 CFR Part 255); Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA CO internal order number used to collect and settle campaign costs. Provides granular cost tracking at the campaign level within the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Accounting

attributes.name: media_impressions_target
attributes.description: Planned number of media impressions (total ad exposures) targeted for the campaign across all channels. Used as a key performance indicator (KPI) for reach planning and post-campaign evaluation against Nielsen/IRI data.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Market Tracking; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Analytics

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Free-text description of the primary business objective for the campaign (e.g., 'Drive 10% household penetration increase for RTD line in Q3'). Supports brand marketing and consumer engagement planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Nielsen/IRI Market Tracking

attributes.name: planned_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated to the campaign in US dollars at the time of planning. Used for financial planning, trade promotion management (TPM), and return on investment (ROI) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this campaign supports a private label product program rather than a branded product. True = private label campaign; False = branded campaign. Relevant for retailer co-marketing and private label program data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Nielsen/IRI Private Label Tracking

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The product category or portfolio segment being promoted by this campaign (e.g., 'RTD Beverages', 'Salty Snacks', 'Dairy'). Aligns with Nielsen/IRI category definitions for syndicated data benchmarking.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; SPINS Category Definitions

attributes.name: reach_target_households
attributes.description: Planned number of unique households targeted for campaign reach. Aligns with Nielsen household panel measurement methodology for consumer packaged goods (CPG) reach reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen Panel Data; IRI Consumer Network Panel

attributes.name: sfmc_campaign_code
attributes.description: External campaign identifier assigned by Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC). Used to correlate lakehouse records with SFMC execution records for digital and email channel campaigns.

attributes.name: shopper_marketing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this campaign includes a shopper marketing activation (e.g., in-store display, planogram feature, digital coupon at point of sale). True = shopper marketing component present.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Nielsen/IRI Assortment Analytics

attributes.name: sku_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of the specific SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) included in the campaign. Supports product-level performance attribution and trade promotion management (TPM) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Trade Promotion Management (TPM)

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the campaign officially launches and media/activation begins. Used for scheduling, budget pacing, and performance window calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; SAP IBP Demand Sensing

attributes.name: target_geography
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the campaign (e.g., 'National US', 'Northeast Region', 'California DMA'). Used for media buying, distribution alignment, and regional performance reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Market Tracking; JDA/Blue Yonder Distribution Planning

attributes.name: tdp_target
attributes.description: Target Total Distribution Points (TDP) for the campaign's featured SKUs. TDP is a standard food and beverage metric combining distribution breadth and depth across retail accounts.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI TDP Metrics; SPINS Distribution Analytics

attributes.name: trade_promotion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this campaign includes a trade promotion component (e.g., retailer co-op, slotting fee, off-invoice discount). True = trade promotion included. Supports Trade Promotion Management (TPM) and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) workflows.
attributes.references: Trade Promotion Management (TPM); SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Records

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the campaign record was last modified in the system of record. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Capture

products.name: campaign_execution
products.description: Transactional record capturing the actual execution of a campaign flight — channel activation, flight dates, creative asset version deployed, placement details, targeted geography, targeted retailer/account, impressions delivered, clicks, reach, frequency, and execution status. One campaign may have multiple execution records across channels and time periods.

attributes.name: campaign_execution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each campaign execution record. Represents a single activation of a campaign flight across a specific channel, geography, and time period. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — primary key.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 — Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail account or trade customer targeted by this execution (e.g., Walmart, Kroger). Supports shopper marketing and trade promotion alignment. PARTY_REFERENCE per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud Account Object

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand being promoted or advertised in this campaign execution. Supports brand equity tracking and spend attribution by brand.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent campaign that this execution record belongs to. One campaign may have multiple execution records across channels and time periods.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Execution spend (media buying, agency fees) is allocated to cost centers for cost tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific creative asset version deployed in this execution. Enables creative performance analysis and FTC compliance tracking for marketing claims.
attributes.references: FTC — Advertising and Marketing Claims Guidelines; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder

attributes.name: formulation_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.formulation_version. Business justification: Execution details reference the exact formulation version being promoted for accurate compliance and claim support.

attributes.name: nutrition_label_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.nutrition_label. Business justification: Campaign Execution Compliance: execution must reference the nutrition label of the SKU to ensure advertised claims match label information.

attributes.name: product_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Campaign execution references a specific SKU; FK replaces free-text SKU and aligns marketing spend with product master.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Financial reconciliation of campaign execution spend uses the PO that funded the media buy, needed for audit and ROI reporting.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Required for In‑Store Promotion Execution: links each campaign execution to the specific stock position allocated for that execution, enabling inventory drawdown tracking and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: The actual media spend incurred for this execution flight as billed by the media vendor or agency. Used for ROI calculation and budget reconciliation.
attributes.references: FTC — Advertising Spend Disclosure; Internal Marketing Finance Policy

attributes.name: ad_format
attributes.description: The format of the advertisement deployed in this execution (e.g., banner, video, carousel, sponsored product). Supports format-level performance and creative strategy analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: banner|video|carousel|native|sponsored_product|story|interstitial|rich_media — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the media agency or buying partner responsible for executing this campaign flight. Used for agency performance tracking and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: buying_type
attributes.description: The media buying model used for this execution (e.g., CPM — Cost Per Thousand, CPC — Cost Per Click, CPA — Cost Per Acquisition, CPV — Cost Per View, flat fee, programmatic). Drives cost structure and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: channel_platform
attributes.description: Specific platform or publisher within the channel type where the execution runs (e.g., Facebook, Google, Instacart, Kroger Precision Marketing, YouTube). Enables platform-level performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Taxonomy; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The marketing channel through which this execution is activated (e.g., digital, social, shopper, television). Drives channel-level spend and performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: digital|social|display|search|email|shopper|out_of_home|television|radio|print — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Taxonomy; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: claim_compliance_status
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance review status for marketing claims contained in this execution. Required when marketing_claim_flag is True. Supports FTC and FDA compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: FTC — Advertising and Marketing Claims Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; USDA — Agricultural Marketing Act

attributes.name: clicks_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of clicks recorded on the ad during this execution flight. Used to calculate click-through rate (CTR) and assess consumer engagement.
attributes.references: IAB — Digital Advertising Measurement Guidelines; MRC

attributes.name: cost_per_thousand_impressions
attributes.description: The cost per one thousand ad impressions for this execution, as negotiated with the media vendor. Standard media buying metric used for cross-channel efficiency benchmarking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this campaign execution record was first created in the system. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Audit Trail

attributes.name: creative_version
attributes.description: Version label of the creative asset deployed in this execution (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Tracks which creative iteration was live during the flight for A/B testing and compliance audit.
attributes.references: FTC — Advertising and Marketing Claims Guidelines

attributes.name: execution_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this execution record, used in agency briefings, media plans, and vendor invoices. Format: CE-YYYY-NNNNNN. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: execution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this campaign execution record. Tracks workflow from planning through completion. LIFECYCLE_STATUS per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: flight_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this campaign execution flight is scheduled to stop running in-market. Used for pacing, budget management, and post-campaign analysis.
attributes.references: IAB — Digital Advertising Glossary; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: flight_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this campaign execution flight begins running in-market. Represents the real-world activation date. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: IAB — Digital Advertising Glossary; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Average number of times a unique individual was exposed to the ad during this execution flight. Calculated as impressions divided by reach. Used to manage ad fatigue and optimize media plans.
attributes.references: IAB — Digital Advertising Measurement Guidelines; Nielsen Reach & Frequency

attributes.name: impressions_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of ad impressions delivered during this execution flight. A core digital media performance metric used for reach and frequency analysis. QUANTITATIVE_RESULT per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: IAB — Digital Advertising Measurement Guidelines; MRC (Media Rating Council)

attributes.name: influencer_partnership_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this execution involves a paid influencer or brand ambassador partnership. Triggers FTC endorsement disclosure compliance requirements.

attributes.name: marketing_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this execution contains a regulated marketing claim (e.g., health claim, nutrient content claim, environmental claim). Triggers FTC and FDA compliance review workflow.
attributes.references: FTC — Advertising and Marketing Claims Guidelines; FDA — Food Labeling Regulations 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: nielsen_market_code
attributes.description: Nielsen-defined market or DMA (Designated Market Area) code associated with the geographic target of this execution. Enables alignment with Nielsen/IRI syndicated market data for sales lift analysis.

attributes.name: placement_name
attributes.description: The specific ad placement or ad unit name within the platform (e.g., Facebook News Feed, Google Search Top, Instacart Sponsored Product). Supports granular placement-level performance analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Ad Unit Guidelines; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: planned_spend_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted media spend allocated to this execution flight in the media plan. Used for budget pacing and variance analysis against actual spend.
attributes.references: FTC — Advertising Spend Disclosure; Internal Marketing Finance Policy

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Total number of unique individuals exposed to the ad during this execution flight. Distinct from impressions (which counts total exposures including repeat). Key metric for brand awareness campaigns.
attributes.references: IAB — Digital Advertising Measurement Guidelines; Nielsen Reach & Frequency

attributes.name: salesforce_activity_code
attributes.description: The native activity or journey step identifier from Salesforce Marketing Cloud corresponding to this execution record. Enables direct traceability back to the source system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Journey Builder API

attributes.name: spend_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the planned and actual spend amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-market campaign financial reporting.

attributes.name: target_audience_segment
attributes.description: The consumer audience segment targeted by this execution (e.g., Millennial Moms, Health-Conscious Shoppers, Snack Enthusiasts). Derived from consumer insights and CRM segmentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud — Audience Builder; Nielsen Panel Data

attributes.name: target_geography_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code representing the primary geographic market targeted by this execution. Supports geo-level spend and performance reporting.

attributes.name: target_region
attributes.description: Sub-national region or market area targeted by this execution (e.g., Northeast US, California, EMEA). Supports regional marketing performance analysis and distribution center alignment.

attributes.name: target_retailer_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific retailer or trade account targeted by this shopper marketing or retail media execution (e.g., Walmart, Kroger, Target). Supports trade promotion and shopper marketing alignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this campaign execution record was last modified. Supports change tracking and data lineage in the Silver layer. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Audit Trail

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) campaign parameter appended to campaign URLs for this execution. Links digital traffic back to the specific campaign for attribution reporting.
attributes.references: Google Analytics — Campaign URL Builder; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) medium parameter appended to campaign URLs for this execution (e.g., cpc, email, social). Supports digital attribution and channel performance analysis.
attributes.references: Google Analytics — Campaign URL Builder; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: Urchin Tracking Module (UTM) source parameter appended to campaign URLs for this execution. Used for digital attribution and web analytics tracking in Google Analytics and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
attributes.references: Google Analytics — Campaign URL Builder; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: vendor_order_number
attributes.description: The media vendor's or publisher's order or insertion order (IO) number associated with this execution. Used for invoice matching and vendor reconciliation.
attributes.references: IAB — Standard Terms and Conditions for Internet Advertising

attributes.name: video_completion_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of video ad views that were completed to 100% of the video duration. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.65 = 65%). Key metric for video creative effectiveness.
attributes.references: IAB — Digital Video Advertising Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: video_views
attributes.description: Total number of video views recorded for video ad formats during this execution flight. Applicable when ad_format is video. Supports video completion rate analysis.
attributes.references: IAB — Digital Video Advertising Measurement Guidelines

products.name: media_spend
products.description: Transactional record of advertising and media spend by campaign, channel, market, and time period. Captures planned vs. actual spend, media type (TV, digital display, paid search, OOH, social, streaming), vendor/media partner, invoice reference, cost-per-thousand (CPM), cost-per-click (CPC), and ROI metrics. Supports advertising spend governance and FTC compliance.

attributes.name: media_spend_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each media spend transaction record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: FK to marketing.agency

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand portfolio entity associated with this media spend. Enables brand-level advertising investment analysis and brand equity tracking.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign under which this media spend was incurred. Links spend to campaign objectives, budgets, and performance tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Media spend must be posted to cost centers for financial reporting; allocation uses cost_center_id instead of denormalized code.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each media spend transaction is recorded in a GL account for accounting; FK replaces the plain code.

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic market or territory where the media was placed. Supports regional spend analysis and market-level ROI reporting.

attributes.name: media_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.media_plan. Business justification: Links each spend record to its media plan for budgeting alignment.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the media partner or vendor (e.g., Google, Meta, NBC, Clear Channel) who delivered the media placement. Used for vendor performance and spend reconciliation.

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Actual media spend amount incurred for this record in the transaction currency. Represents confirmed expenditure as invoiced or settled with the media vendor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Actual Cost; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: agency_fee_amount
attributes.description: Media agency commission or service fee associated with this spend record, separate from the net media cost. Enables total cost of advertising (working vs. non-working spend) analysis.
attributes.references: 4A's (American Association of Advertising Agencies) Agency Compensation Standards

attributes.name: buying_type
attributes.description: Method by which the media inventory was purchased (e.g., upfront commitment, scatter market, programmatic auction, direct buy, sponsorship). Impacts pricing, flexibility, and spend governance.
attributes.references: IAB Programmatic Standards; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary marketing claim featured in the media creative associated with this spend (e.g., health, nutrition, sustainability, taste, price, brand). Supports FTC compliance monitoring and claim substantiation tracking.
attributes.references: FTC Act Section 5; FDA 21 CFR Part 101 (Food Labeling); FTC Green Guides

attributes.name: clicks
attributes.description: Total number of user clicks on the digital advertisement during the spend period. Primary engagement metric for digital and paid search media types.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Google Ads Measurement

attributes.name: committed_spend_amount
attributes.description: Media spend amount that has been contractually committed to the vendor but not yet invoiced or paid. Represents open purchase order value for accrual and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Commitment Management; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: cpc
attributes.description: Cost Per Click — the realized cost for each user click on the digital advertisement in the transaction currency. Primary efficiency metric for paid search and performance-based digital media.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Google Ads CPC Definition

attributes.name: cpm
attributes.description: Cost Per Mille (thousand impressions) — the negotiated or realized cost per 1,000 ad impressions in the transaction currency. Standard media efficiency metric for comparing cross-channel investment value.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; MRC CPM Definition

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this media spend record was first captured in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SLA monitoring for data pipeline freshness.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 8601 Timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency consolidation and FX reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: System or source from which this media spend record was ingested (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, agency billing platform, media platform API, Nielsen, IRI, manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Lineage

attributes.name: dma_code
attributes.description: Nielsen Designated Market Area code identifying the specific US television market where the media aired. Standard geographic unit for US broadcast media planning and spend reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen DMA Methodology; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Company fiscal period in which this media spend is recognized (format: YYYY-P##, e.g., 2024-P06). Aligns spend to internal financial reporting periods which may differ from calendar months.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; Oracle Cloud Financials Period Management

attributes.name: flight_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the media flight or campaign burst concludes. Used with flight_start_date to define the media window for pacing and delivery analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: flight_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the media flight or campaign burst begins airing or serving impressions. A media flight is a discrete scheduled period of advertising activity.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: ftc_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associated advertising creative and claims for this media spend have been reviewed and confirmed compliant with FTC endorsement, disclosure, and advertising substantiation guidelines. Critical for regulatory audit and legal risk management.
attributes.references: FTC 16 CFR Part 255 (Endorsements and Testimonials); FTC Act Section 5

attributes.name: geo_market_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code identifying the geographic market where the media ran. Supports multi-market spend consolidation and regional budget governance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Geographic Codes; Nielsen DMA (Designated Market Area) Standards

attributes.name: grp
attributes.description: Gross Rating Points representing the total weight of a media schedule, calculated as reach multiplied by average frequency. Standard TV and broadcast media planning metric used to measure advertising pressure.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research GRP Methodology; ARF (Advertising Research Foundation)

attributes.name: impressions
attributes.description: Total number of times the advertisement was served or displayed to an audience during the spend period. Primary reach metric for evaluating media delivery against contracted guarantees.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; MRC (Media Rating Council) Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice reference number associated with this media spend record. Used for accounts payable matching, audit trails, and FTC compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Invoice Management; FTC 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: media_channel
attributes.description: Specific media channel or platform within the media type (e.g., YouTube, Instagram, Google Search, NBC Primetime, Spotify, Times Square Billboard). Provides granular channel-level spend visibility beyond the media type classification.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: media_format
attributes.description: Creative format of the media placement (e.g., video, banner, native, audio, sponsorship, influencer, search text). Used for creative performance analysis and format-level spend allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: video|banner|native|audio|sponsorship|influencer|search_text|connected_tv — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: media_type
attributes.description: Classification of the advertising medium used for this spend record (e.g., TV, digital display, paid search, out-of-home, social, streaming). Drives channel-mix analysis and media planning optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TV|digital_display|paid_search|OOH|social|streaming|print|radio — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: planned_spend_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted or planned media spend amount for this record in the transaction currency. Represents the approved budget allocation prior to actual execution. Used for planned vs. actual variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Orders; Oracle Cloud Financials Budgeting

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number issued to the media vendor for this spend commitment. Enables three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) in accounts payable.

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Estimated number of unique individuals exposed to the advertisement during the flight period. Distinct from impressions (which counts total exposures including duplicates). Used for audience coverage planning.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Reach & Frequency Methodology; MRC

attributes.name: roi_index
attributes.description: Media ROI index score derived from marketing mix modeling or attribution analysis, representing the revenue return per unit of media spend. Sourced from Nielsen/IRI MMM outputs. Not a calculated aggregate — represents a point-in-time modeled index value assigned to this spend record.
attributes.references: Nielsen Marketing Mix Modeling; IRI Lift Analytics; ARF ROI Standards

attributes.name: shopper_marketing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this media spend is classified as shopper marketing (in-store, retailer co-op, or path-to-purchase media) as distinct from brand or consumer advertising. Drives working media classification and trade vs. marketing budget allocation.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Budget Classification Standard; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: spend_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the media spend was incurred or the media ran. Used as the primary time dimension for spend reporting and period-over-period analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date Standard

attributes.name: spend_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this media spend transaction, typically sourced from the media buying platform, agency, or SAP FI document number. Used for reconciliation with invoices and agency billing statements.

attributes.name: spend_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the media spend record, tracking progression from planned budget through commitment, invoicing, and payment. Supports spend governance and budget control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Management; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Defined audience segment or demographic target for this media placement (e.g., Adults 18-49, Millennial Moms, Health-Conscious Shoppers). Used for audience alignment reporting and media planning.
attributes.references: Nielsen Audience Measurement; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Audience Segmentation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this media spend record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 8601 Timestamp

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System WBS element code for project-based media spend tracking. Used when advertising spend is managed under a specific marketing project or new product launch initiative.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS (Project System) WBS Element

attributes.name: working_media_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this spend record represents working media (dollars directly purchasing audience exposure) as opposed to non-working spend (agency fees, production costs, research). Standard industry classification for advertising efficiency benchmarking.
attributes.references: ANA (Association of National Advertisers) Working vs. Non-Working Media Definition

products.name: media_plan
products.description: Master record for marketing investment planning and budget governance by brand, campaign, channel, and fiscal period. Captures approved A&P budget, channel allocation (TV, digital, social, shopper, OOH, streaming), planned GRPs, reach/frequency targets, media mix strategy, agency assignments, committed vs. actual spend, variance, budget owner, and approval status. SSOT for marketing-owned working budget — distinct from finance GL. Supports brand investment decisions, planned-vs-actual reconciliation, and marketing finance controls.

attributes.name: media_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the media plan record. Primary key for the media_plan data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the media agency or creative agency assigned to execute this media plan. Supports agency performance tracking and fee reconciliation.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Media plan approval requires sign‑off by a marketing employee; FK supports audit trail for budget authority and compliance.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand for which this media plan is created. Supports brand-level investment tracking and A&P budget governance.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign associated with this media plan. Links media investment to specific campaign objectives and execution.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finance cost center that owns the A&P budget for this media plan. Enables GL-level reconciliation between marketing-owned working budget and finance records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center Master

attributes.name: promotion_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_plan. Business justification: Media planning is built around promotion plans; linking enables plan‑level media budgeting.

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_contract. Business justification: Media plans are executed under a media purchase contract; linking enables contract compliance and spend tracking.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Regional Media Planning: links media plans to storage locations (distribution centers) to attribute media spend to inventory availability in each region, aiding budget optimization and supply‑demand a

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: The actual invoiced and posted spend against this media plan to date. Used for planned-vs-actual variance analysis and marketing finance controls reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Actual Cost Posting; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: agency_fee_amount
attributes.description: The non-working media portion of the budget allocated to agency fees (retainer, commission, or project-based fees) for this media plan. Supports agency cost governance and working vs. non-working media analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Agency Compensation Standard; ANA Agency Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the media plan budget received final authorization from the budget owner. Required for SOX audit trail and marketing finance controls documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Finance Controls Standard; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the media plan budget within the marketing finance controls workflow. Distinct from plan_status — captures the budget authorization state specifically.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Finance Controls Standard; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved Advertising and Promotion (A&P) Budget Amount
attributes.description: The total approved Advertising & Promotion (A&P) budget allocated to this media plan in the plan currency. This is the marketing-owned working budget — the single source of truth (SSOT) distinct from the finance General Ledger (GL). Supports brand investment governance and EBITDA impact tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Finance Controls Standard; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: budget_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the marketing manager or brand director who owns and is accountable for this media plan budget. The primary point of contact for budget governance.

attributes.name: budget_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the approved budget and actual spend (approved_budget_amount minus actual_spend_amount). A positive value indicates underspend; negative indicates overspend. Supports marketing finance controls and budget reallocation decisions.

attributes.name: committed_spend_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the approved budget that has been formally committed via purchase orders, agency contracts, or media buys. Represents legally or contractually obligated spend within the plan period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Purchase Order Commitment; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this media plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this media plan (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency consolidation for global brand investment reporting.

attributes.name: digital_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocated to digital media channels (display, search, programmatic, video) within this plan. Supports digital investment tracking and Return on Investment (ROI) analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Media Channel Allocation Standard; FTC Digital Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: fda_claims_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Advertising Claims Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all health, nutrient content, and structure/function claims in this media plan comply with FDA food labeling and advertising regulations. Critical for food and beverage marketing compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 — Food Labeling; FDA Guidance on Health Claims

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (Q1–Q4) or fiscal period (P01–P13) within the fiscal year to which this media plan is scoped. Supports sub-annual budget pacing and planned-vs-actual reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Fiscal Period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this media plan's budget and spend are attributed (e.g., 2025). Aligns with the company's fiscal calendar for A&P budget governance and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: ftc_claims_reviewed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Marketing Claims Reviewed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all marketing claims included in this media plan have been reviewed for compliance with FTC advertising standards and substantiation requirements. Required for regulated food and beverage marketing claims.
attributes.references: FTC Act Section 5; FTC Food Advertising Guidelines; FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic market scope of this media plan (e.g., 'National', 'Northeast Region', 'Top 10 DMAs'). Supports market-level investment analysis and regional brand equity tracking.

attributes.name: media_mix_strategy
attributes.description: Narrative description of the media mix strategy for this plan, including rationale for channel weighting, sequencing, and integration approach. Supports brand investment decision documentation.

attributes.name: nielsen_market_code
attributes.description: The Nielsen market or Designated Market Area (DMA) code associated with the geographic scope of this media plan. Enables linkage to Nielsen syndicated market tracking data for planned-vs-actual audience delivery measurement.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research DMA Code Standard; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: ooh_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocated to Out-of-Home (OOH) media (billboards, transit, digital OOH) within this plan. Supports channel-level investment tracking and media mix reporting.

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which media activity under this plan is scheduled to conclude. Defines the flight window for budget commitment and agency delivery.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the media plan (e.g., 'FY25 Q1 Snacks National TV + Digital'). Used in dashboards, approval workflows, and stakeholder communications.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the media plan, used in agency briefs, purchase orders, and finance reconciliation. Format: MP- followed by 4–20 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which media activity under this plan is scheduled to begin. Used for flight scheduling, agency briefing timelines, and budget pacing.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the media plan within the approval and execution workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|paused|cancelled|closed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the media plan by strategic purpose. Distinguishes brand-building investment from Trade Promotion Management (TPM) spend, New Product Development (NPD) launches, and shopper marketing activations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: brand_building|trade_promotion|shopper_marketing|new_product_launch|seasonal|always_on — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: planned_frequency
attributes.description: The planned average number of times a member of the target audience is expected to be exposed to the media during the flight period. Used with reach to calculate GRPs and assess media weight sufficiency.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Reach/Frequency Standard; MRC Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: planned_grp
attributes.description: The total planned Gross Rating Points (GRPs) targeted for this media plan. GRP = Reach % × Frequency. A standard media weight metric used to evaluate TV and broadcast investment effectiveness.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research GRP Standard; MRC (Media Rating Council) Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: planned_reach_pct
attributes.description: The planned percentage of the target audience expected to be exposed to the media at least once during the flight period. A key media effectiveness metric alongside frequency.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Reach/Frequency Standard; MRC Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_channel
attributes.description: The dominant media channel for this plan (e.g., TV, digital, social, shopper, Out-of-Home (OOH), streaming). Drives media mix strategy reporting and channel-level budget allocation analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TV|digital|social|shopper|OOH|streaming|print|radio — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Media Mix Strategy Standard; Nielsen/IRI Channel Classification

attributes.name: production_cost_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocated to creative production costs (TV commercial production, digital asset creation, photography) within this plan. Part of non-working media spend.

attributes.name: salesforce_campaign_code
attributes.description: The campaign identifier from Salesforce Marketing Cloud used to link this media plan to digital campaign execution, email journeys, and consumer engagement tracking. Supports cross-channel attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Campaign Object Standard

attributes.name: shopper_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocated to shopper marketing activations (in-store, retailer co-op, Point of Sale (POS) materials) within this plan. Supports trade and shopper investment governance.
attributes.references: Internal Shopper Marketing Standard; Trade Promotion Management (TPM) Governance

attributes.name: social_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocated to social media channels (paid social, influencer partnerships) within this plan. Supports social investment tracking and FTC endorsement compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Media Channel Allocation Standard; FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: streaming_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocated to streaming media platforms (audio streaming, video-on-demand, podcast) within this plan. Supports emerging channel investment tracking.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Descriptive definition of the primary consumer target audience for this media plan (e.g., 'Adults 25–54, HHI $50K+, Snack Purchasers'). Aligns with Nielsen/IRI panel demographic segmentation and brand strategy.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Audience Segmentation; IRI Consumer Panel Data

attributes.name: tv_budget_amount
attributes.description: Budget allocated to television media (linear TV, connected TV) within this plan. Supports channel-level investment tracking and media mix optimization.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this media plan record was most recently modified. Used for change detection, incremental processing in the Databricks Silver Layer, and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the media plan, incremented each time the plan is revised and resubmitted for approval. Supports plan revision history tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: working_media_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the total approved budget allocated to working media (direct media placement costs) versus non-working media (agency fees, production costs). Industry benchmark for media efficiency.
attributes.references: ANA (Association of National Advertisers) Working Media Standard

products.name: consumer_insight
products.description: Master record for all consumer research studies and their derived insights — encompasses qualitative and quantitative studies (focus groups, sensory panels, organoleptic evaluations, NPS surveys, concept tests, U&A studies, segmentation, packaging tests, pricing research, competitive landscape studies). Captures study metadata (study name, research vendor, methodology, sample size, geography, category scope, fielding dates, status, key deliverable reference), key findings, insight category, target segment, and source system. SSOT for all commissioned/subscribed research and the actionable insights derived from them. Supports NPD pipeline, brand strategy, and innovation funnel.

attributes.name: consumer_insight_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consumer research study or derived insight record. Primary key for the consumer_insight data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Associates insight with the specific brand; brand_scope string replaced by FK.

attributes.name: commissioned_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Insight studies are commissioned by specific employees; linking enables Insight Commissioning cost allocation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: promotion_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_plan. Business justification: Consumer insights drive promotion‑plan creation; this FK ties insights to the plan they inform.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Insight studies are commissioned for specific R&D projects, linking insights to project outcomes.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Insight studies are conducted on specific SKUs; linking enables the Insight‑SKU Impact report used in NPD decisions.

attributes.name: actual_spend_usd
attributes.description: Actual amount invoiced and paid to the research vendor in US Dollars (USD). Compared against study_budget_usd for budget variance analysis and marketing ROI reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: allergen_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study includes consumer insights related to allergen awareness, labeling preferences, or allergen-free product demand (True). Supports allergen matrix management and FDA FSMA compliance for labeling decisions.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act); FDA 21 CFR Part 101.4 Allergen Labeling; FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: category_scope
attributes.description: The food and beverage product category or categories covered by the study (e.g., 'Salty Snacks', 'RTD Beverages', 'Dairy', 'Packaged Foods'). Aligns with Nielsen/IRI category taxonomy and internal PLM category hierarchy.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Category Taxonomy; SPINS Specialty Product Intelligence; GS1 Product Category Standards

attributes.name: clean_label_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study includes findings relevant to clean label consumer preferences (True) — e.g., natural ingredients, no artificial additives, transparency. Supports the clean label product development pipeline and marketing claims strategy.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Food Labeling; FTC Green Guides; GFSI Clean Label Standards

attributes.name: concept_test_score
attributes.description: Top-2-box purchase intent or overall concept appeal score from concept testing studies (e.g., 72.50 = 72.5% top-2-box). Null for non-concept-test study types. Key NPD go/no-go gate metric used in the innovation funnel.
attributes.references: ESOMAR Research Standards; SAP IBP New Product Development Planning

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level (%) at which quantitative findings are reported (e.g., 90.00, 95.00, 99.00). Null for qualitative studies. Supports data quality assessment and decision-making thresholds for NPD go/no-go gates.
attributes.references: ESOMAR Research Standards; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP or Oracle cost center code to which the research study expenditure is allocated. Enables financial reporting, budget tracking, and P&L attribution by brand, category, or business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this consumer insight record originated or was ingested (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data, SPINS, Veeva Vault, TraceGains, internal survey platform). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_marketing_cloud|nielsen_iri|spins|veeva_vault|tracegains|internal_survey|external_agency|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: deliverable_date
attributes.description: The date on which the final research deliverable (report, topline, data file) was received from the vendor or published internally. Used for insight freshness tracking and NPD pipeline milestone management.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Control; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: deliverable_reference
attributes.description: Document reference, URL, or Veeva Vault document ID pointing to the primary research deliverable (final report, topline deck, data file). Enables direct access to source documentation for audit, compliance, and deeper analysis.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: fielding_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which data collection (fielding) concluded for the study. Together with fielding_start_date, defines the fieldwork window for temporal validity assessment of insights.
attributes.references: ESOMAR Research Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: fielding_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which data collection (fielding) commenced for the study. Used for timeline tracking, seasonal context analysis, and compliance with ESOMAR fieldwork documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ESOMAR Research Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: geography_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage of the study, expressed as country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), regions, or named markets (e.g., 'USA', 'USA|CAN|MEX', 'EMEA', 'National US'). Supports market-level filtering and cross-market insight comparison.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; Nielsen/IRI Market Definitions

attributes.name: insight_action
attributes.description: The recommended business action or strategic implication derived from the key finding (e.g., 'Reformulate product X to reduce sodium', 'Reposition Brand Y toward health-conscious millennials'). Bridges research output to commercial decision-making.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; SAP IBP Integrated Business Planning

attributes.name: insight_category
attributes.description: Business domain classification of the primary insight derived from the study. Enables routing of insights to the correct brand, innovation, or commercial team. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: brand_equity|product_innovation|packaging|pricing|consumer_segmentation|category_dynamics|shopper_behavior|advertising_effectiveness|sustainability|competitive_intelligence — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data Insight Taxonomy

attributes.name: insight_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the insight is considered stale or no longer actionable due to market changes, product reformulation, or elapsed time. Supports insight lifecycle management and prevents outdated research from influencing current strategy.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Control; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: insight_priority
attributes.description: Business priority rating assigned to the insight by the commissioning team, indicating urgency and strategic importance for action. Drives triage and resource allocation in the innovation funnel and brand planning cycle.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; SAP IBP Demand Sensing

attributes.name: key_finding_summary
attributes.description: Concise narrative summary of the primary actionable insight or finding derived from the study (max ~2000 characters). This is the SSOT for the headline insight used in brand strategy decks, NPD briefs, and innovation funnel reviews.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: npd_pipeline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insight is actively linked to or informing a New Product Development (NPD) initiative in the innovation pipeline (True). Enables filtering of insights that are driving active R&D and NPD gate decisions.
attributes.references: SAP IBP New Product Development; Salesforce Marketing Cloud; GFSI NPD Standards

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) result from the study, ranging from -100 to +100. Applicable only to NPS survey studies. Measures consumer likelihood to recommend the brand or product. Null for non-NPS study types.
attributes.references: Bain & Company NPS Methodology; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Service Cloud

attributes.name: private_label_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study includes competitive analysis or consumer perception data related to private label products (True). Supports trade strategy, pricing, and brand differentiation decisions against private label competition.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Private Label Market Tracking; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
