attributes.description: Cumulative count of sponsored content posts actually published by the influencer against the current contract. Used to track delivery progress and trigger payment milestones.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Internal Contract Management Policy

attributes.name: preferred_content_format
attributes.description: The influencer's primary content format used for brand collaborations (e.g., static post, reel, story, long-form video, live stream, blog). Used for creative brief development and platform-specific campaign planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Internal Creative Strategy Policy

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code for the primary language in which the influencer creates content (e.g., en, es, fr). Used for audience targeting and localization strategy.

attributes.name: product_gifting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the influencer receives Food Beverage product samples or gifts as part of the partnership arrangement (in addition to or instead of monetary compensation). Relevant for FTC disclosure requirements and COGS tracking.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; FDA Food Safety Regulations

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the influencer record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the influencer record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), Silver layer incremental processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: renewal_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the influencer is eligible for contract renewal based on performance metrics, compliance history, and brand safety scores. Supports automated renewal workflow triggers.
attributes.references: Internal Influencer Program Policy; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Classification of the influencer by audience size tier: nano (<10K followers), micro (10K–100K), macro (100K–1M), mega (>1M). Determines fee benchmarks, campaign eligibility, and reach expectations.
attributes.references: Industry Influencer Marketing Standard; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: total_contracted_posts
attributes.description: Total number of sponsored content posts or deliverables committed by the influencer under the current contract term. Used for campaign delivery tracking and contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Management Policy; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

products.name: influencer_engagement
products.description: Transactional record of individual influencer content activations — captures post date, platform, content type (story, reel, post, video), campaign linkage, contracted deliverables, actual deliverables, impressions, engagements, reach, earned media value (EMV), compliance status (FTC #ad disclosure), and payment milestone status.

attributes.name: influencer_engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each influencer content activation record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Food Beverage brand being promoted in this influencer activation. Enables brand-level aggregation of influencer spend, reach, and earned media value (EMV).
attributes.references: Internal Brand Master; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign under which this influencer activation was executed. Links the engagement to campaign budget, objectives, and brand strategy.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the influencer partnership contract that governs the deliverables, payment terms, usage rights, and FTC compliance obligations for this engagement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Object; FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: influencer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the influencer (creator/partner) master record who produced this content activation. Links to the influencer profile including audience demographics and tier classification.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: Influencer activities are coordinated with promotion events; this FK supports influencer‑event performance reporting.

attributes.name: activation_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this influencer content activation, used in agency briefs, purchase orders, and payment reconciliation. Format: INF-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Internal Trade Promotion Management (TPM) Numbering Standard

attributes.name: actual_deliverable_count
attributes.description: Number of content pieces actually published by the influencer for this engagement. Compared against contracted_deliverable_count to assess fulfillment and trigger payment milestones.
attributes.references: Internal Influencer Program Governance; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: agency_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this influencer engagement was sourced and managed through a third-party influencer marketing agency rather than directly by the Food Beverage marketing team. Affects cost accounting and agency fee allocation.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Operations Policy; Oracle Cloud ERP Procurement

attributes.name: audience_size
attributes.description: Total follower or subscriber count of the influencer on the specified platform at the time of content publication. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for performance normalization and tier validation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Internal Influencer Program Governance

attributes.name: content_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the brand/legal team formally approved the influencer content for publication or confirmed post-publication compliance. Used for audit trail and payment milestone triggering.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; Internal Brand Governance

attributes.name: content_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the brand and legal review of the influencer content prior to or post publication. Ensures brand guidelines, nutritional claim accuracy, and FTC compliance are verified before payment release.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; FDA Food Labeling Regulations 21 CFR Part 101; Internal Brand Governance

attributes.name: content_caption
attributes.description: The text caption or description accompanying the influencer post. Captured for FTC disclosure verification, brand claim compliance review, and consumer sentiment analysis.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; FTC Act Section 5

attributes.name: content_rights_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the brand's licensed rights to repurpose or amplify the influencer-created content expire. Critical for paid media amplification planning and legal compliance with content usage agreements.
attributes.references: Internal Influencer Contract Management; Copyright Act; Salesforce CRM Contract Object

attributes.name: content_type
attributes.description: Format classification of the influencer content deliverable (e.g., story, reel, static post, long-form video). Determines performance benchmarks, content rights, and contracted deliverable matching.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Internal Influencer Brief Template

attributes.name: content_url
attributes.description: Direct URL to the published influencer content on the social media platform. Used for compliance review, content archiving, FTC disclosure verification, and performance data pull.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; Internal Digital Asset Management Policy

attributes.name: contracted_deliverable_count
attributes.description: Total number of content pieces (posts, stories, reels, videos) contractually obligated for this influencer engagement. Used to track fulfillment rate against contract terms.
attributes.references: Internal Influencer Contract Management; Salesforce CRM Contract Object

attributes.name: contracted_fee
attributes.description: Gross monetary fee agreed in the influencer contract for this engagement, before any deductions or bonuses. Used for budget tracking, COGS allocation, and payment milestone management.
attributes.references: Internal Trade Promotion Management (TPM); Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this influencer engagement record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Audit trail field for data lineage and record provenance tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this engagement record (contracted_fee, performance_bonus, earned_media_value). Supports multi-currency global influencer programs.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: earned_media_value
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the organic reach and engagement generated by the influencer content, calculated using platform-specific CPM/CPE benchmarks. Key metric for Return on Investment (ROI) reporting and brand equity tracking. Expressed in the contract currency.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Finance Standard; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data Benchmarks

attributes.name: engagement_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of total engagements to total impressions or reach, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0425 = 4.25%). Key performance indicator for content resonance and influencer audience quality benchmarking.
attributes.references: IAB Measurement Guidelines; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the influencer content activation. Tracks workflow from initial brief through contract execution, content go-live, completion, and payment closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|contracted|live|completed|cancelled|disputed — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Internal Influencer Program Governance

attributes.name: engagements
attributes.description: Total count of all user interactions with the influencer content including likes, comments, shares, saves, and reactions. Core performance metric for consumer engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; IAB Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: exclusivity_end_date
attributes.description: Date through which the influencer is contractually prohibited from promoting competing food and beverage brands or products. Null if no exclusivity clause is in effect. Used for competitive conflict monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Influencer Contract Management; Salesforce CRM Contract Object

attributes.name: ftc_disclosure_status
attributes.description: Compliance status indicating whether the influencer post includes the required FTC-mandated paid partnership or #ad disclosure. Critical for regulatory compliance and brand legal risk management.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; FTC Act Section 5

attributes.name: ftc_disclosure_tag
attributes.description: The specific disclosure label used in the post (e.g., #ad, #sponsored, #paidpartnership, platform-native 'Paid Partnership' label). Captured verbatim for FTC audit evidence.

attributes.name: hashtags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hashtags included in the influencer post. Used to verify required campaign hashtags (e.g., #ad, #sponsored) and to track branded hashtag performance.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; Internal Campaign Brief

attributes.name: impressions
attributes.description: Total number of times the influencer content was displayed to users on the platform, including repeat views by the same user. Primary reach metric for awareness-stage campaign measurement.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data Standards; IAB Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: link_clicks
attributes.description: Number of times users clicked on a trackable link (e.g., swipe-up, bio link, UTM-tagged URL) within the influencer content. Measures direct traffic and conversion intent driven by the activation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Internal Digital Marketing KPI Framework

attributes.name: paid_amplification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organic influencer content was additionally boosted through paid media spend (e.g., Instagram Branded Content Ads, TikTok Spark Ads). Affects total media investment reporting and FTC disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which payment was issued to the influencer for this engagement. Populated upon payment confirmation from Oracle Cloud ERP. Null if payment has not yet been processed.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; Internal Accounts Payable Policy

attributes.name: payment_milestone_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment milestone associated with this influencer engagement. Tracks the accounts payable workflow from deliverable approval through payment execution in Oracle Cloud ERP.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; Internal Accounts Payable Policy

attributes.name: performance_bonus
attributes.description: Additional monetary bonus payable to the influencer upon achieving contractually defined performance thresholds (e.g., impressions floor, engagement rate target). Nullable if no bonus clause exists.
attributes.references: Internal Influencer Contract Management; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The social media or digital platform on which the influencer content was published (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, YouTube). Drives platform-specific performance benchmarking and media mix analysis.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: post_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the influencer published the content to their social media platform. This is the principal real-world business event date for this activation record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Internal Campaign Reporting Standard

attributes.name: post_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the influencer content was published on the platform. Used for time-of-day analytics, algorithm optimization, and audit trail.

attributes.name: product_claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of any product-related marketing claim made in the influencer content (e.g., health claim, nutrient content claim, structure/function claim). Critical for FDA and FTC regulatory compliance review of food and beverage advertising.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Regulations 21 CFR Part 101; FTC Act Section 5; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Number of unique users who were exposed to the influencer content at least once. Distinct from impressions; used to measure unduplicated audience size for brand awareness reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data Standards; IAB Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this influencer engagement record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: utm_campaign_code
attributes.description: UTM campaign parameter appended to trackable links in the influencer content for attribution in web analytics platforms. Enables direct traffic, conversion, and Return on Investment (ROI) measurement from influencer-driven clicks.
attributes.references: Google Analytics UTM Standard; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: video_views
attributes.description: Number of times the video content was viewed, applicable for video, reel, and story content types. Platform-specific view thresholds apply (e.g., 3-second view on Facebook/Instagram, 30-second on YouTube).
attributes.references: IAB Video Measurement Guidelines; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

products.name: digital_asset
products.description: Master record for all marketing digital assets — creative files, packaging artwork, photography, video, copy decks, and brand guidelines. Captures asset name, type, format, resolution, brand association, campaign association, version number, approval status, rights/usage restrictions, expiry date, and DAM (Digital Asset Management) system reference. Supports omnichannel content deployment.

attributes.name: digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying each digital asset master record in the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Primary key for the digital_asset product.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Asset approval must be signed off by a marketing employee; FK enables audit of asset approvals for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand master record that this digital asset is associated with. Enables brand equity tracking, brand guideline compliance enforcement, and brand-level asset portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: Brand Management Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign master record that this digital asset supports. Links creative assets to campaign performance analytics, advertising spend attribution, and Trade Promotion Management (TPM) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Campaign Management; TPM Standards

attributes.name: parent_asset_digital_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent digital asset record from which this asset was derived or adapted (e.g., a localized variant references its master asset). Enables asset lineage tracking and derivative management within the DAM hierarchy.
attributes.references: DAM Version Management Standards; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: promotion_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_line. Business justification: Digital assets (e.g., shelf‑talkers) are assigned to specific promotion lines for asset‑to‑promotion tracking.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code of the product this digital asset depicts or supports (e.g., packaging artwork, product photography). Links the asset to the product master for PLM and omnichannel content syndication. May be null for brand-level or campaign-level assets not tied to a specific SKU.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Product Master; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: allergen_claim_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether this digital asset (e.g., packaging artwork, nutritional panel, label) contains allergen declarations or claims. Triggers mandatory regulatory review workflow under FDA FSMA, USDA, and EFSA allergen labeling requirements before approval.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; USDA FSIS; EFSA Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011; GFSI

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the digital asset within the creative approval workflow. Controls whether the asset is eligible for deployment across marketing channels. 'approved' assets are cleared for use; 'expired' assets must not be deployed.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Quality Management; FTC Advertising Compliance; FDA Labeling Regulations 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this digital asset received final approval for deployment. Provides regulatory audit trail for FDA, FTC, and EFSA compliance. Distinct from created_timestamp and last_modified_timestamp as it marks the specific approval lifecycle event.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; FTC Advertising Compliance; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text description of the digital asset's content, purpose, and intended use (e.g., 'Hero banner for Q3 Summer Refresh campaign featuring the new Oat Milk Smoothie SKU, designed for homepage placement and social media'). Supports asset discovery and briefing documentation.
attributes.references: DAM Content Management Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the digital asset as defined by the marketing or creative team (e.g., 'Summer Refresh Campaign Hero Banner', 'Oat Milk Packaging Front Panel v3'). Used for search and discovery in the DAM system.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Management; DAM Taxonomy Standards

attributes.name: asset_subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification within the asset type (e.g., 'hero_banner', 'product_photography', 'tv_spot', 'radio_jingle', 'shelf_talker', 'nutritional_panel_artwork', 'copy_deck'). Supports detailed taxonomy and omnichannel content routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hero_banner|product_photography|tv_spot|radio_jingle|shelf_talker|nutritional_panel_artwork|copy_deck|social_post|email_template|print_ad — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; DAM Taxonomy Standards

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the digital asset by media type. Drives workflow routing, storage tier, and rendering requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: image|video|audio|document|template|brand_guideline|copy_deck|packaging_artwork|infographic|presentation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Asset Types; DAM Taxonomy Standards

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary marketing channel for which this digital asset is intended for deployment (e.g., 'digital', 'print', 'broadcast', 'social_media', 'ecommerce', 'in_store', 'out_of_home'). Drives channel-specific compliance checks and content routing in Salesforce Marketing Cloud. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: digital|print|broadcast|social_media|ecommerce|in_store|out_of_home|direct_mail|foodservice — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; IAB Digital Advertising Standards; FTC Advertising Compliance

attributes.name: clean_label_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this digital asset (particularly packaging artwork and labeling) meets the brand's clean label standards — free from artificial colors, flavors, preservatives, and non-consumer-friendly ingredients. Supports consumer transparency and brand positioning.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; GFSI Clean Label Standards; Brand Marketing Guidelines

attributes.name: color_profile
attributes.description: Color space or color profile of the digital asset (e.g., 'sRGB' for digital/web, 'CMYK' for print, 'Pantone' for brand color-matched packaging). Critical for print production quality, packaging artwork compliance, and brand color consistency.
attributes.references: ISO 12647 Print Standards; Pantone Color Standards; Brand Identity Guidelines

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary market or country for which this digital asset is approved for use (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Supports geo-specific regulatory compliance (FDA, EFSA, USDA, Codex Alimentarius) and rights management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FDA; EFSA; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the individual who created this digital asset record in the DAM or marketing system. Supports audit trail requirements and creative ownership tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ISO/IEC 27001; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this digital asset record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for asset lifecycle management, version history, and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; Veeva Vault Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: dam_asset_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier assigned by the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system (e.g., Bynder, Widen, Canto) to this asset. Used for cross-system referencing and asset retrieval across omnichannel platforms.

attributes.name: dam_system_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier or URL path within the source Digital Asset Management (DAM) system (e.g., Bynder asset URL, Widen asset ID, Canto folder path). Enables direct deep-linking to the asset in the originating DAM platform for retrieval and governance.
attributes.references: DAM System Integration Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Integration

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Playback duration of the digital asset in seconds. Applicable to video and audio asset types (e.g., TV spots, radio jingles, digital video ads). Used for media buying, broadcast compliance, and platform upload validation.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Standards; IAB Video Ad Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this digital asset is no longer authorized for active deployment. Supports campaign lifecycle management, seasonal content rotation, and regulatory label change compliance (e.g., FDA nutritional panel updates).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; Salesforce Marketing Cloud; FTC Advertising Compliance

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this digital asset is approved and authorized for active deployment across marketing channels. Aligns with campaign launch dates, seasonal promotions, and product launch timelines.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Campaign Management; FTC Advertising Compliance

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Technical file format or extension of the digital asset (e.g., 'JPEG', 'PNG', 'MP4', 'PDF', 'AI', 'PSD', 'EPS', 'TIFF', 'MOV', 'WAV'). Determines compatibility with downstream publishing and rendering systems.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 14496 (MPEG); Adobe Creative Cloud Standards; W3C Media Formats

attributes.name: file_size_kb
attributes.description: Physical storage size of the digital asset file expressed in kilobytes (KB). Used for storage capacity planning, CDN bandwidth management, and upload/download performance optimization.

attributes.name: height_px
attributes.description: Vertical dimension of the digital asset in pixels. Used alongside width_px for aspect ratio validation and channel-specific dimension compliance (e.g., social media, e-commerce product imagery, digital shelf).
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: influencer_content
attributes.description: Indicates whether this digital asset was created by or in partnership with an influencer or brand ambassador. Triggers mandatory FTC endorsement disclosure requirements (e.g., #ad, #sponsored) and influencer contract rights verification before deployment.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; FTC Advertising Compliance

attributes.name: is_master_asset
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the master/original version of the asset (True) or a derivative/localized variant (False). Master assets serve as the source of truth for all downstream adaptations and channel-specific renditions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this digital asset record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, cache invalidation in CDN delivery, and audit compliance. Distinct from approved_timestamp which marks the approval event.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; Veeva Vault Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the usage license or rights agreement for this digital asset expires. Assets must be retired from active deployment on or before this date to avoid IP infringement. Triggers automated expiry workflows in the DAM system.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Compliance; Copyright Act; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code indicating the language and regional market for which this asset is localized (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_CA', 'es_MX'). Supports multilingual content management and regulatory labeling compliance across jurisdictions (FDA, EFSA, USDA).
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; FDA 21 CFR Part 101 Labeling; EFSA Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011

attributes.name: nutrition_claim_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether this digital asset contains nutritional or health claims (e.g., 'Low Fat', 'High Protein', 'No Added Sugar'). Triggers FTC and FDA regulatory compliance review to ensure claims meet substantiation requirements under 21 CFR Part 101.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FTC Advertising Substantiation Standards; EFSA Regulation (EC) No 1924/2006

attributes.name: regulatory_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory compliance review for this digital asset, particularly for packaging artwork, nutritional panels, and health/allergen claims. Ensures assets meet FDA, USDA, EFSA, FTC, and Codex Alimentarius requirements before market deployment.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; USDA FSIS; EFSA Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011; FTC Advertising Compliance; Codex Alimentarius Commission; FSSC 22000

attributes.name: resolution_dpi
attributes.description: Image or print resolution of the asset expressed in dots per inch (DPI). Critical for determining suitability for print vs. digital use. Standard print requires 300 DPI; digital display typically uses 72–96 DPI. Applies to image and document asset types.
attributes.references: ISO 12647 Print Standards; FTC Advertising Compliance

attributes.name: rights_holder
attributes.description: Name of the individual, agency, or organization that holds the intellectual property rights to this digital asset (e.g., photography agency, influencer, creative studio). Required for rights clearance, licensing compliance, and FTC disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Compliance; Copyright Act; ISO 22000

attributes.name: rights_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intellectual property rights and usage licensing model governing this digital asset (e.g., 'royalty_free', 'rights_managed', 'creative_commons', 'proprietary', 'licensed'). Determines permissible usage scope and commercial deployment eligibility.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Compliance; Copyright Act; Creative Commons Licensing Standards

attributes.name: storage_location_url
attributes.description: Fully qualified URL or cloud storage path where the digital asset file is physically stored (e.g., Azure Blob Storage URI, AWS S3 path, CDN endpoint). Used for asset retrieval, CDN delivery, and omnichannel content syndication.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; DAM Storage Standards

attributes.name: tags_keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of searchable tags and keywords associated with this digital asset (e.g., 'summer,refresh,oat-milk,dairy-free,snack,packaging'). Enables full-text search, content discovery, and AI-driven asset recommendation within the DAM system and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
attributes.references: DAM Taxonomy Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Management

attributes.name: thumbnail_url
attributes.description: URL of the low-resolution preview or thumbnail image for this digital asset. Used for visual browsing and search results in the DAM system, e-commerce product pages, and marketing portals without requiring full asset download.
attributes.references: DAM System Standards; E-commerce Content Standards

attributes.name: usage_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any specific restrictions on how this digital asset may be used (e.g., 'Not for use in alcoholic beverage promotions', 'Digital use only — no print', 'North America markets only', 'Influencer exclusivity period ends 2025-12-31'). Supports FTC compliance and brand governance.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Compliance; Copyright Act; Brand Governance Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version identifier of the digital asset (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3', 'v3.0.1'). Tracks creative iterations and revision history. Ensures the correct approved version is deployed across channels and prevents use of superseded artwork.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Control; DAM Version Management Standards

attributes.name: width_px
attributes.description: Horizontal dimension of the digital asset in pixels. Used for responsive design validation, planogram compliance, and channel-specific dimension requirements (e.g., social media platform specs, retail display specs).
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

products.name: shopper_program
products.description: Master record for shopper marketing programs executed at retail — in-store displays, FSIs, digital coupons, loyalty tie-ins, endcap programs, and retailer-specific activations. Captures program name, retailer account, type, brand, SKU scope, dates, budget, objectives, and measured results (incremental lift, baseline vs. promoted sales, redemption rate, display compliance, ROI, post-event evaluation). Linked to POS and syndicated data for lift measurement. Supports shopper marketing planning, execution, effectiveness reporting, and TPO alignment.

attributes.name: shopper_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the shopper marketing program record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete, lifecycle-managed shopper marketing activation event with budget, execution, and measurement attributes.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external shopper marketing agency or creative agency engaged to develop and execute program materials (displays, FSIs, digital assets). Links to the vendor/supplier master in SAP S/4HANA MM or Oracle Cloud Procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand featured in the shopper marketing program (e.g., a specific snack or beverage brand). Links to the brand master in the Product domain. Supports brand equity tracking and cross-brand spend analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Brand Management Standards; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee responsible for planning and executing this shopper marketing program. Links to the workforce/employee master in Workday HCM. Used for accountability tracking and program ownership reporting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category (e.g., salty snacks, carbonated beverages, dairy) targeted by the shopper program. Used for category captain reporting, planogram alignment, and Nielsen/IRI syndicated data linkage.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; Internal Category Management Standards

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent Trade Promotion Management (TPM) event or promotion plan that this shopper program is aligned to. Enables TPO (Trade Promotion Optimization) linkage and integrated spend reporting across trade and shopper budgets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; JDA/Blue Yonder TPM; Internal TPO Standards

attributes.name: retailer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer account (e.g., Walmart, Kroger, Target) where the shopper program is executed. Links to the customer/account master in Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud or SAP S/4HANA SD customer master. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Shopper programs target individual SKUs for promotions; the SKU FK supports the Program Effectiveness dashboard.

attributes.name: actual_spend_usd
attributes.description: Actual dollars spent against the shopper marketing program budget as of the most recent financial close. Compared against total_budget_usd to compute budget utilization and variance. Currency: USD (ISO 4217).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; ISO 4217

attributes.name: acv_weighted_pct
attributes.description: ACV (All Commodity Volume) weighted distribution percentage representing the share of total retail sales volume covered by the stores participating in this shopper program. A standard Nielsen/IRI distribution metric used to assess program reach quality.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; Internal Category Management Standards

attributes.name: baseline_sales_usd
attributes.description: Estimated dollar sales volume that would have occurred without the shopper marketing program, derived from Nielsen/IRI syndicated data or internal POS baselines. Used as the denominator for incremental lift calculation. Currency: USD (ISO 4217).

attributes.name: coupon_redemption_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of coupons or digital offers redeemed to total coupons distributed or issued for FSI (Free Standing Insert) or digital coupon program types. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Applicable when program_type is fsi or digital_coupon.
attributes.references: FTC Coupon Redemption Guidelines; Internal Shopper Marketing Standards

attributes.name: coupons_distributed
attributes.description: Total number of coupons or digital offers distributed to shoppers as part of an FSI or digital coupon program. Used with coupons_redeemed to compute coupon_redemption_rate. Applicable when program_type is fsi or digital_coupon.
attributes.references: FTC Coupon Redemption Guidelines; Internal Shopper Marketing Standards

attributes.name: coupons_redeemed
attributes.description: Total number of coupons or digital offers actually redeemed by shoppers during the program period. Used with coupons_distributed to compute coupon_redemption_rate. Sourced from retailer loyalty or clearinghouse data.
attributes.references: FTC Coupon Redemption Guidelines; Internal Shopper Marketing Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shopper program record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this transaction header. Sourced from Salesforce Marketing Cloud or SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: display_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of planned retail store locations where the display or program tactic was confirmed as correctly executed (actual_store_count / planned_store_count × 100). A key shopper marketing execution KPI. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: Internal Shopper Marketing Standards; Retailer SLA Agreements

attributes.name: dsd_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shopper program is executed through a DSD (Direct Store Delivery) distribution model, where the manufacturer's sales representative directly manages in-store execution. DSD programs have distinct compliance and display audit workflows.
attributes.references: Internal DSD Operations Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the shopper marketing program concludes at retail. Defines the measurement window close for post-event evaluation (PEE). Nullable for open-ended programs. Represents the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this program.
attributes.references: Internal Shopper Marketing Standards; SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: facing_count
attributes.description: Number of product facings (shelf-facing units visible to the shopper) allocated to the brand or SKU as part of the shopper program planogram agreement. A standard planogram metric in Food and Beverage retail. Applicable for endcap and in-store display program types.
attributes.references: Internal Category Management Standards; Planogram Standards

attributes.name: fda_label_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all product labeling and nutritional claims featured in the shopper program materials comply with FDA (Food and Drug Administration) labeling regulations (21 CFR). Critical for programs featuring health, nutrient content, or structure/function claims.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FSMA; FDA Food Labeling Regulations

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter number) within the fiscal year in which the shopper program is primarily executed and budgeted. Used for period-level spend tracking and demand planning alignment with SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; SAP IBP; Internal Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the shopper marketing program budget is allocated and financial results are reported. Used for annual shopper marketing spend planning and EBITDA impact reporting. Aligns with the company's fiscal calendar in SAP S/4HANA CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; Internal Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: ftc_claims_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether all marketing claims included in the shopper program materials (e.g., health claims, comparative claims, promotional offers) have been reviewed for compliance with FTC (Federal Trade Commission) advertising guidelines. True = reviewed and approved; False = pending review.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Guidelines; FTC Act Section 5

attributes.name: incremental_lift_pct
attributes.description: Percentage increase in sales attributable to the shopper marketing program above the baseline, calculated as ((promoted_sales_usd - baseline_sales_usd) / baseline_sales_usd) × 100. Primary effectiveness KPI for post-event evaluation (PEE). Expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; Internal TPO Standards

attributes.name: planned_duration_days
attributes.description: The planned number of calendar days the shopper program is scheduled to run at retail. Used for display compliance tracking, retailer SLA management, and program efficiency benchmarking.

attributes.name: post_event_eval_status
attributes.description: Status of the post-event evaluation (PEE) process for this shopper program. PEE captures incremental lift, ROI, display compliance, and learnings to inform future program investment. Drives TPO feedback loop in JDA/Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Internal TPO Standards; JDA/Blue Yonder TPM

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shopper program supports a private label product line rather than a branded product. Private label programs have distinct compliance, margin, and measurement considerations in Food and Beverage retail.
attributes.references: Internal Brand Management Standards; FTC Private Label Guidelines

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the shopper marketing program, used in Trade Promotion Management (TPM) systems, retailer communications, and cross-functional reporting. Sourced from Salesforce Marketing Cloud or SAP S/4HANA SD module. Format: SHP- followed by 4–12 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the shopper marketing program (e.g., 'Summer Snack Endcap Q3 2024 — Walmart'). Used in planning documents, retailer presentations, and effectiveness reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Internal Shopper Marketing Standards

attributes.name: program_objective
attributes.description: Primary business objective driving the shopper marketing program. Determines KPI selection for post-event evaluation and TPO alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trial_generation|repeat_purchase|basket_building|brand_awareness|competitive_defense|new_item_launch|seasonal_activation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Shopper Marketing Standards; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shopper marketing program. Drives workflow routing in TPM and reporting inclusion logic. Values: draft (initial creation), planned (approved, not yet live), active (currently executing at retail), completed (post-event evaluation phase), cancelled (terminated before execution).
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD; Internal TPM Governance

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shopper marketing tactic executed at retail. Determines measurement methodology and reporting template. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: endcap|fsi|digital_coupon|loyalty_tie_in|in_store_display|retailer_activation|sampling|demo — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Shopper Marketing Industry Standards; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: promoted_sales_usd
attributes.description: Actual dollar sales volume recorded during the shopper program execution period, sourced from POS data or Nielsen/IRI syndicated data. Used alongside baseline_sales_usd to compute incremental lift. Currency: USD (ISO 4217).
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; POS Data; ISO 4217

attributes.name: retailer_channel
attributes.description: The retail trade channel in which the shopper program is executed. Used for channel-specific effectiveness benchmarking and ACV (All Commodity Volume) weighting in lift analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mass|grocery|club|drug|convenience|dollar|natural|online|foodservice — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; SPINS Natural Channel Data; Internal Channel Strategy

attributes.name: roi_pct
attributes.description: Return on Investment (ROI) for the shopper marketing program, expressed as a percentage. Calculated as ((incremental gross profit - total program spend) / total program spend) × 100. Core metric for TPO alignment and future program investment decisions.
attributes.references: Internal TPO Standards; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: sku_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) coverage included in the shopper program. Indicates whether the program targets a single SKU, multiple SKUs, the full brand portfolio, or the entire category. Detailed SKU-level linkage is managed in the shopper_program_sku association table.
attributes.references: Internal PLM Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: slotting_fee_usd
attributes.description: Dollar amount paid to the retailer as a slotting fee for securing shelf placement, endcap, or display space as part of this shopper program. A standard cost component in Food and Beverage retail trade. Currency: USD (ISO 4217).
attributes.references: FTC Slotting Allowances Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD; ISO 4217

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the shopper marketing program begins execution at retail. Used for FEFO-aligned inventory planning, display compliance scheduling, and lift measurement window definition. Represents the EFFECTIVE_FROM for this program.
attributes.references: Internal Shopper Marketing Standards; SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: store_count_actual
attributes.description: Number of retail store locations where the shopper program was confirmed to have executed, as verified through display compliance audits or retailer POS data. Compared against store_count_planned to compute display compliance rate.
attributes.references: Internal Shopper Marketing Standards; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: store_count_planned
attributes.description: Number of retail store locations where the shopper program is planned to execute. Used for display compliance rate calculation (actual vs. planned stores) and TDP (Total Distribution Points) impact assessment.
attributes.references: Internal Shopper Marketing Standards; Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data

attributes.name: syndicated_data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the primary syndicated or POS data source used to measure program lift and effectiveness. Determines the measurement methodology and data quality confidence level for reported KPIs.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; SPINS Natural Channel Data

attributes.name: tdp_impact
attributes.description: Change in TDP (Total Distribution Points) attributable to the shopper program, measured as the net gain or loss in distribution points across participating retailers. TDP = number of items × ACV weighted distribution. Sourced from Nielsen/IRI syndicated data.
attributes.references: Nielsen/IRI Syndicated Data; Internal Distribution Standards

attributes.name: total_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated to the shopper marketing program in US dollars, inclusive of all tactic costs (display, FSI, digital, sampling). Used for spend tracking, ROI calculation, and annual shopper marketing budget management. Currency: USD (ISO 4217).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; ISO 4217

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shopper program record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for this transaction header. Used for Silver Layer incremental load processing in Databricks.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Standards

products.name: consumer_promotion
products.description: Master record for consumer-facing promotions — coupons, rebates, sweepstakes, loyalty rewards, BOGO offers, and sampling programs. Captures promotion type, offer value, redemption mechanism (digital, paper, in-app), eligible SKUs, start/end dates, budget, legal terms, regulatory compliance flags, redemption results (rate by channel, retailer performance, aggregate value, fraud flags, ROI). Distinct from trade promotions (owned by trade domain). Supports promotion planning, execution, budget reconciliation, and consumer behavior analysis.

attributes.name: consumer_promotion_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the consumer-facing promotion record. Primary key for the consumer_promotion data product in the marketing domain.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer account when retailer_exclusivity is True. Identifies the specific retail partner for exclusive promotions. Used for retailer performance reporting and trade fund reconciliation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Management; SAP SD Customer Master

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand under which this consumer promotion is executed. Links the promotion to brand equity tracking, marketing spend allocation, and Nielsen/IRI brand performance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Brand Hierarchy Standard; Nielsen Brand Tracking

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign under which this consumer promotion is executed. Links to Salesforce Marketing Cloud campaign records for budget roll-up and performance attribution.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee or team responsible for managing this consumer promotion. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for accountability and workflow routing in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud User Management; Workday HCM Employee Master

attributes.name: product_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Consumer promotion targets a SKU; FK ensures accurate promotion attribution.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Promotion Allocation Process: ties each consumer promotion to the exact inventory stock position reserved for the promotion, supporting allocation, fulfillment, and post‑promotion inventory reconcilia

attributes.name: actual_redemption_count
attributes.description: Running total of confirmed redemptions processed against this promotion to date. Updated via clearinghouse feeds or digital redemption platform. Used for budget burn tracking and fraud monitoring.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Clearinghouse Reporting; SAP SD Settlement

attributes.name: actual_redemption_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all confirmed redemptions processed to date in currency_code. Represents the actual COGS impact of the promotion. Used for budget reconciliation and ROI calculation inputs.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Clearinghouse Reporting; SAP CO Settlement

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of the internal approval workflow for this promotion, covering marketing, legal, and finance sign-off. Must reach 'approved' before promotion_status can transition to 'scheduled' or 'active'.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Approval Workflow; Internal Marketing Governance Policy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the promotion received final internal approval (marketing, legal, and finance). Represents a key lifecycle milestone. Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Control; Internal Marketing Governance Policy

attributes.name: clearinghouse_code
attributes.description: Identifier assigned by the coupon clearinghouse (e.g., Inmar, Quotient) for processing paper and digital coupon redemptions. Required for settlement and fraud detection. Null for non-coupon promotion types.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Clearinghouse Standards; Inmar Coupon Processing Specification

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center code to which the promotion budget and redemption costs are charged. Enables marketing spend allocation by brand, category, or business unit for EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Accounting; Internal Finance Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consumer promotion record was first created in the system. Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED. Populated automatically on insert and never updated.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the offer value and budget amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Required for multi-market promotions. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the promotion offer is distributed to consumers. Distinct from redemption_mechanism (how it is redeemed). Used for marketing attribution and channel ROI analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|direct_mail|social_media|in_store|mobile_app|website|sunday_insert — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Channel Attribution; FTC Digital Marketing Guidelines

attributes.name: eligible_sku_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of SKU eligibility for the promotion. 'specific_skus' requires a linked SKU eligibility list. 'product_line' applies to all SKUs within a product line. Used in redemption validation and planogram alignment.
attributes.references: GS1 Coupon Data Standard; SAP MM Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer promotion expires and is no longer eligible for redemption. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for the promotion lifecycle. Null indicates open-ended promotions (rare; requires legal review).
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Campaign Scheduling; SAP SD Validity Period; FTC Promotional Offer Guidelines

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion has been flagged for suspected fraudulent redemption activity based on clearinghouse anomaly detection or internal audit rules. True triggers investigation workflow.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Fraud Prevention Guidelines; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: fraud_review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the fraud investigation for this promotion. Only relevant when fraud_flag is True. Drives escalation and financial adjustment workflows.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Fraud Prevention Guidelines; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: ftc_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion has been reviewed and confirmed compliant with FTC guidelines on advertising, marketing claims, and promotional offers. Must be True before promotion_status can transition to 'active'.
attributes.references: FTC Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements; FTC Promotional Offer Guidelines

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal marketing and finance team notes regarding promotion strategy, retailer negotiations, or execution considerations. Not consumer-facing. Confidential business information.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consumer promotion record was most recently modified. Serves as RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED. Updated on every write operation. Used for incremental data pipeline processing in Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: legal_terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the legal terms and conditions document governing this promotion (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Links to the approved legal document in Veeva Vault. Required for FTC compliance and consumer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: FTC Guides Concerning Promotions; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: max_redemptions
attributes.description: Maximum total number of times this promotion may be redeemed across all consumers. Controls promotion liability exposure. Null indicates no cap. When reached, promotion_status transitions to 'expired'.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Standards; FTC Promotional Offer Guidelines

attributes.name: max_redemptions_per_consumer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single consumer household may redeem this promotion. Enforced at POS or digital redemption platform to prevent abuse. Null indicates no per-consumer limit.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Standards; GS1 Coupon Data Standard

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum consumer purchase value (in currency_code) required to qualify for the promotion offer. Zero or null indicates no minimum purchase threshold. Used in redemption validation logic.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Standards; FTC Promotional Offer Guidelines

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying product units a consumer must purchase to redeem the promotion (e.g., buy 2 to get $1 off). Null or zero indicates no quantity threshold. Critical for BOGO and multi-buy mechanics.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Standards; GS1 Coupon Data Standard

attributes.name: offer_description
attributes.description: Consumer-facing description of the promotion offer as it appears on the coupon, in-app notification, or marketing material (e.g., 'Save $1.00 on any two bags of Brand X Chips'). Used for content management and legal review.
attributes.references: FTC Promotional Offer Guidelines; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Management

attributes.name: offer_value
attributes.description: The face value of the promotion offer expressed as a monetary amount (e.g., $1.00 off, $5.00 rebate) or as a percentage discount depending on offer_value_type. Represents the consumer-facing benefit. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this promotion.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Standards; SAP SD Condition Value

attributes.name: offer_value_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer_value is a fixed monetary amount, a percentage discount, a free product award, or loyalty points. Determines how the offer is applied at redemption.
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Standards; GS1 Coupon Data Standard

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the promotion across systems (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SAP SD, POS systems). Used on coupons, in-app offers, and EDI transactions. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction header.
attributes.references: GS1 Coupon Data Standard; SAP SD Promotion Configuration

attributes.name: promotion_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the promotion as it appears in consumer-facing materials, campaign briefs, and internal planning documents (e.g., 'Summer Savings Coupon', 'Buy One Get One Free Chips'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Campaign Naming Convention

attributes.name: promotion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the consumer promotion. Controls execution eligibility and budget commitment. Drives workflow in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and SAP SD condition records.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Campaign Lifecycle; SAP SD Promotion Management

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consumer promotion by offer mechanic. Determines redemption logic, legal requirements, and budget treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coupon|rebate|sweepstakes|loyalty_reward|bogo|sampling|instant_win|cashback — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials; Coupon Industry Association Standards

attributes.name: redemption_budget
attributes.description: Portion of total_budget allocated specifically to cover consumer redemption liability (face value of offers redeemed). Distinct from production and distribution budget components. Used for financial accrual and COGS impact tracking.
attributes.references: SAP CO Accrual Management; Internal Trade Promotion Accounting Policy

attributes.name: redemption_mechanism
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the consumer redeems the promotion offer. Drives integration requirements with POS systems, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and clearinghouse partners. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: digital|paper|in_app|mail_in|loyalty_card|auto_apply — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Standards; GS1 Coupon Data Standard

attributes.name: redemption_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of distributed promotion offers that have been redeemed (actual_redemption_count / total distributed units). Industry benchmark metric for promotion effectiveness. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%).
attributes.references: Coupon Industry Association Benchmarks; Nielsen Promotion Analytics

attributes.name: retailer_exclusivity
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion is exclusive to a specific retailer or retail channel. When True, the promotion may only be redeemed at the designated retailer(s). Impacts trade relationship management and slotting negotiations.
attributes.references: Internal Trade Promotion Policy; Salesforce CRM Account Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this promotion record originated (e.g., SFMC = Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SAP_SD = SAP Sales and Distribution, INMAR = Inmar clearinghouse). Supports data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer promotion becomes active and eligible for redemption. Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for the promotion lifecycle. Used in planogram scheduling and retailer communication.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Campaign Scheduling; SAP SD Validity Period

attributes.name: state_registration_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion type (e.g., sweepstakes, contest) requires registration or bonding in specific US states (e.g., New York, Florida). Triggers compliance workflow for legal filing.
attributes.references: State Sweepstakes and Contest Laws (NY GBL §369-e; FL Stat §849.094); FTC Promotional Guidelines

attributes.name: target_market
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes identifying the geographic markets where this promotion is valid (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Drives regulatory compliance checks and retailer eligibility.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; EFSA Promotional Regulations; FDA Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: total_budget
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated for this consumer promotion in currency_code. Covers offer redemption liability, production costs, and distribution costs. Used for budget reconciliation against actual spend. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Finance Policy; SAP CO Cost Center Budgeting

attributes.name: upc_qualifier
attributes.description: The Universal Product Code (UPC) company prefix or specific product code used to qualify eligible products at POS redemption. Encoded in GS1 coupon barcodes for automated clearinghouse processing. Null when eligible_sku_scope is 'all_skus'.
attributes.references: GS1 Coupon Data Standard; GS1 US Coupon Barcoding Specification

products.name: brand_distribution_allocation
products.description: This association captures the contractual allocation of a brand to a distribution center, including the percentage of shelf space, primary stock designation, and the effective dates of the agreement. Each record links one distribution_center to one brand.. Existence Justification: Brands are actively allocated to distribution centers through formal stocking agreements. Each agreement records the allocation percentage, primary‑stock flag, and the effective start and end dates, and both a brand can be stocked in many centers and a center can carry many brands.

attributes.name: brand_distribution_allocation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the brand_distribution_allocation association

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Distribution Allocation - Distribution Center Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution_center

attributes.name: allocation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of shelf space allocated to the brand at the center

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation expires or is superseded

attributes.name: primary_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the brand is the primary stock for the center

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation becomes effective

products.name: campaign_inventory_allocation
products.description: Represents the allocation of inventory (stock positions) to marketing campaigns. Each record links one campaign to one stock position and captures allocation-specific details such as quantity, date, and status.. Existence Justification: Marketing campaigns allocate inventory from one or more stock positions to support promotional activities, and a given stock position can be allocated to multiple campaigns over time. Each allocation is tracked with quantity, allocation date, and status, making the allocation itself a managed business entity.

attributes.name: campaign_inventory_allocation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the campaign_inventory_allocation association

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the campaign

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Campaign Inventory Allocation - Stock Position Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the stock position

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory allocated to the campaign

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation was created

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the allocation

products.name: market
products.description: Master reference table for market. Referenced by market_id.

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Primary key for market

attributes.name: continent
attributes.description: Continent on which the market is located (e.g., "North America", "Europe").

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO country code representing the primary country of the market. If multiple countries apply, the primary is listed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the market record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Standard three‑letter currency code for financial reporting in this market.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free‑form text describing the market's characteristics, target consumer profile, and strategic importance.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the market is retired or no longer used; null if still active.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the market became active for reporting and planning.

attributes.name: is_primary_market
attributes.description: Indicates whether this market is a primary focus for the company's marketing strategy.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used internally to reference the market (e.g., "NA", "EUW").

attributes.name: market_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the market (e.g., "North America", "Western Europe").

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Business segment that the market primarily serves.

attributes.name: market_size_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total market size in US dollars, used for budgeting and forecasting.

attributes.name: market_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the market.

attributes.name: market_type

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Sourcing and procurement of raw materials, ingredients, packaging, indirect materials, and services. Includes supplier master data, purchase orders, MOQs, contracts, supplier performance scorecards, supplier audits, TraceGains compliance documents, approved vendor lists, raw material pricing contracts, and spend analytics.
domains.references: ISO 20400, GFSI Supplier Requirements, ISO 9001, TraceGains

products.name: supplier
products.description: Master record for all suppliers, vendors, co-packers, toll manufacturers, and service providers in the F&B procurement network. SSOT for supplier identity, classification, tier, payment terms, lead times, MOQ thresholds, onboarding status, and key contact information. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master and TraceGains supplier compliance records. Covers direct material suppliers (ingredients, packaging), indirect suppliers, 3PL/logistics service providers, and co-manufacturers.
products.reference: SAP MM Vendor Master / TraceGains Supplier Profile

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the supplier record. Primary key for the supplier master data product in the procurement domain. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master (LFA1-LIFNR mapped to BIGINT).

attributes.name: esg_disclosure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_disclosure. Business justification: Required for supplier onboarding: ESG disclosure submission is reviewed during qualification and stored per supplier.

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Compliance team needs to link each supplier to its FDA/USDA establishment registration for audit reporting and traceability.

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: Supplier sustainability performance targets are tracked to monitor compliance with corporate ESG goals.

attributes.name: account_group_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA vendor account group code (LFA1-KTOKK) that controls the field selection, number range, and partner functions applicable to this supplier. Distinguishes between one-time vendors, regular vendors, and intercompany suppliers.

attributes.name: allergen_control_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has a documented and audited allergen control program in place at their manufacturing facility. Critical for managing allergen cross-contact risk in the Food Beverage supply chain per FSMA Preventive Controls requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart C; FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act); Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 80-2020

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is currently on the Approved Vendor List (AVL), meaning they have passed all required quality, food safety, and compliance assessments and are authorized to supply materials or services to Food Beverage.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Supplier Verification

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Categorical outcome of the most recent supplier audit. A 'conditional_pass' requires corrective action within a defined timeframe. A 'fail' triggers supplier suspension pending remediation.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) from the most recent supplier quality or food safety audit. Drives supplier risk tier assignment and determines re-audit frequency. Sourced from TraceGains or Veeva Vault quality management records.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code Edition 9; TraceGains Supplier Compliance; Veeva Vault QMS

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the supplier's primary registered business address. Used for logistics routing, lead time estimation, and geographic risk analysis.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the supplier's primary registered business address. Used for regulatory compliance, import/export controls, country-of-origin labeling, and trade compliance screening.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FDA FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart L

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was first created in the system of record (SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; ISO 22000

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supplier was deactivated or blocked in the vendor master, preventing new purchase orders from being issued. Null for currently active suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1-SPERR); Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: diversity_classification
attributes.description: Supplier diversity category indicating ownership classification for ESG reporting and supplier diversity program tracking. Used to measure spend with diverse suppliers as required by corporate sustainability commitments and certain customer contracts.
attributes.references: NMSDC (National Minority Supplier Development Council); WBENC (Women's Business Enterprise National Council); FTC Supplier Diversity Guidelines

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) nine-digit identifier for the supplier legal entity. Used for supplier financial risk screening, credit assessment, and global supplier deduplication.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1-DUNS)

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is capable of exchanging Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions (e.g., EDI 850 Purchase Order, EDI 856 ASN, EDI 810 Invoice) with Food Beverage's procurement systems.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; ANSI X12; SAP S/4HANA EDI Integration

attributes.name: food_safety_cert_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the supplier's primary food safety certification. Triggers automated re-certification alerts in TraceGains and may result in supplier suspension if not renewed before expiry.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; TraceGains Document Management; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: food_safety_certification
attributes.description: Primary GFSI-recognized food safety certification held by the supplier (e.g., SQF, BRC, FSSC 22000, IFS, ISO 22000, HACCP). Mandatory for direct material suppliers under Food Beverage's supplier qualification program. Sourced from TraceGains document management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SQF|BRC|FSSC_22000|IFS|ISO_22000|HACCP|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; SQF Code; FSSC 22000; ISO 22000

attributes.name: gln
