products.description: Procurement-side goods receipt (GR) transaction capturing physical receipt of raw materials, ingredients, packaging, or services at a plant or DC against a purchase order. Records GR number, GR date, received quantity, unit of measure, batch/lot number, shelf life/best-before date, storage location, FEFO/FIFO assignment, quality inspection trigger status, and quantity variance vs. PO. This is the procurement-owned PO-closure confirmation event — it triggers three-way match with finance (invoice verification) and signals inventory domain to update stock positions. SSOT boundary: procurement owns the receipt-against-PO confirmation; inventory domain owns resulting stock position changes. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (MIGO). Critical for lot traceability, FSMA compliance, and PO closure.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO) / GR Document

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Primary key for goods_receipt

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.asset. Business justification: Upon receipt of capital equipment, the goods receipt must reference the corresponding asset for warranty and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the received item. Identifies the raw material, ingredient, packaging component, or indirect material received.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or distribution center where the goods were physically received. Critical for inventory positioning and FEFO/FIFO assignment.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific line item on the purchase order for which goods are being received. Enables line-level receipt tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this goods receipt is recorded. Links to the purchase order that authorized the procurement.

attributes.name: receiving_clerk_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Receiving clerk identity is required for traceability, quality checks, and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location within the plant where the received goods are placed. Enables warehouse bin-level traceability.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who delivered the goods. Links to the supplier master data for vendor performance tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier-provided allergen declaration was received with the goods. Critical for allergen matrix management and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The supplier-provided batch or lot number for the received material. Critical for lot traceability, FSMA compliance, recall management, and FEFO inventory rotation.

attributes.name: best_before_date
attributes.description: The date until which the received material maintains optimal quality characteristics. Used for inventory prioritization and customer service level management.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: The carrier-issued bill of lading number for the shipment. Links goods receipt to transportation and logistics documentation for freight audit and claims.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the transportation carrier who delivered the goods. Used for carrier performance tracking and freight cost allocation.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier-provided certificate of analysis was received with the goods. Required for raw material release and TraceGains compliance documentation.

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material met cold chain temperature requirements during transportation and receipt. Non-compliance triggers quality hold and supplier corrective action.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this goods receipt record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and system reconciliation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the goods receipt value is denominated. Required for multi-currency procurement and financial consolidation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|CAD|MXN|BRL|CNY|JPY|AUD — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The supplier-provided delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the shipment. Used for cross-reference with supplier documentation and ASN reconciliation.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the received material should not be used or sold. Critical for FEFO inventory rotation, quality hold decisions, and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods were physically received at the plant or distribution center. This is the principal business event timestamp for the receipt transaction and triggers inventory valuation and FEFO/FIFO aging calculations.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The externally-known business identifier for this goods receipt transaction. Used for cross-system reconciliation, three-way match with invoice, and audit trails.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the goods receipt transaction. Tracks the receipt through posting, quality inspection, approval, and final disposition workflows.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the goods receipt transaction was posted in the system. Provides granular audit trail for receipt processing and system reconciliation.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the received material was manufactured or produced by the supplier. Used for shelf life calculation and FEFO inventory management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this goods receipt record was last modified in the system. Tracks changes for audit compliance and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: The SAP movement type code that classifies the type of goods receipt transaction. Standard codes include 101 (GR for PO), 122 (return delivery), 161 (return from customer).

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity originally ordered on the purchase order line. Used to calculate receipt variance and trigger exception workflows for over-receipts or under-receipts.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The quality management inspection lot number assigned to this goods receipt for quality testing and approval. Links to quality inspection results and certificate of analysis.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received material requires quality inspection before being released to unrestricted inventory. Triggers quality management workflows per GMP and HACCP requirements.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: The difference between received quantity and ordered quantity. Positive values indicate over-receipt; negative values indicate under-receipt. Triggers procurement exception handling and supplier performance scoring.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of material received and accepted at the plant or distribution center. This is the confirmed receipt quantity used for inventory updates and three-way match with purchase order and invoice.

attributes.name: receiving_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the receiving clerk documenting any observations, damage, discrepancies, or special handling instructions for the received goods.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The remaining shelf life of the received material in days, calculated from goods receipt date to expiration date. Used for FEFO assignment and inventory aging analytics.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount associated with this goods receipt. Used for three-way match with invoice and tax compliance reporting.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction code applied to this goods receipt for sales and use tax calculation. Used for tax compliance and invoice verification.

attributes.name: temperature_at_receipt_c
attributes.description: The temperature of the received material at the time of receipt, measured in degrees Celsius. Critical for cold chain compliance and temperature-sensitive ingredient quality verification.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the goods receipt, calculated as received quantity multiplied by unit price. Used for inventory accounting and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the received quantity is expressed. Must align with the purchase order UOM and material master base UOM for accurate inventory accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|EA|CS|PAL|MT|OZ|ML — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The per-unit purchase price of the received material as recorded on the purchase order. Used for inventory valuation and three-way match with invoice.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: The specific dock or unloading bay at the plant or distribution center where the goods were received. Supports warehouse operations and receiving efficiency analytics.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The inventory valuation method applied to this goods receipt for financial accounting. Determines how the received material cost is recorded in inventory and COGS.

products.name: purchase_contract
products.description: Long-term procurement contract or framework agreement with a supplier covering raw materials, ingredients, packaging, or services. Captures contract type (value contract, quantity contract, scheduling agreement), contract period, total contract value, pricing conditions (unit prices, price scales, volume tiers, index-linked escalation), volume commitments, MOQ terms, rebate tiers, exclusivity clauses, force majeure terms, and renewal/termination provisions. Includes pricing validity periods and price adjustment mechanisms. Sourced from SAP MM outline agreements and Oracle Cloud Procurement contracts.
products.reference: SAP MM Outline Agreement / Oracle Cloud Procurement Contract

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase contract. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Contract ownership is assigned to a specific employee for responsibility tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_initiative. Business justification: Procurement contracts are linked to internal sustainability initiatives they fund (e.g., carbon‑reduction projects).

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Contract management tracks which product registrations are covered by each purchase contract to ensure legal market eligibility.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier party with whom this contract is established.

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: Contracts embed ESG performance targets that suppliers must meet, tracked per contract.

attributes.name: allergen_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Specific allergen control and handling requirements stipulated in the contract to ensure compliance with allergen labeling and cross-contamination prevention (e.g., dedicated lines, allergen-free facility).
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews for an additional term unless either party provides termination notice.

attributes.name: contract_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the signed contract document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the purchase contract, used in procurement documents and supplier communications.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the purchase contract. Active contracts are in force; suspended contracts are temporarily paused; expired contracts have passed their end date; terminated contracts were ended early.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement contract structure. Value contracts specify total value with flexible quantities; quantity contracts commit to specific volumes; scheduling agreements include delivery schedules; framework agreements establish terms for multiple purchase orders.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this contract.

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_type
attributes.description: Type of delivery arrangement under this contract. Scheduled deliveries follow a fixed calendar; just-in-time aligns with production schedules; vendor-managed inventory allows supplier to manage stock levels.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract expires or terminates. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms become binding and procurement can begin under this agreement.

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes exclusivity terms requiring the buyer to source specified materials exclusively from this supplier, or vice versa.

attributes.name: food_safety_certification_required
attributes.description: Food safety certifications that the supplier must maintain to fulfill this contract (e.g., SQF Level 2, FSSC 22000, BRC, GFSI-recognized standard).

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause
attributes.description: Text describing the force majeure provisions that excuse performance due to unforeseeable circumstances (natural disasters, pandemics, war, government actions).

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks between buyer and seller for delivery. Examples: FOB (Free On Board), CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms clause where risk and cost transfer occurs (e.g., Port of Los Angeles, Chicago DC).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was last updated.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days from purchase order placement to delivery under this contract. Critical for production planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: material_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the materials or services covered by this contract. Raw materials and ingredients are used in production; packaging materials are for finished goods; indirect materials and MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations) support operations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered per purchase order or delivery under this contract. Critical for production planning and supplier efficiency.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity (e.g., KG, LB, EA, CS, MT, GAL).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the payment schedule and conditions (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30 for early payment discounts).

attributes.name: price_adjustment_mechanism
attributes.description: Method by which contract prices may be adjusted over time. Index-linked ties to commodity indices; cost-plus adjusts based on supplier cost changes; fixed prices remain constant; periodic reviews allow renegotiation.

attributes.name: price_index_reference
attributes.description: Name of the commodity or inflation index used for price escalation (e.g., USDA Dairy Index, CPI, PPI, CME Corn Futures). Applicable when price_adjustment_mechanism is index_linked.

attributes.name: price_validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date until which the pricing conditions remain valid. After this date, prices may be renegotiated or adjusted per escalation clauses.

attributes.name: price_validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the pricing conditions in this contract become effective.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the buyer or procurement team responsible for managing this contract and related purchase orders.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Code or name of the purchasing organization or business unit responsible for this contract within the enterprise.

attributes.name: quality_specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the quality specification document or standard that materials supplied under this contract must meet (e.g., TraceGains spec ID, internal QA standard).

attributes.name: rebate_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes volume-based rebate or discount tiers that provide retroactive price reductions when volume thresholds are met.

attributes.name: rebate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rebate applied when volume commitments or spend thresholds are achieved. May be tiered based on volume levels.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to contract expiration that termination notice must be provided to prevent automatic renewal.

attributes.name: spend_category
attributes.description: Detailed spend classification for analytics and category management (e.g., Dairy Ingredients, Flexible Packaging, Transportation Services).

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for early termination of the contract by either party.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value committed under this contract across all line items and purchase orders. For value contracts, this is the spending limit; for quantity contracts, this is the estimated total value.

attributes.name: volume_commitment_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity committed to be purchased over the contract period. Used for volume-based pricing tiers and rebate calculations.

attributes.name: volume_commitment_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume commitment quantity.

products.name: supplier_scorecard
products.description: Periodic supplier performance scorecard capturing quantitative KPIs across quality, delivery, service, cost, and compliance dimensions. Metrics include OTIF (On Time In Full) rate, fill rate, defect/rejection rate (PPM), non-conformance count and severity, certificate of analysis (CoA) compliance rate, invoice accuracy, responsiveness score, and sustainability rating. Scorecards are generated quarterly or annually and drive supplier tiering, preferred supplier status, AVL renewal decisions, and strategic sourcing decisions. Managed in TraceGains and SAP MM supplier evaluation.
products.reference: TraceGains Supplier Scorecard / SAP MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: supplier_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the supplier performance scorecard record. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a periodic business event capturing quantitative KPI snapshots across quality, delivery, service, cost, and compliance dimensions for a supplier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: evaluator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Scorecard evaluation is performed by internal employees; linking evaluator enables performance reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active procurement contract or framework agreement under which this supplier is being evaluated. Used to align scorecard results with contract renewal and AVL decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Supplier selection for R&D uses scorecards; linking scorecard to rd_project supports the supplier evaluation dashboard per project.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier (vendor) being evaluated in this scorecard. Links to the supplier master record in SAP MM / TraceGains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1); TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: allergen_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments where the supplier's allergen matrix declarations matched the received product's actual allergen profile during the evaluation period. Critical food safety KPI under FDA FSMA and EU Food Information Regulation.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; EU Food Information Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011; GFSI Allergen Management; ISO 22000

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the scorecard was formally approved by the category manager or quality director. Marks the transition from 'in_review' to 'approved' status and triggers supplier communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation Workflow; TraceGains Document Control

attributes.name: avl_status
attributes.description: Current status of the supplier on the Approved Vendor List (AVL) as determined by this scorecard evaluation. Approved: cleared for procurement; Conditional: approved with restrictions; Suspended: temporarily blocked pending corrective action; Removed: delisted.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; TraceGains Approved Vendor List; GFSI Supplier Approval

attributes.name: coa_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of inbound shipments accompanied by a valid, specification-compliant Certificate of Analysis (CoA) during the evaluation period. Mandatory for food-grade raw materials and ingredients under FDA FSMA and GFSI requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Section 204; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018; TraceGains Specification Management

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative field capturing qualitative observations, context for score deviations, notable supplier improvements, or escalation notes from the evaluator. Supports supplier development conversations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation Notes; TraceGains Document Management

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Weighted performance score for the regulatory and food safety compliance dimension, incorporating audit results, certificate currency, FSMA/HACCP documentation completeness, and allergen matrix accuracy. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018; TraceGains Compliance Management

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the supplier must submit or complete the corrective action plan (CAP) in response to scorecard findings. Null when corrective_action_required is False.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; TraceGains Corrective Action Tracking; GFSI; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Corrective Action Plan (CAP) has been triggered as a result of this scorecard evaluation. True when overall score or any critical dimension falls below the defined threshold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Corrective Action; TraceGains Document Management; GFSI; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: cost_score
attributes.description: Weighted performance score for the cost dimension, incorporating invoice accuracy, pricing compliance against contract, and cost reduction contribution. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Invoice Verification; Oracle Cloud Procurement Financials

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

attributes.name: critical_nonconformance_count
attributes.description: Number of non-conformances classified as critical severity (e.g., food safety risk, allergen contamination, HACCP critical control point failure) during the evaluation period. Critical NCRs may trigger immediate supplier suspension.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP Critical Control Points; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018; TraceGains

attributes.name: defect_rate_ppm
attributes.description: Number of defective or rejected units per one million units received from the supplier during the evaluation period. Industry-standard quality metric (PPM). Sourced from SAP QM goods receipt inspection results.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Inspection Lot; ISO 9001:2015; GFSI Quality Standards

attributes.name: delivery_score
attributes.description: Weighted performance score for the delivery dimension, incorporating On Time In Full (OTIF) rate and fill rate. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; OTIF Industry Standard; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the performance measurement window covered by this scorecard. Defines the inclusive end of the data aggregation period for all KPI calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation; ISO 9001 Supplier Performance Monitoring

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the performance measurement window covered by this scorecard. Defines the inclusive start of the data aggregation period for all KPI calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation; ISO 9001 Supplier Performance Monitoring

attributes.name: evaluation_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the scorecard evaluation cycle. Quarterly scorecards are standard for strategic suppliers; annual for approved vendor list (AVL) renewal; ad-hoc for corrective action follow-up.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation; GFSI Supplier Management Requirements

attributes.name: fill_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered quantity actually delivered by the supplier during the evaluation period. Measures supply availability and capacity reliability. Calculated as (quantity delivered / quantity ordered) × 100.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; Supply Chain Fill Rate Standard

attributes.name: food_safety_audit_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent food safety audit conducted against the supplier during or immediately preceding the evaluation period. Audits may be conducted under GFSI-benchmarked schemes (SQF, BRC, FSSC 22000) or internal GMP standards.
attributes.references: GFSI; SQF; FSSC 22000; FDA FSMA; HACCP; ISO 22000:2018; Veeva Vault QMS

attributes.name: food_safety_certification_scheme
attributes.description: GFSI-benchmarked or regulatory food safety certification scheme under which the supplier is currently certified. Determines the rigor of the supplier's food safety management system and influences AVL approval status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SQF|BRC|FSSC_22000|ISO_22000|HACCP|GMP|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF; FSSC 22000; BRC Global Standard; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of supplier invoices that matched the corresponding purchase order and goods receipt without discrepancy during the evaluation period. Sourced from SAP FI three-way match results.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Invoice Verification (MIRO); Oracle Cloud Financials AP

attributes.name: lead_time_performance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders where the supplier met the agreed lead time (from PO issuance to confirmed delivery) during the evaluation period. Complements OTIF by isolating the lead time adherence component.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Confirmation; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: nonconformance_count
attributes.description: Total number of non-conformance reports (NCRs) raised against this supplier during the evaluation period. Includes quality deviations, specification failures, and food safety non-conformances logged in SAP QM or TraceGains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Non-Conformance; TraceGains Document Management; GFSI; ISO 22000

attributes.name: otif_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase order lines delivered both on time and in full quantity during the evaluation period. Industry-standard KPI for supply chain reliability. Calculated as (OTIF deliveries / total deliveries) × 100.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt Analysis; OTIF Industry Standard; SLA Compliance

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Composite weighted performance score for the supplier across all evaluation dimensions (quality, delivery, service, cost, compliance) for the evaluation period. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Drives supplier tiering and AVL renewal decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation (ME61); ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been designated as a preferred supplier based on this scorecard outcome. Preferred suppliers receive priority in sourcing decisions, contract renewals, and new product development (NPD) ingredient sourcing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; Strategic Sourcing Best Practices

attributes.name: price_variance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage deviation of actual invoiced prices from contracted purchase prices during the evaluation period. Positive values indicate supplier overcharging; negative values indicate favorable pricing. Sourced from SAP MM/FI purchase price variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/CO Purchase Price Variance; Oracle Cloud Procurement Financials

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Weighted performance score for the quality dimension, incorporating defect/rejection rate (PPM), non-conformance count and severity, and certificate of analysis (CoA) compliance rate. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Supplier Quality; HACCP; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Qualitative-to-quantitative score (0.00–100.00) measuring the supplier's speed and quality of response to inquiries, issue escalations, corrective action requests, and change notifications during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation Criteria; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: scorecard_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the scorecard was formally issued or generated. Distinct from the evaluation period dates and from audit timestamps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM ME63 Supplier Evaluation; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1

attributes.name: scorecard_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the scorecard document, formatted as SC-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used for cross-referencing in SAP MM supplier evaluation reports and TraceGains compliance documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation (ME61/ME63); TraceGains Document Management

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the scorecard. Draft: data being compiled; In Review: under procurement/quality review; Approved: signed off by category manager; Published: shared with supplier; Archived: superseded by newer period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation; TraceGains Document Control

attributes.name: service_score
attributes.description: Weighted performance score for the service dimension, incorporating responsiveness score, issue resolution time, and communication quality. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: shelf_life_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of inbound shipments meeting the minimum remaining shelf life requirement at time of receipt, as defined in the supplier specification and procurement contract. Supports FEFO inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Shelf Life Management; FEFO; FDA 21 CFR; GFSI

attributes.name: spend_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total_spend_amount field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency spend analytics and FX exposure reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: supplier_acknowledged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has formally acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the scorecard results. Required for closed-loop supplier performance management and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Collaboration; SAP S/4HANA MM Supplier Evaluation; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: supplier_category
attributes.description: Classification of the supplier by the type of goods or services procured. Drives which KPI weights and thresholds apply in the scorecard model. Co-packer and toll manufacturer categories are specific to food and beverage outsourced production. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|ingredient|packaging|indirect|co_packer|toll_manufacturer|service — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Classification; GFSI Supplier Categorization

attributes.name: sustainability_rating
attributes.description: Letter-grade rating of the supplier's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, including carbon footprint, water usage, ethical sourcing, and packaging recyclability. Increasingly required for Scope 3 emissions reporting and retailer sustainability mandates.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Compliance; Codex Alimentarius; GRI Standards; CDP Supply Chain

attributes.name: total_purchase_orders
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders (POs) issued to this supplier during the evaluation period. Provides volume context for interpreting rate-based KPIs such as OTIF rate and invoice accuracy rate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order (ME21N/ME2M); Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: total_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total procurement spend with this supplier during the evaluation period in the reporting currency. Used for spend analytics, strategic sourcing prioritization, and COGS impact assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Spend Analytics; Oracle Cloud Financials; COGS Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions during the review and approval workflow.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards

products.name: supplier_audit
products.description: Supplier audit and corrective action (CAPA) record capturing on-site or remote quality and food safety audits conducted at supplier facilities, plus all resulting Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) records linked to findings. Tracks audit type (GMP, HACCP, SQF, GFSI, social compliance, environmental), audit date, auditor, scope, findings by severity (critical, major, minor), audit score, pass/fail status, next scheduled audit. For each finding: CAPA reference number, root cause description, corrective action plan, supplier response due date, actual response date, verification method, verification status, closure date, and preventive action implemented. Managed in TraceGains and Veeva Vault. Required for FSMA supplier verification and GFSI compliance. This product is the SSOT for both audit execution and CAPA lifecycle management.
products.reference: TraceGains Audit / Veeva Vault Supplier Audit

attributes.name: supplier_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier audit record. Primary key for the supplier audit entity.

attributes.name: auditor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Audit Assignment process requires linking internal auditor employee to each supplier audit for accountability.

attributes.name: compliance_document_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the complete audit report document stored in the document management system (TraceGains or Veeva Vault).

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier being audited. Links to the supplier master data entity.

attributes.name: audit_closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the audit and all associated Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities were formally closed, indicating all findings have been satisfactorily resolved.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The date on which the audit was conducted at the supplier facility. Primary business event timestamp for the audit.

attributes.name: audit_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the audit was concluded.

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required frequency of audits for this supplier in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for biennial), based on risk assessment and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: audit_grade
attributes.description: Letter grade or qualitative rating assigned to the audit outcome based on the score and findings (e.g., A, B, C, D, F or excellent, good, acceptable, needs improvement, unacceptable). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: A|B|C|D|F|excellent|good|acceptable|needs_improvement|unacceptable — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: audit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context related to the audit that do not fit into structured fields.

attributes.name: audit_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the audit, used for tracking and communication with suppliers and auditors.

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the audit scope, including specific processes, product categories, facility areas, and compliance standards evaluated during the audit.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numerical score assigned to the audit based on the evaluation criteria, typically expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00) or point total reflecting compliance level.

attributes.name: audit_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the on-site or remote audit commenced.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audit. Tracks progression from scheduling through completion and closure.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit based on its scope and focus area. GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points), SQF (Safe Quality Food), GFSI (Global Food Safety Initiative), social compliance, environmental, food safety, quality systems, organic certification, or allergen control. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GMP|HACCP|SQF|GFSI|social_compliance|environmental|food_safety|quality_systems|organic_certification|allergen_control — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA FSMA; ISO 22000

attributes.name: auditor_certification
attributes.description: Professional certification or accreditation held by the auditor (e.g., GFSI-recognized, ISO 22000 Lead Auditor, HACCP Certified).

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the third-party auditing organization or certification body that performed the audit (e.g., NSF, SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek).

attributes.name: capa_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Approval Date
attributes.description: Date on which the submitted Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan was reviewed and approved by the quality assurance team.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; Internal Quality Management Standard

attributes.name: capa_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Due Date
attributes.description: Date by which the supplier must submit their Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) response for all audit findings.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; Internal Quality Management Standard

attributes.name: capa_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) is required based on audit findings. True if any findings require formal CAPA response.

attributes.name: capa_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Submission Date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the supplier submitted their Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) response documentation.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; Internal Quality Management Standard

attributes.name: capa_verification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Verification Date
attributes.description: Date on which the effectiveness of the implemented Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) was verified.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; Internal Quality Management Standard

attributes.name: capa_verification_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Verification Method
attributes.description: Method used to verify that the supplier has effectively implemented the Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan (e.g., document review, follow-up audit, remote verification, supplier self-assessment, photographic evidence, test results).

attributes.name: capa_verification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Verification Status
attributes.description: Current status of the Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) verification process (e.g., pending, verified effective, verified ineffective, requires additional action, closed).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; Internal Quality Management Standard

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current certification expires and recertification audit is required.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current certification status of the supplier facility based on the audit outcome (e.g., certified, not certified, certification suspended, certification withdrawn, recertification required).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier audit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of critical non-conformances identified during the audit. Critical findings represent immediate food safety or quality risks requiring urgent corrective action.

attributes.name: facility_address
attributes.description: Complete physical address of the audited supplier facility, including street, city, state/province, and postal code.

attributes.name: facility_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the location of the audited facility (e.g., USA, MEX, CHN, DEU).

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the supplier facility or manufacturing site where the audit was conducted.

attributes.name: fsma_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this audit satisfies Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) supplier verification requirements for the associated supplier.

attributes.name: gfsi_recognized_flag

products.name: sourcing_event
products.description: Strategic sourcing event record capturing RFx activities (RFI, RFQ, RFP) and e-auction events conducted to select or re-qualify suppliers, including all supplier bid/quote responses as line-level detail. Tracks event type, commodity category, participating suppliers, bid submission deadlines, evaluation criteria (price, quality, lead time, sustainability), event status, and award outcome. For each bid: bid reference number, supplier identity, bid submission date, quoted unit price, quoted lead time, MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity), payment terms offered, quality certifications cited, sustainability commitments, bid score against evaluation criteria, rank, and award/reject decision with rationale. Captures total savings achieved vs. baseline spend. Supports category management and spend optimization in Oracle Cloud Procurement and SAP Ariba. attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment must be made to the supplier to comply with agreed payment terms and avoid late payment penalties. Derived from invoice date and payment terms; stored for accounts payable aging and cash flow management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Payables; EU Late Payment Directive

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: ERP payment terms code (e.g., NET30, 2/10NET30) defining the due date and any early payment discount conditions for this invoice. Used for cash flow forecasting, dynamic discounting, and working capital optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; Oracle Cloud Payables; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant or Oracle organization code identifying the manufacturing facility, distribution center (DC), or business unit that received the goods or services and is accountable for the spend. Key dimension for plant-level spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Plant Master; Oracle Cloud Organization

attributes.name: po_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the purchase order document identifying the specific goods or services line that generated this spend transaction. Enables granular PO line-level spend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known purchase order document number from the source ERP system (SAP S/4HANA MM or Oracle Cloud Procurement) that authorizes the procurement spend. Used to trace spend back to the originating PO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud Procurement; ISO 20022

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the spend transaction was posted to the general ledger in the ERP system. Determines the fiscal period and accounting period to which the spend is attributed. May differ from invoice date due to accruals or late processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: ppv_amount
attributes.description: Purchase Price Variance (PPV) amount calculated as the difference between the actual invoice price and the standard cost, multiplied by the invoiced quantity. Positive PPV indicates overspend vs. standard; negative indicates savings. Key metric for procurement performance and COGS management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO PPV; Oracle Cloud Cost Variance; GAAP/IFRS; CIMA

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: SAP purchasing group code identifying the buyer or procurement team responsible for this transaction. Used for buyer-level spend analytics, workload management, and procurement performance reporting.

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: SAP purchasing organization or Oracle procurement business unit code responsible for negotiating and managing the procurement of this transaction. Used for spend analytics by procurement organization and category management accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Organization; Oracle Cloud Procurement Business Unit

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the invoiced quantity (e.g., KG, LB, L, EA, CS, MT). Required for accurate spend-per-unit analysis, minimum order quantity (MOQ) compliance, and cross-supplier price benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM UOM; UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20; GS1

attributes.name: source_document_type
attributes.description: ERP document type code identifying the accounting document category for this spend transaction (e.g., SAP document types: RE=Invoice Receipt, KR=Vendor Invoice, KG=Vendor Credit Memo, KA=Vendor Document). Used for spend classification and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Types; Oracle Cloud Payables Transaction Types

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this spend transaction was sourced (SAP S/4HANA FI/CO, Oracle Cloud Financials, or manual entry). Required for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: spend_amount
attributes.description: Gross spend amount for this procurement transaction line in the transaction currency as invoiced by the supplier. Represents the actual purchase price multiplied by the invoiced quantity before any discounts or adjustments. Core metric for spend analytics and category management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP/IFRS; ISO 4217

attributes.name: spend_amount_local
attributes.description: Spend amount converted to the company code local currency (e.g., USD for US entities) using the exchange rate at the time of posting. Enables consistent spend aggregation and reporting across multi-currency procurement transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation; Oracle Cloud Financials; ISO 4217; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: spend_classification
attributes.description: High-level classification of the procurement spend indicating whether it is direct (raw materials, ingredients, packaging used in finished goods), indirect (MRO, services, overhead), capital expenditure (capex), or operating expenditure (opex). Critical dimension for spend analytics and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of measure for the material as defined in the ERP cost master (SAP CK11N standard cost estimate or Oracle standard cost). Used as the baseline for purchase price variance (PPV) calculation and COGS analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Product Costing; Oracle Cloud Cost Management; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the currency in which the supplier invoice was issued (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency spend analytics and foreign exchange exposure reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the spend transaction in the source ERP system. 'Posted' indicates the invoice is fully approved and posted to the general ledger; 'reversed' indicates a reversal entry; 'blocked' indicates a payment block; 'parked' indicates a pending document; 'cleared' indicates the payment has been made.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Status; Oracle Cloud Payables Status

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Actual price per unit of measure paid to the supplier on this transaction as invoiced, in the transaction currency. Used for purchase price variance (PPV) calculation against standard cost and contract price benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Invoice Verification; Oracle Cloud Procurement; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: unspsc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC)
attributes.description: Eight-digit United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC) classifying the procured commodity or service into a standardized global taxonomy. Enables cross-supplier, cross-category spend benchmarking and category management.
attributes.references: UNSPSC v23 (UN/CEFACT); GS1; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this spend transaction record was last modified or refreshed in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental processing, and audit trail.

products.name: purchase_requisition
products.description: Internal purchase requisition (PR) record representing a formal internal request to procure raw materials, ingredients, packaging, indirect materials, or services. Captures requisition number, requestor, plant/cost center, material/service description, required quantity, required delivery date, estimated value, approval workflow status, and conversion status to purchase order. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (ME51N) and Oracle Cloud Procurement self-service.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchase Requisition (ME51N) / Oracle Cloud Requisition

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase requisition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved the purchase requisition, typically a manager or procurement officer.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.demand_plan. Business justification: Demand‑driven purchase requisitions are generated from the demand plan; linking enables automated requisition creation per plan.

attributes.name: primary_purchase_requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who created or submitted the purchase requisition.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Requisition approval workflow includes the rd_project that originated the request, enabling the requisition‑to‑project audit trail.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred or suggested supplier for this purchase requisition, if specified by the requestor.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was approved by the designated approver.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the approval workflow instance governing this purchase requisition, tracking routing and approval steps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Workflow Engine, Oracle Cloud Procurement Approval

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to an existing procurement contract or pricing agreement that governs this requisition, if applicable.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was converted to a purchase order.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the purchase requisition expense will be charged for financial accounting and budget tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase requisition record was first created in the source system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_address
attributes.description: Full delivery address where the materials or services should be delivered, if different from the plant default address.

attributes.name: estimated_total_value
attributes.description: Total estimated value of the purchase requisition, calculated as quantity requested multiplied by estimated unit price.

attributes.name: estimated_unit_price
attributes.description: Estimated price per unit of measure for the requested material or service, used for budgeting and approval workflows.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number to which the procurement expense will be posted in the financial system.

attributes.name: is_deleted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the purchase requisition has been logically deleted or marked for archival.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase requisition record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material, ingredient, packaging, or service being requested.

attributes.name: material_group_code
attributes.description: Classification code grouping similar materials for procurement, planning, and reporting purposes (e.g., raw materials, packaging, indirect materials).

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material, ingredient, or packaging item being requisitioned. Corresponds to SAP material master.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant, distribution center, or facility where the materials or services are required.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the purchase requisition indicating urgency of procurement need.

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of procurement: raw materials, ingredients, packaging, indirect materials, services, or capital equipment.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number to which this requisition has been converted, if the conversion has occurred.

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Quantity of the material or service requested in the purchase requisition, expressed in the base unit of measure.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver if the purchase requisition was rejected.

attributes.name: requestor_email
attributes.description: Email address of the requestor for communication and notifications regarding the purchase requisition.

attributes.name: requestor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who requested the procurement.

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested materials or services must be delivered to meet operational or production requirements.

attributes.name: requisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was created or submitted by the requestor.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the purchase requisition, externally visible and used in procurement workflows. Typically 10-character alphanumeric code from SAP MM.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase requisition in the approval and conversion workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|partially_converted|fully_converted|cancelled|on_hold — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase requisition based on procurement scenario: standard purchase, subcontracting, consignment, stock transfer between plants, service procurement, or third-party direct delivery.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record from which the purchase requisition originated (SAP S/4HANA MM, Oracle Cloud Procurement, or manual entry).

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Additional instructions or notes provided by the requestor regarding handling, delivery, quality requirements, or other special considerations.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the storage location or warehouse within the plant where the material will be received and stored.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the requested quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, LB for pounds, EA for each, L for liters).

products.name: category_strategy
products.description: Procurement category strategy record defining the sourcing approach, supply base targets, risk posture, and savings objectives for each procurement category (e.g., dairy ingredients, grain/oilseed commodities, flexible packaging, co-manufacturing services, MRO). Captures category name, strategic classification (Kraljic quadrant positioning), number of approved suppliers target, dual/single source policy, commodity hedging strategy, sustainability and ethical sourcing requirements, annual savings target, and category manager ownership. Supports category management, strategic sourcing planning, and annual procurement planning cycles.

attributes.name: category_strategy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the procurement category strategy record. Primary key for the category_strategy data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – Category Management

attributes.name: allergen_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement category includes materials that are or may contain regulated allergens (e.g., dairy, tree nuts, wheat, soy, peanuts). When true, suppliers must provide allergen declarations and the category is subject to enhanced TraceGains specification management and FDA allergen labeling compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA); FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; Codex Alimentarius Allergen Management; TraceGains Allergen Matrix

attributes.name: annual_savings_target_usd
attributes.description: Targeted procurement savings in US dollars for this category in the current strategy period. Represents the expected reduction in total cost of ownership (TCO) through sourcing initiatives, negotiations, and demand management. Feeds into annual procurement planning and EBITDA improvement targets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Cost Savings Tracking; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Savings Management; CIPS Procurement Value Measurement

attributes.name: annual_spend_usd
attributes.description: Total annual procurement spend for this category in US dollars, based on the most recently completed fiscal year. Used to size the category, prioritize sourcing investment, and calculate savings targets. Classified confidential as it reveals commercial spend positioning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – Spend Analytics; Oracle Cloud Financials – Procurement Spend; ISO 20400 Sustainable Procurement

attributes.name: approved_supplier_target_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved Vendor List (AVL) Target Supplier Count
attributes.description: Target number of approved suppliers to maintain on the Approved Vendor List (AVL) for this category. Balances supply security with supplier relationship management investment. Reviewed annually during strategic sourcing planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Approved Vendor List; TraceGains – Supplier Compliance; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: business_unit_owner
attributes.description: Name or code of the primary business unit or division that owns and sponsors this category strategy (e.g., Snacks BU, Beverages BU, Dairy BU, Supply Chain). Supports category strategy alignment with business unit P&L and procurement planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Cost Center / Business Unit; Oracle Cloud Financials – Business Unit

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the procurement category (e.g., DAIRY-ING, GRAIN-OIL, FLEX-PKG, CO-MFG, MRO). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing category hierarchy and used as the business key across ERP and sourcing systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Category Hierarchy; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Category Management

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this category within the procurement category hierarchy (e.g., 1 = top-level segment, 2 = category, 3 = sub-category). Supports hierarchical drill-down in spend analytics and category management dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Category Hierarchy; CIPS Category Management Framework

attributes.name: category_manager_email
attributes.description: Corporate email address of the procurement category manager. Used for workflow notifications, strategy review communications, and stakeholder escalation. Classified confidential as it is an employee contact identifier.
attributes.references: Workday HCM – Core HR; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: category_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the procurement category manager responsible for owning and executing this category strategy. Used for accountability, escalation routing, and category management reporting. Sourced from Workday HCM employee master.
attributes.references: Workday HCM – Core HR; CIPS Category Management Framework

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the procurement category (e.g., Dairy Ingredients, Grain and Oilseed Commodities, Flexible Packaging, Co-Manufacturing Services, Maintenance Repair and Operations). Used in category management reporting and strategic sourcing planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Category Hierarchy; CIPS Category Management Framework

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the category by commodity type. 'agricultural_commodity' = exchange-traded raw materials (grains, dairy, oils); 'industrial_commodity' = packaging materials, chemicals; 'manufactured_input' = processed ingredients, co-pack services; 'service' = logistics, co-manufacturing; 'indirect' = MRO, facilities, IT. Drives hedging eligibility and pricing contract structure.
attributes.references: CBOT/CME Commodity Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Group; FDA FSMA Supply Chain Program

attributes.name: contract_duration_months
attributes.description: Target contract duration in months for supplier agreements in this category. Informs negotiation strategy and contract renewal planning. Typical ranges: 12 months for commodity categories, 24–36 months for strategic categories with capital investment requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Outline Agreements; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Contract Management

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Preferred commercial contract structure for this category. 'spot' = transactional market pricing; 'annual_fixed' = fixed price for 12-month period; 'multi_year' = fixed or structured pricing over 2+ years; 'index_linked' = price tied to commodity index (e.g., USDA, CBOT); 'cost_plus' = supplier cost transparency with agreed margin. Drives contract strategy in SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing contracts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Outline Agreements; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Contract Management; CIPS Contract Management

attributes.name: dual_source_split_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dual Source Primary Supplier Split Percentage
attributes.description: Target volume allocation percentage to the primary supplier when a dual-source policy is in effect (0.00–100.00%). For example, 70.00 means 70% to primary supplier and 30% to secondary. Null when supply_base_policy is 'single_source' or 'multi_source'. Supports supply continuity risk management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Source List Quota Arrangement; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Supplier Allocation

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this category strategy version becomes binding and operational. Aligns with the annual procurement planning cycle start date (typically fiscal year start).
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Contracts

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this category strategy version expires or is scheduled for renewal. Nullable for open-ended strategies. Triggers review workflow when approaching expiry.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Contracts

attributes.name: ethical_sourcing_standard
attributes.description: Ethical sourcing and labor standards audit framework required for suppliers in this category. 'sedex' = Supplier Ethical Data Exchange; 'smeta' = Sedex Members Ethical Trade Audit; 'bsci' = Business Social Compliance Initiative; 'sa8000' = Social Accountability International; 'custom' = company-specific standard; 'none' = not applicable. Supports responsible sourcing programs.
attributes.references: Sedex SMETA; SA8000 Social Accountability International; BSCI; UN Global Compact; FTC Advertising and Marketing Claims

attributes.name: food_safety_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum food safety certification or standard required for suppliers in this category. 'gmp' = Good Manufacturing Practice; 'haccp' = Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points; 'gfsi' = Global Food Safety Initiative benchmarked scheme; 'sqf' = Safe Quality Food; 'fssc22000' = Food Safety System Certification 22000. Mandatory for direct food ingredient and packaging categories. Managed via TraceGains supplier compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; FSSC 22000; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; ISO 22000

attributes.name: geographic_sourcing_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the approved supply base for this category. 'domestic' = suppliers within the home country only; 'regional' = suppliers within a defined trade region; 'global' = worldwide supplier base; 'preferred_domestic' = global scope with preference for domestic suppliers. Impacts trade compliance, tariff exposure, and supply chain resilience.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP); USDA Country of Origin Labeling; Codex Alimentarius; EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: hedge_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of forecasted commodity volume to be covered by hedging instruments (0.00–100.00%). For example, 75.00 means 75% of projected annual volume should be hedged. Supports COGS risk management and financial planning. Classified confidential as it reveals pricing risk posture.
attributes.references: CME Group Risk Management; SAP S/4HANA CO – Commodity Risk Management; FASB ASC 815 Derivatives and Hedging

attributes.name: hedging_strategy
attributes.description: Commodity price risk management strategy applied to this category. 'no_hedge' = market price accepted; 'forward_contract' = fixed-price forward purchase agreements; 'futures' = exchange-traded futures contracts (e.g., CBOT corn, CME dairy); 'options' = price floor/ceiling options; 'index_pricing' = contract pricing linked to published commodity index (e.g., USDA dairy price). Critical for COGS stability in food and beverage manufacturing.
attributes.references: CME Group Commodity Futures; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Price Reporting; SAP S/4HANA CO – Commodity Risk Management

attributes.name: innovation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to supplier-led innovation and co-development activities for this category. 'high' = active joint innovation programs with key suppliers (e.g., new ingredient technologies, sustainable packaging); 'medium' = innovation considered in supplier reviews; 'low' = transactional category with no formal innovation agenda. Supports NPD and R&D pipeline.
attributes.references: CIPS Supplier Relationship Management; SAP S/4HANA MM – Supplier Collaboration; TraceGains Specification Management

attributes.name: kraljic_quadrant
attributes.description: Strategic classification of the procurement category using the Kraljic Portfolio Matrix. 'strategic' = high spend impact, high supply risk (e.g., specialty dairy cultures); 'leverage' = high spend impact, low supply risk (e.g., commodity grains); 'bottleneck' = low spend impact, high supply risk (e.g., proprietary flavors); 'non_critical' = low spend impact, low supply risk (e.g., general MRO). Drives sourcing strategy and supplier relationship investment.
attributes.references: Kraljic (1983) Harvard Business Review – Purchasing Must Become Supply Management; CIPS Strategic Sourcing Framework

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this category strategy was most recently formally reviewed and updated. Used to track review cadence compliance and identify overdue strategy refreshes.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; CIPS Category Management Framework

attributes.name: lead_time_target_days
attributes.description: Target supplier lead time in calendar days from purchase order placement to delivery at the receiving DC or plant. Used in supply planning, safety stock policy design, and supplier SLA negotiations. Feeds into JDA/Blue Yonder supply planning parameters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Info Record; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: moq_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) requirements for this category. 'not_applicable' = no MOQ constraints; 'supplier_standard' = accept supplier-defined MOQs; 'negotiated' = MOQs are negotiated as part of sourcing strategy; 'waived' = MOQs formally waived in contract. Impacts inventory planning and working capital.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Info Record; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Supplier Agreements; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next formal review of this category strategy is scheduled. Calculated from last_review_date and review_frequency. Triggers workflow notifications to the category manager and procurement leadership.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; CIPS Category Management Framework

attributes.name: parent_category_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent category in the procurement category hierarchy, enabling multi-level category tree structures (e.g., INGREDIENTS as parent of DAIRY-ING). Supports roll-up spend analytics and hierarchical category reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Category Hierarchy; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Category Hierarchy

attributes.name: payment_term_days
attributes.description: Standard payment term in days (net days) targeted for supplier contracts in this category (e.g., 30, 45, 60, 90). Longer payment terms improve working capital and cash conversion cycle. Negotiated as part of category sourcing strategy and reflected in SAP S/4HANA FI payment terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI – Payment Terms; Oracle Cloud Financials – Payables; CIPS Working Capital Management

attributes.name: preferred_incoterm
attributes.description: Preferred International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) for supplier contracts in this category, defining the transfer of risk and responsibility for freight, insurance, and customs. Common food and beverage terms: FOB (Free on Board) for bulk commodities, DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) for finished ingredients. Impacts landed cost and supply chain risk allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchasing Conditions; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Contract Terms

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this category strategy is formally reviewed and refreshed. Strategic and bottleneck categories typically require quarterly reviews; leverage and non-critical categories may be reviewed annually. Drives the procurement planning calendar.
attributes.references: CIPS Category Management Framework; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing

attributes.name: savings_target_pct
attributes.description: Targeted procurement savings as a percentage of total annual category spend (0.00–100.00%). Provides a normalized savings ambition metric that enables cross-category comparison regardless of absolute spend size. Supports annual procurement planning cycles.
attributes.references: CIPS Procurement Value Measurement; SAP S/4HANA CO – Cost Savings Tracking

attributes.name: sourcing_approach
attributes.description: Primary sourcing methodology applied to this category. 'competitive_bid' = formal RFP/RFQ process; 'negotiated' = direct negotiation with preferred suppliers; 'sole_source' = single qualified supplier; 'consortium' = industry buying group; 'spot_buy' = open market transactional purchasing. Informs procurement execution strategy.
