attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; SAP S/4HANA MM – Source Determination; CIPS Sourcing Strategy

attributes.name: spend_impact_rating
attributes.description: Assessed financial impact level of this category on total procurement spend and COGS. Used as one of the two axes in the Kraljic Matrix positioning. Combined with supply_risk_rating to determine the Kraljic quadrant classification.
attributes.references: Kraljic (1983) HBR; CIPS Category Management; SAP S/4HANA CO – Spend Analytics

attributes.name: spend_under_management_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total category spend that is actively managed under formal procurement contracts and sourcing agreements (0.00–100.00%). A key procurement maturity KPI. Higher percentages indicate stronger category governance and compliance. Classified confidential as it reveals procurement control posture.
attributes.references: CIPS Procurement Maturity Model; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Spend Analytics; SAP S/4HANA MM – Spend Management

attributes.name: strategy_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the category strategy was formally approved by procurement leadership or the category governance board. Marks the transition from 'approved' to 'active' status in the strategy lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; ISO 9001 Document Control; Veeva Vault Document Control

attributes.name: strategy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional strategic context, rationale, market intelligence, or special considerations relevant to this category strategy (e.g., market disruption notes, regulatory changes, geopolitical risk commentary). Supports category manager documentation and knowledge management.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; CIPS Category Management Framework

attributes.name: strategy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the category strategy record. 'draft' indicates the strategy is being developed; 'active' means it is approved and in execution; 'under_review' indicates a scheduled refresh cycle; 'approved' means formally signed off pending activation; 'archived' means superseded by a newer strategy version.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; SAP S/4HANA MM – Category Management

attributes.name: strategy_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the category strategy document (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Supports version control and audit trail for strategy evolution across annual procurement planning cycles.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud Procurement – Strategic Sourcing; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: supply_base_policy
attributes.description: Approved supply base policy for this category defining whether the business maintains a single, dual, or multiple qualified suppliers. Dual/multi-source policies mitigate supply continuity risk for critical ingredients and packaging materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Source List; Oracle Cloud Procurement – Supplier Management; FSMA Supply Chain Risk

attributes.name: supply_risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessed supply continuity risk level for this category based on factors including supplier concentration, geographic concentration, commodity volatility, regulatory exposure, and lead time. Drives risk mitigation actions and safety stock policy. Reviewed at minimum annually.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 – Supply Chain Program; ISO 31000 Risk Management; SAP S/4HANA MM – Supplier Risk

attributes.name: sustainability_certification_required
attributes.description: Specific third-party sustainability certification standard required for suppliers in this category when sustainability_requirement is 'certified' (e.g., Rainforest Alliance, RSPO, Fair Trade, SBTi, GFSI, Organic USDA). Null when no certification is required. Supports TraceGains supplier compliance document management.
attributes.references: ISO 20400 Sustainable Procurement; USDA Organic Certification; Rainforest Alliance; RSPO; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: sustainability_requirement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sustainability and Ethical Sourcing Requirement Level
attributes.description: Level of sustainability and ethical sourcing requirement applied to suppliers in this category. 'none' = no formal requirement; 'preferred' = sustainability criteria considered in sourcing decisions; 'required' = mandatory sustainability standards in supplier contracts; 'certified' = third-party certification required (e.g., Rainforest Alliance, RSPO, Fair Trade, SBTi). Supports ESG reporting and ISO 20400 compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 20400 Sustainable Procurement; Rainforest Alliance; RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil); UN SDGs; EPA Environmental Compliance

products.name: supplier_risk
products.description: Supplier risk assessment record capturing identified risks associated with specific suppliers or supply categories — including geopolitical risk, single-source dependency, financial stability risk, food safety risk, climate/weather risk for agricultural commodities, and regulatory compliance risk. Tracks risk type, risk rating (high/medium/low), likelihood, impact score, mitigation strategy, contingency supplier identified, and risk review date. Supports supply chain resilience and business continuity planning.
products.reference: Supplier Risk Assessment / Supply Chain Risk Register

attributes.name: supplier_risk_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the supplier risk assessment record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: compliance_document_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the associated supplier compliance document, audit report, or specification record stored in TraceGains. Links the risk record to supporting evidence in the supplier compliance document management system.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Compliance; TraceGains Document Management; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: primary_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier master record against which this risk is assessed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Oracle Cloud Procurement Supplier Master

attributes.name: purchase_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement contract or raw material pricing contract associated with this supplier risk. Enables linkage between risk exposure and contractual protections or obligations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; Oracle Cloud Procurement Contract Management

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: R&D risk assessment report requires mapping supplier risk entries to the rd_project that depends on the supplier.

attributes.name: annual_spend
attributes.description: Total annual procurement spend with this supplier in the reporting currency, used to contextualize the financial significance of the risk and prioritize mitigation investment. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Spend Analytics; Oracle Cloud Procurement Spend Management

attributes.name: approved_vendor_list_status
attributes.description: Current status of the supplier on the Approved Vendor List (AVL) at the time of risk assessment. A risk event may trigger a change from approved to conditional or suspended status. Aligns with TraceGains supplier qualification workflows.
attributes.references: TraceGains Supplier Compliance; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA 21 CFR Part 117 Supplier Verification

attributes.name: audit_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this risk record to a specific supplier audit finding, non-conformance report (NCR), or corrective action request (CAR) from a GMP, SQF, or GFSI audit.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; ISO 22000; Veeva Vault Quality Management

attributes.name: contingency_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of days required to activate and onboard the contingency supplier and resume supply in the event the primary supplier fails. Used in business continuity planning and safety stock calculations.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; JDA/Blue Yonder Supply Planning; ISO 31000:2018

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the supplier's primary operating country, used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping (FDA, EFSA, USDA) and trade compliance assessments.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; FDA Import Regulations; USDA Agricultural Trade

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier risk record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Oracle Cloud Procurement Audit

attributes.name: estimated_financial_exposure
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the business impact if the risk event materializes, expressed in the reporting currency. Includes potential supply disruption costs, expediting fees, reformulation costs, and lost revenue. Used in risk prioritization and EBITDA impact analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Evaluation; SAP S/4HANA CO Profitability Analysis; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: exposure_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated_financial_exposure amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency risk reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle Cloud Financials; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: financial_stability_rating
attributes.description: External or internally-assessed financial stability rating for the supplier (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX, credit rating agency score, or internal procurement rating). Indicates risk of supplier insolvency or financial distress impacting supply continuity.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; Oracle Cloud Procurement Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: food_safety_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk record involves a food safety dimension, including HACCP critical control point failures, allergen cross-contamination risk, microbiological contamination (CFU exceedance), or GMP non-compliance. Triggers mandatory escalation per FSMA and GFSI protocols.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI Benchmarking; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: fsma_verification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Supplier Verification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk triggers a mandatory FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) or domestic supplier verification activity under 21 CFR Part 117. True = verification activity required.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart L

attributes.name: geopolitical_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code) where the supplier operates, used to assess geopolitical, trade, and climate-related risk exposure for agricultural commodities and raw material sourcing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Codex Alimentarius Commission; EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the supplier risk was first formally identified and logged in the risk register. Used for aging analysis and risk trend reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018; SAP S/4HANA MM Risk Management

attributes.name: impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–5) representing the assessed severity of business impact if the risk event materializes. 1 = negligible, 5 = catastrophic. Considers supply disruption, financial loss, food safety, and regulatory exposure.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Assessment; ISO 31010:2019 Risk Assessment Techniques

attributes.name: is_single_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is the sole approved source for the associated material or ingredient, creating a single-source dependency risk. True = single source; False = multiple qualified sources exist. Critical for business continuity planning.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review of this supplier risk record, including reassessment of likelihood, impact, and mitigation effectiveness.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Monitoring; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: likelihood_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–5) representing the assessed probability that the identified risk event will materialize within the review horizon. 1 = rare, 5 = almost certain. Used in risk matrix calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Assessment; ISO 31010:2019 Risk Assessment Techniques

attributes.name: mitigation_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the mitigation strategy was fully executed and verified. Compared against mitigation_target_date to measure timeliness of risk treatment.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Treatment; Veeva Vault Quality Management

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of the mitigation strategy for this risk. Tracks whether corrective or preventive actions have been initiated, are in progress, completed, or placed on hold.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Treatment; SAP S/4HANA MM Corrective Action Management

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Documented strategy to reduce or eliminate the identified risk, including actions such as dual-sourcing, safety stock build, supplier development programs, contractual protections, or regulatory corrective action plans.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Treatment; FSMA Preventive Controls; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: mitigation_target_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the mitigation strategy actions. Used to track on-time execution of risk treatment plans and escalate overdue mitigations.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Treatment; SAP S/4HANA MM Corrective Action Management

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this supplier risk record. Drives review calendar workflows and ensures timely reassessment of high and critical risks.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Monitoring; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation Schedule

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk involves a regulatory compliance dimension, such as FDA labeling violations, USDA inspection failures, EFSA authorization issues, or FSSC 22000 certification lapses. Triggers compliance review workflows.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; USDA FSIS Regulations; EFSA Regulation (EC) No 178/2002; FSSC 22000; ISO 22000

attributes.name: residual_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating remaining after mitigation actions have been applied. Represents the accepted level of risk exposure post-treatment. Distinct from risk_rating which reflects the inherent (pre-mitigation) risk level.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Broader business category grouping for the risk, used for portfolio-level risk reporting and supply chain resilience dashboards. Distinct from risk_type which captures the specific risk driver.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Management; Codex Alimentarius Commission General Principles

attributes.name: risk_closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk was formally closed, either through successful mitigation, risk acceptance, or supplier disqualification. Null if the risk remains open.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018; SAP S/4HANA MM Risk Management

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified risk, including the specific risk event, root cause drivers, and potential business consequences. Authored by the procurement risk analyst.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; TraceGains Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: risk_open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk record was formally opened and entered into the active risk register. May differ from identified_date if there is a lag between identification and formal registration.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018; Oracle Cloud Procurement Risk Management

attributes.name: risk_owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the procurement professional or category manager accountable for monitoring and managing this supplier risk. Aligns with risk ownership principles in ISO 31000.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Ownership; SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Organization

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to this supplier risk record following assessment. Drives escalation workflows, mitigation prioritization, and business continuity planning. Values: critical, high, medium, low.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: risk_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the risk record, used in cross-functional communications, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Format: SR-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Risk Management

attributes.name: risk_reviewer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual who conducted the most recent risk review or assessment. Distinct from risk_owner who holds ongoing accountability.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018; Veeva Vault Quality Management; TraceGains Document Management

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk score derived from the product of likelihood_score and impact_score (range 1–25). Stored as a business-assessed value at the time of review; not dynamically recalculated. Supports risk prioritization and heat map reporting.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supplier risk record. Tracks progression from initial identification through mitigation, acceptance, or closure. Drives workflow routing in procurement risk management processes.
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Risk Management

attributes.name: risk_type
attributes.description: Classification of the risk category associated with the supplier. Covers geopolitical instability, financial stability of the supplier, food safety and HACCP compliance failures, single-source dependency exposure, climate or weather-driven agricultural commodity risk, and regulatory compliance risk (FDA, FSMA, EFSA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: geopolitical|financial_stability|food_safety|single_source_dependency|climate_weather|regulatory_compliance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 31000:2018; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: supply_category
attributes.description: Procurement spend category or commodity group associated with this risk (e.g., raw ingredients, packaging materials, indirect services, agricultural commodities). Aligns with the procurement category hierarchy in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group; Oracle Cloud Procurement Category Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this supplier risk record. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads in the Databricks Silver Layer, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Capture

products.name: supplier_approval
products.description: Represents the approval relationship between a raw material and a supplier. Each record tracks which supplier is approved for which raw material, including approval status and date.. Existence Justification: In procurement, each raw material can be approved for multiple suppliers, and each supplier can be approved for multiple raw materials. The approved‑supplier list is actively managed, with status and approval dates recorded for each raw material‑supplier pairing.

attributes.name: supplier_approval_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the SupplierApproval association

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the raw material

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the supplier

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier was approved for the raw material

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the supplier for the raw material (e.g., Approved, Pending, Revoked)

products.name: sustainability_partnership
products.description: Represents the participation of a supplier in a sustainability initiative, capturing partnership details that are not intrinsic to either the supplier or the initiative.. Existence Justification: Suppliers are actively enrolled in multiple sustainability initiatives, and each initiative aggregates many suppliers. The partnership is managed as a distinct business entity that records the supplier's role, organization, and contact details for each initiative.

attributes.name: sustainability_partnership_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sustainability Partnership - Supplier Initiative Participation Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the sustainability_partnership association

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Links to the sustainability initiative

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Links to the supplier participating in the initiative

attributes.name: partner_contact_name
attributes.description: Contact person responsible for the partnership on the supplier side

attributes.name: partner_organization
attributes.description: Name of the supplier's organization as recorded for the partnership

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Role of the supplier in the initiative (e.g., primary supplier, co‑partner)

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: Represents the contractual relationship between a procurement supplier and a maintenance spare part. Each record captures the specific terms under which a supplier provides a particular spare part.. Existence Justification: A supplier can provide many spare parts, and a spare part can be sourced from multiple suppliers. Each supplier‑part pairing is actively managed with its own unit price, lead time, and contract terms, forming a distinct business entity that users create, update, and delete.

attributes.name: supply_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the SupplyAgreement association

attributes.name: spare_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the spare part

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the supplier

attributes.name: contract_terms
attributes.description: Textual description of contractual terms (payment, warranty, etc.) for this supplier‑part pair

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Lead time in days specific to this supplier‑part contract

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed price per unit for this supplier‑part combination

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Single source of truth for all finished goods, WIP, and raw material stock positions across plants, DCs, and 3PL locations. Manages lot traceability, FEFO/FIFO lot management, shelf life monitoring, stock aging, inventory valuation, and cycle count reconciliation aligned with SAP WM/EWM.
domains.references: FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1.1300), GS1 SSCC

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Core master record representing the current stock balance for each material/SKU and lot at each storage location. Tracks stock categories (on-hand, available, reserved, in-transit, quality-inspection, blocked) and shelf life attributes (remaining days, SLED, BBD, expiry status). Serves as the single source of truth for real-time inventory balances across finished goods, WIP, and raw materials. Updated by every goods movement posting.
products.reference: SAP MM Stock Overview (MMBE) / EWM Warehouse Stock

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock position record. Primary key for the stock position entity.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production or procurement lot/batch number for traceability and FEFO/FIFO management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: packaging_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.packaging_profile. Business justification: Packaging Sustainability reports require linking inventory items to their packaging profile to calculate recyclability and carbon impact per SKU.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: REQUIRED: Stock aging and cost allocation reports must trace each inventory lot back to its originating purchase order line for financial and quality audits.

attributes.name: price_list_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list_line. Business justification: Inventory valuation report uses the price list line applied at receipt to calculate valuation per SKU, a standard accounting process.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Regulatory compliance reports require each stock position to be linked to its product registration for traceability and recall eligibility.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: R&D material reservation: stock positions are allocated to specific R&D projects to track raw material usage for experiments.

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Stock Audit Responsibility Report; assigns a custodian employee to each stock position for accountability.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record (finished goods, WIP, or raw material SKU) for which stock is held.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical storage location (plant, DC, 3PL warehouse, or specific bin/zone) where the stock is held.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Inventory classification based on value and velocity. A items are high-value/high-velocity requiring frequent monitoring; B items are moderate; C items are low-value/low-velocity; X items are obsolete or non-moving.
attributes.references: Inventory Management Best Practices, Pareto Analysis

attributes.name: allergen_segregation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock contains major allergens and requires physical segregation to prevent cross-contamination.

attributes.name: best_before_date
attributes.description: Date until which the product maintains optimal quality characteristics. May differ from expiration date for shelf-stable products.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock position record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical cycle count verification for this stock position. Used to track count frequency and accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP Physical Inventory (MI01), Inventory Control Best Practices

attributes.name: cycle_count_variance
attributes.description: Difference between system quantity and physical count quantity from the most recent cycle count. Positive indicates overage; negative indicates shortage.
attributes.references: Inventory Accuracy Metrics, SAP Physical Inventory

attributes.name: expiry_status
attributes.description: Classification of the stock based on remaining shelf life. Valid indicates sufficient shelf life; near-expiry indicates approaching expiration threshold; expired indicates past SLED; no-expiry indicates shelf-stable products without expiration date.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 global trade item number (UPC, EAN, or GTIN-14) for the material at this packaging level. Used for EDI and retail integration.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, storage, and transportation procedures.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard, DOT Hazmat Regulations

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods movement transaction affecting this stock position (receipt, issue, transfer, or adjustment).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this stock position record. Updated by every goods movement posting or inventory adjustment.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: lot_traceability_code
attributes.description: External lot or batch code used for supply chain traceability and recall management. May differ from internal lot ID.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Traceability Rule, GS1 Standards

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock is certified organic and must be segregated from non-organic inventory to maintain certification integrity.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Date when the lot was manufactured or packaged. Used for traceability and shelf life calculation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Unrestricted quantity available for consumption, sale, or production use. Excludes reserved, blocked, and quality-inspection stock.

attributes.name: quantity_blocked
attributes.description: Quantity restricted from use due to quality issues, regulatory holds, or pending disposition (rework, scrap, return to vendor).
attributes.references: SAP Blocked Stock (MCHB), FDA Hold Procedures

attributes.name: quantity_in_transit
attributes.description: Quantity currently in movement between locations (plant-to-DC, DC-to-DC, or inbound from supplier) but not yet received at destination.
attributes.references: SAP Stock Transport Order (STO), ASN Processing

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Total physical quantity of the material/lot currently present at the storage location, regardless of availability status.
attributes.references: SAP Material Document (MSEG), GAAP Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: quantity_quality_inspection
attributes.description: Quantity under quality inspection hold pending QA release. Cannot be used until inspection results are approved.
attributes.references: SAP Quality Inspection Stock (QM), ISO 22000, HACCP

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: Quantity allocated to specific sales orders, production orders, or transfer orders but not yet physically moved.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock is under quarantine hold pending quality inspection, regulatory clearance, or investigation.

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock is subject to an active product recall and must be segregated and disposed per recall procedures.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the stock was received into the storage location. Used for FIFO aging analysis and inventory turnover metrics.

attributes.name: remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days remaining until shelf life expiration date. Used for FEFO prioritization and aged inventory alerts.
attributes.references: FEFO Inventory Management, SAP SLED Processing

attributes.name: safety_stock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock position is designated as safety stock buffer to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions.

attributes.name: shelf_life_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the product should not be sold or consumed. Critical for FEFO lot management and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Classification for non-standard stock ownership or purpose. Consignment is vendor-owned stock at customer location; customer-owned is stock held on behalf of customer; project is allocated to specific project; sample is for testing; promotional is for marketing programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: consignment|customer_owned|vendor_owned|project|sample|promotional|standard — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Special Stock (MSKA), Inventory Accounting Standards

attributes.name: stock_age_days
attributes.description: Number of days since the stock was received at the storage location. Used for slow-moving and obsolete inventory analysis.
attributes.references: Inventory Management Best Practices, SAP Stock Aging Report

attributes.name: stock_category
attributes.description: Classification of stock status indicating availability and restrictions. On-hand is total physical stock; available is unrestricted and not reserved; reserved is allocated to orders; in-transit is goods in movement; quality-inspection is under QA hold; blocked is restricted due to quality or regulatory issues.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required storage temperature condition for the stock. Ambient is room temperature; refrigerated is 0-8°C; frozen is below 0°C; controlled is specific temperature range per product specification.
attributes.references: GMP Storage Requirements, Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of measure for this stock position. Used to calculate total valuation amount and COGS.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the stock quantity (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, KG for kilogram, LB for pound, LT for liter).

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the stock position calculated using the applicable valuation method (standard cost, moving average, FIFO). Used for inventory accounting and financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330, IFRS IAS 2, SAP Material Valuation (MBEW)

attributes.name: valuation_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the valuation amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: vendor_lot_number
attributes.description: Supplier-provided lot or batch number for raw materials and co-packed products. Used for upstream traceability.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule, Supplier Quality Management

products.name: storage_location
products.description: Master reference for all physical and logical storage locations in the inventory network — plants, distribution centers, 3PL warehouses, cold storage facilities, staging areas, quarantine zones, and allergen-segregated zones. Captures location type, temperature zone (ambient, chilled, frozen), capacity, WMS location code, allergen segregation classification, and operational status. Enables location-level stock visibility and FEFO/FIFO enforcement.
products.reference: SAP WM Storage Location / EWM Warehouse Structure

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the storage location. Primary key.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center if this storage location is part of a DC network node.

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Facility inspection and audit processes map every storage location to the registered establishment for inspection scheduling and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for Location Management & Safety Inspection process; links each storage location to its overseeing manager employee.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility that owns or operates this storage location.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Location‑based pricing zones determine which price list applies to inventory stored at each location, used in regional pricing compliance.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the 3PL provider if this storage location is operated by an external logistics partner.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: REQUIRED: Supplier‑managed warehouse locations need to be linked to the specific supplier site for inbound receipt traceability and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the storage location. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, building, floor). Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: allergen_segregation_class
attributes.description: Allergen segregation classification for the storage location. Ensures physical separation of allergen-containing products to prevent cross-contamination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|peanut|tree_nut|dairy|gluten|soy|shellfish|mixed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling, GFSI Allergen Management

attributes.name: capacity_pallet_positions
attributes.description: Number of standard pallet positions available in this storage location. Key metric for warehouse slotting and inventory planning.

attributes.name: capacity_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total storage capacity of the location measured in cubic meters. Used for space utilization analytics and capacity planning.

attributes.name: capacity_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the storage location in kilograms. Critical for structural safety and load planning.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management System (WMS) Standards, OSHA Warehouse Safety

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the storage location is physically situated. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the storage location is located (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this storage location was decommissioned or ceased operations. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this storage location became operational and available for inventory placement.

attributes.name: erp_storage_location
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Storage Location Code
attributes.description: Storage location code as defined in the ERP system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA storage location). Used for financial valuation and inventory accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: fefo_enforcement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Enforcement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FEFO lot rotation based on expiration dates is enforced at this storage location. Critical for perishable goods management.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), FDA Food Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: fifo_enforcement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Enforcement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FIFO lot rotation is enforced at this storage location. True if FIFO rules are active.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Inventory Management Best Practices

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage location meets GMP standards for food safety and quality. True if GMP compliant.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117 Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage location is certified for halal product storage. Required for halal certification maintenance.
attributes.references: Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America (IFANCA) Standards

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage location is certified to store hazardous materials. True if HAZMAT certification is active.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard, EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage location is certified for kosher product storage. Required for kosher certification maintenance.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent quality or safety inspection of the storage location. Used for compliance tracking and audit readiness.
attributes.references: GFSI Audit Requirements, FDA Inspection Guidelines

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the storage location. Used for logistics routing and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location used in warehouse management systems and operational documents. Typically follows plant-site-aisle-bin hierarchy (e.g., PLT01-DC01-A12-B05).

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the storage location (e.g., 'Chicago DC Frozen Zone A', 'Plant 3 Raw Material Staging').

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location by its primary operational purpose within the supply chain network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: plant|distribution_center|3pl_warehouse|cold_storage|staging_area|quarantine_zone|finished_goods|raw_material — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the storage location. Used for logistics routing and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required inspection of the storage location. Supports proactive compliance management.
attributes.references: GFSI Audit Requirements, FDA Inspection Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or location-specific comments.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location. Determines whether the location can accept new inventory.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage location is certified for organic product storage. Required for USDA Organic compliance.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the storage location. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the storage location. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: temperature_max
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Celsius for this storage location. Exceeding this threshold triggers quality alerts.
attributes.references: HACCP Critical Control Points, FSMA Preventive Controls

attributes.name: temperature_min
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Celsius for this storage location. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance.
attributes.references: HACCP Critical Control Points, FSMA Preventive Controls

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for the storage location. Critical for food safety compliance and FEFO/FIFO enforcement.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), GFSI Storage Requirements

attributes.name: wms_location_code
attributes.description: External location identifier used by the warehouse management system. Enables integration with WMS for real-time inventory tracking.
attributes.references: SAP WM/EWM, Oracle WMS, Manhattan Associates WMS

products.name: goods_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory state change — goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, returns postings, scrap disposals, write-offs, write-ups, reclassifications, cycle count adjustments, reconciliation corrections, and all other inventory adjustments. Each posting captures movement type, quantity, UoM, source/destination locations, lot reference, posting date, reference document, reason code, adjustment reason (for variance and correction postings), financial impact (debit/credit to inventory and COGS accounts), approver where required, and originating event reference (cycle count, quality inspection, production order, or manual correction). Serves as the single, authoritative audit trail for ALL inventory quantity and value changes — no other entity in this domain records stock state mutations. Foundation for inventory reconciliation, COGS postings, adjustment approval workflows, and regulatory traceability. Aligned with SAP MM movement types (101, 201, 301, 311, 551, 561, 701/702).
products.reference: SAP MM MIGO / MSEG Material Document

attributes.name: goods_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods movement transaction. Primary key for this entity. Serves as the immutable reference for all inventory state changes across the enterprise.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who approved the movement. Nullable if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: COST ACCOUNTING: Material movements must be allocated to a cost center for internal cost of goods sold reporting; finance cost_center is the natural target.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Goods movement records shipments that satisfy a sales order; the FK ties the movement to the originating order for shipping and financial reporting.

attributes.name: price_list_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list_line. Business justification: Goods movement posting requires the price list line for material valuation and cost of goods sold, required by finance reporting.

attributes.name: primary_goods_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID of the person who posted the goods movement. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: Movement of promotional goods must be tied to the promotion event for traceability and cost allocation.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: The unique product identifier for the material being moved. References the master product catalog. Also known as material number in SAP.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Goods movement records affect a specific stock position (location + SKU + lot). Adding stock_position_id creates a clear parent‑child link and removes the need for separate location/SKU columns if des

attributes.name: amount_lc
attributes.description: The financial value of the movement in the local currency of the plant. Calculated as quantity × standard cost or moving average price. Positive for receipts, negative for issues. Used for COGS posting and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for movements requiring authorization (e.g., write-offs above threshold, manual adjustments). Pending indicates awaiting approval, approved indicates cleared for posting, rejected indicates denied.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the movement was approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Nullable if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch identifier for the material being moved. Critical for traceability, FEFO/FIFO lot management, shelf life monitoring, and recall execution. Nullable for non-batch-managed materials.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center to which the movement is charged (for issues to cost centers) or credited (for receipts from cost centers). Used for internal cost allocation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the amount_lc field. Typically the local currency of the plant's company code. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|INR|BRL|MXN|CAD|AUD — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: customer_code
attributes.description: Customer identifier for goods issue movements to external customers or for customer returns. Nullable for internal movements.

attributes.name: destination_plant_code
attributes.description: For transfer movements, the plant to which the material is being moved. Nullable for non-transfer movements.

attributes.name: destination_storage_location
attributes.description: For transfer movements, the storage location to which the material is being moved. Nullable for non-transfer movements.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the originating business document (e.g., delivery note date, production order completion date, cycle count date). May differ from posting_date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the goods movement was posted in the ERP system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Distinct from posting_date which is the financial effective date.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: The GL account to which the financial impact is posted. Determined by movement type and account determination configuration. Examples: inventory asset account, COGS account, scrap expense account.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material for human readability and reporting. Denormalized from product master for query performance.

attributes.name: material_document_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the material document. Allows multiple movements to be grouped under a single document header.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP MM material document number generated upon posting. Unique identifier for the goods movement in the source ERP system. Ten-digit numeric string.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the material document was created. Part of the compound key in SAP MM (material_document_number + material_document_year).

attributes.name: movement_indicator
attributes.description: High-level classification of the movement direction and purpose. Receipt increases stock, issue decreases stock, transfer moves between locations, adjustment corrects quantity or value, reversal cancels a prior posting, reclassification changes stock type without location change.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP MM movement type code defining the nature of the inventory transaction. Examples: 101 (GR for PO), 201 (GI for cost center), 261 (GI for production order), 301 (plant-to-plant transfer), 311 (storage location transfer), 551 (scrapping without PO), 561 (initial entry of stock balance), 701 (GR from blocked stock), 702 (GI to blocked stock). Determines debit/credit logic and account determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 101|102|201|202|261|262|301|302|311|312|321|322|343|344|411|412|551|552|561|562|701|702|711|712 — 24 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments or explanations about the movement. Used for manual adjustments, special circumstances, or audit documentation.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or distribution center where the movement occurred. Maps to the organizational unit in SAP.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The financial effective date of the goods movement. Determines the fiscal period for COGS recognition and inventory valuation. Must fall within an open fiscal period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: The profit center responsible for the movement. Used for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material moved in the base unit of measure. Positive for receipts, negative for issues. Three decimal places to accommodate fractional units (e.g., 123.456 kg).

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason for the movement. Examples: production consumption, customer return, quality rejection, cycle count adjustment, obsolescence, damage, theft, donation, sample. Used for root cause analysis and variance reporting.

attributes.name: reference_document_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the reference document. Nullable for document types without line items.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the originating business document (e.g., PO number, production order number, sales order number, cycle count ID). Nullable for manual postings.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: The type of originating business document that triggered this movement. Enables drill-back to source transaction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase_order|production_order|sales_order|transfer_order|cycle_count|physical_inventory|quality_inspection|manual_adjustment — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this movement is a reversal of a prior posting. True if this is a cancellation transaction, false otherwise.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number of the original posting that this movement reverses. Nullable if reversal_indicator is false.

attributes.name: reversed_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year of the original posting that this movement reverses. Nullable if reversal_indicator is false.

attributes.name: source_plant_code
attributes.description: For transfer movements, the plant from which the material is being moved. Nullable for non-transfer movements.

attributes.name: source_storage_location
attributes.description: For transfer movements, the storage location from which the material is being moved. Nullable for non-transfer movements.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The inventory status category of the material. Unrestricted is available for use, quality_inspection is awaiting QA clearance, blocked is not usable, restricted has limited use, returns is customer-returned stock.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The storage location within the plant where the material is physically located. Sub-division of plant for inventory management.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the quantity is expressed. Examples: EA (each), CS (case), KG (kilogram), LB (pound), L (liter), GAL (gallon), OZ (ounce), G (gram), ML (milliliter), TON (ton), PAL (pallet). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|KG|LB|L|GAL|OZ|G|ML|TON|PAL — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Split valuation category for materials with multiple valuation classes (e.g., domestic vs imported, organic vs conventional). Nullable if not split-valuated.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Supplier identifier for goods receipt movements from external vendors. Nullable for internal movements.

products.name: stock_transfer_order
products.description: Transactional record for planned and executed inter-location stock transfers — plant-to-plant, DC-to-DC, plant-to-DC, and 3PL replenishment transfers. Captures transfer order number, source and destination locations, material/SKU, lot/batch, requested quantity, confirmed quantity, transfer reason, priority, planned transfer date, actual shipment and receipt dates, temperature compliance flag, and transfer status (planned, released, in-transit, received, cancelled). Distinct from goods_movement: this entity represents the planning/execution document (the 'order'), while goods_movement records the actual stock postings (issue at source, receipt at destination). Aligned with SAP WM Transfer Order (LT0A) and EWM Warehouse Task.
products.reference: SAP WM Transfer Order (LT0A) / EWM Warehouse Task

attributes.name: stock_transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock transfer order. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP WM Transfer Order (LT0A), SAP EWM Warehouse Task

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for moving the stock between locations.
attributes.references: Carrier Master Data, Transportation Management System

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Cost center to which transfer costs are allocated. Used for internal cost accounting and supply chain cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Cost Center Master (CO), Management Accounting Structure

attributes.name: destination_location_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the receiving location to which stock is being transferred. May reference plant, distribution center, or third-party logistics (3PL) facility.
attributes.references: SAP Plant Master, SAP Storage Location, WMS Location Master

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Transfer orders are often generated to replenish stock for a specific sales order; linking provides traceability from order demand to internal transfer.

attributes.name: primary_stock_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created this transfer order. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: User Master Data, SAP User ID

attributes.name: primary_stock_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating location from which stock is being transferred. May reference plant, distribution center, or third-party logistics (3PL) facility.
attributes.references: SAP Plant Master, SAP Storage Location, WMS Location Master

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Transfer orders moving materials to R&D labs are tied to a project; this FK supports the 'Material Transfer to R&D' operational workflow.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material, finished good, work-in-progress (WIP), or raw material being transferred. Links to product master data.
attributes.references: SAP Material Master (MM), Product Master Data

attributes.name: tertiary_stock_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who approved this transfer order for execution. Required for high-value or cross-region transfers.

attributes.name: transfer_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.transfer_price. Business justification: Inter‑plant transfer orders are priced using a transfer price record for cost allocation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: Actual date when stock was received at the destination location. Captured at goods receipt posting.
attributes.references: SAP Goods Receipt Date, WMS Receipt Confirmation Date

attributes.name: actual_shipment_date
attributes.description: Actual date when stock was shipped from the source location. Captured at goods issue posting.
attributes.references: SAP Goods Issue Date, WMS Shipment Confirmation Date

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer order was approved for execution. Marks transition from planned to released status.

attributes.name: cancelled_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why this transfer order was cancelled. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.
attributes.references: Supply Chain Exception Management, Process Documentation

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity confirmed for transfer after picking and verification. May differ from requested quantity due to availability or quality issues.
attributes.references: SAP Confirmed Quantity, WMS Picked Quantity

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: System Audit Standards, Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this transfer order.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-by date for the lot being transferred. Used for shelf life monitoring and FEFO lot selection.
attributes.references: FDA Labeling Requirements, Product Shelf Life Master Data

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number for traceability. Critical for FEFO/FIFO lot management, recall management, and food safety compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Traceability Rule, GFSI Lot Traceability Requirements, SAP Batch Management

attributes.name: maximum_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in Celsius for this transfer. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Product Temperature Specifications, Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: minimum_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in Celsius for this transfer. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Product Temperature Specifications, Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer order record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: System Audit Standards, Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or instructions related to this transfer order. May include special handling instructions, quality concerns, or coordination details.
attributes.references: Warehouse Operations Documentation, Transfer Order Procedures

attributes.name: planned_transfer_date
attributes.description: Target date for initiating the stock transfer. Used for planning warehouse resources, transportation capacity, and inventory positioning.
attributes.references: SAP Planned Goods Issue Date, Supply Chain Planning Calendar

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level for processing and execution of the transfer order. Determines sequencing in warehouse operations and transportation planning.
attributes.references: WMS Priority Configuration, Transportation Management Priority Rules

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received at destination location. May differ from confirmed quantity due to damage, loss, or discrepancies during transit.
attributes.references: SAP Goods Receipt Quantity, WMS Received Quantity

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Planned quantity to be transferred as specified in the transfer order. Represents the target amount for the transfer.
attributes.references: SAP Transfer Order Quantity, WMS Planned Quantity

attributes.name: shelf_life_remaining_days
attributes.description: Number of days of shelf life remaining at the time of transfer initiation. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management.
attributes.references: FEFO Inventory Management, Product Shelf Life Specifications

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the physical shipment associated with this transfer order. Links to transportation management and carrier tracking.
attributes.references: SAP Transportation Management Shipment Number, Carrier Tracking Number

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific product variant being transferred. Used for inventory tracking and warehouse operations.

attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Special handling requirements for this transfer. Determines warehouse handling procedures, packaging requirements, and transportation mode.
attributes.references: Warehouse Handling Procedures, Transportation Safety Requirements

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of stock status at source location. Determines whether stock is available for transfer and use.
attributes.references: SAP Stock Type Classification, Quality Management Stock Status

attributes.name: temperature_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether temperature requirements were maintained throughout the transfer. False value triggers quality review and potential product hold.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Requirements, HACCP Temperature Monitoring

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transfer requires temperature-controlled transportation and handling. Critical for perishable food and beverage products.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Requirements, Cold Chain Management Standards

attributes.name: transfer_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost associated with this stock transfer including transportation, handling, and administrative costs. Used for supply chain cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Controlling (CO), Supply Chain Cost Accounting

attributes.name: transfer_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the stock transfer order. Used for tracking and reference across systems and documents.
attributes.references: SAP WM Transfer Order Number, SAP EWM Warehouse Task Number

attributes.name: transfer_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason or trigger for the stock transfer. Used for analytics, cost allocation, and supply chain optimization.
attributes.references: SAP Movement Type Reason Code, Supply Chain Business Rules

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock transfer order. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion or cancellation.
attributes.references: SAP WM Transfer Order Status, EWM Warehouse Task Status

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer based on source and destination location types. Determines routing, handling requirements, and approval workflows.
attributes.references: SAP Movement Type Classification, WMS Transfer Type Configuration

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields. Standard units include each (EA), case (CS), pallet (PL), kilogram (KG), pound (LB), gallon (GAL), liter (LTR). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|GAL|LTR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000, SAP Unit of Measure Master

products.name: cycle_count
products.description: Master record for scheduled and ad-hoc physical inventory cycle count events at a storage location. Captures count plan reference, count type (full physical inventory, cycle count, spot check), scheduled date, actual count date, counter assigned, count status (planned, in-progress, completed, reconciled), and variance threshold. Aligned with SAP MI01/MI04 Physical Inventory Document. Supports continuous inventory accuracy programs and audit compliance.

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cycle count event. Primary key for the cycle count record.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Distribution center where the cycle count is performed. Null if count is at plant or 3PL location.

attributes.name: counter_assigned_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Cycle Count Counter Assignment report requires identifying the employee performing the count; creates clear accountability.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or production facility where the cycle count is performed.

attributes.name: accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated inventory accuracy percentage for this cycle count, representing the ratio of items counted correctly to total items counted.

attributes.name: actual_count_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the physical count was performed. May differ from scheduled date due to operational constraints.

attributes.name: audit_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when audit review of the cycle count was completed and findings documented. Null if no audit required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count is subject to internal or external audit review due to materiality or compliance requirements. True if audit required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes related to the cycle count event, including special instructions, issues encountered, or operational observations.

attributes.name: count_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count activity was completed and all items were counted.

attributes.name: count_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes from count start to count completion. Used for labor efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the physical count: manual (paper-based), barcode scan (handheld scanner), RFID (radio frequency identification), automated system (WMS-driven), blind count (no system quantity shown), or guided count (system quantity visible).

attributes.name: count_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the master cycle count plan or schedule that triggered this count event. Used for planned cycle counts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Cycle Count Planning

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count activity was initiated. Used to track count duration and labor efficiency.

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Type of inventory count being performed: full physical inventory (complete stock take), cycle count (scheduled rotation), spot check (ad-hoc verification), wall-to-wall (complete facility count), ABC cycle (frequency based on value), or perpetual inventory (continuous counting).

attributes.name: counter_assigned
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the warehouse worker or team assigned to perform the physical count.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for variance value amounts.

attributes.name: cycle_count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cycle count: planned (scheduled but not started), in-progress (counting underway), completed (count finished, awaiting reconciliation), reconciled (variances resolved and posted), cancelled (count aborted), or on-hold (temporarily suspended).

attributes.name: freeze_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when inventory freeze was lifted and normal operations resumed. Null if no freeze applied.

attributes.name: freeze_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when inventory movements were frozen for the count. Null if no freeze applied.

attributes.name: inventory_freeze_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory movements were frozen during the count to ensure accuracy. True if frozen, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cycle count record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lot_traceability_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether lot-level traceability is required for items in this cycle count due to FSMA or food safety regulations. True if lot tracking required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: physical_inventory_document_number
attributes.description: SAP physical inventory document number generated for this cycle count event. Maps to SAP MI01/MI04 document.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the cycle count based on item criticality, value, or operational urgency: critical (immediate attention), high (expedited), medium (standard), or low (routine).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Cycle Count Planning

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when inventory variances were reconciled and adjustments posted to the general ledger and inventory records.

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the reconciliation process, root cause analysis of variances, and corrective actions taken.

attributes.name: recount_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the recount was completed, if a recount was required. Null if no recount performed.

attributes.name: recount_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount is required due to variances exceeding threshold or data quality concerns. True if recount needed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the cycle count to be performed. Set during count planning phase.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Cycle Count Planning

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that originated this cycle count record (e.g., SAP S/4HANA WM, Oracle WMS, Blue Yonder WMS).
