products.name: reservation
products.description: Transactional record for inventory reservations that earmark specific stock quantities for planned consumption — production orders, sales orders, promotional allocations, or maintenance requirements. Captures reservation type, reserved quantity, requirement date, priority, and fulfillment status. Prevents double-allocation of constrained inventory and supports ATP (available-to-promise) calculations.

attributes.name: reservation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for reservation

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the DC where the reserved inventory is held, if applicable.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Financial cost center associated with the reservation for internal accounting.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the material (SKU) for which inventory is being reserved.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Order fulfillment creates inventory reservations; the reservation record must reference the sales order to track allocated stock for each order.

attributes.name: price_list_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list_line. Business justification: Reservation pricing calculates reserved value using the applicable price list line, essential for revenue forecasting and inventory commitment reporting.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.rd_project. Business justification: Reservation system supports R&D projects reserving inventory; linking reservation to rd_project enables project‑level material planning reports.

attributes.name: reservation_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who initially created the reservation record.

attributes.name: reservation_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the reservation, if an approval step is required.

attributes.name: reservation_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who performed the most recent update to the reservation.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Reservation reserves quantity from a specific stock position. Linking to stock_position eliminates duplicate location/SKU/lot data.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, storage bin, or 3PL site where the reserved stock resides.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation received formal approval.

attributes.name: cancelled_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for cancelling the reservation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reservation record was first captured in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 code representing the currency of the reserved value.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the reserved inventory becomes unsellable or non‑usable.

attributes.name: freeze_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inventory freeze ended.

attributes.name: freeze_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the inventory freeze began.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Indicates the progress of fulfilling the reservation against the reserved quantity.

attributes.name: is_frozen
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved inventory is currently frozen for audit or regulatory purposes.

attributes.name: is_quality_hold
attributes.description: Flag indicating the reserved stock is on quality hold pending inspection or test results.

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved stock requires temperature‑controlled handling.

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature for the reserved product, in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature for the reserved product, in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the reservation record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Optional free‑text comments or instructions related to the reservation.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Code of the manufacturing plant associated with the inventory reservation.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the reservation to influence allocation order.

attributes.name: quality_hold_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the reservation is placed on quality hold.

attributes.name: requesting_party_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal or external party that initiated the reservation (e.g., production planner, sales representative, customer).

attributes.name: requirement_date
attributes.description: Date by which the reserved inventory must be available for the downstream process.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: External business identifier assigned to the reservation, used in operational communications and reporting.

attributes.name: reservation_source
attributes.description: Origin of the reservation request indicating whether it was generated by a system process, entered manually, or received via an API.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reservation indicating whether it is still being planned, has been allocated, completed, or terminated.

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the reservation was created or became effective in the business process.

attributes.name: reservation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the purpose of the reservation such as production order, sales order, promotional allocation, maintenance, or stock transfer.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material that is earmarked for the reservation, expressed in the unit of measure.

attributes.name: reserved_value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the reserved quantity based on current cost or price.

attributes.name: shelf_life_remaining_days
attributes.description: Number of days remaining before the reserved product expires, calculated from production/receipt date.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the upstream system that originated the reservation record (e.g., SAP WM, Oracle SCM).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the reserved quantity is measured (e.g., KG, L, PCS).
attributes.references: Food Beverage unit of measure master

products.name: shelf_life_monitor

attributes.name: product_registration_id

attributes.name: stock_position_id

attributes.name: storage_location_id

attributes.name: compliance_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for monetary values.

attributes.name: event_type

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: expiry_status

attributes.name: gtin

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code used in WMS for the storage location.

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Upper temperature bound for the storage condition of the lot.

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Lower temperature bound for the storage condition of the lot.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent update to the record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form comments or observations related to the lot.

attributes.name: observation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the shelf‑life observation was captured.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the product associated with the lot.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Date the lot was produced or manufactured.

attributes.name: quality_status
attributes.description: Result of quality inspections for the lot.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current total quantity of the lot available in the location.

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: True if the lot has been subject to a product recall.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the lot was received into inventory.

attributes.name: remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Calculated days remaining before the lot reaches its expiration date.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total number of days the product is expected to remain usable from production.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system that generated the record (e.g., SAP WM, MES).

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: True if the lot is stored in a temperature‑controlled environment.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of the lot in the functional currency.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Measurement unit for the quantity (e.g., kilograms, pieces).

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the lot based on the chosen inventory valuation method.

attributes.name: original_shelf_life_monitor_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on shelf_life_monitor (original_shelf_life_monitor_id)

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Authoritative domain for all financial data — general ledger, cost centers, accounts payable/receivable, COGS calculation, standard costing, variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting, EBITDA reporting, revenue management, RSP/pricing strategy, trade spend accruals, intercompany transactions, fixed assets, and financial close processes.
domains.references: GAAP, IFRS, SOX, SAP S/4HANA FI-CO, Oracle Cloud Financials

products.name: gl_account
products.description: General ledger chart of accounts master — the authoritative SSOT for all GL account codes used across the F&B enterprise. Captures account number, account type (P&L vs balance sheet), financial statement version assignment, account group, currency, tax category, reconciliation account flag, posting block status, and account hierarchy classification. Every financial posting, budget line, and cost allocation references this master. Drives journal entry classification and all financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the GL account record in the enterprise data lakehouse. Primary key for the gl_account master data product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts (SKA1/SKB1)

attributes.name: esg_disclosure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_disclosure. Business justification: Specific GL accounts capture environmental expenses; ESG disclosure references these accounts for transparent reporting.

attributes.name: house_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the house bank account associated with this GL account, applicable for bank GL accounts. Links the GL account to the physical bank account for cash management and bank reconciliation. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.HBKID + HKTID. Used in treasury and cash management for F&B global banking relationships.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-BL; Oracle Cloud Cash Management

attributes.name: account_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization indicating whether the account is a balance sheet account (carries forward balances) or a profit and loss account (cleared at year-end). Statistical and memo accounts are used for internal tracking without impacting financial statements. Drives year-end closing procedures and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1; GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_created_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Created By User
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the GL account master record. Supports audit trail requirements and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls over financial reporting. Corresponds to SAP SKA1.ERNAM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1.ERNAM; SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_creation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the GL account master record was originally created in the chart of accounts. Used for audit trail, account lifecycle management, and compliance reporting. Corresponds to SAP SKA1.ERDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1.ERDAT; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_group_code
attributes.description: Account group that controls the number range and field selection for the GL account. In SAP, this is the KTOKS field on SKA1 (e.g., 'GKON' for reconciliation accounts, 'SAKO' for general accounts). Governs which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during account master maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL T077S; Oracle Cloud Financials Account Group

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_node
attributes.description: The node identifier within the GL account hierarchy (e.g., SAP Financial Statement Version node, Oracle account hierarchy node) to which this account is assigned. Enables roll-up reporting from individual accounts to subtotals and totals in financial statements. Supports EBITDA reporting, segment reporting, and management reporting structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL T011; Oracle Cloud Financials Account Hierarchy; IFRS IFRS 8; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: account_long_name
attributes.description: Extended descriptive name of the GL account providing full business context beyond the short name. Used in detailed financial reporting, account reconciliation documentation, and audit trails. Corresponds to SAP SKA1.TXT50.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1.TXT50; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Human-readable short description / name of the GL account as it appears in financial reports, journal entry screens, and the chart of accounts. Corresponds to SAP SKA1.TXT20 (short text) or Oracle account description.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1.TXT20; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known GL account code as defined in the chart of accounts (e.g., SAP G/L account number, Oracle natural account segment). This is the business identifier used in all journal entries, cost allocations, and financial postings across ERP systems. Aligns to SAP SKA1.SAKNR / Oracle COA segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1; Oracle Cloud Financials Chart of Accounts; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account master record. Active accounts accept postings; blocked accounts are temporarily restricted; accounts marked for deletion are pending archival. Drives posting validation in ERP systems and financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: account_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification of the GL account within its primary account type, providing granular categorization for financial reporting and analytics. Examples: for assets — current_asset, fixed_asset, intangible_asset; for expenses — cogs, selling_expense, admin_expense, rd_expense, trade_spend. Supports COGS calculation, EBITDA reporting, and trade promotion management (TPM) accrual tracking in F&B. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: current_asset|fixed_asset|intangible_asset|current_liability|long_term_liability|cogs|gross_revenue|net_revenue|trade_spend|selling_expense|admin_expense|rd_expense — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210; GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Fundamental classification of the GL account indicating its role in financial statements. Determines whether the account appears on the balance sheet (asset, liability, equity) or income statement (revenue, expense). Corresponds to SAP SKA1.KTOKS account group classification and Oracle account type. Critical for P&L vs. balance sheet segregation and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1.KTOKS; GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Country-specific or group-level alternative account number used for local statutory reporting or group consolidation mapping. Enables mapping between the operating chart of accounts and a group/country chart of accounts. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.ALTKT. Supports multi-GAAP and consolidation reporting for global F&B operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.ALTKT; Oracle Cloud Financials; IFRS 10; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: balance_sheet_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is a balance sheet account whose balance carries forward to the next fiscal year without being closed. Balance sheet accounts represent assets, liabilities, and equity. Used in financial close processes, intercompany reconciliation, and fixed asset reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the chart of accounts to which this GL account belongs. In SAP, this is the KTOPL field (e.g., 'INT', 'CAUS'). Enterprises may maintain multiple charts of accounts for different legal entities or reporting frameworks (GAAP, IFRS). Drives account assignment and financial statement version mapping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL T004; Oracle Cloud Financials COA Structure; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: commitment_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether commitment management (funds commitment tracking) is active for this GL account. When true, purchase orders and other commitments are tracked against budget for this account. Relevant for capital expenditure accounts and trade promotion spend management in F&B. Corresponds to SAP SKB1 commitment management indicator.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; Oracle Cloud Financials Budgetary Control

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code (or Oracle legal entity code) for which this GL account is extended. A single chart of accounts account may be extended to multiple company codes with different settings. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.BUKRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.BUKRS; Oracle Cloud Financials Legal Entity; GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10

attributes.name: company_code_posting_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account are blocked at the company code level (as opposed to the chart of accounts level). Allows selective blocking for specific legal entities while keeping the account active in others. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.XSPEB.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.XSPEB; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Classifies the GL account as a primary cost element (originating from FI postings, e.g., material costs, labor), secondary cost element (internal allocations only, e.g., overhead rates, activity allocations), or not applicable (balance sheet accounts). In SAP S/4HANA, primary cost elements are unified with GL accounts. Drives COGS calculation, variance analysis, and cost center accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CEL; Oracle Cloud Cost Management; GAAP ASC 330; COGS methodology

attributes.name: cost_element_type
attributes.description: Numeric type code classifying the cost element behavior in controlling (CO). Examples: 1=primary costs/cost-reducing revenues, 3=accrual/deferral per surcharge, 4=accrual/deferral per debit=actual, 11=revenues, 12=sales deductions, 22=external settlement. Corresponds to SAP CSKA.KATYP. Drives cost allocation, variance analysis, and profitability reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|3|4|11|12|22|41|42|43|50|51|61 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CEL CSKA.KATYP; Oracle Cloud Cost Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code specifying the account currency for this GL account. If set, all postings to this account must be in this currency. Blank indicates the account accepts postings in any company code currency. Critical for multi-currency F&B operations across global markets. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.WAERS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.WAERS; ISO 4217; Oracle Cloud Financials; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account has been flagged for deletion and is pending archival. Accounts flagged for deletion cannot receive new postings and will be removed during the next archiving run. Corresponds to SAP SKA1.XLOEV. Supports master data lifecycle management and chart of accounts housekeeping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1.XLOEV; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: Controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed when posting to this GL account. Determines the entry screen layout for journal entries. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.FSTAG. Critical for enforcing data quality on financial postings (e.g., requiring cost center on expense accounts).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.FSTAG; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: financial_statement_version
attributes.description: The financial statement version (FSV) to which this account is assigned for statutory and management reporting. Controls how the account is grouped and displayed in balance sheets and income statements. In SAP, corresponds to the VERSN field in T011T. Supports parallel reporting under GAAP and IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL T011; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classifies the GL account by business function for cost-of-sales accounting and segment reporting (e.g., manufacturing/COGS, sales and distribution, general and administrative, research and development, marketing). Enables income statement reporting by function of expense per IFRS IAS 1. Critical for F&B P&L reporting by function. Corresponds to SAP FKBER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL FKBER; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 205; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: inflation_index
attributes.description: Reference to the inflation index used for inflation accounting adjustments on this GL account. Applicable in high-inflation economies where F&B operations require IAS 29 (Financial Reporting in Hyperinflationary Economies) compliance. Corresponds to SAP SKB1 inflation index assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 29; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: interest_calculation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator controlling whether and how interest is calculated on balances in this GL account. Used for intercompany loan accounts, overdue receivables, and cash pool accounts. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.ZINRT. Supports intercompany transaction management and treasury operations in F&B.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.ZINRT; IFRS IAS 39; GAAP ASC 835

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_account
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this GL account is designated as a reconciliation account for a subledger (AP, AR, or fixed assets). When true, direct manual postings are blocked and all entries must originate from the corresponding subledger. Supports subledger-to-GL reconciliation controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Last Modified Date
attributes.description: The date on which the GL account master record was last changed. Supports change management tracking, audit trail, and SOX compliance for master data governance. Corresponds to SAP SKA1.LAEDA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1.LAEDA; SOX Section 404; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items are stored and displayed for this GL account. When true, users can drill down to individual postings. Required for accounts subject to audit or detailed reconciliation. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.XKRES. Impacts storage requirements and reporting granularity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.XKRES; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: only_balances_in_local_currency
attributes.business_glossary_term: Only Balances in Local Currency Flag
attributes.description: When true, the system only manages balances in local (company code) currency for this account, suppressing foreign currency balance management. Typically set for cash and bank accounts. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.XSALH. Impacts foreign currency revaluation processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.XSALH; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is activated for this GL account. When true, individual line items remain open until cleared against an offsetting entry (e.g., GR/IR clearing accounts, bank clearing accounts). Essential for reconciliation of goods receipt/invoice receipt accounts in F&B procurement. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.XOPVW.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.XOPVW; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level at which financial planning and budgeting is performed for this account (e.g., cost center level, profit center level, company code level). Drives integration with SAP IBP and budgeting tools for demand planning, COGS forecasting, and trade spend budgeting in F&B operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; SAP IBP; Oracle Cloud Financials Planning

attributes.name: posting_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account are currently blocked at the chart of accounts level. When true, no journal entries can be posted to this account across all company codes. Used during account restructuring, period-end controls, or when an account is being retired. Corresponds to SAP SKA1.XSPEB.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKA1.XSPEB; Oracle Cloud Financials Account Controls

attributes.name: profit_center_default
attributes.description: Default profit center assigned to this GL account for automatic profit center derivation during posting. Ensures that balance sheet items and certain P&L items are assigned to the correct profit center for segment reporting. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.PRCTR. Supports F&B brand/category P&L reporting and IFRS 8 segment disclosure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA SKB1.PRCTR; IFRS IFRS 8; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: profit_loss_statement_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profit and Loss (P&L) Statement Account Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is a profit and loss (income statement) account. P&L accounts are closed to retained earnings at fiscal year-end. Complements account_category for explicit P&L identification used in EBITDA reporting, trade spend accruals, and revenue management analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account serves as a reconciliation account for a subledger (accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets) or is a standard posting account. Reconciliation accounts cannot be posted to directly; postings flow through the subledger. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.MITKZ. Critical for AP/AR and fixed asset subledger integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.MITKZ; Oracle Cloud Financials; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: revaluation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is subject to foreign currency revaluation at period-end. When true, open items or balances in foreign currency are revalued to the current exchange rate. Critical for F&B companies with multi-currency operations. Corresponds to SAP SKB1 revaluation settings. Supports IFRS IAS 21 and GAAP ASC 830 compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Defines the field used to populate the allocation field in line items posted to this account, enabling sorting and grouping of line items in account statements. Common values: '001' (posting date), '012' (document number), '031' (material number). Corresponds to SAP SKB1.ZUAWA. Supports efficient account analysis and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.ZUAWA; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Specifies the tax category applicable to this GL account, controlling which tax codes can be used when posting to this account. Blank indicates no tax is applicable. Values such as '+' (all tax codes allowed), '-' (only input tax), or specific tax category codes. Critical for VAT/GST compliance in F&B operations across jurisdictions. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.MWSKZ. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: input_tax|output_tax|all|none|input_only|output_only — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.MWSKZ; FDA 21 CFR; EU VAT Directive; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: Assigns the GL account to a tolerance group that defines acceptable payment difference limits for clearing open items. Controls automatic write-off of small differences during payment processing and account clearing. Corresponds to SAP SKB1.TOGRU. Relevant for AR/AP clearing in F&B trade management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL SKB1.TOGRU; Oracle Cloud Financials

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Cost center master data representing organizational units responsible for incurring costs — plants, production lines, sales regions, R&D labs, and corporate functions. Sourced from SAP CO. Captures cost center code, description, responsible manager, controlling area, company code, profit center assignment, cost center category (production, administration, marketing), valid-from/to dates, and currency. Foundational for COGS allocation, variance analysis, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents an organizational unit the business owns and manages for cost allocation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP CO (Controlling) Module — Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: cost_center is defined under a legal entity; replace string code with FK to company_code

attributes.name: establishment_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.establishment_registration. Business justification: Cost centers are assigned to specific production facilities; linking to establishment registration enables facility‑level cost tracking for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: packaging_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.packaging_profile. Business justification: Cost centers manage packaging initiatives; the FK ties financial cost allocation to specific packaging profiles.

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the manager accountable for costs incurred by this cost center. Used for budget ownership, variance reporting, and approval workflows. Maps to SAP field VERAK (Person Responsible). Sourced from Workday HCM.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Person Responsible; Workday HCM Core HR

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: Cost centers are assigned responsibility for specific sustainability targets in budgeting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: Primary activity type code associated with this cost center, representing the unit of output used for direct activity allocation (e.g., machine hours, labor hours, production runs). Used in standard costing and variance analysis. Maps to SAP CO activity type (LSTAR).
attributes.references: SAP CO — Activity Type Master (KL01); IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or distribute costs from this cost center to other cost objects (orders, products, other cost centers). Drives COGS calculation accuracy and variance analysis. 'direct_activity' uses activity types; 'assessment' and 'distribution' use cycle-based allocation.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Allocation Cycles (KSV5/KSU5); IFRS IAS 2 (Cost Allocation)

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Approved annual budget for this cost center in the cost center currency for the current fiscal year. Used as the baseline for budget vs. actual variance reporting and EBITDA forecasting. Sourced from SAP CO budget planning (KPF6).
attributes.references: SAP CO — Cost Center Budget (KPF6); IFRS IAS 1 (Management Commentary)

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2025) to which the budget_amount applies. Enables multi-year budget tracking and year-over-year variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Cost Center Budget Planning; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing a distinct area of operations or responsibility within the company for internal balance sheet and P&L reporting. Supports segment-level financial reporting across legal entities. Maps to SAP field GSBER.
attributes.references: SAP FI — Business Area Configuration; IFRS IFRS 8

attributes.name: changed_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this cost center master record in SAP CO. Supports change audit trail and Sarbanes-Oxley internal control documentation. Maps to SAP field AENAM.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Changed By; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: cogs_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Relevant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs incurred by this cost center are included in COGS calculation (True) or classified as operating expenses (False). Production and quality cost centers are typically COGS-relevant; administrative and marketing cost centers are not.
attributes.references: SAP CO — COGS Allocation; IFRS IAS 2 (Inventories — Cost Inclusion); FDA 21 CFR Part 110

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) area code that governs this cost center. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. All cost centers within a controlling area share the same chart of accounts and fiscal year variant. Maps to SAP field KOKRS.
attributes.references: SAP CO Configuration — Controlling Area (OKKP); IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Functional classification of the cost center indicating its primary business activity. Drives COGS allocation methodology and EBITDA reporting segmentation. Maps to SAP field KOSAR (Cost Center Category). CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Cost Center Category; IFRS IAS 2 (Inventories — production cost allocation)

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cost center within the controlling area, as assigned in SAP CO. Used in journal entries, purchase orders, and COGS allocation. Maps to SAP field KOSTL (Cost Center). BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Cost Center Master; IFRS IAS 1 (Presentation of Financial Statements)

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Long-form description of the cost center's business purpose, scope of operations, and organizational context. Provides additional detail beyond the short name for reporting and governance.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Cost Center Master

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable short name of the cost center (e.g., 'Chicago Snack Plant', 'R&D Lab - Beverages', 'North America Sales Region'). Maps to SAP field KTEXT. IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Cost Center Master

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the cost center record. 'locked' prevents new postings; 'pending_deletion' marks records flagged for archival after period close. Maps to SAP deletion flag and lock indicators. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Cost Center Status; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Operational classification distinguishing how costs flow: 'direct' cost centers incur costs directly attributable to production (e.g., production lines); 'indirect' and 'overhead' centers accumulate shared costs for allocation; 'service' centers provide internal services charged to other cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Cost Center Type; IFRS IAS 2 (Cost Absorption Methodology)

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: SAP cost element group associated with this cost center, defining the set of cost elements (G/L accounts) that can be posted to it. Supports cost reporting by cost element category (material, labor, overhead, depreciation).
attributes.references: SAP CO — Cost Element Groups (KAH1); IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where this cost center operates (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for statutory reporting, transfer pricing compliance, and regulatory cost allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IFRS IAS 21; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this cost center master record in SAP CO. Supports audit trail and change management governance. Maps to SAP field ERNAM.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Created By; SOX Section 404 (User Access Controls); ISO 9001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center master record was first created in the source system (SAP CO). Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage. Maps to SAP field ERDAT/ERZET. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Created On; SOX Section 404 (Audit Trail); ISO 9001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which costs for this cost center are planned and reported (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the currency for budget, actual, and variance postings. Maps to SAP field WAERS.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Currency; ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates)

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code to which this cost center belongs (e.g., 'MFG-OPS', 'FIN-CTRL', 'MKT-BRAND'). Supports departmental cost rollup reporting and aligns with HR organizational structure from Workday HCM.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Organizational Assignment; Workday HCM Org Structure

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal calendar applicable to this cost center (e.g., 'K4' for calendar year, 'V3' for April–March). Governs period-end close and budget cycle alignment. Maps to SAP field GJAHR variant.
attributes.references: SAP FI — Fiscal Year Variant (OB29); IFRS IAS 1 (Reporting Period)

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP functional area code classifying the cost center by business function (e.g., manufacturing, sales, administration, R&D) for cost-of-sales accounting and functional income statement reporting. Maps to SAP field FKBER.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Functional Area; IFRS IAS 1 (Income Statement by Function of Expense)

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region associated with this cost center (e.g., 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia Pacific'). Supports regional P&L reporting, trade spend analysis, and sales region cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: north_america|europe|asia_pacific|latin_america|middle_east_africa|global — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP CO — Regional Reporting; IFRS IFRS 8

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.description: Node identifier within the standard cost center hierarchy (SAP standard hierarchy) to which this cost center belongs. Enables hierarchical cost rollup reporting from individual cost centers to plant, region, and enterprise levels. Maps to SAP field KHINR.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Standard Hierarchy (OKEON); IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center participates in intercompany cost allocations (True), meaning costs may be charged across legal entities. Triggers intercompany elimination processes during financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Intercompany Allocation; IFRS IAS 27; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: is_locked_for_posting
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is locked (True) to prevent new actual cost postings, typically applied during period-end close or when a cost center is being restructured. Maps to SAP CO lock indicator (SPERRK).
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Lock Indicator; SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls)

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is a statistical cost center (True) used only for informational reporting without actual cost postings, or a real cost center (False) that receives actual cost allocations. Maps to SAP CO statistical indicator.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Statistical Cost Centers; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost center master record in the source system. Supports change detection for incremental data loads and audit compliance. Maps to SAP field AEDAT/AEZET.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Changed On; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: overhead_key
attributes.description: SAP overhead key assigned to this cost center, determining the overhead surcharge rates applied during product costing. Links to overhead costing sheets used in standard cost estimates for manufactured goods. Maps to SAP field ZUORD.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PC — Product Costing (CK11N); IFRS IAS 2 (Overhead Absorption)

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code associated with this cost center, linking manufacturing or distribution facility operations to cost accounting. Critical for COGS allocation to production plants and OEE-based variance analysis. Maps to SAP field WERKS.
attributes.references: SAP MM/PP — Plant Master; FDA 21 CFR Part 110 (GMP facility identification)

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Code of the profit center to which this cost center is assigned for internal profitability reporting. Enables P&L reporting at the profit center level and supports EBITDA analysis by business segment. Maps to SAP field PRCTR.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting); IFRS IFRS 8 (Operating Segments)

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Reporting segment code (e.g., 'SNACKS-NA', 'BEVERAGES-EU', 'DAIRY-APAC') to which this cost center contributes. Enables EBITDA reporting by business segment per IFRS 8 operating segment disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Segment Reporting; IFRS IFRS 8 (Operating Segments)

attributes.name: source_record_key
attributes.description: The natural key of this cost center record in the originating source system (e.g., the concatenation of controlling area and cost center code in SAP CO: 'A000/CC1001'). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Cost Center Master Key; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this cost center record was extracted (e.g., 'SAP_CO_PRD', 'ORACLE_ERP_PROD'). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse — Silver Layer Data Lineage; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: standard_rate
attributes.description: Planned cost rate per unit of activity for this cost center, used in standard costing to value production orders and calculate COGS. Expressed in the cost center currency per activity unit. Variances between standard and actual rates are reported in period-end variance analysis. MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category.
attributes.references: SAP CO — Activity Price Planning (KP26); IFRS IAS 2 (Standard Cost Method)

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center is active and available for cost postings. Supports time-dependent master data management and ensures costs are only allocated to active cost centers. Maps to SAP field DATAB. EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Validity Period; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date after which this cost center is no longer active for cost postings. A null or far-future date (e.g., 9999-12-31) indicates an open-ended cost center. Maps to SAP field DATBI. EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: SAP CO KS01 — Validity Period; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element code linking this cost center to a specific capital project or R&D initiative in SAP PS (Project System). Relevant for NPD project cost tracking and capital expenditure allocation.
attributes.references: SAP PS — WBS Element (CJ20N); IFRS IAS 38 (Intangible Assets — R&D Capitalization)

products.name: profit_center
products.description: Profit center master representing autonomous business segments for internal P&L reporting — brands, product lines, geographic regions, or channels (retail, foodservice, DTC). Sourced from SAP CO-PCA. Captures profit center code, name, hierarchy node, responsible manager, company code, controlling area, segment classification, and currency. Enables brand-level and channel-level EBITDA decomposition critical to F&B revenue management.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the profit center record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents an internal organizational resource (autonomous business segment) used for P&L reporting in SAP CO-PCA.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: profit_center is defined under a legal entity; replace string code with FK to company_code

attributes.name: responsible_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Profit center performance reports need the manager's employee ID for responsibility tracking and compensation alignment.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate shared costs (e.g., manufacturing overhead, corporate G&A) to this profit center. 'direct' — costs posted directly; 'assessment' — periodic cycle-based allocation; 'distribution' — proportional distribution; 'settlement' — order/project settlement; 'none' — no allocation applied. Impacts COGS calculation and variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP CO-CCA; IFRS; GAAP Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Code of the brand associated with this profit center when the profit center represents a brand-level P&L segment. Enables brand-level EBITDA decomposition, brand equity tracking, and trade promotion management (TPM) analysis. Null for non-brand profit centers.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; PLM Standards; Brand Management Best Practices

attributes.name: budget_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the current active budget period for this profit center. Defines the boundary for budget vs. actual comparisons, financial close processes, and period-end accruals for trade spend and COGS.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP IBP; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: budget_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the current active budget period for this profit center. Used in budgeting, forecasting, and EBITDA variance analysis to align actuals against planned financial targets within the correct fiscal window.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP IBP; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Sales channel classification for channel-level profit centers, enabling channel-level EBITDA decomposition. Values: retail (traditional brick-and-mortar), foodservice (restaurants, cafeterias), DTC (direct-to-consumer), ecommerce (online retail), export (international distribution), institutional (B2B bulk). Null for non-channel profit centers.
attributes.references: Revenue Management Best Practices; SAP CO-PCA; Trade Promotion Management (TPM) Standards

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) area code to which this profit center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost and profit accounting is performed. All profit centers within a controlling area share the same chart of accounts and fiscal year variant.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code associated with the overhead or functional costs allocated to this profit center. Enables COGS calculation and variance analysis by linking profit center P&L to cost center cost pools (e.g., manufacturing overhead, marketing spend).
attributes.references: SAP CO-CCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary country of operation associated with this profit center. Used for country-level P&L reporting, regulatory compliance (FDA, EFSA, USDA), and transfer pricing documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this profit center master record was first created in the source system (SAP CO-PCA). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the profit center currency used for internal P&L reporting (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Profit center currency may differ from company code currency for multinational operations. Critical for EBITDA decomposition and revenue management reporting.

attributes.name: dummy_profit_center_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the SAP dummy profit center used to capture postings that cannot be assigned to a real profit center (e.g., balance sheet items, unassigned transactions). The dummy profit center is a standard SAP CO-PCA construct and must be identifiable for exclusion from P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions posted to this profit center are subject to intercompany elimination during group consolidation. When true, revenues and costs are eliminated in consolidated financial statements to avoid double-counting. Critical for IFRS 10 group reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP Group Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code that defines the fiscal year structure for this profit center (e.g., K4 for calendar year, V3 for April–March). Determines period mapping for financial close, budgeting, and EBITDA reporting cycles.
attributes.references: SAP FI; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP functional area code assigned to the profit center, classifying costs by business function (e.g., manufacturing, sales, marketing, R&D, administration). Enables cost-of-sales accounting and functional P&L reporting per IFRS requirements.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP FI; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: geographic_region_code
attributes.description: Code representing the geographic region (e.g., NA, EMEA, APAC, LATAM) associated with this profit center when the profit center represents a regional P&L segment. Enables regional EBITDA decomposition, cross-border intercompany reconciliation, and regulatory compliance reporting by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; IFRS 8; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: gl_account_group
attributes.description: SAP GL account group associated with the profit center, defining the range of general ledger accounts that can post to this profit center. Ensures correct account assignment for revenue, COGS, trade spend accruals, and intercompany transactions.
attributes.references: SAP FI-GL; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_code
attributes.description: Code of the standard hierarchy node in SAP CO-PCA to which this profit center is assigned. Defines the position of the profit center within the enterprise profit center hierarchy, enabling roll-up reporting from individual profit centers to business units, divisions, and corporate level.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this profit center master record in the source system. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the profit center is locked for financial postings in SAP CO-PCA. When true, no new journal entries, cost allocations, or revenue postings can be made to this profit center. Used during period-end close, organizational restructuring, or audit holds.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_code
attributes.description: Code of the immediate parent profit center in the internal hierarchy, enabling self-referential tree traversal for roll-up P&L reporting. Null for top-level profit centers. Supports brand-level and channel-level EBITDA decomposition across hierarchical levels.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Code of the product line (e.g., RTD beverages, RTE snacks, dairy) associated with this profit center when the profit center represents a product-line-level P&L segment. Supports product-line-level revenue management, pricing strategy (RSP/EDLP), and COGS variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; PLM Standards; FDA Product Classification

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the profit center within the SAP CO-PCA controlling area. This is the business-facing identifier used in financial reporting, journal entries, and intercompany allocations (e.g., PC_SNACKS_NA, PC_BEV_EMEA). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: profit_center_description
attributes.description: Free-text long description of the profit center's business purpose, scope, and organizational context. Provides additional context beyond the short name for financial analysts, auditors, and data stewards. Sourced from SAP CO-PCA long text field.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: profit_center_group
attributes.description: SAP profit center group to which this profit center belongs, enabling grouped reporting and planning across related profit centers (e.g., all beverage profit centers grouped under 'GRP_BEVERAGES'). Used in planning layouts, report painter reports, and EBITDA roll-up structures.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: profit_center_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of the profit center within the enterprise profit center hierarchy (e.g., 1 = corporate, 2 = division, 3 = brand/channel, 4 = sub-brand). Enables hierarchical roll-up queries and drill-down analysis in EBITDA reporting and financial dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the profit center as defined in SAP CO-PCA (e.g., 'North America Snacks', 'EMEA Beverages', 'DTC Channel'). Used as the IDENTITY_LABEL in financial dashboards, EBITDA reports, and brand-level P&L decomposition.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit center in SAP CO-PCA. 'active' — operational and accepting postings; 'inactive' — temporarily suspended; 'locked' — blocked for new postings (e.g., during restructuring); 'in_planning' — set up for future fiscal year; 'archived' — decommissioned and closed. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: profit_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center by the dimension it represents for internal P&L reporting. Supports brand-level (e.g., a specific snack brand), product-line-level (e.g., RTD beverages), geographic-region-level (e.g., LATAM), or channel-level (e.g., retail, foodservice, DTC) EBITDA decomposition. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; Revenue Management Best Practices; IFRS 8

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this profit center is subject to external regulatory financial reporting requirements (e.g., FDA facility-level reporting, USDA program reporting, SEC segment disclosures). When true, additional data governance controls and audit trails are applied.
attributes.references: FDA; USDA; SEC Regulation S-K; IFRS 8; ASC 280

attributes.name: sap_profit_center_key
attributes.description: The natural composite key from SAP CO-PCA combining controlling area and profit center code (e.g., '1000/PC_SNACKS_NA'). Preserved in the Silver Layer for traceability back to the source system and for cross-system reconciliation with Oracle Cloud ERP or other financial systems.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: SAP segment classification code assigned to the profit center, enabling segment reporting per IFRS 8 / ASC 280. Segments typically align to major business divisions such as Snacks, Beverages, Dairy, or Packaged Foods. Used for external financial disclosures and investor reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; ASC 280

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the profit center used in space-constrained reporting interfaces, planogram layouts, and financial dashboards (e.g., 'NA Snacks', 'EMEA Bev'). Sourced from SAP CO-PCA short text field.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this profit center record was ingested (e.g., SAP_S4HANA_PROD, SAP_S4HANA_EU). Enables multi-system reconciliation in the Silver Layer when profit centers are managed across multiple SAP instances or ERP systems.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture; Data Governance Best Practices

attributes.name: standard_costing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether standard costing is activated for this profit center. When true, product costs are valued at standard cost and variances (price, quantity, efficiency) are tracked against actuals. Critical for COGS calculation, margin analysis, and manufacturing variance reporting in F&B operations.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PC; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: sustainability_segment
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center's product portfolio or operations by sustainability commitment level. Supports ESG reporting, sustainability-linked financial targets, and green revenue tracking. 'sustainable' — meets defined sustainability criteria; 'transitioning' — in progress toward sustainability targets; 'conventional' — standard operations.
attributes.references: EPA; ISO 14001; GRI Standards; FSSC 22000; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code associated with the profit center's primary operating location. Used for indirect tax (VAT/GST) determination, transfer pricing compliance, and regulatory reporting to tax authorities (IRS, HMRC, etc.). Aligns with SAP tax configuration.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TX; IRS; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IFRS; FDA

attributes.name: transfer_price_method
attributes.description: Method used for intercompany transfer pricing when goods or services are exchanged between profit centers. 'cost_plus' — cost plus a markup; 'market_price' — prevailing market rate; 'negotiated' — bilaterally agreed price; 'none' — no intercompany transfers. Required for intercompany reconciliation and tax compliance.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP CO-PCA; IFRS; IRS Section 482

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which this profit center is valid and active for financial postings in SAP CO-PCA. Supports time-dependent master data management and ensures correct period assignment during financial close and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: Date until which this profit center is valid for financial postings. After this date, the profit center is locked for new postings. Null indicates an open-ended validity. Used for decommissioning profit centers during organizational restructuring or brand divestitures.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS

products.name: company_code
products.description: Legal entity master representing each incorporated company within the Food Beverage group — subsidiaries, joint ventures, and holding entities across geographies. Sourced from SAP FI. Captures company code, legal name, country, currency, fiscal year variant, chart of accounts assignment, tax jurisdiction, VAT registration number, and intercompany indicator. Governs statutory reporting, intercompany eliminations, and multi-entity consolidation.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the company code record in the Food Beverage lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity. Role classification: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a legal entity (incorporated company, subsidiary, joint venture, or holding entity) that the business owns and manages within the Food Beverage group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The primary accounting standard under which this company code prepares its statutory financial statements. Determines recognition, measurement, and disclosure rules for revenue, inventory (COGS/FIFO), fixed assets, and trade spend accruals. Drives parallel ledger configuration in SAP.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation; US GAAP FASB ASC; SAP S/4HANA FI Parallel Ledger Configuration

attributes.name: address_city
attributes.description: City of the registered office of the legal entity. Used in statutory filings, regulatory submissions, and legal correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Address; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: address_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the registered office of the legal entity. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regulatory filings, and statutory correspondence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Address; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: address_region
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the registered office. Used for sub-national tax jurisdiction determination, state-level regulatory compliance (e.g., California Prop 65 for food labeling), and regional statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (REGIO); US State Tax Authorities; California Proposition 65

attributes.name: address_street
attributes.description: Street address of the registered office of the legal entity as recorded in the official company registry. Used for statutory correspondence, regulatory filings with FDA/USDA/EFSA, and legal notices. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Address; FDA 21 CFR; EFSA EU Regulation 178/2002

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing the operational division or segment within the Food Beverage group (e.g., North America Snacks, EMEA Beverages, APAC Dairy). Used for segment-level financial reporting, cross-company-code balance sheet preparation, and divisional P&L analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: The SAP chart of accounts key assigned to this company code, defining the general ledger account structure used for financial postings. Governs the GL account hierarchy, COGS account assignments, revenue accounts, and trade spend accrual accounts. Maps to SAP KTOPL field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (KTOPL); IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: company_code_code
attributes.description: The four-character alphanumeric SAP FI company code that uniquely identifies the legal entity within the ERP system. This is the externally-known business identifier used across all SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP) and in intercompany transactions, statutory reporting, and financial consolidation. Maps directly to the BUKRS field in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — BUKRS; IFRS IAS 27 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: company_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the company code within the Food Beverage group. Controls whether the entity is available for posting, planning, and reporting. Inactive or dormant entities are excluded from operational processes but retained for historical audit and statutory purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master; IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: company_registration_number
attributes.description: Official company registration number issued by the national company registry (e.g., Companies House in the UK, SEC in the US, Handelsregister in Germany). Used for statutory filings, regulatory submissions, and legal entity verification in trade agreements.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; Companies Act 2006 (UK); SAP S/4HANA FI Legal Entity Master

attributes.name: consolidation_group
attributes.description: The consolidation group or reporting unit to which this company code belongs within the Food Beverage group financial consolidation structure. Used in SAP Group Reporting or BPC to aggregate financial results for segment reporting, EBITDA roll-ups, and statutory consolidated accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting; IFRS 10; US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: consolidation_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this company code is included in the Food Beverage group consolidated financial statements. Entities with this flag set to false (e.g., dormant shells, entities below materiality threshold) are excluded from group EBITDA reporting and multi-entity consolidation runs.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; US GAAP ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) area to which this company code is assigned. The controlling area defines the organizational unit for management accounting, cost center accounting, profit center accounting, COGS variance analysis, and standard costing. A single controlling area may span multiple company codes for cross-entity cost allocation. Maps to SAP KOKRS field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (KOKRS); IFRS IAS 2 Inventories; US GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 country code representing the country in which the legal entity is incorporated and registered. Determines applicable tax jurisdiction, regulatory reporting requirements (FDA, EFSA, USDA), and statutory accounting standards.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP S/4HANA FI (LAND1); EFSA EU Food Safety Regulation; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: SAP credit control area assigned to this company code, governing customer credit limit management, accounts receivable exposure monitoring, and credit risk controls for trade customers. Relevant for revenue management and trade spend credit exposure. Maps to SAP KKBER field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR (KKBER); IFRS IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the local (functional) currency of the company code. All financial postings, COGS calculations, standard costing, and statutory financial statements for this entity are denominated in this currency. Maps to SAP WAERS field.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI (WAERS); IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company code was deactivated or blocked for new postings in SAP FI. Null for currently active entities. Used to manage the lifecycle of dormant, liquidated, or divested entities within the Food Beverage group and to control consolidation scope.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master; IFRS 5 Non-current Assets Held for Sale

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity within the Food Beverage corporate group structure. Drives consolidation treatment, intercompany elimination rules, and statutory reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: subsidiary|joint_venture|holding|branch|associate|operating_entity — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements

attributes.name: erp_system_instance
attributes.description: Identifier of the SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Cloud ERP system instance from which this company code record is sourced. Relevant for Food Beverage entities that operate across multiple ERP landscapes (e.g., post-acquisition entities not yet migrated to the central SAP instance). Supports data lineage and source system traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA System Landscape; Oracle Cloud ERP; Food Beverage Enterprise Architecture Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant code defining the fiscal calendar structure for this company code — including whether the fiscal year is calendar-year aligned or offset (e.g., April–March, October–September), and the number of posting periods. Critical for period-end close, budgeting cycles, and demand planning alignment. Maps to SAP PERIV field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (PERIV); IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: food_safety_license_number
attributes.description: Regulatory license or registration number issued by the applicable food safety authority (e.g., FDA Food Facility Registration Number, USDA Establishment Number, EFSA authorization number) for this legal entity. Required for manufacturing, importing, or distributing food and beverage products. Critical for FSMA compliance and GFSI certification tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Food Facility Registration; FSMA; USDA FSIS; EFSA EU Regulation 178/2002; GFSI

attributes.name: functional_currency_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the local currency of this company code is also its functional currency as defined under IFRS IAS 21. When false, a separate functional currency determination is required, impacting foreign currency translation adjustments in the consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: gfsi_certification_scheme
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Scheme
attributes.description: The GFSI-benchmarked food safety certification scheme held by this legal entity. Indicates the food safety management standard under which the entity operates (e.g., SQF, BRC, FSSC 22000). Used for supplier qualification, customer compliance requirements, and regulatory audit readiness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SQF|BRC|FSSC_22000|IFS|GlobalGAP|not_certified — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; BRC Global Standard; FSSC 22000; ISO 22000

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the Food Beverage group reporting currency used in consolidated financial statements, EBITDA reporting, and multi-entity consolidation. Typically USD or EUR for global food and beverage groups. Enables currency translation for intercompany eliminations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Consolidation Currency

attributes.name: gst_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Goods and Services Tax (GST) Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether Goods and Services Tax (GST) or equivalent consumption tax applies to transactions of this company code. Relevant for entities operating in GST jurisdictions (e.g., Australia, Canada, India, Singapore). Drives tax code determination in SAP SD and MM for food and beverage product sales.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration; GST Act (Australia, India, Canada); Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was formally incorporated and registered with the relevant national company registry. Used for entity age calculations, statutory anniversary filings, and historical financial consolidation scope determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Legal Entity Master; IFRS IAS 27; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this company code participates in intercompany transactions within the Food Beverage group. When true, the entity is subject to intercompany elimination rules during group consolidation, transfer pricing policies, and intercompany billing processes. Maps to SAP intercompany configuration.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Configuration

attributes.name: language_key
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code representing the primary language used for correspondence, statutory documents, and regulatory filings for this company code. Drives language-specific output for invoices, financial statements, and FDA/EFSA regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; SAP S/4HANA FI (SPRAS); FDA 21 CFR Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: SAP ledger group assigned to this company code, enabling parallel accounting under multiple accounting standards (e.g., IFRS and local GAAP simultaneously). Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements for Food Beverage entities operating across jurisdictions with different statutory requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New General Ledger; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full registered legal name of the incorporated entity as it appears in the official company registry of the country of incorporation. Used for statutory reporting, regulatory filings, intercompany agreements, and financial consolidation disclosures.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 27; SEC Regulation S-X; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master (BUTXT)

attributes.name: parent_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code of the immediate parent entity within the Food Beverage group legal entity hierarchy. Enables traversal of the corporate ownership structure for intercompany elimination, transfer pricing, and group consolidation. Self-referencing for the ultimate holding entity.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA FI Group Hierarchy

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: SAP posting period variant that controls which fiscal periods are open or closed for financial postings in this company code. Governs the financial close process, period-end accruals, and trade spend accrual postings. Maps to SAP XVPER field.

attributes.name: profit_center_standard
attributes.description: Default SAP profit center assigned to this company code for management accounting purposes. Profit centers align to business units (e.g., Snacks, Beverages, Dairy) and are used for internal P&L reporting, EBITDA analysis by segment, and revenue management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Profit Center Accounting; IFRS 8 Operating Segments
