attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the company code master record was first created in the source ERP system (SAP FI or Oracle Cloud ERP). Represents the business creation event, not the lakehouse ingestion time. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and entity lifecycle tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Log; ISO 8601; Food Beverage Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the company code master record in the source ERP system. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental lakehouse loads, and audit trail compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Change Documents; ISO 8601; Food Beverage Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or trading name of the legal entity used in internal reporting, dashboards, and operational communications where the full legal name is impractical. Corresponds to the SAP company code short description field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this company code master record was ingested into the lakehouse. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements for the Silver layer. Values: SAP_S4 (SAP S/4HANA FI), ORACLE_CLOUD (Oracle Cloud ERP Financials), LEGACY (pre-migration legacy ERP).
attributes.references: Food Beverage Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Architecture

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code identifying the specific federal, state/province, and local tax authority applicable to this company code. Used for automated tax calculation on sales orders, purchase orders, and intercompany transactions. Drives compliance with FDA, USDA, and local food safety levy requirements. Maps to SAP TXJCD field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (TXJCD); US Internal Revenue Code; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Employer Identification Number (EIN) or equivalent national tax identification number assigned to the legal entity by the relevant tax authority. Used for statutory tax filings, payroll tax reporting, and regulatory submissions to FDA and USDA.
attributes.references: US IRS EIN; OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Master

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The OECD-approved transfer pricing method applied to intercompany transactions involving this company code. Governs how intercompany prices are set for goods (e.g., finished snacks, beverages transferred between manufacturing and distribution entities) and services. Critical for tax compliance and EBITDA integrity across the group. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUP|resale_price|cost_plus|TNMM|profit_split|not_applicable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines 2022; IFRS IAS 24 Related Party Disclosures; US IRC Section 482

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: Value Added Tax (VAT) registration number issued by the tax authority of the country of incorporation. Required for EU VAT compliance, cross-border trade invoicing, and regulatory reporting to EFSA and national tax authorities. Used in intercompany billing and trade documentation.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; EFSA EU Food Safety Regulation; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Core financial posting document capturing every debit/credit transaction in the general ledger — the atomic unit of financial truth for the F&B enterprise. Encompasses document header (document number, company code, fiscal year, posting date, document type, currency, exchange rate, reversal indicator) and all constituent line items (line number, GL account, debit/credit indicator, amounts in document and local currency, cost center, profit center, tax code, assignment text, business area). Drives all financial statements, trial balance generation, regulatory reporting, COGS allocation, and variance drill-down for F&B manufacturing and trade spend.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the journal_entry data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete financial posting event in the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF (Accounting Document Header)

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Journal entry belongs to a company; replace string code with FK to company_code

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry belongs to a cost center; add FK to cost_center

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SOX audit requires tracking which employee created each journal entry; linking created_by_employee_id to employee provides mandatory accountability.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entry references a GL account; add FK to gl_account

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entry belongs to a profit center; add FK to profit_center

attributes.name: assignment
attributes.description: Free-text or structured assignment field used for sorting and matching open items (e.g., invoice number, payment reference, purchase order number). Critical for automated payment clearing, dunning, and accounts payable/receivable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.ZUONR; US GAAP ASC 310; IFRS IFRS 9

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing an organizational unit (e.g., Snacks, Beverages, Dairy, Packaged Foods) for which internal financial statements can be drawn. Enables segment reporting and divisional P&L analysis without requiring separate company codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.GSBER; IFRS IFRS 8 (Operating Segments); US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP controlling area code that groups company codes for management accounting purposes. Defines the organizational scope for cost center accounting, internal orders, and profitability analysis (CO-PA). Enables cross-company-code cost allocation and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — BKPF.KOKRS; US GAAP ASC 280; IFRS IFRS 8

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center code identifying the organizational unit responsible for cost incurrence (e.g., a manufacturing plant, distribution center, or functional department). Drives COGS allocation, overhead absorption, and variance analysis in the CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Module — BSEG.KOSTL; US GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the journal entry record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA). Captures the precise date and time of system entry for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.CPUDT + BKPF.CPUTM; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; ISO 22000

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the transaction currency in which the journal entry amounts are originally denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Distinct from local/company-code currency. Required for multi-currency consolidation and FX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.WAERS; ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original source document (invoice, receipt, contract, etc.) that triggered the journal entry. May differ from posting_date; used for aging analysis, payment terms calculation, and audit substantiation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.BLDAT; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: document_header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the journal entry header level providing business context for the posting (e.g., 'Monthly COGS accrual — Plant 1001', 'Trade spend settlement Q3', 'Intercompany recharge — Snacks Division'). Supports audit review and financial close commentary.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.BKTXT; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally visible ten-digit accounting document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI at the time of posting. Uniquely identifies the journal entry within a company code and fiscal year. Used for audit trail, drill-down, and cross-reference with source documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.BELNR; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the journal entry in the financial close process. 'draft' = not yet posted; 'posted' = active in GL; 'parked' = saved but not posted pending approval; 'reversed' = offset by a reversal document; 'cleared' = open items matched; 'blocked' = held for review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/404; IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character SAP document type code classifying the nature of the journal entry (e.g., SA=General Ledger, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AB=Asset Posting, WA=Goods Issue, ML=Material Ledger). Controls number range assignment and field selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|AB|WA|ML|KZ|DZ|RE|RV — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.BLART; US GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the journal entry record was created in the system. Distinct from posting_date (accounting effect) and document_date (source document). Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.CPUDT; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to translate document-currency amounts to local currency at the time of posting. Expressed as units of local currency per one unit of document currency. Critical for FX gain/loss calculation and multi-currency consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.KURSF; IFRS IAS 21; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric fiscal posting period (1–16) within the fiscal year. Periods 1–12 represent standard months; periods 13–16 are special closing periods used for year-end adjustments. Drives period-end close, trial balance, and P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.MONAT; IFRS IAS 34; US GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year in which the journal entry is recorded. Used for period-end close, financial statement preparation, and year-over-year variance analysis. May differ from calendar year depending on the company's fiscal year variant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.GJAHR; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 270

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: General Ledger account number from the chart of accounts to which the journal entry is posted. Determines the financial statement line (P&L or balance sheet) affected. Drives trial balance, COGS calculation, trade spend accruals, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.HKONT; US GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (for regulated cost accounts)

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry involves a transaction between two legal entities within the Food Beverage group (True) or is a standalone entity posting (False). Intercompany entries require elimination during group consolidation and are subject to transfer pricing policies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF; IFRS IAS 27; US GAAP ASC 810; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: internal_order
attributes.description: SAP internal order number used to collect costs for a specific project, campaign, or temporary cost object (e.g., a new product launch, capital project, or trade promotion). Enables granular cost tracking beyond cost center level for NPD and trade spend management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OPA Module — BSEG.AUFNR; US GAAP ASC 730 (R&D); IFRS IAS 38

attributes.name: journal_entry_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the journal entry by its accounting purpose. 'standard' = regular transaction posting; 'accrual' = period-end accrual; 'reversal' = offset of prior posting; 'recurring' = periodic template-based entry; 'statistical' = non-financial reporting entry; 'intercompany' = cross-entity transaction. Drives financial close workflow and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; US GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the journal entry record in the source system. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Silver Layer. Supports financial close monitoring and SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF change log; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the accounting ledger group to which the journal entry is posted (e.g., '0L' for leading ledger, 'L1' for IFRS parallel ledger, 'L2' for local GAAP ledger). Supports parallel accounting under multiple accounting standards (IFRS and US GAAP simultaneously).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New GL — BKPF.RLDNR; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code's local (functional) currency. Used for statutory financial reporting in the country of the legal entity. Enables translation of document-currency amounts to local currency for balance sheet and P&L.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.HWAER; ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger and affects account balances. Determines the fiscal period assignment. Critical for period-end cut-off, accrual accuracy, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.BUDAT; IFRS IAS 1; US GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit SAP posting key controlling the debit/credit indicator, account type, and field selection for the journal entry. Standard values include 40 (GL debit), 50 (GL credit), 31 (vendor credit), 21 (vendor debit), 01 (customer debit), 11 (customer credit). Drives account determination and field status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.BSCHL; US GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: posting_period_status
attributes.description: Status of the fiscal period to which this journal entry belongs at the time of analysis. 'open' = period accepting postings; 'closed' = period locked after financial close; 'blocked' = temporarily restricted; 'future' = not yet open. Supports period-end close monitoring and financial reporting integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — OB52 Posting Period Variant; US GAAP ASC 270; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP profit center code identifying the organizational unit responsible for revenue and cost accountability (e.g., a brand, product line, or geographic market). Enables profitability analysis, brand-level P&L, and EBITDA reporting by business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Module — BKPF/BSEG.PRCTR; IFRS IFRS 8; US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the originating source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, purchase order number, sales order number, or EDI transaction reference). Enables cross-referencing between the journal entry and upstream operational documents for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.XBLNR; US GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IFRS 15

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: Accounting document number of the corresponding reversal or reversed document. Populated when reversal_indicator is True (this is the reversal) or when this document has been reversed by another. Enables bidirectional audit trail linkage between original and reversal postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.STBLG; US GAAP ASC 250; IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal document (True) or an original posting (False). Reversal entries offset prior postings for corrections, accrual reversals, or period-end adjustments. Critical for audit trail integrity and financial close accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.STBLG; US GAAP ASC 250; IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business reason for reversing the journal entry (e.g., '01'=Reversal in current period, '02'=Reversal in next period, '03'=Accrual reversal, '04'=Error correction). Supports financial close governance and SOX control documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.STOGRUND; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/404; IFRS IAS 8

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which the journal entry originated (e.g., SAP_S4HANA for primary ERP, ORACLE_ERP for subsidiary systems, MANUAL for spreadsheet uploads, INTERFACE for EDI/API feeds). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount (VAT, GST, sales tax) associated with the journal entry in document currency. Populated for tax-relevant postings. Used for tax return preparation, VAT reconciliation, and regulatory reporting to FDA, USDA, and tax authorities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module — BSEG.HWBAS; EU VAT Directive; IRS; EFSA

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Two-character SAP tax code identifying the applicable tax condition (e.g., V1=Input VAT 10%, A1=Output VAT 10%, I0=Zero-rated, X0=Tax-exempt). Drives automatic tax calculation, tax account determination, and VAT/GST reporting to tax authorities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Module — BSEG.MWSKZ; FDA 21 CFR; EFSA; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; IRS Publication 334

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all credit line item amounts in the document currency for this journal entry. Must equal total_debit_amount for a balanced entry. Used for trial balance validation, financial statement generation, and double-entry integrity checks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.DMBTR aggregation; US GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: total_credit_amount_lc
attributes.description: Sum of all credit line item amounts translated to the company code's local (functional) currency. Paired with total_debit_amount_lc for local-currency trial balance and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.WRBTR aggregation; IFRS IAS 21; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all debit line item amounts in the document currency for this journal entry. Must equal total_credit_amount for a balanced entry (double-entry bookkeeping). Used for trial balance validation, financial statement generation, and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.DMBTR aggregation; US GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: total_debit_amount_lc
attributes.description: Sum of all debit line item amounts translated to the company code's local (functional) currency. Used for statutory financial reporting, local GAAP compliance, and country-level P&L and balance sheet preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BSEG.WRBTR aggregation; IFRS IAS 21; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner when intercompany_indicator is True. Used for intercompany elimination during group consolidation, transfer pricing documentation, and intercompany reconciliation processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BKPF.VBUND; IFRS IAS 27; US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Work Breakdown Structure element code for project-based cost assignment (e.g., capital expenditure projects, plant expansion, new production line installation). Enables project cost tracking, capitalization decisions, and fixed asset accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module — BSEG.PS_PSP_PNR; IFRS IAS 16; US GAAP ASC 360

products.name: ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts payable full lifecycle record encompassing invoice receipt through payment execution and settlement for all vendor obligations — raw material and ingredient suppliers, co-packers, 3PL providers, packaging vendors, and indirect service providers. Covers three-way match (PO, GR, invoice), invoice verification (vendor invoice number, vendor account, invoice date, payment terms, gross/tax/net amounts, match status, blocking reasons), payment execution (payment document, payment method including ACH/wire/check, bank account, payment date, discount captured, payment run ID), and clearing/settlement status. Sourced from SAP FI-AP. Critical for COGS accruals, cash flow forecasting, working capital optimization, supplier payment compliance, and early-payment discount capture in F&B procurement.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the accounts payable invoice record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Module; Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: ap_invoice belongs to a legal entity; replace string code with FK to company_code

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which this invoice expense is allocated for internal cost accounting and COGS/EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Accounting (CSKS); Finance Domain

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the goods receipt document confirming physical receipt of goods or services, used in three-way match (PO, GR, invoice) verification. Enables FIFO/FEFO inventory costing alignment.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MKPF/MSEG); Three-Way Match Process

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the SAP automatic payment program run (F110) that processed this invoice payment. Used for batch payment reconciliation, bank file tracing, and payment run audit.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP F110 Payment Program; Internal Treasury Operations

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice is matched as part of the three-way match process (PO, goods receipt, invoice). Critical for COGS accruals and procurement compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order (EKKO/EKPO); Three-Way Match Process

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) master record who issued this invoice. Covers raw material and ingredient suppliers, co-packers, 3PL providers, packaging vendors, and indirect service providers. Satisfies PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Vendor Master (LFA1); Procurement Domain

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why an invoice has been placed on payment hold (e.g., price variance, quantity variance, quality hold, missing GR, duplicate invoice). Used for dispute management and supplier performance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_variance|quantity_variance|quality_hold|missing_gr|duplicate|missing_po|terms_dispute — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP RBKP.ZLSPR; Internal AP Dispute Management Policy

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was cleared in the AP subledger, confirming full settlement. Used for DPO calculation, working capital reporting, and financial close reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSAK.AUGDT; GAAP ASC 230; Internal Financial Close Policy

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice has been fully cleared (paid and matched), partially cleared, or remains open in the AP subledger. 'reversed' indicates a posting reversal. Used for AP aging analysis and period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSIK/BSAK.AUGDT; GAAP ASC 420; Internal Financial Close Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this AP invoice record was first created in the source system (SAP FI-AP). Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.CPUDT/CPUTM; ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Required for multi-currency operations across global Food Beverage markets and foreign exchange revaluation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI-AP BKPF.WAERS; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount available if payment is made by the discount_due_date. Represents the financial benefit of early payment programs. Tracked for ROI analysis of working capital optimization initiatives.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSIK.SKFBT; Internal Treasury Policy; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: discount_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether the early payment discount was successfully captured at time of payment. Used to measure discount capture rate KPI and evaluate treasury performance against working capital targets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Payment Run; Internal Treasury KPI Framework

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which payment must be made to capture the early payment discount offered by the vendor (e.g., 2% if paid within 10 days). Used for dynamic discounting and working capital optimization programs.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSIK.SKFBT; Internal Treasury Early Payment Discount Policy

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with agreed payment terms and avoid late payment penalties. Calculated from invoice_date and payment_terms_code. Critical for cash flow forecasting and working capital management.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSIK.ZFBDT; UCC Article 2; Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: edi_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The EDI transaction identifier for invoices received electronically via EDI 810 (Invoice) transaction set. Used for automated invoice matching, EDI reconciliation, and supplier EDI compliance tracking in F&B procurement.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI 810 Invoice Transaction; GS1 EDI Standards; Internal EDI Integration Policy

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was entered into the SAP system (BKPF.CPUDT). Used for invoice processing cycle time analysis and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.CPUDT; Internal AP SLA Policy

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to the local company code currency at the time of posting. Used for FX variance analysis and treasury reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.KURSF; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal posting period (01–12 for regular periods, 13–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year. Used for monthly financial close, accrual management, and period-over-period variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.MONAT; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this invoice posting belongs (SAP BKPF.GJAHR). Used for period-end financial close, EBITDA reporting, and budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.GJAHR; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this invoice is posted for financial reporting (e.g., COGS raw materials, packaging expense, logistics cost). Enables P&L line item analysis and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSEG.HKONT; GAAP Chart of Accounts; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount of the invoice before tax deductions and discounts, as stated on the vendor invoice. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET required for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for COGS accruals, cash flow forecasting, and working capital analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSIK.WRBTR; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor's invoice document, representing the principal business event date of the invoice. Used for payment terms calculation, aging analysis, and cash flow forecasting. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.BLDAT; UCC Article 2; IRS Publication 538

attributes.name: invoice_reference_text
attributes.description: Free-text reference or description field from the vendor invoice or AP clerk entry (SAP BKPF.BKTXT). May contain delivery note numbers, contract references, or service period descriptions. Used for invoice search and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.BKTXT; Internal AP Documentation Policy

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AP invoice through the payables workflow. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. 'blocked' indicates a hold pending resolution (price, quantity, or quality discrepancy).
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP RBKP.RBSTAT; Internal AP Workflow Policy

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. 'credit_memo' represents vendor credits for returns or adjustments. 'intercompany' covers transactions between legal entities within the Food Beverage group. Drives accounting treatment and workflow routing.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.BLART; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 24 (Intercompany)

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice represents a transaction between two legal entities within the Food Beverage corporate group. Intercompany invoices require elimination in consolidated financial statements per IFRS IAS 27.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Intercompany Processing; IFRS IAS 27; GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is part of a recurring payment schedule (e.g., monthly 3PL service fees, lease payments, SaaS subscriptions). Used for automated accrual management and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Recurring Entry (FBD1); Internal AP Automation Policy

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net invoice amount translated to the company code local currency (e.g., USD for US entities) using the exchange rate at posting date. Used for consolidated financial reporting and EBITDA calculation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSIK.DMBTR (local); IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Indicates the result of the three-way match process comparing the purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. 'three_way_matched' confirms all three documents align within tolerance. Critical for invoice approval and COGS accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP MM Invoice Verification (MIRO); GAAP ASC 420; Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net payable amount after tax and discount adjustments (gross_amount minus discounts plus tax_amount). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Represents the actual cash obligation to the vendor for payment execution.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSIK.DMBTR; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was executed and funds were disbursed to the vendor. Used for Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) calculation, cash flow actuals, and supplier payment compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSAK.AUGDT; Internal Treasury Policy; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI accounting document number generated when the payment was executed (clearing document). Links the invoice to its payment for reconciliation and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSAK.AUGBL; Internal AP Audit Policy

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to settle this invoice (ACH electronic transfer, wire transfer, check, virtual card, or direct debit). Drives payment run configuration and bank reconciliation processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSIK.ZLSCH; NACHA ACH Rules; Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, 2/10NET30) defining the due date calculation and early payment discount conditions. Drives cash flow forecasting, working capital optimization, and early-payment discount capture strategy.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP T052 Payment Terms; UCC Article 2; Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility, distribution center, or warehouse that received the goods or services invoiced. Used for plant-level COGS analysis and supply chain cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP MM EKPO.WERKS; SAP S/4HANA Plant Master; Internal Supply Chain Taxonomy

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was posted to the general ledger in SAP FI (BKPF.BUDAT). Determines the accounting period for financial close and COGS accrual recognition.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.BUDAT; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS 37

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: Business spend category classifying the nature of the goods or services invoiced. Enables COGS vs. SG&A allocation, category spend analytics, and supplier segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|packaging|co_packing|3pl_logistics|indirect_services|capex|toll_manufacturing|marketing|utilities|maintenance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Group (MARA.MATKL); Internal Spend Taxonomy; UNSPSC

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The internal SAP FI accounting document number assigned upon invoice posting (BKPF.BELNR). Used for cross-referencing with general ledger entries and financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.BELNR; SAP S/4HANA Finance Module

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (VAT, GST, sales tax) applied to this invoice. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Used for tax reporting, input tax recovery, and compliance with FDA/USDA indirect cost regulations.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BSET.HWSTE; IRS Tax Code; EU VAT Directive; EFSA Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this AP invoice record in the source system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for incremental data loading and change data capture in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP Change Document; ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: vendor_bank_account
attributes.description: The vendor's bank account identifier used for payment execution (masked/tokenized for security). Required for ACH and wire payment processing. Classified as confidential financial data per PCI DSS and internal treasury controls.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP LFBK Vendor Bank Details; PCI DSS v4.0; NACHA ACH Rules; Internal Treasury Security Policy

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number as printed on the vendor's invoice document. Used for vendor reconciliation, dispute resolution, and audit trail. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AP BKPF.XBLNR; IRS Invoice Documentation Requirements; FDA FSMA Traceability

products.name: ar_invoice
products.description: Accounts receivable full lifecycle record encompassing billing through cash application and settlement for all customer obligations — retail chains, foodservice distributors, convenience operators, and DTC consumers. Covers invoice issuance (customer account, billing document, invoice date, payment terms, gross/net amounts, EDI/portal status), dunning and collections management, payment receipt (remittance document, payment method, lockbox batch, remittance amount, short-payment amount, deduction code), cash application, and clearing status. Sourced from SAP FI-AR and SD billing integration. Drives revenue recognition, DSO management, cash application automation, and deduction identification for F&B commercial finance.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the accounts receivable invoice record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (retail chain, foodservice distributor, convenience operator, or DTC consumer) to whom this invoice is issued. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; SAP FI-AR

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: ar_invoice belongs to a legal entity; replace string code with FK to company_code

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: AR invoice belongs to a cost center; replace code with FK

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AR invoice references a GL account; add FK to gl_account

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: AR invoice belongs to a profit center; replace code with FK

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order from which this invoice was generated, enabling order-to-cash traceability.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order (VBAK); SAP FI-AR

attributes.name: billing_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity issuing the invoice. Required for intercompany reconciliation, statutory reporting, and multi-entity financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP FI BUKRS; IFRS 10; FASB ASC 810

attributes.name: billing_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known SAP SD billing document number (VBELN) that uniquely identifies this invoice in the source system and on customer-facing documents. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing (VBELN); SAP FI-AR BELNR

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Commercial channel through which the sale was made. Enables channel-level revenue reporting, trade spend analysis, and margin management across retail, foodservice, DTC, and e-commerce.
attributes.references: SAP SD Distribution Channel (VTWEG); F&B Commercial Finance Standard

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice was cleared (fully settled) in SAP FI-AR. Used for DSO calculation, aging analysis, and period-end close reconciliation.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI clearing document number (AUGBL) assigned when the invoice is fully or partially cleared against a payment or credit memo. Null for open items.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the source system (SAP FI-AR). Used for audit trail and data lineage. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). Required for multi-currency revenue reporting and FX translation. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of customer-taken deductions against this invoice (e.g., promotional allowances, freight claims, shortage claims). Central to F&B deduction management and trade spend reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Deduction Management; TPM Trade Spend; F&B Commercial Finance

attributes.name: deduction_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the reason for a customer deduction (e.g., promotional allowance, freight claim, shortage, pricing dispute). Enables deduction analytics and recovery tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promo_allowance|freight_claim|shortage|pricing_dispute|quality_claim|early_pay_discount|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Reason Code (RSTGR); GS1; F&B Deduction Management Standard

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason the customer has disputed this invoice (e.g., pricing discrepancy, quantity shortage, quality issue). Supports root cause analysis and deduction recovery.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR UDM_DISPUTE; F&B Deduction Management Standard

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any customer dispute raised against this invoice. Enables dispute management workflow tracking and deduction resolution reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Dispute Management (UDM_DISPUTE); F&B Commercial Finance

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP distribution channel code (VTWEG) indicating the route-to-market for this invoice (e.g., wholesale, DSD, e-commerce). Supports channel profitability and trade spend analysis.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which full payment must be received per the agreed payment terms. Used for aging analysis, dunning scheduling, and DSO management.

attributes.name: dunning_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent dunning notice sent to the customer for this invoice. Used to schedule next dunning action and track collections activity.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR MADAT; Credit Management Best Practice

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning (collections escalation) level assigned to this invoice in SAP FI-AR, ranging from 0 (no dunning) to the maximum configured level. Drives collections workflow and customer communication.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR MAHNS; FASB ASC 310; Credit Management Best Practice

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the cash discount available to the customer if payment is received by the early payment discount date. Used for discount accrual and deduction validation.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_date
attributes.description: Last date by which the customer may pay to qualify for the early payment (cash) discount defined in the payment terms (e.g., the '10' in 2/10NET30). Supports cash discount accrual and working capital optimization.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR ZBD1T; Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Article 2

attributes.name: edi_status
attributes.description: Transmission status of the invoice via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) or customer portal. Tracks whether the invoice was successfully delivered electronically to the customer, supporting straight-through processing and dispute prevention.
attributes.references: EDI X12 810 Invoice; GS1 EDI Standards; SAP SD EDI

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal year and period (YYYY-MM) to which this invoice is posted in the general ledger. Used for period-end close, revenue reporting, and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP FI GJAHR/MONAT; FASB ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before trade discounts, allowances, and deductions. Represents the list-price billing value used as the starting point for net revenue calculation. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing NETWR; FASB ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was issued to the customer, representing the principal business event date for revenue recognition and payment term calculation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing Date (FKDAT); FASB ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the invoice within the accounts receivable workflow. Drives DSO reporting, dunning triggers, and cash application automation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Clearing Status; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice by its commercial purpose. Drives revenue recognition treatment, GL posting logic, and reporting segmentation. attributes.name: lockbox_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the bank lockbox processing batch in which this invoice's payment was received. Enables reconciliation between bank lockbox files and SAP FI-AR cash application.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Lockbox (FLB2); NACHA; Bank Lockbox Processing Standard

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount due after applying trade discounts and allowances to the gross amount. Represents the contractual obligation for payment and the basis for revenue recognition. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET net total.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR DMBTR; FASB ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: open_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice after applying all payments, credits, and deductions. Drives DSO calculation, aging bucket reporting, and dunning level determination.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Open Item Management; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of cash received and applied to this invoice. May differ from net_amount due to short payments, deductions, or partial payments.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which payment was received and applied against this invoice. Null if unpaid. Used for DSO calculation and cash flow reporting.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used by the customer to remit payment (e.g., ACH, wire transfer, check, EDI payment). Drives cash application routing and remittance matching.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR ZLSCH; EDI X12 820; NACHA

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, 2/10NET30) defining the due date calculation, early payment discount percentage, and discount period for this invoice. Governs cash application and DSO targets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR ZTERM; Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Article 2

attributes.name: remittance_document_number
attributes.description: Customer-provided remittance advice document number accompanying the payment, used to match incoming cash to open invoices during cash application.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR ZUONR; EDI X12 820 Remittance Advice

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which revenue from this invoice is recognized in the general ledger per FASB ASC 606 / IFRS 15 five-step model. May differ from invoice_date for consignment, bill-and-hold, or multi-element arrangements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: SAP sales organization (VKORG) responsible for the sale, defining the selling entity, pricing procedures, and revenue assignment for this invoice.

attributes.name: short_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount by which the customer's remittance falls short of the invoiced net amount, excluding valid deductions. Triggers deduction investigation and collections follow-up.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Residual Item; F&B Commercial Finance Deduction Management

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sales tax, VAT, or GST amount calculated on the net invoice amount per applicable jurisdiction tax rules. Required for tax compliance reporting to FDA-regulated markets and international jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR MWSTS; IRS; EFSA; Codex Alimentarius; IFRS

attributes.name: trade_discount_amount
