attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Conditions (KONV); TPM Trade Spend; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was last modified in the source system, capturing payment applications, dispute updates, or status changes. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

products.name: finance_standard_cost
products.description: Standard cost master and variance analysis record for each SKU/material — combining the pre-determined cost used for inventory valuation and COGS calculation with actual manufacturing and purchase price variances. Captures material number, plant, costing variant, standard price per unit, cost component split (raw materials, direct labor, manufacturing overhead, packaging, freight-in), costing lot size, valid-from date, and release status. Also captures all variance records: production order or purchase order reference, variance category (price variance, quantity variance, scrap variance, mix variance, lot-size variance, overhead variance), variance amount and percentage, period, cost center, and settlement status. The financial backbone for F&B gross margin management, standard cost roll-up decisions, make-vs-buy analysis, and operational efficiency reporting.

attributes.name: finance_standard_cost_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the standard cost record. Primary key for the standard cost master and variance analysis entity.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: standard_cost is defined per legal entity; replace string code with FK to company_code

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: standard_cost is allocated to a cost center; replace code with FK to cost_center

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: standard_cost references a GL account; replace code with FK to gl_account

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: standard_cost is allocated to a profit center; replace code with FK to profit_center

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the standard cost (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, LB for pound, CS for case). Must match the material master base UOM for consistency.

attributes.name: co_packing_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost component for third-party co-packing or toll manufacturing services per unit. Applicable when production is outsourced to contract manufacturers or co-packers.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Management accounting controlling area for cost center and profit center reporting. May span multiple company codes for consolidated management reporting and cross-company cost allocation.

attributes.name: cost_change_amount
attributes.description: Absolute change in standard cost per unit from previous to current period. Positive indicates cost increase; negative indicates cost reduction. Drives inventory revaluation and margin impact analysis.

attributes.name: cost_change_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage change in standard cost from previous to current period. Key metric for cost inflation tracking, procurement performance, and pricing strategy decisions.

attributes.name: cost_component_structure
attributes.description: Configuration key defining the cost component split schema (e.g., which cost elements roll into raw material, labor, overhead categories). Ensures consistent cost classification across products and plants.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the detailed cost estimate calculation that produced this standard cost. Links to the itemized cost roll-up with BOM explosion, routing operations, and overhead allocation details.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the cost estimate. Only released estimates are activated as standard costs for inventory valuation. Created and calculated are preliminary; marked for deletion are superseded.

attributes.name: costing_lot_size
attributes.description: Production lot size used as the basis for standard cost calculation. Fixed costs are spread across this quantity. Larger lot sizes reduce per-unit fixed overhead; smaller lots increase it, creating lot-size variance.

attributes.name: costing_variant
attributes.description: Costing methodology variant used for standard cost calculation (e.g., PPC1 for product costing, PC01 for material ledger). Determines valuation approach, cost component structure, and overhead allocation rules.

attributes.name: costing_version
attributes.description: Version number for the standard cost estimate. Allows multiple cost scenarios (current, planned, simulated) to coexist for comparison and what-if analysis before release.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the standard cost record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and change tracking for compliance and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Standard costs are maintained in local plant currency and converted to group reporting currency for consolidation.

attributes.name: direct_labor_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost component for direct production labor per unit. Calculated from routing operation times multiplied by labor rates. Includes line operators, batch mixers, and packaging crew.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for variance tracking. Period 1-12 for calendar fiscal year; may differ for non-calendar fiscal years. Enables monthly variance trending and seasonality analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which the standard cost or variance is applicable. Standard costs are typically set annually; variances are tracked by fiscal period for trend analysis and budget comparison.

attributes.name: fixed_overhead_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost component for fixed manufacturing overhead per unit. Includes depreciation, plant supervision, property taxes, insurance, and fixed maintenance allocated based on normal capacity utilization.

attributes.name: freight_in_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost component for inbound freight and logistics per unit. Includes transportation of raw materials and packaging to the manufacturing plant, allocated to finished goods.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) in the ERP system. Links to the product master for finished goods, semi-finished goods, raw materials, and packaging components.

attributes.name: other_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost component for miscellaneous manufacturing costs not classified in other categories. May include quality testing, rework allowance, or special handling charges.

attributes.name: packaging_material_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost component for primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging materials per unit. Includes bottles, cans, cartons, labels, shrink wrap, pallets, and shipping materials.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or production facility where the standard cost is applicable. Standard costs are plant-specific to reflect local labor rates, overhead allocation, and manufacturing efficiency.

attributes.name: previous_standard_price
attributes.description: Prior period standard cost per unit before the current cost roll. Used to calculate cost change impact, revaluation amounts, and year-over-year cost trend analysis.

attributes.name: price_control_indicator
attributes.description: Valuation method indicator: S for standard price (predetermined cost), V for moving average price (actual cost). Food and beverage finished goods typically use standard price; raw materials may use moving average.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity unit for which the standard price is defined (e.g., 1, 10, 100, 1000). Standard price per unit is divided by price unit to get per-base-unit cost. Commonly 1 for finished goods, may be higher for low-value materials.

attributes.name: raw_material_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost component for raw materials and ingredients per unit. Derived from BOM (Bill of Materials) quantities multiplied by component standard prices. Largest cost driver in food and beverage manufacturing.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when the cost estimate was released and activated as the official standard cost. Marks the transition from preliminary to production-ready cost. Critical for audit trail and variance analysis cutover.

attributes.name: released_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the cost accountant or controller who released the standard cost estimate. Provides accountability for cost master changes and supports SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) compliance audit requirements.

attributes.name: standard_price_per_unit
attributes.description: Total standard cost per base unit of measure. Used for inventory valuation, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, and gross margin reporting. Sum of all cost component splits.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the standard cost record was last modified. Tracks cost master maintenance activity, variance postings, and data refresh cycles for data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date for this standard cost. Standard costs are typically updated annually or semi-annually during the standard cost roll process, with mid-year adjustments for significant material or overhead changes.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date for this standard cost. Null or far-future date indicates the current active standard cost. Historical records retain prior period costs for variance trending and year-over-year analysis.

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Material valuation class determining GL (General Ledger) account assignment for inventory and COGS postings. Links material type to chart of accounts for financial reporting.

attributes.name: variable_overhead_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost component for variable manufacturing overhead per unit. Includes utilities, indirect materials, consumables, and variable maintenance that scale with production volume.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the variance (actual cost minus standard cost). Positive variance indicates unfavorable (actual higher than standard); negative indicates favorable (actual lower than standard). Aggregated for EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization) reporting.

attributes.name: variance_category
attributes.description: Classification of manufacturing variance type. Price variance: material cost differences. Quantity variance: usage differences. Scrap variance: waste. Mix variance: recipe substitution. Yield variance: output differences. Lot-size variance: volume impact on fixed costs. Overhead variance: absorption differences. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_variance|quantity_variance|scrap_variance|mix_variance|yield_variance|lot_size_variance|overhead_variance|resource_usage_variance — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance amount expressed as a percentage of standard cost. Used for materiality assessment, exception reporting, and operational performance scorecards. Thresholds trigger management review.

products.name: finance_budget
products.description: Annual and rolling financial budget master capturing planned financial targets by cost center, profit center, GL account, and fiscal period. Sourced from SAP CO budgeting or Oracle Cloud EPM. Captures budget version (original, revised, latest estimate), fiscal year, period, company code, cost center, profit center, GL account, budget amount, currency, budget type (opex, capex, headcount), approval status, and budget owner. Foundational for variance-to-budget reporting and EBITDA target management in F&B.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key for the budget data product.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Finance budget is scoped to a company; replace string with FK

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Finance budget is scoped to a cost center; replace code with FK

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or employee ID of the budget owner responsible for managing and monitoring this budget line. Typically the cost center manager or department head.

attributes.name: primary_finance_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or employee ID of the person who approved the budget. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Finance budget is scoped to a profit center; replace code with FK

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: Annual budgeting allocates funds to each sustainability target; the FK enables traceability of spend.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The planned budget amount for the specified fiscal period, cost center, and GL account. Represents the financial target or allocation in the budget currency.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the budget was approved by the authorized approver. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the budget record. DRAFT = In preparation, SUBMITTED = Awaiting approval, APPROVED = Approved for use, REJECTED = Not approved, LOCKED = Finalized and locked for the period.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: Categorization of the budget planning approach. ANNUAL = Annual fixed budget, ROLLING = Rolling forecast budget, SUPPLEMENTAL = Additional budget allocation, CONTINGENCY = Reserve or contingency budget.

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by financial category. OPEX = Operating Expenses, CAPEX = Capital Expenditures, REVENUE = Revenue Budget, HEADCOUNT = Workforce Budget, COGS = Cost of Goods Sold, TRADE_SPEND = Trade Promotion and Marketing Spend.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area code for cross-company code reporting. Represents a business segment that may span multiple legal entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Business Area Master

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: Four-character code representing the controlling area for cost accounting and management reporting. Aligns with SAP CO controlling area structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) - Controlling Area Master

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for country-specific budget allocation (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was first created in the lakehouse. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Indicates the currency in which the budget is denominated.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel code for channel-specific budget planning (e.g., Retail, Foodservice, E-commerce, Direct Store Delivery).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Distribution Channel Master

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for which this budget applies. Typically ranges from 1 to 12 for monthly budgets, or 1 to 4 for quarterly budgets.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget is defined. Represents the annual planning period (e.g., 2024, 2025).

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area code for classifying budget by business function (e.g., Manufacturing, Sales, R&D, Marketing, Supply Chain).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Functional Area Master

attributes.name: geographic_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for regional budget planning (e.g., NORAM, EMEA, APAC, LATAM). Enables regional financial target setting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: is_carry_forward
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line represents a carry-forward from a previous fiscal period. True = Carry-forward budget, False = New budget allocation.

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the budget record is locked for editing. True = Locked (no further changes allowed), False = Unlocked (editable). Used to freeze budgets after approval or period close.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was last updated in the lakehouse. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context, assumptions, or justification for the budget allocation. Used for documenting budget rationale and planning assumptions.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code to which this budget applies. Used for plant-specific budget allocation in manufacturing and operations.

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Product category or product line code for product-specific budget allocation (e.g., Snacks, Beverages, Dairy). Used for category-level financial planning.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Planned quantity associated with the budget (e.g., headcount, production volume, units sold). Used for non-monetary budget planning such as workforce or production capacity.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the budget quantity (e.g., FTE for headcount, MT for metric tons, EA for each). Provides context for the budget_quantity field.

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: Sales organization code for revenue and sales-related budgets. Represents the sales division or region responsible for revenue targets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Sales Organization Master

attributes.name: source_record_key
attributes.description: Primary key or unique identifier of the budget record in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation back to the source system.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this budget record originated (e.g., SAP_CO, ORACLE_EPM, ANAPLAN). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: version_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the version of the budget (e.g., ORIGINAL, REVISED, LE1, LE2, FORECAST). Enables tracking of budget iterations and revisions throughout the fiscal year.
attributes.references: SAP CO Budget Management - Version Control

attributes.name: version_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the budget version (e.g., Original Budget, Q2 Revised Budget, Latest Estimate). Provides human-readable context for the version code.

products.name: forecast
products.description: Rolling financial forecast record capturing updated revenue, cost, and EBITDA projections by period, profit center, and business unit. Distinct from budget (which is annual/fixed) — forecasts are updated monthly or quarterly. Captures forecast version, forecast date, fiscal year, period, company code, profit center, GL account category, forecasted amount, prior forecast amount, variance to budget, currency, and forecast owner. Supports S&OP financial integration and investor guidance for F&B.
products.reference: SAP IBP Financial Planning / Oracle EPM

attributes.name: forecast_id
attributes.description: Primary key for forecast

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Forecast is prepared for a company; replace string with FK

attributes.name: forecast_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the manager or executive who approved this forecast version. Supports governance and audit trail.

attributes.name: forecast_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or user identifier of the person responsible for submitting and maintaining this forecast line. Typically a finance business partner or profit center controller.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Forecast references a GL account; add FK to gl_account

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Forecast is prepared for a profit center; replace code with FK

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Cycle ID
attributes.description: Identifier linking this financial forecast to the corresponding S&OP cycle. Ensures alignment between demand planning, supply planning, and financial forecasting.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the forecast was formally approved. Marks the transition from draft to official forecast.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The original annual budget amount for this period and account. Used for variance-to-budget analysis and performance tracking.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: High-level business unit or division code (e.g., Snacks, Beverages, Dairy). Used for executive-level reporting and strategic planning.

attributes.name: commentary
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explaining key assumptions, risks, opportunities, or changes from prior forecast. Provides qualitative context for quantitative projections.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Subjective confidence rating assigned by the forecast owner. Indicates reliability and risk associated with the forecast estimate.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for country-specific forecasts. Supports statutory reporting and local market analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this forecast record was first created in the source system. Audit field for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the forecasted amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency forecasting and consolidation.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel for revenue forecasts (e.g., retail, foodservice, DSD, e-commerce). Enables channel-specific forecast analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel Master Data

attributes.name: driver_type
attributes.description: Primary business driver or assumption category underlying the forecast (e.g., volume growth, pricing action, product mix shift, foreign exchange impact). Enables driver-based planning and variance explanation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume|price|mix|fx|inflation|productivity|investment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period within the year (e.g., P01-P12 for months, Q1-Q4 for quarters, H1-H2 for half-years, FY for full year). Defines the granularity of the forecast.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Period Structure

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this forecast applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with the company's fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: The date when this forecast version was created or submitted. Represents the as-of date for the forecast snapshot.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the forecast record. Tracks progression from draft through approval to publication.

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast by planning horizon and frequency. Rolling forecasts are continuously updated; annual/quarterly/monthly are fixed-period; reforecast is a mid-cycle update; flash is a rapid preliminary estimate.

attributes.name: forecasted_amount
attributes.description: The projected financial value for this forecast line in the specified currency. Represents the current best estimate of revenue, cost, or profit for the period.

attributes.name: geographic_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region or market for the forecast (e.g., NORAM, EMEA, LATAM, APAC). Enables regional performance tracking and investor reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_category
attributes.description: High-level financial statement line item category for the forecasted amount. Enables aggregation and variance analysis by P&L component. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue|cogs|gross_profit|operating_expense|ebitda|depreciation|ebit|interest|tax|net_income — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Chart of Accounts and Financial Statement Mapping

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Detailed GL account number for the forecasted line item. Provides granular mapping to the chart of accounts for financial close integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the forecast owner for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: prior_forecast_amount
attributes.description: The forecasted amount from the previous forecast version for the same period and account. Enables trend analysis and revision tracking.

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Product category or portfolio segment for revenue and COGS forecasts (e.g., Salty Snacks, Carbonated Soft Drinks, Dairy). Supports category-level planning.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the forecast was published to executive dashboards and investor relations. Indicates availability for external guidance.

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: Sales organization responsible for revenue forecasts. Aligns with SAP SD sales organization structure for channel and customer segmentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Master Data

attributes.name: scenario_code
attributes.description: Planning scenario for the forecast (e.g., base case, upside, downside). Supports scenario planning and risk assessment for investor guidance.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which the forecast was extracted (e.g., SAP_IBP, ORACLE_PBCS, ANAPLAN). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this forecast record was last modified in the source system. Tracks revision history.

attributes.name: variance_to_budget_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the forecasted amount and the budget amount (forecasted_amount - budget_amount). Positive values indicate favorable variance for revenue, unfavorable for costs.

attributes.name: variance_to_prior_forecast_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the current forecast and the prior forecast (forecasted_amount - prior_forecast_amount). Tracks forecast revision magnitude.

attributes.name: version_code
attributes.description: Version identifier for the forecast cycle (e.g., V1, V2, Q1R1, Q2R2). Distinguishes between initial forecast and subsequent revisions within the same fiscal period.
attributes.references: Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Best Practices

products.name: fixed_asset

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id

attributes.name: acquisition_date

attributes.name: asset_class_code

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the fixed asset, including make, model, capacity, and distinguishing characteristics (e.g., 'High-Speed Bottling Line - Line 3 - 600 BPM').

attributes.name: asset_location
attributes.description: Detailed physical location of the asset within the plant or facility (e.g., 'Production Floor - Line 3 - Bay 12'). Used for asset tracking, maintenance scheduling, and physical inventory.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the fixed asset, typically assigned by the ERP system (SAP FI-AA asset master number). Used for asset tracking, reporting, and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Active assets are in service and depreciating; under construction assets are capitalized but not yet depreciating; retired/disposed assets are no longer in use.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical barcode or RFID tag number affixed to the asset for inventory tracking and physical verification during asset audits.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was capitalized on the balance sheet. May differ from acquisition date for assets under construction (AUC) that are capitalized upon completion.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was first created in the source system (SAP FI-AA). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts (original cost, accumulated depreciation, net book value). Typically the local currency of the company code.

attributes.name: depreciation_gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account number for accumulated depreciation (contra-asset account, e.g., 1509 - Accumulated Depreciation - Machinery). Used for balance sheet presentation.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense. Straight-line is most common for F&B manufacturing assets; units of production may be used for high-utilization equipment.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was physically disposed, sold, or scrapped. May differ from retirement date if there is a lag between decommissioning and disposal.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal (proceeds minus net book value).

attributes.name: expense_gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account number for depreciation expense postings (e.g., 6800 - Depreciation Expense). Used for income statement reporting and COGS allocation.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account number for the asset balance sheet account (e.g., 1500 - Machinery and Equipment). Determined by asset class and used for financial statement reporting.

attributes.name: impairment_amount
attributes.description: Total impairment loss recognized on the asset when its recoverable amount falls below net book value. Recorded as a write-down and reduces the carrying value.

attributes.name: impairment_date
attributes.description: Date the impairment loss was recognized. Triggers adjustment to net book value and may affect future depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the asset against loss, damage, or theft. Used for risk management and claims processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was last updated in the source system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was last physically verified during a fixed asset inventory audit. Used to ensure asset register accuracy and compliance with SOX controls.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the equipment manufacturer or vendor (e.g., 'Tetra Pak', 'Krones', 'Siemens'). Used for vendor management, spare parts sourcing, and warranty claims.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model or part number for the asset. Used for technical specifications, spare parts identification, and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset on the balance sheet, calculated as original cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the remaining capitalized value.

attributes.name: original_cost
attributes.description: Initial acquisition or construction cost of the asset at capitalization, including purchase price, freight, installation, and directly attributable costs. Represents the gross book value before depreciation.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant, distribution center, or facility location where the asset is physically located. Used for site-level asset tracking and capex reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Original purchase order number used to acquire the asset. Links the asset to procurement records and vendor invoices for audit trail and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Number of years remaining in the assets useful life as of the current reporting period. Calculated as useful life minus elapsed time since capitalization.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was retired from service or disposed. Triggers final depreciation calculation and removal from active asset register.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Depreciation is calculated on (original cost - salvage value). Often zero for F&B manufacturing equipment.

attributes.name: sap_asset_key
attributes.description: Composite key from SAP FI-AA (company code + asset number + sub-number) used for exact source system reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number or unique equipment identifier for the asset. Used for warranty tracking, maintenance history, and asset verification.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source ERP system from which the asset record originated (e.g., 'SAP_S4_PROD', 'ORACLE_ERP_US'). Used for data lineage and multi-system integration.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected economic useful life of the asset in years, as determined by asset class and business policy. Used to calculate straight-line depreciation rate (1 / useful life).

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased. Used for vendor performance tracking and warranty claims.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the manufacturer or vendor warranty expires. Used to determine whether repairs are covered under warranty or must be expensed.

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Intercompany financial transaction record capturing cross-entity charges, transfers, and settlements between Food Beverage legal entities — manufacturing entities billing distribution entities, shared service centers charging operating companies, and royalty flows between IP-holding and operating entities. Captures sending company code, receiving company code, transaction type (goods transfer, service charge, royalty, loan interest), amount, currency, exchange rate, netting status, and elimination flag for consolidation. Essential for statutory reporting and transfer pricing compliance.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: intercompany_transaction may be charged to a cost center; replace code with FK to cost_center

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Intercompany transaction creation audit demands employee identification for compliance and internal control reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: intercompany_transaction posts to a GL account; replace code with FK to gl_account

attributes.name: netting_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the intercompany netting run in which this transaction was included. Format NET followed by 8-digit date stamp. Null if transaction has not been netted.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: intercompany_transaction may be charged to a profit center; replace code with FK to profit_center

attributes.name: sending_company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: intercompany_transaction sender entity; replace string with FK to company_code

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area code representing the line of business or product category associated with this intercompany transaction. Used for segment reporting and cross-company business area consolidation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this intercompany transaction record was first created in the source ERP system. Captures date and time with timezone for complete audit trail.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The business date when the intercompany transaction was created or initiated. May differ from posting date due to period-end processing or backdated entries.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique business document number assigned to this intercompany transaction in the ERP system. Ten-character alphanumeric identifier used for audit trail and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number Range

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the receiving entity must settle the intercompany payable to the sending entity. Calculated based on posting date and payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

attributes.name: elimination_document_number
attributes.description: The consolidation system document number that records the elimination entry for this intercompany transaction. Populated only after consolidation processing. Used for audit trail and reconciliation between legal entity and group reporting.

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this intercompany transaction must be eliminated during the consolidation process for statutory reporting. True indicates the transaction will be reversed in consolidated financial statements to avoid double-counting revenue and expenses within the group.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency to local or group currency. Typically the spot rate on the posting date or a monthly average rate depending on company policy.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the transaction was posted. Typically 1-12 for standard calendar periods, or 13-16 for special closing periods used during year-end adjustments.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction was posted, based on the posting date and the fiscal year variant of the sending company code. Four-digit year value used for period-based financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the group reporting currency (typically USD or EUR) for consolidated financial statements. Essential for EBITDA reporting and corporate performance analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this intercompany transaction record. Used for audit trail and change tracking in financial controls.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this intercompany transaction record was last updated in the source ERP system. Captures date and time with timezone for complete audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the local currency of the sending company code using the exchange rate at the time of posting. Used for statutory reporting in the sending entity's functional currency.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The final payable or receivable amount after applying taxes, discounts, and adjustments. This is the amount that will be settled between the two entities through intercompany netting or payment.

attributes.name: netting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany transaction is included in the periodic intercompany netting process to reduce cash movements between entities. Not netted indicates standalone settlement; included in netting means eligible for next netting run; netted indicates already processed; excluded indicates manual settlement required.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the intercompany transaction was settled through payment or netting. Null if transaction remains open. Used to calculate days sales outstanding (DSO) and payment performance metrics.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method used to settle the intercompany transaction. Wire transfer indicates bank payment; netting indicates multilateral netting process; offset indicates manual clearing against another transaction; manual journal indicates accounting adjustment without cash movement.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and early payment discount conditions for this intercompany transaction. Four-character code referencing the payment terms master data (e.g., N030 for net 30 days).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date when the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger in both sending and receiving entities. This date determines the fiscal period for financial reporting and must align with the open accounting period in both company codes.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity receiving the intercompany charge or transfer. Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the receiving entity in the corporate structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the intercompany reconciliation process indicating whether the sending and receiving entity records match. Matched indicates both sides agree; unmatched indicates discrepancy; disputed indicates formal disagreement; under review indicates investigation in progress.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this intercompany transaction to the originating business document such as a sales order, purchase order, invoice, or goods receipt. Provides traceability to the underlying operational transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag (True/False) indicating whether this intercompany transaction is a reversal of a previously posted transaction. True indicates this is a correcting entry; False indicates an original transaction.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original intercompany transaction that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal indicator is True. Provides audit trail for corrections and cancellations.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source ERP system from which this intercompany transaction was extracted. Supports multi-system landscapes where different legal entities operate on different ERP instances (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Cloud ERP).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), or other indirect tax amount applied to the intercompany transaction. May be zero for certain cross-border transactions or exempt services.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO country code representing the tax jurisdiction governing this intercompany transaction. Critical for determining VAT/GST treatment, withholding tax obligations, and transfer pricing documentation requirements.

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: The trading partner code identifying the counterparty entity in intercompany reporting. Used in consolidation systems to match and eliminate reciprocal transactions between group entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting Trading Partner

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency before any adjustments, taxes, or discounts. Represents the base charge or transfer value between entities.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated. This is the currency agreed upon between the sending and receiving entities for the transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany transaction. Draft indicates pending approval; posted indicates recorded in both entities; cleared indicates payment settled; reversed indicates cancellation; eliminated indicates consolidated for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the cross-entity charge. Goods transfer represents inventory movements between manufacturing and distribution entities; service charge captures shared service center allocations; royalty represents intellectual property licensing fees; loan interest covers intercompany financing; management fee represents corporate overhead allocations; cost allocation represents other cross-entity cost distributions.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the intercompany transaction price. Cost plus adds a markup to cost; market price uses external benchmarks; negotiated represents arm's length agreements; comparable uncontrolled uses third-party comparables; resale minus deducts margin from resale price. Critical for tax compliance and OECD transfer pricing documentation.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax deducted from the intercompany transaction amount for cross-border payments subject to tax treaty provisions. Typically applies to royalties, interest, and service fees. Zero for domestic transactions or exempt categories.

products.name: fiscal_period
products.description: Fiscal period management and financial close orchestration record defining accounting periods and all period-end close activities for each company code. Captures fiscal year, period number (1-12 plus special periods 13-16), start/end dates, period type (regular, special, year-end), open/close status per account type (assets, liabilities, revenue, expense), and posting authority controls. Also encompasses complete close task management: task name, task type (accrual posting, depreciation run, cost allocation, IC reconciliation, balance sheet reconciliation, financial statement preparation), responsible team, planned/actual completion dates, status (open, in-progress, complete, blocked), predecessor dependencies, sign-off owner, and SLA tracking. Controls posting windows and enables close cycle management, audit trail, SOX compliance evidence, and period-end SLA reporting for F&B financial operations.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fiscal_period

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: fiscal_period is scoped to a legal entity; replace string code with FK to company_code

attributes.name: asset_posting_status
attributes.description: Posting authorization status for asset account types (fixed assets, depreciation). Controls whether asset transactions can be posted in this period.

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether detailed audit logging is enabled for all transactions posted in this fiscal period for compliance and forensic purposes.

attributes.name: balance_sheet_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of balance sheet account reconciliation process for this period, ensuring all balance sheet accounts are substantiated and reconciled to sub-ledgers.

attributes.name: blocked_close_tasks
attributes.description: Count of close tasks that are currently blocked due to unmet dependencies or issues requiring resolution.

attributes.name: close_actual_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date when the financial close process was completed and certified.

attributes.name: close_cycle_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the financial close cycle for this period (e.g., January 2024 Close, Q1 2024 Close, FY2024 Year-End Close).

attributes.name: close_delay_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the close process exceeded the target date. Zero or negative if close was on time or early.

attributes.name: close_sla_met
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the close process met the target SLA (True if actual close date is on or before target date, False otherwise).

attributes.name: close_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date when the financial close process for this period was initiated.

attributes.name: close_status
attributes.description: Overall status of the period-end close process: not_started (close not initiated), in_progress (tasks underway), complete (all tasks finished), certified (final sign-off and SOX attestation complete).

attributes.name: close_target_date
attributes.description: The planned target date by which the financial close process should be completed, per the close calendar and SLA (Service Level Agreement).

attributes.name: completed_close_tasks
attributes.description: Count of close tasks that have been marked as complete for this fiscal period.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the controlling area (CO module organizational unit) to which this fiscal period applies for cost accounting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_status
attributes.description: Status of cost center and internal order allocation cycles (assessment, distribution, overhead allocation) for this fiscal period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the local currency for this company code and fiscal period (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: depreciation_run_status
attributes.description: Status of the periodic depreciation calculation and posting run for fixed assets in this fiscal period.

attributes.name: expense_posting_status
attributes.description: Posting authorization status for expense account types (COGS, operating expenses). Controls whether expense transactions can be posted in this period.

attributes.name: financial_statement_status
attributes.description: Status of financial statement preparation and approval workflow for this period: not_started, draft (in preparation), review (under management review), approved (signed off), published (externally released).

attributes.name: fiscal_period_number
attributes.description: Sequential period number within the fiscal year. Regular periods are 1-12; special adjustment periods are 13-16 for year-end close activities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Period Standard

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this period belongs, represented as a four-digit integer (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Two-character code defining the fiscal year calendar structure (e.g., K4 for calendar year, V3 for April-March fiscal year). Determines period start/end dates and number of periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: intercompany_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of intercompany transaction reconciliation for this period: not_started, in_progress, reconciled (balanced), or variance (unresolved differences requiring investigation).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fiscal period record was last updated, reflecting the most recent change to period status or close task progress.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the ledger group or accounting principle (e.g., 0L for leading ledger, 2L for IFRS parallel ledger) to which this period applies.

attributes.name: liability_posting_status
attributes.description: Posting authorization status for liability account types (accounts payable, accrued expenses). Controls whether liability transactions can be posted in this period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing important notes, issues, or commentary related to this fiscal period close (e.g., significant variances, process improvements, system issues).

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the fiscal period when transactions can be posted.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the fiscal period when transactions can be posted.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Overall status of the fiscal period controlling whether any posting activity is allowed: not_opened (future period), open (active posting), closed (period-end complete), locked (archived, no changes).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Control

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fiscal period: regular (monthly operating periods 1-12), special (adjustment periods 13-16), year_end (final close period), or opening (initial balance period).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Period Type Classification

attributes.name: posting_authority_override_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether authorized users can override posting restrictions for this period (typically False for closed periods to maintain data integrity).

attributes.name: responsible_controller
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the financial controller or accounting manager responsible for overseeing the close process for this period.

attributes.name: revenue_posting_status
attributes.description: Posting authorization status for revenue account types (sales revenue, other income). Controls whether revenue transactions can be posted in this period.

attributes.name: sign_off_date
attributes.description: The calendar date when the sign-off owner provided final certification for this fiscal period close.

attributes.name: sign_off_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive (CFO, Controller, VP Finance) who provides final certification and sign-off for this fiscal period close.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source ERP or financial system from which this fiscal period record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Oracle Cloud Financials).

attributes.name: sox_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of SOX internal control certification for this period: not_required (non-SOX entity), pending (awaiting sign-off), certified (controls attested), exception (control deficiency identified).

attributes.name: total_close_tasks
attributes.description: Total count of close tasks defined for this fiscal period across all task types and responsible teams.

products.name: tax_record
products.description: Tax transaction record capturing VAT, GST, sales tax, excise duty, and sugar tax postings associated with customer invoices, vendor invoices, and intercompany transactions. Sourced from SAP FI tax module. Captures tax document reference, tax type (input, output, excise, sugar levy), tax code, tax jurisdiction, taxable base amount, tax amount, currency, tax rate, reporting period, and tax authority. Supports indirect tax compliance and regulatory reporting obligations across F&B global markets including FDA/USDA and EFSA jurisdictions.

attributes.name: tax_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax transaction record. Primary key for the tax_record product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer associated with this tax transaction for output tax scenarios (sales tax, VAT on customer invoices).

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor invoice document that generated this tax posting for input tax scenarios.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer invoice document that generated this tax posting for output tax scenarios.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: tax_record is filed by a legal entity; replace string code with FK to company_code

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger journal entry that contains this tax posting for manual or intercompany tax adjustments.

attributes.name: product_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Tax records need to be associated with the product registration to report taxes per regulated product and satisfy agency filing requirements.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor associated with this tax transaction for input tax scenarios (VAT on vendor invoices, excise duty on raw material procurement).

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax liability was paid to the tax authority or input tax was recovered. Populated when tax_status is cleared.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the payment or settlement document that cleared this tax liability or input tax receivable. Populated when tax_status is cleared.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center code for tax expense allocation in cost accounting. Used for non-recoverable input tax and excise duty cost assignment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the tax transaction. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY. Supports multi-currency tax reporting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to local currency for tax reporting. Null if transaction currency equals local currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which the tax transaction is recorded. Examples: 1-12 for monthly periods, 1-4 for quarterly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the tax transaction is recorded, based on the company code fiscal year variant. Examples: 2023, 2024.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the tax amount is posted. Examples: 154000 (Input VAT Receivable), 175000 (Output VAT Payable), 520100 (Excise Duty Expense).

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this tax transaction is associated with an intercompany transaction between two company codes within the same corporate group. True if intercompany, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company code local currency. Used for statutory reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or distribution center code where the taxable transaction originated. Relevant for excise duty and sugar levy calculations tied to production volume.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center code for internal management reporting and tax cost allocation. Links tax expense to business segments.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction that negated this tax posting. Populated when tax_status is reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The code indicating the reason for reversing this tax transaction. Examples: CN (credit note issued), ERR (posting error), ADJ (tax rate adjustment). Populated when tax_status is reversed.

attributes.name: reverse_charge_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transaction is subject to reverse charge VAT mechanism, where the buyer (not the seller) accounts for VAT. True if reverse charge applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the source ERP system from which this tax record was extracted. Examples: SAP_FI_PROD, SAP_FI_EU, ORACLE_ERP_CLOUD. Supports multi-system data integration and lineage.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount posted to the tax GL account. This is the product of taxable_base_amount and tax_rate_percentage.

attributes.name: tax_amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The tax amount converted to the company code local currency using the exchange rate. Used for statutory tax reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the tax authority or regulatory body to which this tax is remitted. Examples: IRS (US), HMRC (UK), Bundeszentralamt für Steuern (Germany), Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (France).

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code configured in the ERP system that determines tax rate, tax type, and GL account assignment. Examples: V0 (zero-rated VAT), V1 (standard VAT), I1 (input VAT), E1 (excise duty code).

attributes.name: tax_document_date
attributes.description: The date of the source document (invoice date, receipt date) that triggered the tax transaction. Used for tax point determination and VAT reporting.

attributes.name: tax_document_number
attributes.description: The unique document number assigned to this tax transaction in the source ERP system (SAP FI tax module). This is the externally-known identifier for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: The certificate or authorization number issued by the tax authority granting exemption for this transaction. Required for audit trail when tax_exemption_indicator is True.
attributes.references: IRS Form 4029, State Sales Tax Exemption Certificates

attributes.name: tax_exemption_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transaction qualifies for tax exemption under applicable regulations. True if exempt, False otherwise. Examples: export sales (zero-rated VAT), essential food items (sales tax exempt).
attributes.references: OECD Tax Exemption Guidelines, FDA Food Labeling

attributes.name: tax_exemption_reason_code
attributes.description: The code representing the legal basis for tax exemption. Examples: EXP (export), ESS (essential goods), RES (resale), GOV (government entity). Populated only when tax_exemption_indicator is True.
attributes.references: OECD Tax Policy, EU VAT Directive Annex III

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax authority jurisdiction code where this tax is assessed and reported. Examples: US-CA (California), GB-HMRC (UK), DE-BZSt (Germany), FR-DGFiP (France). Supports multi-jurisdictional tax compliance.

attributes.name: tax_line_item_number
attributes.description: Line item sequence number within the parent financial document, distinguishing multiple tax postings on a single invoice or journal entry.

attributes.name: tax_posting_date

products.name: food_safety_plan
products.description: Unified food safety plan master records covering both FSMA Preventive Controls (21 CFR Part 117) and USDA HACCP (9 CFR Part 417) requirements for each facility and product category. Documents hazard analysis, critical control points, preventive controls (process, allergen, sanitation, supply chain), critical limits, monitoring procedures, corrective action procedures, verification activities, and recall plan reference. products.name: esg_disclosure
products.description: Master record for the complete ESG reporting lifecycle — from disclosure preparation through submission to external rating receipt and peer benchmarking. Captures formal ESG disclosure submissions (reporting period, framework version for GRI, CDP, TCFD, CSRD/ESRS, disclosure scope, verification status, assurance level, submission metadata) and external ESG ratings received from third-party agencies (MSCI, Sustainalytics, ISS ESG, CDP scores, DJSI/FTSE4Good index membership), including rating methodology version, overall score and pillar sub-scores (E/S/G), rating category or tier, assessment date, prior period comparison, score drivers/detractors, data gaps flagged, index inclusion/exclusion status, and investor inquiry tracking. Provides unified ownership of the disclose-rate-benchmark cycle for investor relations and targeted ESG improvement planning.

Captures initiative name, ESG pillar (environmental, social, governance), category (energy efficiency, water reduction, waste elimination, sustainable sourcing, fleet electrification), owning business unit, implementation status and phase gates, projected environmental impact (CO2e tonnes avoided, water m3 saved, waste kg diverted), actual impact realized to date, capital investment required, operating cost savings, payback period, and linkage to corporate sustainability targets. Enables portfolio management of ESG investments and ROI tracking.
products.reference: ISO 14001 Environmental Management / GRI Management Approach

products.name: audit
products.description: Records of internal and third-party sustainability audits and assurance engagements conducted at manufacturing plants, supplier facilities, distribution centers, and corporate offices. Captures audit type (ISO 14001 surveillance, social compliance, limited/reasonable assurance for ESG data, packaging recyclability verification, deforestation-free supply chain), audit standard applied, audit date and duration, auditing body or assurance provider, scope boundaries, findings by severity (critical, major, minor, observation), corrective action plans with due dates, closure status, and certification or assurance statement outcome. Supports ISAE 3000 assurance, GFSI benchmarked schemes, and responsible sourcing verification.

products.name: employee
products.description: Core master record and single source of truth for all Food Beverage workforce identity, employment agreements, and lifecycle history. Covers full-time, part-time, seasonal, and contract workers across manufacturing plants, DCs, corporate offices, and field sales. Stores Workday HCM employee ID, legal name, preferred name, employment type, hire date, termination date, rehire eligibility, job classification, FLSA status, EEO category, I-9 verification status, badge number, work location, cost center assignment, manager, HR business partner, and full employment contract details (contract type, CBA reference, union local, pay basis, standard hours, probation/notice periods, renewal terms). Captures embedded lifecycle event history (hire, transfer, promotion, termination, LOA). SSOT for workforce identity, employment agreements, and lifecycle audit — no separate contract product exists.

domains.description: Manages preventive and corrective maintenance of manufacturing equipment, CMMS work orders, spare parts inventory, calibration schedules, and asset reliability programs across all F&B production facilities

products.name: asset
products.description: Master record for all maintainable physical assets across F&B production facilities — filling lines, mixers, pasteurizers, CIP systems, boilers, compressors, conveyors, refrigeration units, and utilities. Captures asset ID, asset name, asset type (production equipment, utility, facility, instrumentation), asset category, manufacturer, model number, serial number, installation date, commissioning date, decommission date, asset status (active, inactive, decommissioned, scrapped), criticality rating (critical, major, minor), plant/facility assignment, production line assignment, cost center, replacement value, current book value, expected useful life (years), maintenance strategy (preventive, predictive, run-to-failure), OEM warranty expiry date, asset tag/barcode, parent asset reference for hierarchy, and asset class per ISO 14224. SSOT for all maintainable equipment identity in the maintenance domain — distinct from manufacturing.equipment_master which focuses on production execution context.

products.name: price_list

Distinct from sales.price_list which is the commercial-facing view — this domain owns the pricing master governance record including cost-plus build-up, margin floors, and pricing authority approvals.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `food_beverage_ecm`.`_metrics`.`customer_account_overview`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "High‑level customer account KPIs for executive and operational insight."
  source: "`food_beverage_ecm`.`customer`.`account`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "market_segment"
      expr: market_segment
      comment: "Segment of the market the account belongs to."
    - name: "account_status"
      expr: account_status
      comment: "Current status of the account (e.g., Active, Inactive)."
    - name: "channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Sales channel through which the account is served."
    - name: "key_account_flag"
      expr: key_account_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating a key strategic account (True/False)."
    - name: "month_created"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the account record was created."
  measures:
    - name: "total_accounts"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of accounts."
    - name: "key_account_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN key_account_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of key strategic accounts."
    - name: "active_account_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of accounts with status 'Active'."
    - name: "avg_days_since_first_order"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(current_date(), first_order_date))
      comment: "Average number of days since the first order for each account."
$$
metric_views.description: High‑level customer account KPIs for executive and operational insight.

LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1

  source: "`food_beverage_ecm`.`customer`.`case`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "case_status"
      expr: case_status
      comment: "Current status of the case (e.g., Open, Closed)."

      expr: channel
      comment: "Channel through which the case originated."
    - name: "month_created"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the case was created."
  measures:
    - name: "case_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of cases logged."
    - name: "total_refunded_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(monetary_amount_refunded AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total monetary amount refunded across cases."
    - name: "total_requested_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(monetary_amount_requested AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "avg_resolution_time_hours"
      expr: AVG((unix_timestamp(closed_timestamp) - unix_timestamp(opened_timestamp))/3600)

$$
metric_views.description: Case management metrics to monitor financial impact and operational efficiency.
